title: Again TB Joshua’s Disciples Gives Bags Of Rice and Million Naira To Widows In Lagos
text:
The disciples of late Senior Prophet TB Joshua have continued his legacy by giving out massively in humility to the poor, less privileged, disabled, widows and down-trodden in the society.



Just last week, it was reported that they gave out 250 Bags of rice and a sum of N1.5 Million to the disabled in Lagos.



Following that trend as Prophet TB Joshua did when he was alive, the disciples stormed Egbeda area of Lagos state today Saturday, 8th of January, 2022 to reach out to nothing less than over 300 widows with 250 bags of rice and cash gift of over N1 Million.



During the presentation, one of the disciples, Evangelist Joseph encouraged the widows not to be despaired because they have lost their spouses but they should look up to Jesus Christ and trust in his goodness



He quoted words from Prophet TB Joshua’s message to the widows titled The Chief Husband Man, while urging the widows to always rely on Jesus because He cares for the weak, the rejected and other vulnerable people.



If I may quote our mentor, Prophet TB Joshua in his message to widows: The Chief Husband Man. He said Jesus Christ is The Chief Husband Man. Jesus cares for the weak, the rejected and other vulnerable people. (Psalm 68:5) He is the Father of the fatherless and Husband to the widows. The fact that you have lost your spouse does not mean you should despair, no! As a Child of God, you only need to trust in His Goodness. (Isaiah 54:5-6) You can look unto Jesus, the Chief Husband Man of the house and gather the broken pieces of the marriage. He knows how to make up for the loss of your loved one because Jesus is the compassionate Healer of our wounds. So let His compassion check your passion today. In Luke 7:11-15 Jesus saw a widow, her only son was dead and she was weeping. Jesus said to her, “Weep not, for I am involved in your affair.” How you manage your situation is what matters.



Whether we die or live, we are permanently  married to Christ; When death strikes, He alone is able to comfort and rehabilitate the surviving member of the union so that he or she can stand up under the circumstances. So what is your situation? Are you in want as a result of your widowhood? Look unto Jesus, He is your Father and a Friend closer than a brother. Cheer up for God in His Sacred Temple, cares for orphans and widows; always prepared to meet their needs.’’



He further noted that caring to the widows, orphans and less privileged has always been part of Prophet TB Joshua, therefore the importance of continuing the legacy



‘’ Caring for the widows, orphans and other less privileged in the society has always been a part of Prophet TB Joshua’s charitable activities. And we his Disciples, with the assistance of our wonderful supporters, have come here today in continuation of his benevolence, with bags of rice and cash gifts for you and your families this new year, 2022.’’



After the presentation, the elated widows were moved to tears as the gifts came to them as a huge surprise.



One of them, Olabisi Olabode revealed that she has been watching the philanthropic act of Prophet TB Joshua on Emmanuel TV but has never been a beneficiary until today. She prayed for the disciples and ask God to keep their families.



‘’I am very happy with what is happening today, I pray TB Joshua continues to rejoice with the angels. I pray his disciples live long. This is the first time I will be witnessing this in our area but I know TB Joshua gives to the widows because I watch it on Emmanuel TV, I pray God continues to protect his family’’



Another widow, Bosede Samuel explained that she used to visit SCOAN to received bags of rice, cash gifts from Prophet TB Joshua and expressed joy that the disciples continued to good works of the man of God. She prayed for them and asked God to continue blessing them.



‘’I love what happened today. When Prophet TB Joshua was alive, we always go to his church to collect rice and money. Whenever we go, they take good care of us, we eat and enjoy ourselves. I’m very happy his disciples continued this legacy and I pray God repays them in many folds.’’



Furthermore, the disciples appreciated the widows for receiving their gifts and promised to continue reaching out to them often.



‘’Please take note: We are not the ones blessing you by what we have to give today, rather you are the ones blessing us by accepting our gifts. Why? Because the Bible says, it is more blessed to give than to receive. More also, the man of God said, giving offers us an opportunity to reshape our destinies. So we thank you our mothers for blessing us, for accepting these gifts. This is just the beginning and we trust God Almighty the great Provider will continue the supply in Jesus name’’

title: AN INSIDIOUS DISGUISE
text:
The art of camouflage has been developed since the depths of antiquity. It has since been used for the purpose of hunting and warfare. People, however, are not the only ones who use camouflage; the devil also uses it for his purposes. He knows that if he appears with a trident and horns against you, you will immediately notice him and call unto Jesus who will deliver you. That is why he prefers to use an “INSIDIOUS DISGUISE” – temptation. Temptation is the presentation of evil; it is an opportunity to choose temporary pleasure rather than permanent gain. Using the deceptive tactic of temptation he penetrates subcutaneously, bypassing people’s defence system, which is the Word of God and prayer.



To avoid falling victim to this strategy of the enemy, we must put into practice the words of Jesus: “𝐖𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐲 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐟𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 […]” (𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟔:𝟒𝟏). We watch and pray when we engage our hearts with the Word of God. So, engage your heart with the Word of God you have read attentively, slowly and repeatedly and it will begin to influence your conduct and character, equipping you against the temptations and the tactics of the devil.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Holy Father, as I study Your Word and keep it in my mind, I ask for Your grace so that my spirit may always be watchful to avoid falling into temptations – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#EvilInDisguise #WatchAndPray

title: DO YOU LOVE ME?
text:
If we are to be responsible to Christ, it will be because of our love for Him. It is only through love that we can respond to God and our fellow men. Prophet T.B. Joshua says that anyone who does not love or anyone who does not forgive cannot be entrusted with the power to heal, bless and deliver; he will use it to hurt himself and others. Faith, when it is practised genuinely, works by love. 



In John 21: 15- 17, Jesus Christ asked Peter one of the most penetrating and most dangerous questions, “Do you love me?” In other words, do you have a relationship with me? The basic qualification for a lasting relationship was found in this question, “Do you love me?” 



A relationship cannot exist without love; love looks around to see those in need. Nothing will keep us on course than a deep love for the Lord. This new year, let us show love to one another by giving what our lives depend on, not those things we do not need. There is no love that does not express itself in giving.



Say this prayer with me: 1)  Lord Jesus Christ, give me love enough to overlook the mistake of others.2) Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to give people another chance.3) Jesus, give me love enough until it overflows to others, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen!

title: LAST-MINUTE FAITH
text:
It is common for people today to live a spiritually-distant life, cut off from God and the things of faith. Surprisingly, however, when something painful happens to them, very often they suddenly turn to God and request for the support that only a close relationship with Him can guarantee. They start attending church regularly, they read spiritual books, and pray fervently, in the hope of attracting the attention of Jesus Christ in their affairs. The big question, though, is: Can this last-minute faith save us? Can this kind of faith work?



𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟓:𝟏𝟎-𝟏𝟐 “[…] 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐦 𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐯𝐢𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐰𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐝𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐭. 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐭. 𝐋𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞. ‘𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝,’ 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐮𝐬!’ 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐝, ‘𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐥𝐲 𝐈 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐈 𝐝𝐨𝐧’𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐲𝐨𝐮.’”



In this biblical passage, we get to see what happened to those virgins who wanted to save the day at the last minute; unfortunately, the situation could not be saved! The Bible makes us understand that faith is not a panic button pushed only when in trouble; it is a lifestyle of trusting God, in both good and hard times. Let us, therefore, take the decision to stop being last-minute believers, and rather establish a lasting relationship with Jesus Christ, because this is the only guaranteed way to have God involved in our lives.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Lord Jesus Christ, forgive me for my instability in my relationship with You. Help me to keep my decision and follow You without ‘breaks’! In Your mighty name I pray, amen!”#LastMinuteFaith #PanicButton

title: GOD IS NEVER LATE!
text:
“In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.” – Proverbs 16:9



Do you know that you have been given the time and space to act in only as allotted to you by God? If you did, then you would see Him as the Owner of your time. You would understand that He is busy designing and arranging events that will continue to unfold until His purpose is revealed in your life. You would trust in His divine will and see that despite how difficult it seems at times, His timing is perfect; He is never late.



It was at the point of fire that God rescued Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego (Daniel 3).It was at the point of total surrender that God provided Abraham with the lamb for slaughter (Genesis 22).It was at the point of giving up that Jesus turned Peter’s wasted hours into success hours (Luke 5).



If you examine the journey of your life, you will recognise the truth that God is never late. Have you ever felt as if you were falling and just before hitting the ground, God caught you and lifted you up? You are not the only one! God wants us to exhaust all our worldly advantages, our human wisdom, our self-confidence and come to the end of ourselves so we would value Him and His purpose would be revealed in our lives for His glory.What are you experiencing in your life right now? Are you tempted to feel impatient and anxious, worried or doubtful? Remember, you cannot separate God from His will, His promises and His time. Decide today to relax in the precious arms of the Holy Spirit and trust that as a true believer, your time belongs to God.  Your duty is to obey God’s Word; His duty is to fulfil His promises in your life and truly, He is never, ever late.



PRAYER – Ask God to give you an obedient heart, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ! #GodsHeartTV #BrotherChris #Devotional

title: MAKE THINGS HAPPEN
text:
Do you remember a time when you could do anything you put your mind to? A time when life was full of possibilities? And to your dismay, you now come to realise that the life you live seems far less extraordinary than the one you had dreamt of. The difference between the life we dream and the life we have is US! 



Most of the times we bring up countless excuses to explain why we could not make it in life. We make up reasons to excuse our backing away from our God-confirmed dreams. The truth, though, is that no mortal man or devil can supersede the plan of God for our lives! There is only one person who can get us out of the will of God, and that is ourselves!



We are the ones to change our direction so easily or the ones who do not put our best effort in what we do; and the reason is that we do not really believe in what we are up to. When you really believe in your vision and goal, there is no alternative! In 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟏:𝟒𝟎 Jesus said it clearly: “𝐃𝐢𝐝 𝐈 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝?”.It is time to take that dream back and fight for it, because the promise of God is there for those who are determined to make it happen! 



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, remind me of my God-given dream for my life; help me to find out what I am created for. Remove all the fears that keep me from stepping into my future; help me to listen to Your promises and Your encouragement rather than people’s opinions. Give me the power to resist laziness; awaken me so that I may see clearly where my future is. Father, forgive me for giving up on life! Inspire me one more time so that I may be one of those who make things happen! In Your holy name I pray, amen!”#MakeThingsHappen #DreamAgain

title: STAY IN FAITH
text:
Faith is the evidence of things not seen. After a farmer has planted his seed, he believes it is growing before he sees it grow. This is faith which is, ‘the evidence of things not seen’ (Hebrews 11:1). In Christ, we have a perfect evidence for faith. Any man or woman can get rid of their doubts by looking steadfastly and only at the evidence which God has for our faith. Seeing only what God says will produce and increase our faith. Oh what a means of blessing is the look of faith to Christ! There is life, light, liberty, love, joy, guidance, wisdom, perfect health – in fact, everything. 



Real faith is based upon the Word of God. Real faith says, “If God’s Word says it is true, it is”; whereas faith by feelings says, ‘Unless I see, I cannot believe; unless I touch, I cannot believe’ (John 20:25). Believing God is to believe His Word. Remember, if you believe in Him, you can say what He has said and do what He has done. Jesus said to His disciples, ‘As the Father has sent me, so send I you’ (John 17:18).



Prayer Points:• Ask Jesus to give you the grace to keep the Words of the Holy Spirit in your mind, in your mouth and in every conversation.• Lord, give me the grace to make Your Word the standard for my life. Give me the grace to prove the Words of God, to teach them, to live by them and to make them work.• Lord Jesus, open my heart. • Open my heart to faith• Open my heart to Your Spirit• Open my heart to Your Words• Make my heart a dwelling place. In Jesus’ name

title: JESUS’ FOCUS
text:
Proverbs 16:2 “All a man’s ways seem innocent to him, but motives are weighed by the Lord.”



Most of us live our lives so focused on how we are doing, how we are feeling and how we are treated but do we ever take time to stop and consider what Jesus’ focus is?



We know God by the Word He speaks and His Word represents His heart’s desire. A look at God’s words will not take you long to realise that what He is looking at is most often not what we are looking at!



➡️In a shepherd boy, he saw a king (1 Samuel 16:7)➡️In a convicted criminal, he saw a heart to change (Luke 23:43)➡️In a few pennies of the widow’s mite, he saw a true act of worship (Mark 12:41)



That is because Jesus’ focus is the motive behind what we do – that is why He tests our hearts to reward us. So don’t be too quick to rejoice, to condemn, to criticise the actions of others because Jesus is interested in the motivation of our heart. It is time to examine your own motives. Why do you do what you do? Do you talk to be seen, walk to be noticed, give to be praised? 



PRAYER: Ask God to give you a heart that is pure, a heart that does not bear grudges, a heart that is simple and sincere, not a rebellious heart – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ!

title: TUNE IN TO HIS VOICE
text:
“𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐰, 𝐭𝐡𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐎 𝐉𝐚𝐜𝐨𝐛, 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐇𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐎 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥: “𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐧𝐨𝐭, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐞𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐛𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞; 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐞!” – 𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟑:𝟏



What a privilege! The Creator of the universe calls us His own, He knows our name and encourages us to not be afraid.



How do these words reflect in your own life? Have you put your trust in your Creator, or do you still fight your fears alone? Do you belong to God or are you captive of the sinful desires of this world? 



When you belong to God then you become a stranger to this world and there is a barrier between you and its sinful desires. This barrier is not a physical one but an inner voice in your heart that directs and guides you; it is the voice of your consciousness! At any given moment in life the voice of your consciousness speaks to you, offers you the solution, motivates you to approach God. Do you hear this voice?



If the voice of your conscience sounds like a distant whisper, draw nearer to God and stand in faith to His commandments, because when you stay in faith in Christ Jesus, that is when you can hear God’s voice most clearly! Make yourself familiar with His voice and learn how to allow it to guide you on a daily basis. Its guidance in your conscience teaches you how to talk like Jesus would, how to act like Jesus would; how to think as He would; because you are not your own, but God’s! Tune in to His voice and live in harmony with your Creator! 



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord God, talk to me and direct my decision-making process! Inspire me, fill me with passion for progress and the burning fire for change that Your voice sets ablaze in the hearts of people. In the Holy name of my Lord, Jesus, I pray. Amen!”#HearHisVoice #GodInspired

title: BE A TOMORROW THINKER!
text:
Did you know that it is by looking forward that you discover new things, new horizons and new opportunities you would not have ordinarily dreamed of? Exactly!



Life is beautiful when you learn to look forward!  And Jesus Christ is a bright example in regards to that because He is a tomorrow thinker! This means that He is never oriented to the past but to one’s future. And this is made clear by the way He lived His earthly life, of which we read about in the Word of God.



Remember the day our Lord met the woman caught in the act of adultery? He said to her, “‘𝐖𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧, 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲? 𝐇𝐚𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮?’ ‘𝐍𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞, 𝐬𝐢𝐫,’ 𝐬𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝. ‘𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐧𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐨 𝐈 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮,’ 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐝. ‘𝐆𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐬𝐢𝐧.’” (𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟖:𝟏𝟎-𝟏𝟏)



As He said to this woman, so He says to you; Jesus is carrying today the same message that says, “Your past is over!”. He doesn’t care about your past because He sent out His Word to cleanse you and now you are clean because of that Word! However, for you to see and live life through His eyes that see the future’s potential, you need to stop looking back -at your past- because it is a trap of satan.



The past is the only connection to your enemy, the devil, because it is the only information he has about you. On the contrary, God is oriented to your future, to what you are going to become; He looks to the ‘you’ of your dreams and encourages you to look ahead as well, because discovery is for forward lookers and for them the best is always yet to come!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, empower me to disconnect myself from my unworthy past and to look to what lies ahead, in order to discover the new horizons You promise in Your Word! In Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#LookForward #DiscoverYourself

title: THE WORD OF GOD IN OUR HEART
text:
Christianity today seems to be of human wisdom. There seems to be no difference between Christianity and religion. However, the Bible makes us understand that Christianity is not a religion but a relationship. Jesus came to restore the relationship and fellowship between God and man.



Christianity lies in the heart. It is all about the Word of God in our heart but today Christianity has become the Word of God in our mouth. People simply declare, “I am a Christian,” but the question is, “Are you such in heart?” The fact that you carry a Bible and a big cross does not necessarily mean you are a Christian. Are you a Christian in heart? It is not enough to profess Christianity but we must run the race well by living up to that profession. 



The Bible says in Matthew 15:8, “These people honour me with their lips but their heart is far from me.” Anyone can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but not everyone can confess Jesus is the Lord with all their heart. That is why satan keeps dislodging and displacing many, because they are not where God wants them to be. Your heart should be where God wants it to be.



In 1 Chronicles 28:9, the Bible says the Lord searches the heart and knows the thoughts of man. As Christians we will face challenges; when they come, we should consider them pure. Today, many see their trials as sorrowful moments because they only profess Christianity with their mouth but not in the heart. If you are truly a Christian, your challenges are to strengthen your desire and determination for God. Your challenges are to improve you, not to impair you. No one can say Jesus is Lord without the Word of God in their heart. You need the Word of God in your heart to contact Jesus.



In this season make sure you work on your spiritual life. Make sure your heart is at its best for God, because the Spirit of the Father expresses Himself through our heart. Your heart cannot be at its best for God without your being spiritual. Henceforth, let God’s Word be the foundation of all that you do, because Christ and His Word are one.Ask Jesus Christ to come and make His home in you. Amen!#relationshipgoals #instagram #instagram #tbjoshua

title: STOP MAKING IT EASY FOR THE DEVIL!
text:
Ephesians 6:11 – “Put on the full armour of God, so that you can take your stand against the devil’s schemes.”



The devil is a wily foe! And there is not enough physical or mental strength to contend with his cunning tricks. It takes the spiritual strength of one grounded in the Living Word to identify his tricks for what they are. Irrespective of the method he uses, the devil’s aim is clear – to break your communion with God and cut off your dependence upon Him. One of his most common traps – which most of us encounter on an almost daily basis – is offence. The major challenge is that when we get offended, we hardly realise how trapped we are! 



But remember – no one knows you better than you know yourself. If you discover the peace of heart and internal joy Christ promised His followers has started seeping out of your daily life and decisions, take time to examine yourself. Are you harbouring offence in your heart? Is your spirit free? People of God, stop making it easy for the devil! Be encouraged by this powerful quotable quote from Prophet TB Joshua – “You will receive in a moment what you have been seeking for years when you let go of offence!”



PRAYER: My heart is the prayer room. LORD, speak to my heart; let me hear Your voice! Help me to let go of offence that I may be sensitive to the leading of Your Spirit – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ!#Devotional #BrotherChris #GodsHeartTV #GodsWord #Encouragement #AllAboutJesus

title: Prophet TB Joshua: Loaned From HEAVEN!!
text:
How was Prophet TB Joshua able to stand so strong in the midst of such intense persecution and attack? What was the secret of his strength? Corresponding grace from Heaven! 



Be blessed by these spontaneous moments of Heavenly wisdom from Prophet TB Joshua as he ministered personal prophecy to congregants at The Synagogue, Church Of All Nations (SCOAN) in Lagos, Nigeria.



‘The Legacy Lives On’ is a new program on God’s Heart TV with Brother Chris dedicated to sharing words of wisdom and lessons of life from God’s servant, Prophet TB Joshua.

title: FREE FROM FEAR!
text:
“I cannot escape to the mountains, lest some evil overtake me and I die.” (Genesis 19:19)



When God was about to destroy Sodom and Gomorrah, Lot did not obey His instruction to flee to the mountains because of fear. He argued with God and rationalised that he would be much safer going to a small town nearby called Zoar. God agreed to his request, but then a few verses later we read that Lot left Zoar and ended up living in the mountains after all because “he was afraid to dwell in Zoar”(verse 30).



What is the lesson here? Even though Lot went to different locations, he took his fear with him. This means Lot’s problem was not on the outside (his location) but on the inside (his fear). Fear comes from focusing on your present situation rather than on God – and it leads to wrong decisions! Human logic is one of fear’s favourite tools, so beware of rationalising God’s instruction to sidestep what He is asking you to do. When your flesh responds with fear, don’t be too quick to jump into a decision. Take time to pause and listen to the prompting of the Holy Spirit in your heart! Remember – we have a Friend, the Holy Spirit, who is able to overcome that monster called fear in our lives!



PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, replace the fear within me with a strong faith, and replace the anxiety within me with a quiet confidence, in Jesus’ name!#Devotional

title: IF JESUS SAYS YES, WHY DO YOU SAY NO?
text:
The beginning of the end for our Christian faith is when we start doubting God’s promises for our life. Let us talk about one of His promises – VICTORY. What does victory mean to you? How many victories have you got during your walk with the Lord? 



One of the biggest victories that the believer might achieve in his life is keeping the right attitude and focus during both bad and good times. Keeping that sense of victory in the heart, when everything around does not make any sense, is the hardest and the biggest achievement! Keeping a positive faith and believing what Jesus said in 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟏𝟑, “𝐈 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐨 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐦𝐞!”, makes us different from others. But sadly, most of the times that is not the case: we cry, as unbelievers cry; we give up as others give up. The difference is except that we put the blame on the devil. 



Instead of blaming satan for our failure, it is time that we start taking responsibility for our negative attitude, which has become the real obstacle to our progress, and start believing in what God has said, “We can do all things!”. Because victory in Christ Jesus is not for those who quit but for those who endure! Believing in God’s promises is not about our feelings, but about a choice of focus and attitude. Make the right one and you will see how soon you will be living in the fulfilment of His promises, for they all are “YES” and “AMEN”!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, clean my dirty mind with the precious blood of Jesus, burn all the negative and contrary thoughts with Your fire. Lord, remind me of the promise of victory, when I feel that I am failing; teach me to be still as You were during Your challenges. Fill my heart with hope and help me to live the rest of my life making a difference. In Your mighty name I pray, amen!”#RightAttitude #PositiveFaith

title: Evelyn Joshua Get 63 Year Old Victoria A House
text:
A 63-Year-Old Woman, Mrs Victoria Adebayo came to The SCOAN with her Family to share a testimony of the goodness of God in her life and thank Mummy Evelyn Joshua who gifted her a new House.



Mrs Victoria began her testimony by telling the church that when she had come to The SCOAN many years ago with numerous problems and issues, she was accepted wholeheartedly by Prophet T.B. Joshua. 



As the years passed, she had continued to enjoy the mentorship of Prophet T.B. Joshua. As such, when the man of God transited to glory, Victoria said she had cried: “It is finished for me!” A while afterwards, Victoria decided she wanted to return to her village.









She then approached woman of God Pastor Evelyn Joshua and told her. Moved with compassion, the woman of God promised to go with Victoria to the village. Thinking it was an impossibility, Victoria marvelled at the unexpected offer. To cut a long story short, the woman of God said she would be sending people with Victoria to the village to do one thing: build her a house! 



Only a few months later, the house is now standing in decent glory on a plot of land in Iyin-Ekiti State, Nigeria. 



Amazed at this incredible gesture, Victoria thought it necessary to testify to the world about the blessing she has received. 



Victoria’s younger sister, who accompanied her to testify today, also recalled how a touch from Prophet T.B. Joshua about five years ago had ended her 17 years of barrenness. 



“Nothing is impossible for God; let’s have faith in him,” said Victoria’s in-law, Wahab. “Focus on God,” declared Victoria.

title: PURE IN HEART
text:
Christianity is the largest religion in the world with more than 2.3 billion believers – about a third of humanity. However, the number of Christians across the earth does not accurately reflect the multitude of those who truly resemble Jesus Christ with their lifestyle. This is because true Christianity is essentially more than a confession of faith; it is a way of life characterised by sanctification and purity of heart, as our Lord Jesus Christ emphasises in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟓:𝟖 – “𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝”.



True Christianity lies in the heart, in the purity of the heart. Any outward form of piety and worship, without a thorough reformation of heart and life, is a dangerous delusion! It gives us a place among religious people, but it does not make us genuine Christians in the eyes of God.



Remember, our heart is the spiritual temple of our Lord, in which perpetual praise is offered to Him! If we want to be genuine children of God, we must keep His temple within us clean. And our heart can only be clean when it is ruled by His living Word!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, sanctify and cleanse my heart of all things that are not in accordance with Your Word, that I may worship You in spirit and in truth as a genuine follower of Yours – in Your Holy Name I pray, amen!”#PureInHeart #TrueChristianity

title: SPEAK WHAT YOU BELIEVE!
text:
Matthew 7:28-29 – “When Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were amazed at his teaching, because he taught as one who had authority, and not as their teachers of the law.”



Something was different about Jesus and the way He taught. It was not merely His impressive choice of words or style of delivery; He actually believed what He was saying! When He summarised the Law and Prophets, He didn’t talk about details or disputes; He talked about love and doing unto others as you would have them do to you (Matthew 7:12). He approached the Scriptures in a different way from the Teachers of the law. With the help of the Holy Spirit, He went straight to the heart of the matter! Jesus never strived to look good; He simply was good! He never laboured to appear truthful; He simply spoke the truth! 



For example, when Prophet TB Joshua was dealing with family reconciliation cases in the church, he cut through the complex disputes by being able to focus on the real heart issues – under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit. This was not a technique but an overflow of his intimate relationship with God. His words were impacted by the Holy Spirit because he actually believed them and lived them. Remember, we can only tap the blessings of God when our heart and mouth both get in accord with the Word of God. Therefore, speak what you believe – and let the Holy Spirit use your words! 



PRAYER: Ask God to give you the special grace for your mouth and your heart to be in accord with the Holy Spirit – the grace to speak with your mouth what you believe in your heart, in Jesus’ name!#Devotional

title: BEWARE OF SPIRITUAL PRIDE
text:
The only way to keep the world and its valued things (fame, popularity, pride, offenses, etc.) from living in our heart is by regularly taking the Word of God into our heart and making it part of us (Psalm 119: 11). Prophet T. B. Joshua says, “Obeying God’s Word at the beginning seems hard, until we come to realise that all He is asking for is our good, to make life free and full.” 



Remember our obedience to God’s Word is the only proof of our faith in Him. Believers must read the Word of God with devotion because it has healing power, purifying power; it keeps us from error and sin and it has enduring power (John 17:17). Read it!



The Word is not written pages but on the lips of the believer. We children of God must think of God’s Word, speak God’s Word and act God’s Word because our lives depend on knowing it. It is not committing the Word to memory that is valuable but letting that Word become an integral part of us.  Ask the Holy Spirit to give you the grace to read the Word of God as if your life depends on it. Amen!

title: ACTRESS BATTLE SPIRITUAL HUSBAND
text:
Amaka’s Light Begins To Shine As Spirit Husband Is Banished Forever.



“Growing up I didn’t know I had a spiritual problem,” began Amaka today when she spoke about her deliverance from a household idol to which her grandmother had dedicated her while in the womb.



Testifying about how the idol had troubled her life, she gave various instances of the setbacks and disappointments that she kept experiencing at the edge of breakthrough. 



Miss Amaka



“I became comfortable with failure,” she said. She also said that the spirit in her had made her resentful of marriage. In seeking a solution to her problems, she visited a witch doctor who gave her a soap to bathe with and other things to use.



Instead of a better life, however, things worsened for the young woman and she became unable to sleep. Given the pattern of constant disappointment in her life, Amaka lost faith in divine favour, believing that only hard work could deliver her. 



Moreover, she became vain and thought that she needed to enhance her looks via plastic surgery in order to make it in her acting career. She said that her deliverance had in fact started on December 12, 2021, when she was first ministered with the New Anointing Water. She said that when she had got home later that night, she had had a dream in which she saw dead, bloody pythons hanging on stakes. 



The deliverance became perfect last Sunday, when she again received ministration of the New Anointing Water and the evil spirit in her vanished forever. 







Later in the week, she visited The SCOAN Prayer Mountain for meditation. Surprisingly, she was unable to pray as she suddenly became lethargic. 



Later, however, an usher advised her not to give in to the devil and she picked up herself after regaining strength from within. Since then, she has received offers for acting shoots. “Throughout yesterday I was at a shoot,” she revealed. She advised people to make themselves available for the Spirit of God.

title: THE CENTRAL CHARACTER
text:
Isaiah 43:7 – “Everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory, whom I formed and made.”



The Bible tells us that we are created for the glory of God. He is the Divine Designer, the Master Planner, the Unseen Hand that controls the affairs of men. Therefore, as a Christian, whatever situation you are facing is actually unto the glory of God – no matter how unpleasant or unsettling it seems. However, it’s often difficult to appreciate this when you are in the midst of life’s troubles and trials! It takes proper reflection in the light of God’s Word to recognise this life-changing reality – that you are not the central character in the story; God is!  



Focusing on Him will put whatever you are facing in its proper perspective. Because if you know that your situation is unto the glory of God, this understanding would impart strength to endure and joy to conquer! It is unfortunate to witness so many people murmur, worry, complain daily – because their lives are centred on how they are doing, how they are feeling and how they are treated. It’s not about you; it’s all about Jesus – He is the Central Character.



PRAYER – Ask God to strengthen your desire and determination to serve Him, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ!

title: THE MISSING FACTOR TO SUCCESS
text:
Most people believe that with hard work they can achieve any desired result; they take for granted that with great effort victory can be secured or that extensive thought will eventually always bring forth a solution. However, in so many cases things just don’t develop as expected. Then one comes to realise that there must be a missing factor; the one that contributes to creating success besides the obvious and well established one (which is hard work)!



What is the factor that can even challenge the most fundamentals of life’s principles? In Ecclesiastes 9:11 we read: “I have seen something else under the sun: The race is not to the swift or the battle to the strong, nor does food come to the wise or wealth to the brilliant or favor to the learned; but time and chance happen to them all”. Through the wisdom of the Ecclesiastes, the Creator of life teaches us that there is a determining factor which ultimately controls the manifestation of the blessing, the solution or the victory we seek; it is a factor that overwrites all others, and it is none other than living in harmony with the One who created life and who can be found in every aspect of it; God.



But then how could we live in harmony with something that is in the spiritual world? Well, only by walking in the spirit! This brings us to a profound conclusion: for you to enjoy the proceeds of victory, you must be spiritually inclined!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to become more spiritually inclined as I meditate and apply Your words that give eternal life. In Your mighty name I pray, amen!”#TheMissingFactor #Success

title: THE CHRISTIAN’S WEAPONS OF WARFARE
text:
As a Christian are you armed for battle? When the enemy attacks you with hatred, intimidation or campaign of calumny, what is your first line of defence?



It is rather common that the person we see through the scope when we point our firearms toward the enemy is our fellow brother! And, as alarming this is, it attests to the fact that we are not really armed for battle!



The Bible teaches that life is a battlefield and the sooner we understand this, the wiser we will be. Yet, it goes on to clarify the nature of the war and in 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟑-𝟒 it clearly states that as Christians “𝐰𝐞 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐫 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 […]”. In other words, the Bible condemns the use of the war tactics of the world, which may be epitomised by a single popular phrase: an eye for an eye. The Lord Jesus rather teaches us that in order not to end up like the masses out there who are merely wandering and unsure of their goals and dreams, we should let others hate us, persecute us, call us names, judge us and not the other way around!



If we are really armed for battle, we will not fight against people, we will not strive against people. If we are strong spiritually, our love becomes protection against the hatred of the adversary! If we are strong spiritually, our faithfulness becomes protection against the unfaithfulness of the adversary!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I am weak and prone to misbehave in the face of attack because I am not armed for battle! Arm me with Your Spirit and character that I may fight back not with carnal weapons that destroy, but with the tested weapons of the Spirit that secure my heart and bring life that conquers the death that satan wants to put in place! In Your mighty name I pray, Lord, amen!”#ArmedForBattle #HeavenlyArmour

title: HONOUR GOD WITH YOUR GIFT
text:
Whatever we give for the relief of the poor and in support of God’s worship is to God. Remember that it is praiseworthy to give not only to our power but beyond our power. Most of us see what we have to give to others as helping them, thereby we magnify ourselves above those we are giving to. We have forgotten that all we are doing is giving back to God, what He has given to us from His generous hands.



The question we need to ask ourselves now is, what is our gift? How are we using it to serve humanity for the glory of God? Prophet T.B Joshua says, “we might not be equally gifted, but God has done it in such a way that each one of us has something to contribute.”



Mark 12: 41- 44 says that our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ honoured the poor widow’s giving attitude because it reflected the disposition of her heart. So great was her love for God that even out of her poverty and lack, she still found a way to give. Your gift could be your money, time, love, strength, or smile – that is what God will use to bless others through you. Remember we serve and honour God when we help our fellow men. The question we need to ask ourselves now is, how many people have we helped today? It is not our huge gifts that impress Jesus Christ but the quality and level of our sacrifice, as demonstrated by that widow. 



Let’s pray: 1)  Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to give what my life depends on, and not what I don’t need.2) Ask Jesus Christ to give you His eyes to see those who need what you have to give for the salvation of their souls.

title: GOD’S GLORY AT THE FOREFRONT!
text:
Colossians 1:28-29 – “He is the one we proclaim, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom, so that we may present everyone fully mature in Christ. To this end I strenuously contend with all the energy Christ so powerfully works in me.”



Apostle Paul was supernaturally strengthened to carry out his mission for Christ as ‘strenuously contended’ for God’s purpose – keeping God’s glory at the forefront of his motives. Truly, the highest motive in serving God is the desire to please Him and love for Jesus Christ is the only motive that will stand the test of time. The journey of life comes with both good and hard times – and no one depending solely on natural strength or human gifts can stand in the face of this unless he is strengthened from above. 



One may show great zeal for God out of mere conviction – but when the thorns, heat and vicissitudes of life come, the unstable zeal will soon be choked. It takes supernatural strength to steady our hearts in the face of life’s ups and downs – to not get overwhelmed by man’s praise or overtaken by man’s persecution. Our relationship with God must be the principle from which we act and the end at which we aim. In other words, keep Jesus at the centre of your life!  Yes, challenges will come, but there will be strength to see you through. Yes, temptation will come, there will be grace to overcome. There will be supernatural endowment to achieve your God-given assignment – for His glory! 



PRAYER: Whatever barrier that stands between your heart and the Holy Spirit – command it to be removed, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ!#Devotional

title: LIVE IN THE LIGHT!
text:
“𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐥𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐬𝐥𝐞𝐞𝐩; 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐮𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐰𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐝. 𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐝𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭” – 𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟏𝟏-𝟏𝟐



Are you tired of walking down a bleak road where fear, anger, envy, jealousy, greed, lust and darkness are the order of the day? When the light of faith and hope has been extinguished, life becomes a tedious road. God’s Word, however, teaches us that as children of God, we were not called to become accustomed to darkness, but to shine as light! Remember, God has put His Word in our hearts and that Word is a lamp to our feet and a light to our path. Indeed, “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐥 𝐢𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐚 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐝𝐚𝐲, according to 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟒:𝟏𝟖.



How can this bright light dwell in us? The Word of God is the light; as we contemplate the thoughts of God then our hearts are filled with the light that eradicates all darkness because to the extent you think the thoughts of Christ, to that same extent do you have the presence of God in your life. The extent to which you reject His light, to that extent will you be filled with terrifying darkness.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I come from darkness, yet seeking Your light. Open my heart to receive Your Word at the center of my heart and flood me with the light that frees and saves – in Your Holy Name I pray, amen!”#LightOfChrist #ShineBright

title: ONE WITH A DIFFERENCE
text:
We live in a time when the most common excuse we humans offer when we become the object of criticism is: “But this is what everyone does!”. We many times mention the majority’s behaviour in our attempt to justify our mediocre results!



The question, however, is this: Would you like to end up like the masses out there, who are merely wandering and unsure of the future, without a real sense of direction? Remember that the Bible parabolically emphasises in the Gospel of 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟕:𝟏𝟑 that “𝐰𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐢𝐭”. Without a doubt, the majority of people are not successful – few are those who have direction and goals, and who, therefore, consciously choose to give their best in the pursuit of progress. They are the ones who are distinguished for their achievements!



Jesus Christ calls us to defy the norm of the majority and to fight for distinction, for personal change and for success. After all, the Lord’s exhortation to enter the narrow gate emphasises that as God’s children, we should not do what many do but what the best do! The Lord today calls us to give our best and in this way leave our imprint in a positive way in the lives of others and in society at large, for the glory of His name!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, strengthen my determination to do what the best do; empower me so that I am not carried away by the influence of the majority. In Your mighty name I pray, amen!”#BeTheBest #NarrowGate

title: PUT YOUR WORRIES IN HIS HANDS
text:
The Bible says in Romans 8:1-2, “There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit. For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.”



Worry is one of the problems we are facing today. Sometimes it is obvious: You are worried about your family, you are worried about your career, you are worried about your health. At other times, worry is a little trickier to identify: You are anxious about the future or you are unable to control a situation. Today our list of worries is endless. Worry has not only physical consequences but also spiritual ones. Worry interferes with God’s Spirit in our lives. Despite all these worries, God’s love for us remains unfailing. 



Look at great heroes in the Bible such as David and Peter who had their fair shares of worry over failure but whose situations God used to bring them to a place of honour. Your challenge today is not a crisis; it is a friend! A man can be poor in spirit and yet be a friend of Jesus Christ, a man can be sick in body and yet be a candidate of heaven. Hence, when we are tempted to worry about our situation, we should remember that God’s love for us never fails. Your current situation is a mere stopping interval, a preparation for the future God has planned for you. 



Take your worries to the Lord in prayer. Putting your future—all your worries in His hands—is the mark of a true Christian. When you turn your worries into prayer and hand over your heavy load to Him, then the peace of the Lord which transcends all understanding will guide your life (Philippians 4: 6-7). Ask God to turn your worries into success and guide you to stay focused on your divine purpose.

title: Congratulations to Racine and Ruth
text:
CONGRATULATIONS!!! To our dear brother and sister – Racine and Ruth – congratulations on your Divine union! 



As our mentor Prophet TB Joshua taught us, the bedrock of lasting marriage is the joyful recognition that you belong together in God – to fulfil mutual destiny in Christ! What more can we say but ‘Thank You, Jesus Christ!’ 



Please see Racine and Ruth’s official wedding website for further pictures –



https://www.racineandruth.org/live-stream 



Glory be to God!

title: DON’T BE MISLED BY YOUR SITUATION!
text:
There is something far more important than your situation. Beyond your situation lies God’s purpose for your life! So, if the situation you are in now does not guarantee your future, do not despair; the end has not come, the best is yet to come! And this is a fact because “[…] 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐭𝐨𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐇𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐞” (𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟖:𝟐𝟖).



So never fall victim to satan’s propaganda! Do not allow him to make you doubt the goodness of your Heavenly Father and His plan for your life. When you are facing the uncertainties of life, do not think that God has abandoned you but look first to the Cross, where the price was paid for the wisdom and knowledge you need to handle such a situation!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, strengthen me that I may not be misled by the uncomfortable situation I am currently faced with, but that I may remain focused on Your will and Your plan in the midst of it, in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen!”#BeyondYourSituation #FocusOnTheCross

title: FORGIVENESS IS TO YOUR BENEFIT
text:
Ready for some real talk? Know for a fact that the person most hurt by unforgiveness is you! This is because when pain, offence and bitterness abide in your heart, it hinders your communion with God!



A heart that is free and occupied by God is a necessary condition in order for one to benefit from their rights and great privileges in Christ. The Word of God points this out in the Gospel of 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟓:𝟕 – “𝐈𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐌𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐌𝐲 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐬𝐤 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐫𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐭 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮”.



If you do realise that you don’t abide in Him and it is not His words that abide in you but rather negative emotions and pain, you can take matters in your hands and challenge the current state of things! It is up to you to stop allowing negative emotions to abide in you and occupy your heart! It is up to you to protect yourself and your blessings! And you can do that by forgiving!



When you forgive and let go of offence, something will happen to you that cannot be explained by the natural mind! You will once again begin to enjoy your rights and privileges in Christ Jesus, because it is God who will abide in your heart!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, teach me how to forgive and prevent satan from littering my heart with his products; hatred, pain, hopelessness and disappointment. In the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#LetGoOfOffence #Forgive

title: RELEASE YOURSELF!
text:
It is impossible to establish a healthy relationship with a person who has left another relationship bitter and offended. The way we leave a relationship is the same way we will enter the next one. The unforgiveness you owe from your former relationship will hinder your future. Offence is very common and it is an epidemic; we have almost come to believe it is a way of life. It is impossible to live this life without offence. Remember, offence can come in any way. Whether you are right or wrong, you don’t have any right to hold an offence.



Expectations of a certain behaviour from our loved ones, relatives and acquaintances set us up for offence. We are often disappointed and offended when our expectations are not met. Your response to an offence determines your future. 



Our Lord Jesus Christ said on the Cross: “Father, forgive them.” Those needing to be mindful of their future include both the offender and the offended. Offence is an effective instrument used by satan to trap us and make us one of his own. 



In John 20: 23, the Bible says: “If you forgive the sin of anyone, they are forgiven, and if you retain the sin of anyone, they are retained.” As Christians, we must know that relationship originates from God and overflows to the people. Our relationship with friends and relatives must remain an integral part of God’s original relationship. Physical growth is a function of time, intellectual growth is a function of learning but spiritual growth is a function of obedience—obedience to God. People of God, we have been held hostage by unforgiveness and bitterness. Until we release ourselves from such bondage, healing, deliverance and blessings cannot locate us. 



How do we release ourselves from this self-imprisonment? It is by letting go of offence. Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me love enough to overlook the mistakes of others. Amen!”

title: LEAVE JUDGEMENT FOR GOD!
text:
Matthew 7:1-3 – “Do not judge, or you too will be judged. For in the same way you judge others, you will be judged, and with the measure you use, it will be measured to you. Why do you look at the speck of sawdust in your brother’s eye and pay no attention to the plank in your own eye?”



It is common today to see people quickly pass judgment on others when they see them take certain actions – yet also justify themselves if a situation arises in which they take those very same actions. Why? Often, you judge yourself according to your intentions, but judge others according to their actions – or rather your own interpretation of their actions. 



As a result, we are often inclined to be more lenient on ourselves and more critical of others – because we don’t make the same instinctive allowance for weaknesses in others as we do for ourselves. The simple answer given by Jesus Christ was not to judge others at all but to leave judgement for God. As Prophet TB Joshua said, “If we judge others now, who will judge us on the Last Day?” Take time to reflect on this and prioritise taking care of your own heart in the light of God’s Word. 



PRAYER: Oh LORD, draw me to a closer relationship with You – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ! #Devotional

title: INTERPRETING SILENCE
text:
Has it ever happened to you that you did not answer a question posed to you right away? If so, did that delay of yours to reply always meant “No”? Certainly not, because the reasons for a delayed response may be various and actually even of great importance. The same applies to our communication with God!



The fact that we have asked Him many questions for which we have not yet received an answer, that is, the fact that He remains silent in some of our questions does not necessarily mean that the answer is “No”. In 𝟐 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟑:𝟗 this is made quite clear: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐢𝐧 𝐤𝐞𝐞𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐞, 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬. 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮 […]”.



We understand, thus, that the fact that many of our prayers have not been answered yet does not necessarily mean that the Lord denies to grant us our requests. Consequently, if an answer is not given to the first prayer, nor to the second, we must hold on and hold out till we receive an answer! Instead of drawing hasty conclusions of our own, we must insist in our prayer, and God will soon provide us with an answer; at His schedule and time and not at ours, for God’s time is the best!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to be patient and persistent in prayer whenever the answer to my prayer seems to be delayed. In Your name I pray, amen!”#GodsTime #AnsweredPrayers

title: THE WAITING MODE
text:
A sophisticated misconception about the concept of faith has widely advanced in our time and greatly undermines the practical application of Christianity! It is all about the following phenomenon: many Christians today are trapped in a waiting mode in the midst of the various events of life; they refuse to take steps towards any direction – either forward, or backward, or right or left – in an attempt to resolve the issues of their concern. And this is because they actually do patiently wait for the Lord to intervene in their affairs.



And while they have the feeling that in this way they have placed their issues in the hands of the Lord and now quietly trust Him, the Lord has a complete opposite opinion of what trust in Him entails!



Let us take the opportunity to delve into the Lord’s way of thinking: “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐬, ‘𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐫𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐞? 𝐓𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐨𝐧. 𝐑𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐟𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐚 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐠𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐚 𝐨𝐧 𝐝𝐫𝐲 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝’” (𝐄𝐱𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐬 𝟏𝟒:𝟏𝟓-𝟏𝟔).



The Lord asked Moses to stop being inactive, and, in an act of trust in Him, rather start using what God had already put in his hands! The lesson for us here is indeed remarkable: trusting God does not consist in praying alone. There are times to pray in faith and times to act faith. In other words, there are things we do ourselves and others we expect of God.



Acting in faith is one of those things we do ourselves; God will not act for us, He will not run the race for us! God’s role is to strengthen us so that we can act, so that we can run our race ourselves!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, open the eyes of my faith that I may realise that it is me who must run my own race and fight my own battles. Strengthen me, o Lord, that I may act in faith! In Your name I pray, amen!”#WaitingMode #TakeAction

title: Your Faith Will Not Fail!
text:
Luke 22:32 says, “But I have prayed for you, Simon, that your faith may not fail. And when you have turned back, strengthen your brothers.” 



Jesus knew that Simon Peter would betray Him and also knew that he would repent. As a born-again Christian, your faith may fail but not fall off. Whatever happens, Jesus knows that you are a stakeholder in the Kingdom; you have a seat and He knows you are coming back to Him. If our faith is being kept up in an hour of temptation, though we may fall – yet we shall not be utterly cast down. This means that your faith may fail, but not totally, not finally.



What is happening to you today as a born-again Christian? Remember that satan’s desire is to attack you. Don’t forget that he begged for permission from God to attack Job. If God allows it, if God is aware, as was the case with Job, you can be attacked but cannot be destroyed. Such attacks should strengthen your desire for God, improve and strengthen your relationship with God, thereby making you stronger. When you are aware of this, you will become a beneficiary of God’s blessings.



Remember, when attack comes, it doesn’t mean you are not a Christian. Don’t misjudge yourself. Don’t let your situation mislead you. Have faith in God because Jesus is aware. He said in John 16:33: “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world, you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.” Jesus is aware!!!



It honours God most if we believe in Him when all senses contradict Him. Say this prayer: Lord Jesus, deliver me from whatever factors, issues that challenge my faith, be it sickness, poverty, hardship, worry, affliction, persecution, or temptation. Amen!

title: THE GOOD LIFE
text:
Your world can be greatly simplified and become more beautiful, if you come to know the secret to the good life! The secret is hidden in the way you choose to respond to people and circumstances…



The secret is all about letting love lead! It can be found in the words of Jesus in the book of 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟑:𝟑𝟒 – “𝐀 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮: 𝐋𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫. 𝐀𝐬 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐬𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫.”.



The secret in the choice of letting love lead is simple. Choices are like seeds; you always reap the same kind of seed you planted, and you always reap more than you planted! It is that simple; what you will become tomorrow depends on the choices you make today. 



Interested in the good life? Then, • Love and be loved• Help and be helped• Show mercy and receive mercy• Be kind for God’s sake and receive kindness• Give and receive more of whatever you gave• Sow and reap more of whatever you planted



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, give me love enough to overlook the mistakes of others and continue sowing the seeds of the future I love and not of the one I fear. Strengthen me that I may continue to sow seeds of the good life even under extreme pressure and tension. In Your holy name I pray, amen!”#TheGoodLife #TheSecret

title: STRIKE THE ROOT OF THE PROBLEM
text:
“If only they had not ruined everything, I wouldn’t be in this mess! And how could one even expect me to remain focused or perform under such pressure?”, you say when things have gone terribly wrong. 



The truth though is that we can only have two things in life; reason or results. Reasons don’t count! You can complain, you can blame others, but at the end of the day you are the one responsible for the results you produce. No matter the circumstance, the bottom line is that you make the choices that determine your future.



In that sense, you are the real cause of the problem.  Now, when you bother about a problem while neglecting its cause, you cannot have a lasting solution and that is why the problem keeps recurring!



You see, it all comes down to one’s own self. So, if you have decided to deal with yourself – the cause of your failure or poor performance – the Bible has a mighty word of encouragement for you: “𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞, 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 […]” (𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟐). In other words, the Bible exhorts you to never give up in the face of adversity, never bend under pressure, because victory is not for those who quit but for those who endure!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, strengthen me that I may remain steady in an unsteady world! Empower me that I may make the right decisions under pressure! In Your mighty name I pray, amen!”#TheRealCause #WorkOnYourself

title: PUT ON THE ARMOUR OF GOD
text:
Have you ever wondered why many Christians who are supposed to be soldiers of Christ are so weak in battle? When it comes to spiritual warfare, Christians who are supposed to be battle axes in the hands of God are always found wanting. This is because they are not armed for battle. How can we be armed for battle? If you are armed for battle, you will not be fighting against people, you will not strive against people, you will not be fighting against flesh and blood. You will not be fighting the wrong battle!



We are to battle the spiritual entities that cause crisis and tension in our careers, homes, families, and spiritual lives. The Book of Ephesians 6:11-12 says to put on the full armour of God so that you can take your stand against the devil for our struggle is not against flesh and blood but the rulers and the power of this dark world. Brethren, you can’t stand against the clever attacks of satan except you are protected with the full armour of God. 



You must understand that our values must be tested against facts and experiences. Your situation is necessary to draw you close to God so that you might give all in service to Him and maintain your union with God. The Bible says, when we are tempted with thorns in our flesh we should give ourselves to prayers. Our situation is an opportunity to honour God! Stop murmuring, stop complaining, your value must be tested against facts and experiences. As God rescued Job amid his trials, He will see you through your situations today in Jesus’ name. Better is not good enough, as a Christian whose life is centered in Christ Jesus, the best is yet to come in your life, in your health, and your family in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen!

text:

Happy 16th Birthday Emmanuel TV!!!#EmmanuelTV #HappyBirthday

text:
