title: THE SHORTEST ROUTE TO GOD
text:
God is good! And because He is good, we can bring our requests to Him, share our concerns with Him and cast our cares upon Him! Do you wonder how? Well, through prayer!



Prayer is the shortest route between our hearts and God! When we pray in His name, Jesus takes over; then everything is in His care. It is no longer our burden, as long as we do not cancel our prayer with a wrong confession.



It is in His will to answer prayers and, as Apostle John said, “𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐰𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐨𝐝: 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐟 𝐰𝐞 𝐚𝐬𝐤 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐜𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥, 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐮𝐬” (𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟓:𝟏𝟒). Hallelujah! Then, when we pray according to His will, we are assured that He heard us, and if He heard us, that is as good as an answer!



It is as good as an answer because, in fact, when we pray, the answer we get depends on how God chooses to implement His will in that matter! Thus, if the answer to your prayer seems to be delayed, remember that He is still saying something about your matter of concern; He is busy working on your request! Learn to hear what He has to say! Hearing from God is a much greater blessing than all the blessings you are waiting for.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Our Father in Heaven, hallowed be Your name! Fill our hearts with Your thoughts from above, when the answer to our prayer seems to be delayed! Open our eyes to Your dimension of operation! In Jesus name we pray, amen!”#Prayer #SpeakToGod

title: DON’T FALL INTO DISCOURAGEMENT!
text:
Exodus 6:9 – “Moses reported this to the Israelites, but they did not listen to him because of their discouragement and harsh labour.”



What Moses was reporting to the Israelites was good news – that God was going to free them from their slavery in Egypt and take them to the Promised Land. But the people did not listen to him because they were discouraged – looking at their condition in the natural. Indeed, the situation on the ground seemed to be getting worse because Pharaoh had increased their workload. 



What is the lesson for us as believers? In the course of our journey, challenges will certainly come! In fact, when God is coming with a huge blessing for you, one of the first signs is that you will receive attacks! They are informants of promotion. But we must not allow these challenges to overwhelm us to the point of falling into discouragement. 



A discouraged heart cannot be sensitive to hear what God is saying about the situation. Because when you are discouraged, you will look at life through the lens of your circumstances. Recall the words of Prophet TB Joshua: “God cannot use a discouraged servant.” Therefore, no matter what you are going through, see your challenge as a reason to depend on God, knowing that beyond that challenge lies Divine promotion! 



PRAYER: Oh Lord, I cannot get along without You! Show Yourself stronger in my life! Release me into my Divine future, in Jesus’ mighty name!

title: Prayer For Ukraine
text:
God is aware of the current situation, and because He is aware He will surely make a way out for everyone who is affected by the raging warfare. 



Prophet T.B. Joshua had prophesied about these events nine years ago. We wish to extend a special hand of fellowship to our fellow Ukrainians in these trying times. We urge you not to despair, we are praying for you. Keep your focus on Jesus Christ while obeying the authorities of your country.



Long live the Republic of Ukraine!Emmanuel!

title: TRUSTING GOD KICKS OUT FEAR
text:
There is no doubt that fear holds us back in many areas of our lives. It keeps us stuck, stagnant and does not allow us to make important decisions for our lives! But when our focus is on God, we would be calm, calculated and determined, even when everything around us is unquiet.



In particular, the Word of God states in 𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟏:𝟏𝟎, “𝐒𝐨 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐟𝐞𝐚𝐫, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐦𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐝, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝. 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐮𝐩𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐦𝐲 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝”.



“This is a wonderful testimony of the power hidden in the protection that exists under the grace of God Almighty. In order to experience it, however, you must trust the One that has no beginning and end with all your heart!



Therefore, the key to overcoming our fear and being completely free from it, is total and complete trust in God, because by faith your fear is defeated and you would see that by might shall no man prevail.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, as I trust in you in every situation, help me to be able to wash away every trace of fear from my life. With faith in your almighty name I pray, amen!”#TrustGod #KickFearOut

title: THE BELIEF IN OUR HEART
text:
The Book of Romans 10:9-10 says, “If you declare with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord’, and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved. For it is with your heart that you believe and are justified and it is with your mouth that you profess your faith and are saved.” 



Our heart serves as a communication point between us and God. We believe with our heart, and faith releases that belief through our mouths. If you declare with your mouth, “Jesus is Lord” and there is no belief in your heart, you are just saying empty words. To have this belief in your heart, you must read, act, and obey God’s Word. The more you reflect and meditate on God’s Word, the more your spirit acts on it.



Reading God’s Word slowly allows you to stay focused and devoted to His full attention. To have this belief in our hearts, we must read the Bible slowly, attentively and repeatedly. Before you can read the Bible, you must first reflect inside – deep reflection. You must ensure that your heart is free, since only a free heart can communicate with God. If your heart is not free, it is imprisoned. That is, your heart is overburdened with sorrow, difficulties, problems, obstacles, and so on. Worrying about things that will overwhelm you rather than focusing on God’s will has an impact on the glory of God in your life. That free heart is the one that works with God, that communicates with God, that acts with God, that hears from God and that submits to God. Reading the Bible with devotion necessitates a free heart as well as a private and quiet environment.



There is power in our mouth; the belief in our heart is released by faith out of our mouth. When the Word of God takes residence and dominates your heart, it influences your actions and character. The more you read the Bible slowly, attentively, and repeatedly, the more you meditate about what you have read and the more your spirit acts upon the Word. The more you turn the Word of God over and over in your heart, the more it becomes part of you.



Finally, as Christians, let us make it a duty to read the Word of God because the Word of God can only become part of us when our heart is free and when we read God’s Word slowly, attentively, and repeatedly – with devotion. Say this prayer with me: Lord Jesus Christ, I let go of offense and grudges. Lord Jesus, free my heart to follow you; free my heart to receive from you, in Jesus’ name!

title: TAKE CARE OF YOUR SPIRIT
text:
If we notice our daily life, we will discover that we spend many hours of the day taking care of our bodies.  A large percentage of our time is devoted to sleeping, eating and to various other activities that benefit and strengthen our bodies… However, the Word of God in 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟐𝟑 reveals a truth that many either do not know or strongly refuse to accept. It says, “𝐌𝐚𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞, 𝐬𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡. 𝐌𝐚𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐞 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐨𝐝𝐲 𝐛𝐞 𝐤𝐞𝐩𝐭 𝐛𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐟 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭”. 



In other words, the Word of God clearly states that man is a spirit, has a soul and dwells in a body!  But what do we do for our spirit as spiritual beings that we are?  How much time do we spend on our spirit daily?  Do we feed and care for it every day as we do for our physical body or do we neglect it?



These questions are enough to make us understand that it is time to start caring more about our spirit, because we must not forget that one day this body will be destroyed, but the spirit will live forever!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, forgive me for all the years I have lived my life, being completely indifferent to my spirit. Give me the necessary spiritual maturity to understand how important it is to take care of my spirit as well as I take care of my body – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!” #FeedYourSpirit #ManIsASpirit

title: THERE IS ALWAYS HOPE
text:
There are times in life when we feel we have reached the bottom. That we are the worst people in the world, that our situation is irreversible and that there is no turning back. The robber on the cross in 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐𝟑:𝟑𝟗-𝟒𝟑 probably felt the same way. But the Word of God says, “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬, 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝐦𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐝𝐨𝐦.’ 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦, ‘𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐥𝐲 𝐈 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐭𝐨𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐦𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐞’”. 



Who would have imagined that a man like that, completely isolated by society because of his actions, a criminal, could be saved and actually secure a place in Heaven among the saints? If the robber mentioned in the Word of God managed to find grace and mercy before the Lord, despite his troubled past, the chances of you regaining your position as a child of God are still very high, as long as you do not give up in the face of adversity. 



Do not allow your past to determine your future, because no matter your past, life never completely closes the door to opportunity! As long as you are alive, you are given the opportunity by God to repent, correct yourself and move forward. But there is one condition; do not give up!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, as I read Your Word, encourage me and give me the strength to continue and not give up. I believe that as I continue to follow You, You will continue to give me opportunities to correct myself, change and move forward – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#DontGiveUp #ThereIsHope

title: TALK ABOUT VICTORY NOT WARFARE
text:
The life of believers testifies that being faithful to God does not eliminate adversity. Remember that this life is warfare where only the serious-minded are victorious. The life we enjoy is determined by the words we speak. Prophet T.B Joshua says there will be an account of the words spoken by the mouth because the mouth is the revealer of what is in the heart.



If the words we speak in preaching and in teaching are not in accordance with God’s Word, I mean in accordance with the scripture, they will remain idle, meaningless, and oftentimes destructive. Speak what you believe because the heart and mouth must be in one accord with God’s Word.



What are you saying concerning your family, career and situation?  The life we enjoy does not translate the words we speak. We never pray for poverty, yet we find ourselves in the realm of poverty. We never confess failure and sickness, yet we find ourselves in these situations. This is to tell us that the words we speak are not in one accord with what is in our hearts. The Bible says that David’s Victory went in the footprint of his confession because he spoke with his mouth what he believed in his heart.



Prophet T.B Joshua says, “God watches over the confession of our faith and makes it good.” Therefore, say to yourself: I am no longer condemned. I am linked up with God. Disease and sicknesses are things of the past. I am more than a conqueror. My past is over!



Say this prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to be conscious of my faith, even under great trials and temptations.

title: THE CURE OF IMPERFECTION
text:
Though man is the greatest creation of God and he is made in His likeness, perfection still eludes us all. Even though the greatest Creator has created us, we daily allow our imperfections, that is our weaknesses, to get the best of us! We fall into self-pity and forget that if the curse of imperfection hits, it is our responsibility to confess to God and receive His mercy, learn from it and keep on growing. Remember what the Word of God says in the book of 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟔:𝟔𝟗-𝟕𝟓 when Peter denied Jesus Christ three times. The Bible states, […] “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦, ‘𝐁𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐬, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐲 𝐌𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬.’ 𝐒𝐨 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐞𝐩𝐭 𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐥𝐲.”



After Peter denied Jesus Christ, he wept bitterly, which means that he realised that he was struck by the curse of imperfection. He, therefore, ran to God in order to confess to Him and receive His infinite mercy! Indeed, he received His mercy which helped him become the rock upon which the church of Christ was built.



So, no matter what sort of imperfection comes your way, know that as a child of God everyone falls but great people get back up. Choose to be great and have the right approach when you make a mistake and you will see that God takes broken things and makes them useful in His hands.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, no matter the mistakes that I make, I know that mistakes are correctable. No matter how imperfect I am, I am still Your child. Help me overcome my imperfections and get back up every time that I fall so that I can one day become as perfect as You. Amen!”#Imperfections #GodsMercy

title: CHRISTIAN IN THE HEART
text:
Are you a Christian in the heart? The Bible makes us understand that Christianity is not a religion but a relationship with God in the heart! Jesus Christ actually came to the world in order to restore this relationship and communion between God and man. Unfortunately, today the Christianity of many is found in their titles and words rather than in their heart!



Our Lord knows this very well, and that is why in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟏𝟓:𝟖 He observes, “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐰 𝐧𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐌𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡, 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐫 𝐌𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐬, 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐫 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐌𝐞”. Indeed, anyone can say “Jesus is Lord” with their mouth, but not everyone can confess that Jesus is Lord with all their heart! 



The quality of our Christian confession is revealed when challenges come to man’s way; that is where the value of the relationship we have with God in our heart is revealed, and that is where its absence is made obvious!



So, unity with God is the true essence of Christianity, and that’s why the greatest thing satan aims is to break your relationship with God! Because He knows that Jesus Christ is made Alive and works in your life only when you are connected to Him!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Lord Jesus, I want to have a true relationship with You! I reject superficial religion and ask You to fill me with Your Spirit and bring me close to You, so that I may become a genuine child of Yours – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#RelationshipWithGod #TrueChristianity

title: GUARD YOUR HEART
text:
John 4:24 says, “God is Spirit, and those who worship Him must worship in spirit and truth”. The Almighty God is Spirit and therefore must be worshipped in spirit and truth, otherwise, one is merely wasting his or her energy. There must be a deliberate and passionate longing within the spirit and heart of man for God whenever he worships his Creator. God looks beyond the words we speak but focuses more on the depth of our hearts and spirit. If you speak words in prayer and it is not according to the Spirit then it is not according to the truth of God’s Word.



The power of God moves only when the Word and the Spirit unite. God’s power cannot move without the unification of the Word and the Spirit to bring about healing, deliverance, and all of God’s blessings. God’s power working through His Word and His Spirit brings about whatever we desire from God. The Word of God becomes part of us through meditation. Meditating on the Word of God allows our spirit to act for the release of God’s power. The more you meditate on the Word you read, the more your spirit acts upon the Word and when the spirit acts upon the Word, the Word becomes part of you. The Word has not yet become a part of you when your spirit has not yet acted upon it.



People of God, guard your heart because it is the contact point for the Holy Spirit. We have to be on our guard to ensure that we do not lose the battle which is fought in the heart. When you fail in your heart, you fail all. When your heart is a dwelling place for God, it becomes Heaven. Your heart is Heaven if you are a child of God. What you decree now has been decreed in your heart, if you are a child of God. The bank of miracles is in Heaven. Take care of your heart!



Say this prayer: O Holy Spirit, let Your Word abide in me and I in Your Word, that it may renew the attitude of my mind in true righteousness and holiness, thereby making my heart a dwelling place for You. Amen!

title: ALLOW THE POTTER TO WOEK ON YOU
text:
Have you ever seen a potter molding clay? As the potter molds the clay, so God desires to mold us into that which He deems necessary and good, in order for us to become useful vessels in His hands. But it is important to note that this can only happen as long as we are willing to allow the living Word to enter us and make us pliable. Remember, what the Word of God says in 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟏𝟖:𝟒-𝟔, “𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐩𝐨𝐭, 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐞. 𝐇𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐂𝐚𝐧 𝐈 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐝𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥, 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬?’ 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝. ‘𝐋𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐲 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫, 𝐬𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥’”.



If we do not allow the living Word to enter us, then our vessel becomes unmoldable, hard as a rock, as those hearts that the Word of God speaks of. We need to understand that our disobedience makes us become unmoldable, it does not allow the Potter to mold us into the shape He wishes. We need to soften our hearts and make our ears sensitive to the voice of God and finally stop telling Him to stop trying to change us and make us better.



We hinder God from using us by not allowing correction to shape our lives! By not allowing the Word of God to penetrate us! Remember, what it takes gold to be gold is what it takes you to be a Christian.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I come to You aware of the fact that until I allow You to work on me, I will not be useful in Your hands. Therefore, I ask for Your grace to help me be pliable in Your hands with my obedience. Amen!”#YouNeedShape #JesusThePotter

title: AN OPPORTUNITY TO DRAW CLOSER TO GOD!
text:
Exodus 18:8 – “Moses told his father-in-law about everything the Lord had done to Pharaoh and the Egyptians for Israel’s sake and about all the hardships they had met along the way and how the Lord had saved them.“



When Moses was leading the people of Israel through the wilderness after their deliverance from Egypt, he met up one day with his father-in-law, Jethro. After recounting to him God’s mighty power in delivering them from Egypt, Moses also highlighted all the hardships they had been through after that deliverance, testifying to Jethro about how God had saved them each time they called on Him.



Take note – being delivered from the hands of the Egyptians did not mean an end to their hardships! They faced many trials and temptations on their journey – such as a shortage of water and food – but the purpose of each hardship was to teach them total dependence on God. As a Christian, examine your life and you would discover that one of the main ways we learn dependence on God is through cycles of hardship or difficulty – in which we draw closer to Him and He delivers us from them or in them. 



But as Jesus warned us in Luke 21:34, instead of seeing them as an opportunity to draw closer to God, we are tempted to either try to escape them using alternatives outside of Christ or to become anxious, worried and desperate. Ask yourself today – in the midst of your difficulty, pressure or tension, will you try to escape, become worried and anxious, or will you see that situation as an opportunity to draw closer to God? 



PRAYER: Oh LORD, help me to turn away today from that which has the power to turn me away from You, and give me the grace to turn to You in the midst of my trials, in Jesus’ mighty name!

title: TURN YOUR SCARS INTO STARS
text:
Just as many people in the course of their lives suffer a mark or a scar on their body, so also many people suffer a scar, a stigma or a wound in their soul. This stigma may have to do with rejection, wrong choices or mistakes of the past. Blind Bartimaeus bore upon him the stigma of blindness, but he did not allow this wound to keep him away from the Saviour. “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐚𝐳𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐡, 𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐲, ‘𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬, 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝, 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐦𝐞!’” (𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝟏𝟎:𝟒𝟕). With great determination, he approached and seized the opportunity to the new life that Jesus Christ had to offer!



Like Βartimaeus, seize the opportunity that God offers to you! Don’t let your bad experiences wipe you out. Turn your scars into stars! Let go of the pain of the past, learn from unpleasant experiences and move forward with a new vision! Jesus Christ wants to support you in your transition to a new life!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, as I disengage myself from the pain and wounds of the past, I ask You to heal my wounds and turn them into stars – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#TransformYourLife #Change

title: LOOKING UNTO GOD
text:
For those whose lives are centered in Christ Jesus, the best is always yet to come. Many Christians complain today because their lives are not being centered on Christ Jesus; their lives are centered on how they are doing, how they are treated, and what their circumstances look like. We are called not to be among the masses who move without direction, vision, and purpose. We are called to look unto Christ Jesus, our Saviour. So, I ask: when you look at your life what do you see? What does Jesus see? 



The Bible says in Colossians 3:1- 2 “Since you have been raised to a new life with Christ, set your sight on the realities of heaven, where Christ sits in the place of honor at God’s right hand. “In your Christian walk, at times, you may find yourself overwhelmed. You may work hard and struggle greatly and yet never make any progress. You may be working in the house of God, doing what seems right on the outside and yet when it’s time for God to mark your work, you will discover that you have failed. God loves us not because we are good or qualified on the outside. He loves us simply because He is love. That love is what He has demonstrated on the cross. 



When you look to God amid your situation, you will not be overwhelmed. Job had a great test of faith but he looked unto God and a calm assurance and confidence took his place. He learned to fix his thoughts on God and not on himself. If you are thinking about God who has the power to forgive, you will stop thinking about your unrighteousness. You will begin to think about the kind of person you will like to be, not the person you are now. 



We have wasted too much time thinking our thoughts and not the thoughts of God. Do not yield to the temptation to act out of character. Remember, we are in the world but not part of it. We are faith people, members of the household of faith, citizens of heaven. Do not let the magnetic attraction of this worldly pleasure draw you away from looking unto God.

title: HAPPY PALM SUNDAY – 2022
text:
As we enter this holy week, let us prepare our hearts to reunite with God! On a day like this, 2,000 year ago, our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ entered Jerusalem in a triumphal way; yet, inside Him He knew that the end was coming. That is, the end to our past! Because for this reason the Son of God appeared… to put an end to our past and give birth to a bright new future in us!



Let us remember with gratitude all the agony Jesus went through in the garden of Gethsemane while praying, and the pain that was to follow for our redemption; that is, so that we can be healed, delivered, saved and made whole in Christ Jesus! 



“‘𝐇𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬’ 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐛𝐨𝐝𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐝𝐢𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬; ‘𝐛𝐲 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐝.’” (𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟐:𝟐𝟒)



#HappyPalmSunday #ReuniteWithChrist

title: Happy Palm Sunday From The SCOAN

text:

Happy Palm Sunday, viewers all over the world!

title: THINK ON THAT WHICH IS FROM ABOVE
text:
Research has shown that the majority of our thoughts are negative! Unfortunately, that is not surprising because if we take a look around us, we will surely see that the influence deriving from our surroundings – friends, family members, news – is mostly negative… Wars, rumours of wars, sicknesses, incurable diseases unknown to mankind, economic crisis and many other negative things are bombarding us on a daily basis. 



But, the Word of God is there in the midst of it all to remind us how to keep our mind busy with heavenly thoughts that are from above in order to remain calm even when everything around us seem to be unquiet! More specifically, in 𝐂𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟑:𝟏-𝟐, the Word of God gives us the key to have perfect management of our thoughts, as children of God, regardless of what is happening around us. “𝐈𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭, 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐤 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐯𝐞, 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐢𝐬, 𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝.  𝐒𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐯𝐞, 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡”.



A man is what he thinks about all day long; the level of the thoughts of your heart determines your life. No matter what you occupy your mind with, it is time to stop thinking about that, and start thinking about that which is from above!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord God, help me discipline my mind and make it my servant and not my master. Give me Your grace so that I can keep my mind busy with Your divine Word and not things that have no eternal value – in Jesus’ name I pray, amen!”#ThinkHeaven #JesusThoughts

title: BE WILLING TO TAKE EVERY COURSE
text:
No one can predict the future based on current signs. Jeremiah 29:11 says, “For I know the thoughts that I think towards you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.” What a beautiful picture He has given us but know one thing, if gold must be gold, it has to pass through fire. The road to the throne is not without its difficulties. You must be willing to take every course necessary to become the person God made you to be. You can’t be greater than your processing. When God is carrying out His plan in people’s lives, He also prepares and arranges events that will continue to unfold until His purpose is revealed. Jesus says in John 16:33, “In this world, there will be trouble but take heart, I have overcome the world.” This implies that there may be difficulties but you can still turn things around.



You can still turn things around, no matter what the circumstances you’re in. Refuse to accept your situation or to be defeated by them. Refrain from admitting defeat! Revelation 12:11 says that we overcome by the Blood of the Lamb and the Word of our testimony. Remember, when you take God’s Word to heart and truly make it part of you, it will by its very nature change you and when it does, you will find yourself called to act with Him. That is when you begin to be what God says you are and do what God says you can do. When you know that you can still turn it around, you will always be happy, even when there seems nothing to be happy about. When you bless God in your trials, you will be blessed by God through your trials. You should see your hard time as a reason to bless God as much as you see your good time as a reason to bless His name.



Give Jesus time; the answer will work itself slowly but surely. There is nothing God created that He cannot change. With God, all things are possible. With God, you can still turn it around. If you believe that with Jesus, you can change your situation, say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, I trust Your Word; strengthen me to endure and manage my present situation. With You, all things are possible, I believe my case is settled. In Jesus’ name!”

title: HE PAID THE PRICE FOR OUR SINS!!!
text:
What a day, when the Son Of God was crucified for our sins and the Cross became the symbol of our faith and redemption. On that day a supreme sacrifice was made and the highest price was paid.



He was unjustly nailed to a cross, so you could be forgiven of your sins and have a life that is truly fulfilling. What a grace! This day, we encourage you to take time to reflect on Jesus’ sacrifice for you and appreciate Him for a life invested in your potential! #GoodFriday #SupremeSacrifice

title: HE KNOWS BEST
text:
As Christians, we derive joy from telling others about God and how Faithful He is in the midst of trials and tribulations. Many times, however, when it is our turn to put in practice everything we pleasantly and effortlessly tell others to do, we see that we find it hard to trust the One who always knows best! We start to question God and everything He allows us to go through, forgetting what His Word says in 𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟓:𝟗, “𝐖𝐨𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐪𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐥 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐌𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫, 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝. 𝐃𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫, ‘𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠?’ 𝐃𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐬𝐚𝐲, ‘𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬’?”.



Who are we to question God, to question His will, His promises, and His time? Do we know better than our Father? Remember Abraham! When God asked him to sacrifice his only son, he said, “Yes!”, not because he understood, not because he wanted to kill his son, but because he knew that God knows best. Therefore, no matter your situation, stay focused because when you stray from your goal or your task because of your situation you forget God’s promise of victory and you lose His protection.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, relying on Your Word I confess victory in every battle, not because everything is in my favour, but because I put my trust in You and Your finished work – in Your holy Name I pray, amen!#HeKnowsBest #TrustInGod

title: GUARD YOUR HEART
text:
Anytime you train yourself to think positively and speak positively, you will act positively. On the contrary, when you allow yourself to think negatively and speak negatively, you will act negatively. Remember our heart is where God dwells and that is why it must be alert and purified by the word of God. But if your heart sleeps, satan takes the opportunity to attack. As children of God, we must capture our thoughts. Once we can capture our thoughts, we capture it all. Remember that true Christianity lies in the heart. 



What is going through your heart? What is the state of your heart? Let’s not forget that our heart must be at its best for God. Why? Because the Holy Spirit expresses itself through our hearts. God cannot make His home in your heart if your heart is filled with these things like offence, bitterness or rage. Sin regarded in the heart, spoils the comfort of God’s grace and ruins the success of our prayer. Prophet T.B. Joshua says that the person most hurt by unforgiveness, bitterness and pain of the past is YOU. Our heart must be made spiritual by regularly taking the Word of God into it and acting upon on it, then that Word can become an integral part of our being. Brethren in Christ, the word of God in our heart becomes our weapon to fight and defeat satan. The human heart when it is free is sensitive to the spirit of God, but when it is bound or burdened by hatred and bitterness, it loses its sensitivity and therefore becomes useless as an instrument.



Say this prayer: 



1. Oh Holy Spirit, come into my soul and make my heart your dwelling place. 2. Draw my heart oh Holy Spirit, that I may do only what is Holy, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen!

title: HAPPY 7TH ANNIVERSARY, SCOAN THESSALONICA!!!
text:
Exactly 7 years ago, the Synagogue, Church Of All Nations Thessalonica, had its very first, long-awaited service. Some had been praying for a SCOAN branch in Europe for years, and the joy that God answered their prayers still remains indescribable. Within these 7 years, thousands of people have received the healing, blessing and freedom they had been seeking, as God never stopped giving His children everything He promised in His Word in abundance!



Indeed, Jesus Christ still empowers His disciples to change the world today! It is the name of Jesus that we are exalting and glorifying today, because He gave us a divine instruction in 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝟏𝟔:𝟏𝟓. “𝐇𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, ‘𝐆𝐨 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐥 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧’.”



We glorify and thank the Lord from the bottom of our hearts, because throughout these 7 years, His power never stopped being confirmed with great signs and wonders! As you read this text, give all the glory to God and share with us your own personal experience at the Synagogue, Church of All Nations Thessalonica, in the comments section below!



This is only the beginning – the best is yet to come!#Anniversary #SCOANThessalonica

title: TURN YOUR FEARS INTO MOTIVES
text:
We live in a world where everything seems to be falling apart. People are anxious about tomorrow and do not know what the future holds… The constant struggle for survival has led the majority of people to think pessimistically and live in fear, without faith and hope. God, however, is always by our side and we can always rely on Him to help us in every difficulty we experience!



As children of God, if we realise that our life is full of fear, we should know that the only way to completely remove fear from our life is to be filled with faith, because fear and insecurity dominate a life without faith! More specifically, the Word of God in 𝟐 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐲 𝟏:𝟕 states, “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐮𝐬 𝐚 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐞𝐚𝐫, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐚 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐝”.



Therefore, it is understandable that fear does not come from God, and that is why we must turn our fears into motives that will draw us closer to God, in order to receive the faith that He has prepared for us! We must make the decision to stop seeing our problem, our struggle for survival, as a personal challenge, but as a challenge against God! Let fear become the motive for you to get closer to God, and not far from Him! Do not let fear overwhelm you; you and God are a majority!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Holy Father, open the eyes of my faith that I may see things from Your point of view, so that I may no longer fear but overcome with the power in Your holy name – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#FearNot #Faith

title: THE CURE FOR LONELINESS
text:
Loneliness causes people to feel empty and unwanted, and it is not necessarily about not being with other people!  Even when surrounded by friends and relatives, one can still feel lonely, eagerly waiting to feel the presence of the One who is closer than a brother. The One who can do what no man can do; Jesus Christ!



In Scripture, we discover that God is present in our loneliness, “𝐀 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐚 𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐰𝐢𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐬, 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐲 𝐝𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠. 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐢𝐧 𝐟𝐚𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐬,𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠; 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐚 𝐬𝐮𝐧-𝐬𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝.”—𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟔𝟖:𝟓-𝟔. He is there in times of grief and in times of discouragement, He is there when others forsake us, and when we are disappointed! Ultimately, those who belong to God, through Christ Jesus, are never really alone! Our main duty is to take care of our relationship with Him, through meditation and prayer, because no state of being is as rewarding as living in tune with God.



Therefore, take heart! If you stop struggling on your own and rely on Him, He will comfort you with His love and restore the joy in your heart! Indeed, He is the best cure for loneliness!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus, thank You for being my closest Friend, my Father, my comfort. You are all that I need! I ask for Your forgiveness for every time I did not appreciate You. May Your warmth and love fill my emptiness – in Jesus’ name, amen!#TheBestCure #Loneliness

title: OUR SPIRITUAL WALK WIH GOD
text:
As a Christian, you are in a spiritual walk with the Lord and in your spiritual walk with the Lord, you have both good and hard times alike. As a child of God, your hard times are as good as your good times because there is no real evil in it; it is for the glory of God. Let’s look at the life of Joseph. He had to pass through the dry pit to slavery at Potiphar’s house and then to the prison and from the prison to the throne. His tests and trials prepared him for the challenges ahead. Every successful teacher was once a student. We Christians enjoy the opportunity of being a coach to others.



People of God, adopting a lifestyle that is based on purpose provides an opportunity to enrich others, by positively leaving your imprint. When you can expand this philosophy to a wider vision, your purpose or vision will become crystallised. If you are focused only on making money, a large slice of life will pass you by because money is just a small slice of life. Money cannot give us joy, peace, comfort, or eternal life but Jesus can. The blessings of the world enrich the body temporarily but the blessings of Christ enrich the soul for eternity.



Let’s live for eternity and we shall secure all that is available in it. As Christians, we are recommended to follow these tiny steps of faith with patience in Christ Jesus, for there are no shortcuts to spiritual maturity. When you are in a haste to achieve something in life, you are bound to make costly mistakes that will pull you back, if not down. When your vision is clear, your life will have meaning. To live life to the fullest, your goal must reflect your purpose. What is your challenge? To turn your hard times into good times, every day, you must stay true to your purpose in life despite snow or rain. The purpose of life sees beyond the pain and joy of life we receive and the purpose of life is to glorify the creator, not the created. Amid your storm, trials and pleasures as well, stay focused, for those who bless God in their trials will be blessed by God through their trials.

title: THE BEST MEDICINE
text:
We are in a period of time when the use of medication has become almost vital for the entire human population. New kinds of medication are created daily to treat different types of infection and symptoms.



Nevertheless, there are still many issues that man claims to have no cure. But in 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟑𝟎:𝟐, the Word of God proves us wrong by mentioning, “𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐦𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐈 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞”. In this Psalm, king David teaches us that there is a medicine that can relieve any symptom and can bring a solution to every problem. This medicine is nothing but prayer! Prayer is a salve for every sore, a remedy for every malady. 



If you are still searching for the best cure for your illness or a more suitable solution to your problem, start praying and then you will see your problem bowing down, in the name of Jesus!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, as I pray in Your almighty name, may You bring a solution to my problems and a cure to my sicknesses –  amen!”#TheBestMedicine #Prayer

title: ONLY BELIEVE!
text:
John 5:24 – “Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.” 



The way of salvation is simple – “only believe”. But we read about the many difficulties that Jesus’ listeners had in simply believing Him, and our own experiences teach us the same thing. Salvation is free but it is not cheap and believing is simple but not always easy.



Let us consider a couple of the blockages to belief that Jesus pointed out:– The religious leaders were too focused on the glory that comes from man – “How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God? (John 5:44)– The crowd who followed Jesus’ were so focused on the natural food Jesus had provided through a miracle that they didn’t give attention to believing Jesus’ message, which was spiritual food. (John 6:26-36)



Even some of the disciples did not truly believe because they didn’t deeply understand that “the Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing.” (John 6:63-64)



Indeed, we cannot save ourselves by our good works or efforts and if we are to believe, we must not seek human glory or focus too much on our own need for material breakthrough. We must receive the Word of God in our hearts, and then, as Prophet TB Joshua said, “Believing is simply acting on the Word”.



PRAYER: Lord, I believe. Help my unbelief!

title: MAKE YOUR HISTORY TODAY!
text:
A large percentage of people face various problems and situations that lead them to despair. There are also many that wonder if all the difficulties they go through have any benefit or just exist to make us suffer…



The Bible teaches us that as we try to overcome our troubles, we are making history and fulfilling our destiny! In 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝟏𝟎:𝟒𝟕 the Word of God states that the fact that Bartimaeus could not see, filled him with determination and pushed him to approach Jesus Christ in order to receive the healing he so desperately needed. “𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐍𝐚𝐳𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐡, 𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭, ‘𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬, 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝, 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐦𝐞!’”. With this act of faith, blind Bartimaeus made history as he was trying to overcome his sickness!



Let us, therefore, be encouraged by the story of Bartimaeus, 2,000 years later. Let us begin to solve our problems, bearing in mind that in the life of the child of God, nothing happens for nothing and nothing happens by chance.



🙏𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐲: “Dear God, I thank You for Your grace and mercy in my life. I thank You for giving me the opportunity to make history for Your glory – in Jesus’ mighty name, Amen!”#MakeHistory #OvercomeTroubles

title: OUR POSITION IN CHRIST JESUS
text:
Isaiah 53:5-6 says, “But He was wounded for our transgressions, He was bruised for our iniquities; The chastisement for our peace was upon Him, and by His stripes, we are healed. All we like sheep have gone astray; We have turned, every one, to his own way; And the Lord has laid on him the iniquity of us all.”



We are Christians because of the finished work of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ on the Cross of Calvary. In other words, we are Christians not because of what we do but because of what Christ has done. At Calvary, Jesus defeated the devil and it is His victory that gives us victory. Jesus paid the ultimate price for the redemption of mankind by dying a painful and shameful death to set us free from sin and its penalty.



Are you suffering? Are you in pain? Or maybe you are asking yourself the following questions: “Am I a child of God? Why am I facing these troubles?” Don’t be discouraged. As a Christian, do not allow your situation to mislead you. The fact that you are a Christian does not mean that you will not face troubles or difficulties. Always remember your position in Christ Jesus – a position of victory, good health, deliverance, success, prosperity, hope, fulfillments and all of God’s blessings. Therefore, amid poverty, pain and sickness, believers should rejoice because there is hope. Jesus is the Hope!



Say this prayer: By the power of resurrection, that destined good health, promotion, career, and marriage that has been taken from me – BE RESTORED, in the name of Jesus Christ! Amen!

title: SCOAN IS MOVING IN JESUS’ NAME EVEN AFTER PROPHET TB JOSHUA
text:
General Overseer, Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN), owners of Emmanuel TV Team, Prophet TB Joshua and wife, Evelyn



Has anyone of us in The Synagogue, Church of All Nations (SCOAN) ever wondered why our Father in the Lord, Prophet TB Joshua, has to go so suddenly? Or why has SCOAN had to go through what it has to go through since June 5, 2021? We may not know all the answers. However, as we approach the first anniversary of that event let us ponder on what God is telling us and doing in our time. Let us come together and celebrate the life and time of a great prophet of our time.



Truly Prophet TB Joshua’s physical absence is an immeasurable missing but, His great work of love, his complete dedication to the full gospel of Jesus Christ, his teaching, his unique charisma, etc., will all remain with us. We can say right away that was spoon-feeding all of us, from his family, his numerous disciples and workers, Emmanuel TV Partners and his other associates, regular or occasional Church members, visitors, and viewers of Emmanuel TV worldwide, everyone got fed freely. His absence should encourage us to grow more spiritually and depend on the Holy Spirit that was also living in Prophet TB Joshua.



His passing away has been greatly felt, even though at different degrees, depending on whether you were his wife, children, disciples, followers, or even critics. Nevertheless, there are great signs of reassurance to build our faith and hope; not just from the Holy Scriptures and the Holy Spirit. His wife and now SCOAN’s new leader, Prophetess Evelyn Joshua is filling the space her husband left. Many assemblies, offshoots of SCOAN, are springing up in many countries his disciples have run back to. We are praying for all of them to be filled with the Holy Ghost so that we can build on the same foundation laid by Christ Jesus, faithfully and powerfully.



Not that anyone of us has already obtained everything, or has already arrived, but the goal is to keep pressing on and take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of us, (Philippians 3:12). We shall continue to advocate the need for our mutual unity, love and working in one accord. If the Apostle Paul is willing to admit that He hasn’t full attained the fullness of salvation, then there is a need to support each other and build on whatever we learned under Prophet TB Joshua.



We shall press forward as Paul says. By that Paul is teaching us that Jesus Christ died so that we might have salvation. Jesus Christ left us so that the Comforter could come and teach us all things.  Remember also that Jesus isn’t still on the cross. Jesus isn’t in the tomb. Jesus has moved on. Let us encourage each other also that Prophet TB Joshua has moved on and so we have to move on too. Yet our father in the Lord will live continually in our hearts. But we’re grateful to God for briefly lending him to the world.



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin Nigeria

title: SPRING INTO ACTION
tags: The Synagogue Church of all Nations
text:
The Word of God teaches us that if indeed we have faith, then we need to act upon that faith because faith demands action! This means that you have to show your works of faith, just as when the Israelites marched around Jericho for seven days, and its walls collapsed! They did not sit at home with their hands crossed, focused on their faith alone. They were certain that if they sprang into action, God would remove any obstacle that came before them! In 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝟐:𝟏𝟖 the Word of God clearly mentions how our faith needs to be demonstrated! “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐚𝐲, ‘𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬.’ 𝐒𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐦𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐲 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐛𝐲 𝐦𝐲 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬.”



Faith without works is dead faith! Noah could not just rely on his faith to save humanity from the flood that was to come, but had to spring into action and build the ark with the belief that, indeed, the flood was coming! Noah became the vessel God used to save humanity and every other living thing. Therefore, stop talking about your problems, because faith focuses on Jesus Christ instead of our problems, and spring into action today!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus, I know that You are capable of helping me grow genuine faith that makes things happen. Give me Your grace to spring into action and be like the great men of faith who changed the course of history – amen!#TakeAction #Faith

title: PATIENCE IS A NECESSARY VIRTUE
text:
When everything is well in one’s life, it is very easy to have patience. But, what happens when situations get tougher? That is when the real test comes – when we have no other choice than to be patient, while the only thing we want is an immediate solution to our problem!



In 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟏, Paul urges us to continue running the good race of faith saying, “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐫𝐮𝐧 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐮𝐬, 𝐟𝐢𝐱𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐞𝐲𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡. 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐣𝐨𝐲 𝐬𝐞𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬, 𝐬𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐭 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝”. This is the instruction our Almighty Father gives us in times when impatience overwhelms us. 



Patiently waiting on God’s time, we show our faith and trust in the One who can bring the best outcome to any concern we might be facing! All the heroes of faith went through the trial of patience and, if we read their stories, we will see that God did not only solve their problems but also rewarded them generously! Therefore, be patient because God’s answer is not for those who are in a hurry. Even when God seems to be silent, He is still saying something!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I ask You to give me grace and patience, so that I may await Your heavenly intervention and not strive in vain with my own strength. I completely trust my life in Your hands – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#BePatient #Virtue

title: BE EQUIPPED WITH GOD’S WORD
text:
Jesus Christ has authority over unclean spirits and the power to compel them to leave. As followers of Christ, we have authority over sicknesses and demonic activities, as well as the power of God to instruct them where to go and they must obey. As Christians, we don’t have to be concerned about satan or upset by his tricks, such as failures, disappointment, setbacks, affliction and diseases. Instead, we must boldly challenge him because we have the power of Jesus Christ’s name at our command. The name Jesus Christ has power but only among those who would allow God’s Word to dwell in and dominate them. If there is an indwelling Word, Christ will come to the scene when you call His name, since the Word dominating you is the Christ you are calling to the scene – to cure, deliver, bless and rescue. It is the Word that has taught us the worth, authority and legal right to use the name, Jesus Christ.



When our spirit acts on the Word, the Spirit will be released in accordance to how much we hear God’s Word with our hearts. Genuine Christians are always instructed by the Holy Spirit. As a result, in each case, they receive precise information or suggestion from the Holy Spirit that the action should be carried out. Such was the case with Apostle Paul in Acts 16:16-18. The evil spirit departed the slave girl immediately after Apostle Paul had a specific instruction from the Spirit of God to command the unclean spirit out of her. This implies that unless we receive specific instructions or suggestions from the Spirit of God to call the name, Jesus Christ, and we call the name, our words will be useless, meaningless and oftentimes destructive. In Acts 19:14-16, this was what happened to the seven sons of Sceva.



Authority assures us that Jesus Christ is the Healer, Deliverer and Saviour of the world but power makes healing, deliverance and salvation a reality. As a result, it is very necessary to speak the name of Jesus Christ with authority and power. 



If you know that you require Christ’s intervention in your life, say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, remove whatever barrier between me and Your Word. Grant me the grace to read and act on Your Word, live by Your Word and do Your Word because in Your Word, there is healing, deliverance and all of God’s blessings! In Jesus’ name!”

title: THE ATTITUDE THAT ATTRACTS SUCCESS
text:
Every human has a purpose in life and God, as the Loving Father that He is, wants us all to discover that purpose and, of course, fulfil it. He wants you to progress, succeed and be saved through the glorious plan He has for your life, and at the same time, He wants to save others through you. However, God wants you to succeed, but to succeed with a purpose! When your purpose is clear, it is easier to plan your success with God’s help, because the Lord honours the people that plan!



If you are successful today, do not forget that we were created for the glory of God! Therefore, everything we do should honour Jesus Christ! The way you speak, the way you think, the way you act and your overall behaviour should honour Jesus Christ. The Word of God urges us to do so in 𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟒:𝟏𝟏, “𝐈𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐝𝐨 𝐬𝐨 𝐚𝐬 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝. 𝐈𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐝𝐨 𝐬𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐬, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭. 𝐓𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫. 𝐀𝐦𝐞𝐧”. 



If you want to fulfil God’s purpose for your life, start obeying this instruction. Start having the behaviour of a  winner today; the behaviour that attracts the blessings of God!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, I glorify You and praise You for what You are. Help me to obey Your Word and have Jesus Christ’s character so that I can come closer to fulfilling Your purpose in my life every day – amen!”#Success #Purpose

title: SET THE RIGHT PRIORITIES
text:
A large percentage of people today are looking for fame, glory and wealth. We tirelessly work to get everything that this world has to offer, trying to live up to the standards set by society and we end up forgetting what really has priority in our lives.



What if you have the best car, the best house and the best job? Man continues to search for outer beauty, splendour and prestige; yet all that glitters is not gold!



As children of God, we should first aim to grow in our spiritual life and then in other areas of our lives. In fact, Jesus Christ states in 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝟖: 𝟑𝟔-𝟑𝟕, “𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝, 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐟𝐞𝐢𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐥? 𝐎𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐥?”.



In other words, the Word of God urges us to set the right priorities and not to spend our lives on things that have no eternal value. The Word of God urges us to prosper in our spiritual life, because if we do not prosper in our spiritual life and we seem to prosper in some other areas it is dangerous; satan will enslave us. We must not forget that heavenly treasures are the only ones that will remain for eternity. Thus, if we all obey the will of God, and walk in His ways, after we have endured, we will receive the crown of victory, which the Lord promised to those who love Him.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the maturity that comes from Your Spirit to always recognise what really has priority in my life. May I from now on spend my life only on things that have real and eternal value, in the name of Jesus Christ!#Priorities #SpiritualLife

title: SIN’S ANTIDOTE
text:
Sin regarded in the heart spoils the comfort of God’s grace and ruins the success of our prayers. It means, sin is a barrier, a reproach, a wall between the promises of God and us. We are on one side in need of healing, deliverance and all of God’s blessings while Jesus Christ our Saviour is on the other side offering all the good things – healing, deliverance, etc. Prophet T.B. Joshua says that when a Christian sins, fellowship is broken but he does not lose his place as a son. Your seat is still there; all you need to do is to realise your wrong doings, confess them and never return to them again. 



As Christians, our sins (wrongs) should make us see the need for God the more. That is, the more we sin, the more we feel that weakness and the more we fast and pray. Thus, what satan aimed at to separate us from God has brought us even more closer to God. The case of Apostle Paul in that Book of Romans 7:14 is a typical example of how children of God should respond when they miss the mark. He admitted his weakness saying, “What I really wanted to do, I do not do, but what I hate is what I find myself doing.” Brethren in the Lord, remember sin is a spiritual thing and should be handled spiritually. 



The Book of Psalms 51:1 – end tells us of how King David dishonoured himself in order to receive God’s mercy and forgiveness. The Bible says that every time David sinned against God, he removed his coat of kingship and put on a sackcloth to demonstrate how sorry he was. Prophet T.B. Joshua says, “A Christian can make a bad mistake but the difference between us and the people out there is that we always want to be forgiven each time we sin and the guilt of our sin will not let us rest until we ask and receive forgiveness.” The man of God also says that the antidote to the poison of sin is to walk in the Spirit. This means that the antidote to the poison of sin is REPENTANCE. 



SAY THIS PRAYER: I was baptised into Christ and I died when He died, sin’s power over me – be broken, in Jesus’ name! Oh Holy Spirit, help me to do what is right at all times, even if it is contrary to what I naturally want to do.

title: Prophet TB Joshua Is Living On In Our Hearts As Our Rallying Point
text:
Prophet TB Joshua



Sunday, June 5, 2022, will mark the first anniversary and celebration of the life and time of the Founder of the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN), Prophet TB Joshua. He passed away on Saturday, June 5, 2021, just seven days before his 58th birthday. On any human scale, it would have been an immeasurable loss to the Church, the family, the devastating disciples and followers, and the national and international communities. Even Arigidi Akoko, his home town couldn’t believe he could die. Hence His Royal Highness, the Saki of Arigidi, declared all markets and shops to close immediately on hearing the news.



Less than a year after, SCOAN, led by the Prophet’s wife, Mama Evelyn Joshua, is moving on because the cause for which TB Joshua has come to represent does not allow for mourning or to be sorrowful about.  His life can only be celebrated because it is a life devoted entirely to the service of God and humanity, and such that people can see Christ in action. He made the mission of Jesus easier and clearer for people to appreciate. He would dress simply, and mingle freely and humbly with people. His teachings are simple, Biblical, and relate to everyday life without unnecessary ceremonies or rituals. We see Jesus Christ in him. No wonder his wife could step in as if nothing has happened because of the openness and sincerity of the purpose of the original mission. It is a celebration of the life of a worthy prophet of God with a mission. Therefore we are less sad. In all this God has a purpose in everything and unto God, we commit everything including each soul. We must all join our faith together as one united in Christ, to pray for the perfection of what God has started in SCOAN, even under the leadership of Evelyn Joshua.



As we celebrate this great prophet of our time we equally remember not just the SCOAN in Lagos but every offshoot and work of TB Joshua. In particular, we remember every disciple that learned under the prophet, praying for a renewed, fresh and abundant anointing on them and their ministries. Prophet TB Joshua had crusades around the world. Our prayers also go to those who through this crusade activity gave their lives to Jesus. The goal of Prophet TB Joshua is that Jesus must be honoured as the kingdom of God expands on earth. Also that everyone will come to the saving knowledge of Jesus Christ through the Word demonstrated in deliverance, prophecy, healing, teaching and compassionate giving. Prophet TB Joshua’s disciples will do well to let love lead them and be guided by the Word of God every moment, even in this perilous time. Jesus has promised to send the Promise of the Father to clothe us with power from above, (Luke 24:49). May you receive the fullness of the Holy Ghost Power in your daily life.



Just as we believe that the life of Prophet TB Joshua was to fulfil God’s mission even so we individually must wait on God our heavenly father to send us out on our divine missions. Meanwhile, TB Joshua will remain a rallying point for many Christians around the globe from now to eternity. This alone is a major reason for celebration. Unless we are blessed, favoured and given from above no Christian leader can achieve this status Prophet TB Joshua has achieved. Apostle John said it better when he said, “A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven”, (John 3:27). Therefore we shall continually rejoice and celebrate all the memory we have had knowing Temitope Balogun Joshua. It has been a big privilege having first-hand contact and knowledge about him. Yet the best is yet to come to SCOAN or any of his offshoot ministries.



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria

title: THE ONLY OPINION THAT MATTERS
text:
As we look back at our lives, every one of us can remember specific points when we were bullied by someone. People have a tendency to look at someone’s weakness and use it to attack them and make them feel inferior. But, the fact that man mocks and belittles your ideas does not change who you are in the sight of God.  People judge based on outward appearance, but God judges one’s heart!



We see a perfect example of this in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟕:𝟐𝟗-𝟑𝟏 when Jesus Christ was mocked right before they crucified Him, “[…] ‘𝐇𝐚𝐢𝐥, 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐉𝐞𝐰𝐬!’ 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐟𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐤 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧 […] 𝐀𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 […] 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐡𝐢𝐦.”. What people do not understand, they call names, and what they understand, they destroy! What people did not know is that by crucifying Jesus Christ, they were actually helping Him fulfil God’s purpose!



Therefore, remember that as a child of God, no matter what you go through, you are created for a special purpose, and everything happening in your life is to help shape you into a useful vessel in His hands. Hence, the mockery of others is a clear sign of the greatness that lies ahead. So, take heart and rejoice, because God is the One that holds the world in the palm of His hand and the only opinion that matters at the end of the day is His!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to always remember that no matter what people say, the only opinion that truly matters is Yours. May you strengthen my heart so that I won’t be influenced by other people’s opinions about me because I know that You have created me for greatness – amen!”#GodsOpinion #WhatMatters

title: A CONTENT LIFE
text:
No one can be content without God. Some people have money and positions but they lack contentment. This proves that wisdom in the practical sense of ability cannot guarantee your desired future. A contented life comes by grace. When the grace of God comes upon you, it will put an end to all your labours and personal struggles. When it is time for God to manifest in your life, there would be a driving force that would change your actions and location. 



It is the mind of God to answer prayers even when He seems not to respond immediately to our petition, He is still saying something. As Christians, we are told to ask for wisdom, healing and blessings but let us ask in faith without wavering. This is because God dwells in our hearts through faith. When the eyes of your faith are opened, you will know the value of your trials. Your prayers of many years are not lost. No matter the situation you are going through you must have it in your heart to bless God. As you trust and obey God, may the Holy Spirit dwell in your heart, may you have a contented life that will bring peace and comfort to your spirit, soul, and body in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: 𝐇𝐎𝐖 𝐓𝐎 𝐎𝐕𝐄𝐑𝐂𝐎𝐌𝐄
text:
Holding an offence against someone hinders and handicaps us from fulfilling our full potential. When you focus on who has offended you, you let offence get the best of you, and thus, you are at the mercy of your emotions, losing touch and communion with God. Yet, when you forgive and let go of offence, something will happen to you that cannot be explained by the natural mind!



In 𝐄𝐜𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝟕:𝟗 we read, “𝐃𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐥𝐲 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐫 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐚𝐩 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐨𝐨𝐥𝐬”. From this, we understand that offence is a characteristic of a foolish person, who very easily becomes subject to it. But if we want to overcome our daily challenges, we first of all have to realise how satan entraps us with the trap of offence!



At the time of His crucifixion, instead of Jesus holding an offence in His heart, he said, “𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠!” (𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐𝟑:𝟑𝟒). Therefore, let us follow His example so that we may live a meaningful and joyful life, where we can overcome, with the Lord on our side.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, take more of my offence and give me more of Your love so that I can forgive those who have hurt me – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Offence #LetItGo

title: DO YOU BUILD OR DESTROY?
text:
Just as builders can either build or tear down a building, our words can either build people up or pull them down! How many times have you been too quick to speak, resulting in hurting someone or regretting your words? How often do the words you speak edify and benefit others?



The Word of God, in 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟗, emphasizes the following: “[…] 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐜𝐤 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧, 𝐬𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐤 […]”. We need the Holy Spirit in order to have wisdom and discernment in every conversation we have. If you rush to speak without first listening to what others have to say, you can easily become the architect of a bad situation!



Therefore, beware of your words! Start speaking words that will benefit, develop, grow and build up the people around you, and you will see that God will not be slow to transform your own life either!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I read Your Word, fill my heart so that out of it beneficial words may come forth. Thus, I may build up the people around me, instead of pulling them down – in Jesus’ name, amen!”#BuildPeopleUp #PullingDown

title: A CHRISTIAN’S RESPONSE
text:
Genesis 45: 4 -5 says, “And Joseph said to his brothers, ‘Please come near to me.’ So they came near. Then he said: ‘I am Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt. But now, do not therefore be grieved or angry with yourselves because you sold me here; for God sent me before you to preserve life. Joseph had reasons he did not yield to Potiphar’s wife’s temptation, give in to despair in the barren pit or lose hope in the filthy prison. He considered who he was, a covenant child – a child with a promise of God.



A child of destiny knows he is one with a difference. He always knows that here is the market and home is in Heaven. Joseph was a child of destiny and that was why when he was in the dry pit, he said to himself, ‘This is not where I belong’. A child of promise knows where he belongs. If you know where you belong, you would not allow anything to overwhelm you, manipulate you, dictate your direction or influence your response negatively. You would stay focused on the divine course of God for your life and continue to run the straight race through God’s good grace. Remember that many people occupying powerful positions all over the world were singled out for success because of how they responded to the many attacks, insults and opposition they received.



If Joseph had been overwhelmed by his situation in the dry pit, he would have given in to despair. If he had been overexcited at the good treatment he received in the house of Potiphar, he would have given in to pleasure and pride. In other words, his dream would have died in him. Don’t let your dream die within you. There is something far more important than your present situation – your dream and goals in life.



PRAYER: Ask Jesus Christ to help you run the straight race through His good grace!

title: THE GREATEST COACH
text:
People involved in sports like football always have a coach that gives them instructions, shows them the way, provides correction, advises them, encourages them to work harder and is willing to do whatever is needed for them to succeed. In the same way, we too, as children of God, must make our Lord Jesus Christ our life’s Coach, if we want to see His hand working in our lives!



In the book of 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐬 𝟗:𝟔, we see how Jesus played the role of a coach in Paul’s life and with one simple instruction,“𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐩 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐨 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐝𝐨”, He transformed His entire life for good! From that day on, Saul, later named Paul, made our Lord his Coach and he began to make things happen! Paul’s thinking changed, his attitude towards life changed, and everything about him changed! That is because when Jesus becomes your Coach, you will be asked to see what is not yet seen, to do what is not yet done, to say what is not yet said! So run to Jesus Christ so that you can receive the greatest training through His teachings, and you will see your life change 180 degrees!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I will commit myself to Your Word and make You my life’s Coach from this day forward! I know that as I do so, the sky will be my limit, in the name of Jesus Christ!”#LifeCoach #JesusChrist

title: The Harvest is Plenty But the Labourers are Few
text:
The of Prophet TB Joshua Legacy Lives On



We read in Luke Chapter 10: 1-2 how Jesus appointed seventy disciples and sent them two by two to go into every city and place He would come. Jesus said o them, “The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray ye, therefore, the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest”. This was the Lord Jesus Christ’s grand work. Jesus is bringing both physical and spiritual restoration to this dying and decaying world. As a worker in the field, it is necessary first to be transformed so that we can participate in Jesus’ work of salvation.



Jesus has explained these concepts clearly in Matthew (13:38-39). Jesus explains that the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the kingdom, and the tares are the children of the wicked one. The enemy that sowed tares is the devil. The harvest is the end of the world and the reapers are the angels.



The Prophet TB Joshua, Founder of the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN), and our celebrant of June 5th have been one of the Labourers sent out to work in the field. His impact, his teaching and how he has fought gallantly with the enemy of God that is sowing tares around, is what we are celebrating. It is necessary also for each labourer to look inward and depend solely on God’s Promise of the Holy Spirit and the Sword of the Spirit. Jesus is sending us out but Jesus is coming behind us too. He isn’t leaving us alone. There is no place for laziness, complacency, or relying on resources outside Jesus’ provision. On some occasions, Jesus says we shouldn’t take anything extra but at other times to put on the whole armour of God, (Ephesians 6:11).



As we mark the First Anniversary of our beloved Prophet TB Joshua, (maybe as his wife, children, those who learned under him for several years, those he was able to touch in one way or so, those who merely follow him on Emmanuel TV and Partners, even his critics and adversaries), let us not forget to work sufficiently hard in God’s harvest field. TB Joshua was an effective pastor, prophet, church leader, preacher, and a man filled with the Holy Ghost. Any other Church, different from SCOAN, would have been fortunate to have him lead their congregation. He was able to bring Jesus into action and he contributed to the harvest. Unfortunately, the right workers are still very few indeed today. We ask the Lord of the harvest to send out workers into His harvest field.



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria

title: THE LEGACY LIVES ON
text:
Just a year has passed since the departure of the great Prophet and Spiritual father, Prophet TB Joshua. The God-sent servant of our Lord came to this world with a mission, which he fulfilled! As he used to say, “One life for Christ is all I have; one life for Him is so dear!”.



What a privilege! What an honour! What an undeserving grace to taste the glory of God in its majesty through the teachings and heavenly wisdom of Prophet TB Joshua! In a world where darkness and despair dominate the souls of men, the prophet of God brought the fire of the Holy Spirit and was used as a useful tool in the hands of God Almighty, in order to return the hearts of men back to their Creator!



High ranked demons and legions, unclean spirits and curses bowed down at the mention of Jesus’ mighty name from the lips of His anointed servant! We all witnessed and tasted this special power of God for many years at Prophet T. B. Joshua’s ministry, the Synagogue, Church Of All Nations in Lagos, Nigeria.



An inconceivable joy fills our hearts in the memory of the legacy he has left behind! In memory of his love, his determination, his offer to the whole world! Even though our Prophet has returned to the Lord, his powerful words, his resounding presence and his holy example will continue to live, because he planted seeds of spirit and truth in millions of lives! Among them, in fact, are people whom the Lord set to learn under him and continue to have the fire of revival lit. The spiritual heirs! Those in whom he invested day and night, in order to spread the truth of the Gospel throughout the world and to unborn generations!



From the bottom of our hearts we thank God Almighty for His prophet in our generation! On this day, we honour prophet TB Joshua for his divine mission, his beneficial work, the eternal Word he preached, and for the millions of lives he brought to light. May the memory of his departure always remind us of a loving relationship with God, as he taught us that, “Nothing will keep us on course like a deep love for the Lord!”.



In memory of the Prophet of all nations, Prophet T. B. Joshua!#TheLegacyLivesOn #ProphetTBJoshua

title: BOTHER CHRIS TRIBUTE TO PROPHET TB JOSHUA
text:
MY TRIBUTE TO PROPHET TB JOSHUA – BROTHER CHRIS



A famous poet once wrote:“Lives of great men all remind usWe can make our lives sublime,And, departing, leave behind usFootprints on the sands of time.”



➡️ One year ago, God summoned His servant Prophet TB Joshua to come home and rest. ➡️ One year ago, he closed his eyes to all things in this wicked world and opened them in a world of eternal glory.  ➡️ One year ago, one of God’s Generals of our generation left his beautiful footprints on the sands of time.



As the Prophet Isaiah said in Isaiah 52:7 – “How beautiful on the mountain are the feet of those who bring Good News, who proclaim peace, who bring good tidings, who proclaim salvation.”



And though he sleeps, he still speaks (Hebrews 11:4). By faith, he still speaks! 



I know the term ‘Man of God’ has been watered down in today’s society when compared to what we read in the Bible. But if ever such words were to appropriately describe someone in our generation today, it would be Prophet TB Joshua – a real MAN OF GOD! Not a religious man, a traditional man or a materially-minded man. A man driven by conviction, not convention.



➡️ A trailblazer and a torchbearer➡️ Accessible but untouchable➡️ Tested by the fire of life and proven by the test of time



A man who rekindled the flame of practical Christianity, who made the Bible come alive, who demonstrated the union of the Word and the Spirit. A man I have the privilege to call my mentor, my role-model, my hero in Christ. 



There are so many things I could say in honour of Prophet TB Joshua. I could talk about: – his deep compassion for people– his wise, weighty counsel– his keen sense of humour– his steely, unwavering determination– his simple humility – his firm, fiery discipline– his inspiring words that went like an arrow straight to your heart – words that pricked the conscience, prompted repentance and prepared one for eternity.



But the truth is that words are simply insufficient to express all God has used (and continues to use) Prophet TB Joshua to do. So today, I will let my words be few, knowing the greatest tribute I can give is not just with my lips – but with my life. True tributes last a lifetime. 



But if I were to summarise – especially as one privileged to witness him behind-the-altar – I would say this: Prophet TB Joshua loved Jesus Christ with every fibre of his being! – That unbridled passion for the cause of Christ– That total commitment to the advancement of His Kingdom – That deep relationship with God permeated everything that had to do with him. 



This reflected in the way he handled persecution, treated trouble, managed people, used resources, conducted affairs at the wonderful ministry of The SCOAN: God first before anything and everything else! 



People often talk about the miracles, signs, wonders, deliverance, healing, prophecy – but the level of anointing flowing through Prophet TB Joshua simply reflected the level of his sacrifice for the Kingdom of God. His great love for God made him great – and such greatness outlives, outlasts generations.



I count myself privileged to be one among the millions who God used Prophet TB Joshua to change – to bring me to a closer relationship with God. I am eternally grateful and will ever acknowledge his enormous role in my life.

title: WHAT MATTERS TO YOU?
text:
Most people nowadays are looking for a friend, a companion, someone to understand them, but above all to emphasise mostly on their strengths and how good or charismatic they are. The reason people want to be accepted by those around them is the fact that they do not seek a relationship with the Creator of Heaven and earth. They do not care to know our Heavenly Father’s point of view on their own lives, and therefore, they pay more attention to what others have to say about them.



However, the opinion that should mean more to us is that of God! As true followers of God, we have to seek a true relationship with Him, because when you have a relationship with God, you change and become a person who is directed by the Heavenly Father and not by the influence of others. 



In 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟏𝟒𝟑:𝟏𝟎, king David said, “𝐓𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐝; 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐥𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝”.



It is meaningless to seek recognition and guidance from the people around you, as they are also confused and do not know where they are going. The Word of God is the only tool that has the ability to guide you. Do not wait for a more convenient day to put Jesus Christ in the centre of your heart and make His Word the standard for your life. Learn more about Him and when you do, you will see your life change!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, open the eyes of my faith so that I can see what I really need to live for You. Guide my steps, so that Your will may be done in my life and not mine – in Your name I pray, amen!”#WhatMatters #GodsOpinion

title: Nigeria 2023 Election: TB Joshua’s Prophecy Concerning APC, PDP (VIDEO)
text:
When God speaks, the wise listen. Arguably, the leading prophetic voice in Nigeria to date is Prophet T.B. Joshua. Interestingly, though sleeping in the Lord, his Prophetic messages are still potent.



In a throwback video released online and obtained from the BOLD MISSION page, the Prophet has already given a sure prophetic warning concerning the current political situation in Nigeria. In the trending video, the clergy whose transition to glory clocked one on Sunday, June 5th, 2022 predicted there will be a leadership tussle regarding who will be the Presidential candidate of the ruling party, APC



He also gave a Prophetic message for the Opposition party, PDP. Except….



This is a message for Nigeria. There will be a leadership tussle on who will lead and who will be the Presidential candidate in the APC and this will affect APC as a Political Party.
