They should be vigilant. Many are not part of them but they are with them. I repeat again. They should be vigilant. Many are not part of them but they are with them. That is, many are with them in flesh but not with them in spirit. They should be vigilant. It’s a culture, when they hear this, work on it and pray about it. At last, the PDP will pay any price to unite. They will pay any price to unite. I don’t know the price that they will pay but this is what God showed me. That is about PDP.



This area is concerning me and concerning you and is very sensitive. Listen to that: Many of the key leaders of political parties will go down. What will happen will result in the correction of the corruption situation in Nigeria. Many corrupt leaders will go down. The beginner is not the owner but the finisher!

title: OUR SHIELD
text:
As human beings, we all go through various trials and challenges in our daily lives. Many times, however, these trials and challenges test our character and our faith, causing us to be filled with anger, sadness or even bitterness. In the midst of the situations we face, we often tend to forget that our battle is not against flesh and blood, but principalities and powers that cause tension and pressure in our lives. Thus, if we want to have the conviction that Jesus Christ is fighting for us in the spirit, we must devote time to His Word in order to know Him better!



The Word of God particularly states in 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟏𝟖:𝟑𝟎, “𝐀𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝, Η𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐞𝐜𝐭: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝’𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐥𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬; Η𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐥𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐠𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐇𝐢𝐦”. Are you still fighting alone? The Word of God assures you that He is your shield against the dark forces of darkness! So, engage your heart with the Word of God you have read attentively, slowly and repeatedly, and it will begin to influence your conduct and character. 



As you read His Word as if your life depends on it, your heart will be protected from every temptation and arrow of the enemy!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, as I engage my heart with whatever pleases You, fill me with Your Word, so that it becomes my defence, shield and response to the forces of darkness – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen! “#EngageYourHeart #YourShield

title: A PROPHET WAS BORN ON JUNE 12,1963
text:
𝐀 𝐏𝐑𝐎𝐏𝐇𝐄𝐓 𝐖𝐀𝐒 𝐁𝐎𝐑𝐍 𝐎𝐍 𝐉𝐔𝐍𝐄 𝟏𝟐, 𝟏𝟗𝟔𝟑



In the book of 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟖:𝟐𝟎, Jesus assures us that He will always be with us to the very end of the age! Fulfilling His promise, God Almighty keeps sending His anointed ones to change lives, change nations and change the world today! We glorify the name of the Lord for sending a prophet to the world on June 12, 1963! His imprint on this world will forever be remembered and admired!



Indeed, adopting a life-style that is on purpose provides an opportunity to enrich others by leaving your imprint in a positive way!#AProphetWasBorn #TBJoshua

title: FOCUS ON YOUR BRIGHT FUTURE
text:
God has taken every believer’s future and placed it as an image, as a portrait in their heart. Thus, each believer has the responsibility to discover that calling, as well as take the decision to walk in it. But what happens when our unworthy past and the difficulties we have faced, have started to make the image of our future fade?



The Word of God gives us a clear answer in  𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟑:𝟏𝟒 where it states, “𝐈 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐭𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐳𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬”. 



This verse urges all Christians to look ahead, where the divine reward of God is! The time for you to start building a close relationship with God has come. When you start to do so, you will be directed by the Heavenly Father and you will learn to look forward, letting go of anything that doesn’t glorify God from your past. It is by looking forward that you discover new things, new horizons and new opportunities you would not have ordinarily dreamed of!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to leave my past behind and keep my vision, goal and mission in the forefront of my mind. I know that this is the only path that leads to success – in Your holy name I pray, amen!”#BrightFuture #KeepYourVision

title: WHAT ARE YOU CONFESSING?
text:
Sometimes in life, you will find yourself in a situation where you can’t find a solution or someone to help, whether you look to the right or left. Life might become so difficult that you lose faith in everything you’ve come to rely on. I have some wonderful news for you that will help you turn your position around today and transform your life in a significant way. The God of Joseph wants to elevate you from servitude to kingship. He is the God of David, who can help you defeat all of your foes. He is the God of Solomon, who wants to turn your poverty into wealth. Remember to take your position in the believer’s authority when you are confronted with a difficult situation that threatens your trust in God.



Failure, sickness, disease, setback and disappointment will continue to plague you as long as you continue to confess them. When you are glorifying your problems above your Heavenly Father, you are destroying your confidence in God’s Word. Never allow your situation and challenges dictate the direction of your confession. It is time to change your confession. You should talk good health and not sickness because the Bible says in Isaiah 53:5, “By His wounds, I am healed.” You should talk victory instead of defeat because the Bible says in 1 John 4:4, “Greater is He that is in me than the one who is in the world.”



If you believe God for your miracle, say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, give me the joy and peace of walking with You. Give me the grace to act and dwell in Your Word. Let me feel your presence in every area of my life and grant me an overcoming spirit, in Jesus’ name!”

title: ASK FOR FORGIVENESS
text:
In the past, during the time of Moses, whenever people sinned before God, animal sacrifices were required so that their sins could be forgiven. But through the sacrifice of Jesus Christ, God made a new covenant with men, through which anyone who comes before Him in an attitude of repentance, having acknowledged his mistake, Jesus Christ is ready to forgive them and wash out their iniquity! 



What is your approach each time you make a mistake? Our failure to admit our wrong prevents our harmony with God, thereby creating an invisible barrier between us and God.



If you desire to be in unity with God, then confess your sins and run to Jesus Christ for forgiveness, because “𝐈𝐟 𝐰𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬, 𝐇𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐮𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐮𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐮𝐧𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬”, according to 𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏:𝟗. Thus, if you realise that you need forgiveness, open your heart and pray!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Oh, Holy Spirit, I know that I am a sinner. Come into my heart, wash me with Your precious blood, save my soul today. My Savior, thank Υou for my salvation – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#JesusSaves #Salvation

title: THE POWER OF PRAYER!
text:
As long as we live in this world it is impossible not to experience pain, sadness and incidents that cause us discontentment. It is these situations that make us doubt our faith, our relationship with God and His ability to help us. 



God never promised in His Word that we will not face challenges and temptations. In the book of 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟏𝟏𝟔:𝟑,  the Word of God mentions, “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐡 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐦𝐞; 𝐈 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐛𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐰. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐈 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝…”. We see king David taking refuge in prayer as a means of comfort and healing amid the hardships he was facing! From this example, we learn a great lesson; when we are afflicted with a thorn in our flesh, we should give ourselves to prayer!



So, if you still have not found a way out of the troubles you are going through, do not waste any more time! Start praying and see what will happen! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, right now, I bring all my problems to Your feet. Comfort me in my hurting and relieve my pain – in Your name I pray, amen!”#PrayerLife #Changes

title: LOVR IS THE REAL MEASURE OF SPIRITUALITY
text:
God is love. The scripture makes us understand that there are three things on this earth that will last: faith, hope and love – the greatest is love. This shows that love is the greatest Christian virtue. If love is the greatest, it means faith cannot work without love and also hope cannot work without love. The power of faith will be short-circuited. (John14:27) Jesus said my peace I give to you not as the world gives. It means there are two kinds of love: God’s love and human love. Human love is but a shadow of God’s love; God’s love is for salvation sake.



Many of us have rejected our prospective helpers because of our inability to see beyond the situation at hand. The Bible is talking about the love that never gives up. Love that can put up anything, love that is tolerant. Love keeps going to the end, no matter the challenges and difficulties. If you know the weakness of your friend, help him instead of rejecting him. Who knows if he will be your helper tomorrow. The first place you should look into when you seem not to hear from God is your love walk. You are created to change somebody. You may not be qualified to help every person you meet today but somebody needs what you possess. There is no love that does not express itself in giving.



A Christian is known by his love. Love looks around to see who is in need, who is sick, who is worried and who is unsafe. If I speak in the tongue of angels but I don’t love others, then I am simply making noise – talking to the air. If I have faith that can move mountains but I don’t love others, then I have accomplished nothing in life. Our position in Christ Jesus is enhanced each time we help someone in trouble. Therefore, let us not love in words or in tongues but in deed and truth. Let us be known as people who are for good. I mean, we should do good to change the bad we see. People of God, if you want to grow in your spiritual life, follow the path of love because love is the real measure of spirituality.

title: NO ONE CAN SUCCEED ALONE!
text:
For the human body to function properly, every part is necessary! For example, the heart needs the lungs, the lungs need the brain and the brain needs oxygen for the human body to operate properly. Similarly, God Almighty has created the world in a way that no man can make on his own, all alone!



Our Lord Jesus Christ, knowing that He could not complete His mission alone, had His disciples with Him for three and a half years! He even advised them in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟖:𝟏𝟗-𝟐𝟎, by saying: “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐠𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, 𝐛𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐳𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐥𝐲 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐭𝐨 𝐨𝐛𝐞𝐲 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 […]”.



Thus, the Word of God makes it clear that no one can succeed alone. We depend on others to succeed in our respective calling! Therefore, look around you and find good, well-informed and inspiring people to help you succeed in your calling! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I play my part in reading Your Word daily, help me find people who will add and multiply in my life, so that I can fulfil the purpose for which You have created me – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Success #DivineCalling

title: A CHRISTIAN IS A FARMER
text:
The title “Christian” is known to have various meanings and uses in life today. One of the most important works for a child of God is the one of “farming”, which is sowing into God’s Kingdom and the lives of others. This is a guaranteed path to personal fulfilment and peace, because the law of sowing and harvesting is unchangeable, having been laid down by God from the beginning of time.



To know a happy, prosperous and successful life, we must first learn how to plant. We have to be cautious of our actions because when we plant wrong seeds, a wrong harvest will come! Our inability to acknowledge what God wants us to sow is the root cause of the unsuccessful life we experience today.



The word of God proves this to us in the book of 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟖:𝟐𝟐, “𝐀𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬, 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐬𝐭, 𝐜𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐭, 𝐬𝐮𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫, 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞”. The law of sowing and harvesting does not only change individuals’ lives, but also ultimately influences the destinies of entire societies in a positive way. 



Therefore, make the decision to take the necessary steps towards sowing the right seeds, the ones that lead to a successful future!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me sow the seed that produces the bountiful harvest I will be reaping tomorrow. May the seed I plant today create the future God has promised me – in Your mighty name, amen!”#SowingSeeds #Harvest

title: WHO IS YOUR SOURCE?
text:
John 16:33 says: “These things I have spoken to you, that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation; but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world.”



In this world of tribulation, it is very easy to get off track and take your focus off Jesus Christ. Many Christians focus on their situation instead of the one that can deliver them from it. It is true that your situation is there, yes, your situation is real but there is something more real than your situation – the potency of God’s Word. Identifying your source and trusting in it does not deny the situation but makes you focus on the one that can save you. This is because faith is not denial, it is trusting in someone who is more reliable, faithful, dependable, His name is Jesus Christ – the Son of the Living God.   



What are you facing right now? What challenge are you facing that is drawing your attention away from your Creator? Is it hardship or difficulty? The Bible says that in the face of tribulation, we must keep our focus by identifying our source. As children of God, we must acknowledge the battle the Bible talks about in Galatians 5:16-22 – the battle of the mind. This is the battle of choosing between right and wrong, your choice in this battle is your personal decision. You can complain, you can blame others but you are responsible for what you choose or give your attention to. What are the things that can make you lose focus? It is those foolish things that cause tension and pressure. Remember that no matter what was going on in Jesus’ life, He kept His focus. In the face of temptations and trials, He didn’t lose His focus, instead He kept His eyes on His Father. Like Jesus, when you know where you are going, whatever happens to you midway cannot change your focus.



The situation with you now on the outside may be poor, painful, frightening and discouraging but remember your dream – that dream should be your focus, not your present situation.



PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to continue to identify You as my source and help me to keep my dream alive, in Jesus’ name.

title: CHOOSE THE HEAVENLY REWARD
text:
It is undeniable that many people – including Christians – wish to appear generous and merciful in front of other people. They may engage in charitable acts, such as feeding the poor or helping widows and orphans. However, they often do these things with a hidden agenda, in order to receive glory and recognition from people, and not for the sake of the name of Jesus!



Indeed, the Word of God is clear on this matter. In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟔:𝟐-𝟒, the Word of God characteristically states: “𝐒𝐨 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐲, 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐦𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐬, 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐲𝐩𝐨𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐝𝐨 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐲𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐨𝐠𝐮𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐭𝐬, 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐬. 𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐥𝐲 𝐈 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐲, 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐞𝐟𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐭. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐭, 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮”.



From these verses, we understand that whoever seeks to receive glory from men has already received their reward. Our help should come from a place of sincere and selfless love, so that we can receive God’s blessings. Because the blessings of the world enrich the body temporarily, while the blessings of Christ enrich the soul for eternity.



🙏Prayer: “Heavenly Father, I know that a Christian is known by their love. Forgive me if my heart has not been pure before You, and show me how I can help my neighbour with genuine willingness and humility, so that Your name may be glorified, in the almighty name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#HeavenlyReward #GodsLove

title: WHAT REALLY MATTERS!
text:
Jesus Christ never promised that following Him is a bed of roses. That decision requires commitment, faith, patience and perseverance. But the question that confounds a large percentage of Christians today is whether it is ultimately worth the pain, trials, and temptations we face as we walk down the road to salvation. What if we fail to see the face of God in the end?



The Word of God, which has the answer to any question a Christian may have, says in 𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟑:𝟐, “𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐬, 𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐧. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬, 𝐰𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐬 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬”.



Therefore, if you have doubted or been unsure whether it is worth serving God or not, Jesus Christ tells you today that it is worth believing God even when every sense contradicts Him because He has promised to honour those who honour Him!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me overcome my doubt, fill me with faith that moves mountains! I know that one day, by Your grace and mercy, I will see Your face. Thus, I will continue to seek You and worship You until we meet! In Your name we pray, amen!”#GodsFace #UntilWeMeet

title: LOVE CONQUERS ALL
text:
One of the most important principles that Jesus Christ taught us is to care for one another and help those in need. But what should we do with people who don’t seem to be behaving very well towards us? Should we love them and care for their well-being?



In 𝐍𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝟏𝟒:𝟒-𝟓 we see the attitude of Moses when the people of Israel rebelled against God, him and Aaron. Specifically, the Word of God states: “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐧 𝐟𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥”. 



Although the Israelites wanted to stone Moses and Aaron, they both began to plead with God for the people, knowing that their lives were at risk. They knew that regardless of the people’s behavior toward them, they had to make sure that God’s plan would be fulfilled. They did not choose to turn their backs on the people of Israel in the midst of trial because they knew that looking the other way when your brother is in trouble is equal to rejecting Christ Himself.



Moses and Aaron saved the people from God’s wrath because they chose to show love! Their attitude is an example that we should always love our enemies, bless those who curse us and do good to those who hate us, because love conquers all!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, help me to use Your ways and Your love to help my enemies. May Your commandments be engraved on my heart forever, in Your name I pray, amen!#LoveWins #LoveEveryone

title: SUCCESS IS FOUND WITHIN US
text:
Many people today sleep and wake up with the hope that their life will suddenly change. They think that something will suddenly happen and put them in the position of success and prosperity they always dreamed of. Unfortunately, however, this rarely happens… That fact should not worry us or impress us, because God’s Word repeatedly reminds us that life does not just happen to us. It is all about choices and how we respond to every situation.



This is also confirmed in the parable of the talents in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟓:𝟏𝟒-𝟑𝟎 “[…] 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐛𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞. 𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞, 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦”. In other words, instead of waiting for a huge change to come out of nowhere, let us focus on now and what we have in our hands at the moment! 



Our lives cannot drastically change until we change something we do every day! So, let us start working and investing in our future today so that one day we can reap what we have desired and worked for! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give us the opportunity to sow good seeds, and as we do, multiply them back into our lives – in your holy name we pray, amen!”#SowGoodSeeds #Success

title: How To Honor Jesus
text:
Jesus’ name must be honored. How can Jesus’ name be honored? John 6:63 says, “The spirit gives life, the flesh counts for nothing, the word I have spoken to you they are full of the spirit and life”. Christ and the Word are One. John 6 verse 65 says, “He went on to say this is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the father enabled them”. You can’t just wake and say, I am going to Jesus. You must be enabled and energized. This means that for Jesus’ name to be honored, two things must meet – the Spirit and the Word. It is not just to be born of the Word but you must be born of the Spirit. The Word refreshes our mind while the Spirit renews our strength. It is not just to say be healed; it must be spirit and life. The power of God must go through the Word and the Spirit. The Word of God must dominate your heart.



How can the Word dominate you? The Word dominates us through meditating, obeying, and acting on it. Meditating on the Word is a visit with God. Anyone can say,” Thank You Jesus after a miracle, but not everybody can say Thank You, Jesus, before the miracle”. It takes faith to say Thank You, Jesus. Note that faith is expecting Jesus to do what He promised to do. God’s Word has priority over His name. By His Word, we are saved. If you don’t have God’s Word, you have nothing at all and you can’t bring Jesus on the scene.



Do you want to be like Jesus? The Holy Spirit is our guide. You need faith to follow Him. God’s Word is Spirit. It has the ability to quicken us spiritually. Only faith pleases Jesus. The righteous shall live by faith. (Romans 1:17) He who comes to God must believe and have faith. When you pay attention to God’s Word, you will find out that faith comes spontaneously. We need to meditate on God’s Word and turn it over and over again in our hearts. People of God, note that when our spirit acts on God’s Word, it forms faith and that will help you to honor God before your situation.

title: THE PURPOSE OF TRIALS
text:
Our Lord Jesus Christ was unjustly tortured, nailed to a cross, and rejected even by His own disciples! In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟕:𝟑𝟎-𝟑𝟏, we read: “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐟𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐤 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧. 𝐀𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐨𝐟𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐜𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐦. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐡𝐢𝐦”.



Jesus knew that His trial, though painful, hurtful, and brutal, served one purpose: to open the way of salvation for anyone who believes in Him! Do you know the purpose of the trials you are going through? In the Word of God, we also read that all things work together for good to those who love God. 



Therefore, your trial is not to destroy you, but to take you to a new level in life! A time of testing is a time to strengthen one’s relationship with God. So, when you know the purpose of your trial, you will be able to endure, confident that God is in control. That is how you will overcome, just like our hero, Jesus Christ! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to remember in every situation, that everything in my life is for a purpose. Give me the grace to overcome and to glorify Your Holy Name with my life. Amen!”#Trials #PurposeOfTrials

title: PERSEVERANCE IN PRAYER
text:
Every believer knows that prayer is essential for a vivid and deep relationship with God. Through prayer, we express our love and thanksgiving to the Lord and make our requests known to Him. However, many Christians today, though they pray to God to intervene in their case, find it difficult to believe that God hears them and also wants to answer their prayers – as long as they are in accord with His will.



Jesus Christ, leaving zero space for doubt, says in 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝟏𝟏:𝟐𝟒 “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐈 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐬𝐤 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫, 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐭, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬”. 



It is God’s desire to bless His children with every heavenly blessing. Therefore, when you pray, your prayer should be followed by absolute confidence in God that He is working out the answer to your prayer! In other words, if an answer is not given for the first prayer nor to the second, we must hold on and hold out till we receive an answer.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, I ask you to work in me and fill me with faith so that I may no longer doubt Your plans for my life, but believe that the best is always yet to come – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#DontGiveUp #ContinuePraying

title: THE MYSTERY OF GOD’S GRACE
text:
God’s grace is a mystery because it is the opposite of merit – undeserved favor. It is not something brought to pass by our power, goodness, kindness, might, holiness, natural ability, and skill. Remember, all is of grace because all our spiritual advantages are from God. Therefore, all boasting is excluded. The Bible says that no one is righteous, not even one, and if we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us. Jesus Christ knows how undeserving of His grace we are, that is why He has decided to forget our past in order to determine our future.



The case of Moses is an example of God’s grace. By His grace, God looked at Moses, a murderer, and saw in him a deliverer. This means that no one is too bad or too good to qualify for God’s grace. God Almighty is not interested in our unworthy past. Jesus Christ enters our life to put an end to our unworthy past and give birth to a glorious future. He does not want us to look back because looking back is a trap of satan; He wants us to be forward-looking. Remember that knowing God is not only seeing His works but learning His ways. You must learn to maintain the grace you have received.



God freely gives His grace to those who rely on His Word. Therefore, allow God’s Word to channel your way and never allow your situation to dictate your direction. That is the only way to receive and maintain the grace of God in your life. May the light of God continue to guide your way. May the Word of God continue to live in you, grow in you, abide in you, as you abide in it, in Jesus’ name!

title: DO THE IMPOSSIBLE
text:
As Christians, we are called to overcome the trials and challenges of life without giving up. In other words, we are called to be fearless and do the impossible with God’s help! How can we hold out and stand firm while living in a world full of challenges and temptations? How can we boldly stand for what we believe? In the book of 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟐𝟕:𝟏𝟒, the word of God states, “𝐖𝐚𝐢𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝; 𝐛𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐚𝐢𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝”.



If you always wanted to make a difference in this world but didn’t know how, if you always wanted to learn the way to stand for what you believe, but it seemed impossible, it’s time to trust in Jesus Christ. Make Him up your role model, put all your hope in God because when God is by your side, you can face the final race of life with courage!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to be perfect like You. Give me the faith that moves mountains, the strength to stand for what I believe and do what has never been done – in Your name, we pray, amen!”#ImposiblePossible #TrustInGod

title: RE-ESTABLISH YOUR PRAYER POINTS
text:
As we meditate on God’s track record in our lives, we see that He is not limited by anything. Yet, though we are made in His likeness, we many times tend to limit ourselves by not believing in God’s promises for our lives, which is sadly leaving an imprint on our prayer points. While praying, we are deeply influenced by our emotions and we, therefore, lack a sense of objectivity. We neglect to realise that asking God for a specific thing would amount to limiting God to a certain answer, whereas in 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟐𝟗:𝟏𝟏 the Word of God states, “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮,’ 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, ‘𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚 𝐟𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞”. 



Since God is faithful to His word, then we must take His Word to heart and aim high because He, indeed, has the best plans for us. So, when you pray, do not settle for less than what is promised to you as a child of the Most High! Pray for that which you never believed you could obtain in life, take God to His word and you will see where your prayers can take you!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I pray for You to help me re-establish my prayer points, so they are pleasing to You and according to Your Word. Help me obtain what You have prepared for me and pray knowing that You have more in store for me than I could ever imagine, in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#PrayerPoints #Prayer

title: DIG DEEP AND FIGHT THROUGH
text:
Romans 5:3-5 says: “And not only that, but we also glory in tribulations, knowing that tribulation produces perseverance; and perseverance, character; and character, hope. Now hope does not disappoint, because the love of God has been poured out in our hearts by the Holy Spirit who was given to us.”



As Christians, we are encouraged not to base our Christian journey on our challenges; I mean the fact that you are facing challenges does not mean you are not a friend of God. Every man that walks by faith will have testing. Those afflictions, trials, tribulations, and campaigns of calumny are for your spiritual benefit; they are meant to help you learn to pray more, trust God the more, depend on God the more, and have faith in God the more.



The Heroes and Heroines of faith never questioned why giants, obstacles, or stumbling blocks challenged their future – they simply ran to represent God on the battlefield. That you find yourself in a hard place does not mean you are not a candidate of Heaven. Stephen never questioned why stones were being hurled at him; he stood and resembled God in all He stood for. That you face an enemy as close as your mouth does not mean you are not a favourite of Heaven. Job never fainted when a wind pulled down his home; he continued to think, talk, act, plan, work, and rule with God.



Hear Jesus saying to you, in the Book of John 16:33, you who live in the world, I have given you the strength to overcome whatever comes. When discouragement comes, don’t stop; dig deep and fight it through. To His power, nothing is impossible.



PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, give me the grace to be strong, active, and alert in this realm of prayer service, in Jesus’ name!

title: THE BELIEVER’S SECRET WEAPON
text:
God has given His children many “weapons” to deal with every problem, every situation or obstacle comes before them as they walk the path of salvation. But there is a secret “weapon” given to us that acts as a driving force to help us overcome any challenge we face!



In 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟑𝟗:𝟐𝟎 we read: “𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐩𝐡’𝐬 𝐦𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐢𝐧 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐧, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠’𝐬 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐝”. Although the Lord had revealed to Joseph that his future was bright, Joseph’s imprisonment did not limit him or make him question God’s promise for his life. On the contrary, his faith in the dream that God had shown him, his vision, gave him the strength to endure the prison.



What situation are you in today? Are you experiencing sadness, disappointment, rejection? Your secret weapon as a Christian in order to overcome is your vision! Because, to a man of vision, no matter what happens, no matter what comes, there is always a future. So, if you’re looking for the “weapon” that will help you overcome every challenge that comes your way, it’s time to believe in your vision!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, impart in me a vision that will help me endure any situation! May I always remember that my future is bright, no matter what my present situation indicates – in the name of Jesus Christ we pray, amen!”#BelieveInYourVision #Dream

title: TAKE CARE OF YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD
text:
When a person trips and falls, a wound is created in the body. In order for this wound to heal, daily care and treatment are required. By the very same token, in order for us, as children of God, to be able to deal with life itself when we are “knocked down”, we need to take care of our relationship with our Creator on a daily basis!



The Word of God in 𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚 𝟏:𝟖, quotes the words of God to Moses’ servant, Joshua: “𝐊𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐁𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐚𝐰 𝐚𝐥𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐬; 𝐦𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐭 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐭. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐮𝐜𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐟𝐮𝐥”. It is important to understand that Christianity is not a religion, it is a relationship! God wants to have a daily relationship with you! The breakthrough, healing, and freedom you seek will come when you begin to nurture your relationship with God Almighty on a daily basis! For, if you take care of the depth of your relationship with God, He will take care of the breadth of your success!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I play my role by nurturing my relationship with you on a daily, take over every area of my life – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#RelationshipWithGod #AFriendOfGod

title: GO BACK TO GOD
text:
Good morning and win today. Everything in the absolute world of science and technology has fallen apart; we simply have to return to God. After we might have exhausted our strength and resources and everything proved abortive, there’s only one person that can heal us, deliver us, and give us peace of heart. It is none other than our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ.



When we are young, we believe we can go all the way without reverence to God. Some of us also thought that when we go to school and graduated and get a job, everything will be fine. Some of us also thought that if we get married and have kids, everything will surely be fine. Now we are married and have kids, yet there’s dissatisfaction in our lives. Prophet T.B. Joshua always says that until we experience God, there will be dissatisfaction in our lives, a sense of hunger to know what life is all about, and the desire to know what happens after life is over, after death.



The book of Luke 15:11-32 tells us the story of the lost son, who returned home after collecting his share of his possession from his father. He went to an unknown land and squandered it on wasteful living. The Bible says that immediately after his father saw him from afar, he had compassion on him, ran, and embraced him. This is to tell us that Jesus Christ is always ready and willing to take us back.



SAY THIS PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, I come to you as a sinner, have mercy on me, and bring me back to you.

title: SAY “NO” TO BITTERNESS!
text:
If we manage the disagreements we have with our fellow human beings properly, they can lead to greater agreement and unity. On the other hand, however, if our disagreements remain unsettled, they will only create bitterness in our hearts…



The Word of God in 𝐄𝐩𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟑𝟏-𝟑𝟐, characteristically mentions: “𝐆𝐞𝐭 𝐫𝐢𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐫, 𝐛𝐫𝐚𝐰𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫, 𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐞. 𝐁𝐞 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮”. In other words, we should not allow disagreements to breed bitterness in our hearts. Instead, we should forgive, as God forgave us!



The fact that we disagree on a certain issue should not break our union or our friendship because there is always a way out in Christ Jesus! Bitterness and unforgiveness block God’s blessings from our lives, they destroy our relationships with others and create an invisible wall between our hearts and God! So, the way to say “No” to bitterness is to remember that we need to forgive, because we also need to be forgiven too!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, strengthen my spirit so that I will be able to say “No” to bitterness. May all my disagreements lead to greater understanding – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, amen!#Bitterness #SayNo

title: THE DEFINITION OF FAITH
text:
How do we exactly define faith? How do we apply it to our lives? The definition of faith is clearly stated in 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟏:𝟏, “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐞”.



It is this firm conviction that every Christian is called upon to adopt and put into practice. But when? When you are confronted with the challenges of life! When there is no money in your wallet, no food on your table, nor health in your body. Then is the time for the child of God to proclaim that God is with them, relying on His promise that says that He will not leave us nor forsake us!



Faith is not a panic button to push only in times of trouble; it is a lifestyle of trusting in God! If you are waiting for something bad to happen to you in order to pray, then it may already be too late! On the contrary, faith is a lifestyle of trusting God, in both good and hard times alike! As we read in 𝐉𝐨𝐛 𝟒𝟐:𝟏𝟎-𝟏𝟕, it is this lifestyle that draws God’s blessings to our lives and will help us to not give up on the good race of faith, finally reach the finish line and receive the crown of glory!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, having realised that faith is not simply praying for a blessing or a breakthrough in my life, but having a steady focus on You, empower me to be fully obedient to You, thus showing the necessary faith to live a life of joy and success!”#InGodWeTrust #Faith

title: CONFESSION OF GOD’S WORD
text:
Jesus went to the mount of Olives. Now, early in the morning, He came again into the temple and all the people came to Him and He sat down and taught them. Then, the Scribes and Pharisees brought to Him a woman caught in adultery. And when they had sat her in their midst, they said to Him, ‘Teacher, this woman was caught in adultery in the very act (John 8:1-4). Then, Jesus spoke to them again saying, “I am the Light of the world; he who follows Me shall not walk in darkness but have the light of life. One cannot walk in the light when the Word does not prevail in him. When the Word doesn’t prevail in you, you will begin to confess other words. The Word of God is light. When you walk in the light, you will not walk in difficulty, sickness, or poverty. As long as you walk in your situation, you are walking in darkness. So, as a Christian, the Bible says that we are the light of the world. No matter the situation you are in; if you know you are a Christian and you have confessed Him as your Lord and personal Saviour, leave it for Him. He is in charge and He is aware.



If you are a doer of the Word, the Word will be living in your lips, just exactly as it lives in the Master’s mouth. Your word becomes God’s Word and your lips become God’s ambassador. The Word dominating you is the Lordship of Christ in you. Right now, begin to confess His Word. Confess who you are in Christ Jesus. Leave it for Him; He is in charge. The Word you speak determines the life you enjoy. So, right now, open your lips and begin to speak to your life. Defeat and failure are things of the past. Say: “Good Morning, my business; it is a new dawn! Good Morning, my career, my finances, my future, it is a new dawn!”

title: TB Joshua Designed SCOAN as an Effective Spiritual Ministry
text:
Prophet TB Joshua



 The training we received under the mentorship of Prophet T.B. Joshua, the founder of the Synagogue Church of All Nations, (SCOAN), is to teach what Jesus taught, to live how Jesus lived, and to go where Jesus went. Jesus’ teaching took men who were ordinary fishermen, tax collectors, etc., and changed them into reproductive Christians who reached their world with the Gospel in a demonstration of power. It is a great appreciation that God is using the wife of TB Joshua, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, the disciples of TB Joshua, and believers who have keyed into the ministry to organize, and mobilize themselves to achieve the goal of evangelism of Jesus.



Ephesians 4:16 emphasizes the importance of everybody doing their part.  The SCOAN ministry is for the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, and the edifying of the body of Christ. It is not a mission solely for TB Joshua who was only been a vessel used by God. Jesus remains the vine, whilst believers are the branches. Jesus said, “He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing,” (John 15:5). Let us continually abide in Jesus that we may produce the desired fruit of the spirit.



Therefore, as ambassadors of Jesus Christ, “Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for He who promised is faithful”, (Hebrew 10:23). On our own we are “fixing our eyes on Jesus, the Pioneer and Perfecta of faith, (Hebrew 12:12). We shall pray along with Pastor Evelyn Joshua and her team for God to continue to use them to do exploits for God and humanity. In SCOAN better is not good enough, the best is yet to come. It shall always be a New Down, a New Morning, in SCOAN in Jesus’ name. Only that everyone should come, looking unto Jesus the Author and Finisher of our Faith.



 Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria.

title: WHAT IS IN YOUR HANDS?
text:
Have you ever wondered how many times you have been the solution to someone’s problem? Most of the time, people help their fellow brothers in order to receive some kind of reward. But, as children of God, we should help without expectation, we should do good without expecting an equivalent response from others.



In 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟏𝟔, the Word of God mentions that God is delighted when we do what is good. More specifically, the Word of God states: “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐬𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐬𝐚𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐝”. 



Do not wait for a more convenient day to become a solution to someone’s problem! What is in your hands? Whatever is in your hands now is a solution to someone else in need! God has no hands, but your hands to do His work today! Are you ready to become a solution?  



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I begin to help other people so that their lives can move forward, help me to do what is right in Your sight, so that my life can move forward too – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#BeASolution #OfferHelp

title: A PURPOSEFUL LIFE
text:
Many people today live a life without purpose, and most of us believe that with career, financial independence, marriage, or having children, we will have the satisfaction and fulfilment we desire. We get to the point where we look at our lives and see an empty life, without having fulfilled God’s purpose for our lives. Without knowing for what purpose we were created… The answer, however, is not far from us, because the Lord, knowing that until we experience GOD, there will be dissatisfaction in our life, he characteristically mentions in 1 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟑𝟏: “𝐒𝐨 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐨𝐫 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤 𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐨, 𝐝𝐨 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝”.



In other words, God’s Word urges us to always remember that no matter what we do with our careers, no matter what our profession, our hobbies or our interests are, if we feel some inexplicable emptiness within us, it is because we have not yet discovered the primary purpose of our creation! Man was created  for the glory of God! Thus, everything we do should glorify Him who has no beginning and no end! God wants us to succeed, but He wants us to succeed with a purpose! And that purpose is to glorify His Holy name! Is God glorified through your life? It’s not too late to make a fresh start! Let us pray…



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I know that You created me for a great purpose that will glorify Your name. Help me to fulfil the purpose for which You have created me, help me to act according to Your will in every circumstance and to always have Your purpose at the forefront of my mind.”#LifePurpose #GloryOfGod

title: WHAT YOU MUST DO AS A CHRISTIAN
text:
In our relationship with God, we have our own role to play to enable Him to fulfil His promises to us. God expects us to present ourselves as willing instruments before He can dwell in us, walk with us and show us the direction to follow, as we fellowship with Him in Spirit and in truth. Walking with God in Spirit and in truth guarantees us the greatest assurance of His protection, love, blessing, peace, breakthrough, and hope.



We can only walk with God when we make His Word dominate our hearts and allow Him to direct us in life’s journey. God is a loving Father who would never lead His children astray. Although the challenges of life may sometimes appear to overwhelm us and make us think that God has abandoned us. However, we must realise that in our walk with Him, He sometimes allows us to face such challenges to strengthen our faith and belief in Him and to lead us to an expected end. As children of God, our duty is to obey God’s command while His duty is to keep His promises such was the case with Job, Martha, and Daniel; they all showed absolute faith in our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, and they demonstrated their unwavering faith in the ability of God to deliver and rescue them.



In our walk with God, for our needs to be met, we need to play our own role because God cannot do what we must do ourselves. Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, hears the voice of my cry; listen to the meditation of my heart and grant me all my petitions, in Jesus Christ’s name!”

title: YOUR CHRISTIAN IDENTITY
text:
Our identity as children of God is often times questioned and examined – those around us seek to find what it is that makes us who we are! Why do we call ourselves Christians? This speculation brings us to self-examination as children of God, to see if, indeed, we are who we say we are. In 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟑:𝟑𝟓, it says,  “𝐁𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐬, 𝐢𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫”. 



Jesus Christ does not recognise you by your name but by your love! Our love is what proves to the world our sonship and fellowship with Jesus Christ, as we follow His example: Jesus died for us while we were still enemies of God, soaked in sin! It is time to showcase the fruit of love to the world, with acts of love to those around us, those in need, and those who are lacking what we take for granted. Let love lead and as it states in 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟔:𝟑𝟓, “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐭 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐮𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝”.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I pray for you to make me a channel of love where there is hatred, a channel of light where there is darkness, and a channel of hope where there is despair – in Your Holy name I pray. Amen.”#TrueChristian #KnownByLove

title: The Holy Spirit Gives Power to Love As Jesus Loves
text:
Prophet T.B. Joshua



Many people that eventually visit the Synagogue, Church of All Nations, (SCOAN), for one reason or the other, a good percentage of them have gone through a life of brokenness and a life of emptiness. They have lived in the deep darkness of this world. They have experienced satanic oppression, depression, anxiety, and all worldly mess. In their relationships, it has mostly been chaos, heartache, sickness, betrayal, mistrust, or others. Everywhere they have gone in this world it has only been darkness and spiritually dead places.



Through the power of the Holy Spirit, they eventually encounter a prophet of God in the SCOAN.  Every Christian that has an encounter in the SCOAN, that Christian loves them with the love of Jesus. The love flowing out of Jesus is captivating, brilliant, powerful, alive, active and sharper than any double-edged sword, (Hebrews 4:12). The kind of love you find in Prophet TB Joshua, and in his SCOAN, is also refreshing and it breaks down the power of the enemy.



Truly, there is the love of God given to each believer through the Holy Spirit. That love captures every heart working in darkness, creating a magnetic force that pulls people to Christ, and consequently to freedom, abundant life and to divine breakthrough. Jesus said, “All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away”, (John 6:37). Hence, without further delay please come to Jesus today.



Prophet TB Joshua taught and believed that “Every Christian needs to be filled with the Holy Spirit”. This is a basic requirement to be an effective disciple, to live a victorious life and to love as Jesus loves. Only the Spirit of God living and active in us will prevent us from holding a grudge and have a free spirit that God can access, occupy and use. That is the favour God gives us freely and our love output is a sign that the Holy Spirit abides in us.



In his efforts to encourage believers to quest for the Holy Spirit, Prophet TB Joshua lived a sacrifice and love life. He created avenues for prayer without ceasing, distributed faith-building materials, and raised disciples that would be alive and sensitive to the nature and move of God, including his own wife, Evelyn Joshua whom we can pray along with. Without the Holy Spirit working in us, there is nothing we can do. It isn’t a big degree in theology that is essential but to be filled with the Holy Spirit so that we can do God’s will. Therefore (Ephesians 5:18), do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit.



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria

title: LIVE THROUGH YOUR SITUATION
text:
How many times has a problem that you would last forever but was eventually solved much sooner than you expected occurred in your life? Have you ever found yourself in a situation that seemed final and unchanging, and suddenly, after some time, it ended or even unexpectedly turned in your favour?  The above has happened and continues to happen to all of us because no situation is permanent! As children of God, the situations we go through are not to destroy us, but to give us valuable lessons about life and take us to a new level.



In   𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟑𝟎:𝟓 we read“[…] 𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐩𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐫𝐞𝐣𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠”.  This is a great lesson for all of us because our situation becomes easier to handle when we know it will not last long. So, as you learn these valuable lessons about life today, take heart, because the end of your situation is not far away!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:“Lord Jesus Christ, as I have received this revelation of Your Word, help me endure and not despair about every problem or situation that unexpectedly appears before me, in Your holy name I pray, amen!”#TemporaryProblems #NotPermanent

title: THE NEED FOR GOD’S WORD
text:
Hebrews 4:12 says, “For the Word of God is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, and of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.”



The name ‘Jesus Christ’ has power indeed but only among those who are committed to the glory of Heaven. The power that flows from His name, the power we will realise in calling His name, will be in proportion to our love for His Word. When that love is expressed, don’t be surprised to see things changed, loosed, or bound. As a Christian, remember that anyone who does not love cannot be entrusted with such power to heal, deliver, bless and save because he will misappropriate, or misuse it to hurt himself and others. When our spirit acts upon the Word of God, the Spirit will be released to the degree we stand in reverence of His Word. To stand in reverence of His Word is to hear His Word, not only with our ears but most importantly with our hearts.



To hear the Word of God in our hearts requires openness and hunger for God’s Word. Christ has no dwelling place in a life that is not dominated by the Word of God because the Word dominating you is the Lordship of Christ in you. The case of the seven sons of Sceva in Acts 19:14-16 shows that faith is not an imitation. It must arise in each person’s heart – this means that God will not meet you because you imitate what someone else did. God Almighty will meet you when you obey what He told you to do by His Spirit based on His Word. In other words, it is the doer of the Word that receives things from God. Therefore, as Christians, let us not only be a hearer of the Word but also a doer of the Word.



Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, grant me the grace to be not only a hearer of Your Word but also a doer of Your Word! In Your Word, there is healing, deliverance, and all of Your blessings. As I dwell in it and act in it, let Your will be done in my life, in Jesus’ name!”

title: TRIUMPH IN EVERY BATTLE!
text:
The victory of Jesus Christ is a past victory! However, how can we take His victory as our own in the present? God’s Word has taught us that he who desires triumph or victory must be ready to embrace war because triumph or victory is a product of warfare. Our Lord, Jesus Christ, during His earthly ministry, fought the enemy of our soul and overcame him once and for all, using the weapon with which the Heavenly Father equipped Him! That is none other than the Word of God! His Word in your heart will strengthen you, arm you, and protect you as you fight against your enemy. 



What is your battle today? Are you fighting with your doubts, your weaknesses, or negative thoughts? Learn today how God’s Word on your lips produces the spirit of an overcomer! While facing challenges, never confess that you can’t do it! While facing temptation, never confess that you are weak because He who conquered even death supports your position, as long as you fill  your heart with His Word daily! 



𝐃𝐞𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐦𝐲 𝟐𝟎:𝟒 “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐠𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐨 𝐟𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲”. Therefore, are you ready to overcome? Immerse yourself in the reading of His Word!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I come to meet You in Your Holy Word, so that You may fill me with it and overcome every temptation and every adversity today! Open my heart and help me to understand it and put it into practice so that I may be victorious as You are – in Your Holy Name I pray, amen!”#Victory #ReadyToTriumph

title: BREAKING NEWS – MAN OF GOD HARRY ARRESTED
text:

The reason for his arrest is that the name of Jesus Christ was preached with power that saves, heals and delivers, and this has caused the rage of the devil and his agents to be broadcasted in all the national TV stations and newspapers in Greece.

But, instead of praising God for His signs and wonders, they ridicule His divine work and understate His divine ability to heal diseases, deliver the demon-possessed and change lives for the better. The same exact thing was done in other times by those who came against the divine work of our Lord Jesus Christ, the work of the Holy Apostles, the Fathers of the Church and other spiritually blessed priests.



The supposed reason the man of God Harry and one of his close associates, Mr. Dimitris Panapakidis, was arrested is that he was operating the church without the required permit from the authorities. That is why, as you may have noticed on our church’s social media, our services were taking place at the prayer mountain for months and later on we held events at Aristotelous Square, in the city center.



Man of God Harry’s message to all the Christian believers of all denominations: 



“Remember what I told you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also” (John 15:20). I am glad and I am rejoicing that God granted me worthy of being arrested and led to police custody for our Lord Jesus Christ’s sake!



I pray that all you, believers in faith, watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation, because we are in dangerous times, as the world has loved the darkness more instead of God’s light. Thank you for your prayers and support in these difficult moments.Always remember that better is not good enough, the best is yet to come!



May God be with us!

title: More On Wiseman Harry Arrest
text:
BLESSED ARE THOSE WHO ARE PERSECUTED FOR JESUS CHRIST’S SAKE!!!



The man of God Harry’s arrest is undoubtable proof that the Word of God hasn’t changed and will never change! As the great Apostle Paul mentions in 𝟐 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐲 𝟑:𝟏𝟏-𝟏𝟐, “𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, 𝐬𝐮𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬—𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐀𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐜𝐡, 𝐈𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐮𝐦 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐋𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐈 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐝. 𝐘𝐞𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐮𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦. 𝐈𝐧 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐭, 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐚 𝐠𝐨𝐝𝐥𝐲 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐝”.













As you continue to remember us in your prayers, we believe that the mighty hand of God will keep supporting us throughout this challenging period. We appreciate the love and support you have all shown ever since the news became public. May God bless you all!



Surely the best is yet to come, in Jesus’ mighty name!



May God be with us!
