title: THE WEAPON OF OUR TESTIMONY
text:
Revelations 12:11 says: “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony ….” This means that the word of our testimony is a weapon, a weapon of victory that brings us into our ordained position as overcomers. As Christians, we are encouraged daily to use our testimony together with the name of Jesus as a weapon to wage war against satan and his cohorts.



Today, when people testify about the goodness of God in their lives, they always talk about the immediate goodness of God, forgetting to mention what God did in the past. We are meant to glorify God, not only for what He is doing presently in our situation but for what He did in the past and what He is able to do in the future. If your situation is sickness, remember the sickness you had in the past and how God delivered you from the shackles of death. When we are faced with new challenges, we are supposed to go down the memory lane and remember how God delivered us from difficult circumstances in the past and also be encouraged by the promises that are ours in the Bible.



Remember that the devil wants you to focus on what you don’t have so you can see a reason to start lamenting and complaining instead of giving thanks to God for what He did in the past and what He is doing presently. The Book of John 11:41 gives an account of the encounter between our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ and Lazarus. The Bible said that our Lord Jesus Christ used the weapon of testimony (His act of giving thanks to His Heavenly Father) even when Lazarus was still in the grave. While people were crying and wailing, Jesus refused to let the situation at hand derail Him or affect His confidence in God. Child of God, what is your situation? Is it barrenness, poverty, sickness, stagnation, rejection, or limitation? As long as God is aware of your situation, He will not leave you without a solution.



MAKE THIS DECLARATION: I am no longer condemned, I am what God says I am, I have what God says I have and I can do what God says I can do, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: RUN FOR FORGIVENESS
text:
The first people God created, Adam and Eve, were in the Garden of Eden and lived in a perfect relationship with God! Then, their disobedience took them away from Him. In fact, when God gave them the opportunity to apologize, Adam blamed Eve and she blamed the serpent! Thus, both of them failed to recognize and admit their mistake.



How many times today do we also disobey God’s instructions? Our failure to admit our wrong prevents our harmony with God, thereby creating an invisible barrier between us and God! The Word of God emphasizes in 𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏:𝟗, “𝐈𝐟 𝐰𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬, 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐮𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐮𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐮𝐧𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬”. If you want to live a fulfilled life with God, remember that there is no sin that He cannot forgive. So, in the midst of every wrong-doing run to Him for forgiveness, with genuine repentance and sincerity of heart!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I acknowledge my sins and ask You to forgive me. Remove the barrier of sin from my heart, and bring me to You today – in Your Holy Name I pray, amen!”#Forgiveness #Repentance

title: EMBRACE CORRECTION
text:
Many of us find it hard to accept that we have made a mistake – let alone listen to someone else correct us. In 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟏𝟖, we read: “𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐫𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐦𝐞, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐝”. From this verse, we understand that discipline is necessary for our progress as children of God. 



How do we react every time someone corrects us for a mistake we have made? Do we get offended, do we get angry, or do we rejoice and see it as an opportunity to improve and become better Christians and better human beings in general? 



Reading in the New Testament the progression of Jesus Christ’s disciples, we see that Peter was the disciple who received the most rebuke and also the harshest correction from the other disciples. Jesus went so far as to say to him the famous to all phrase, “Get behind me, Satan” (Mark 8:33)! But as he accepted his teacher’s correction, He honoured him and later made him the stone on which the church of Jesus Christ was built! Could we possibly endure this degree of correction? Finally, if you want to be a good follower of Jesus Christ so that you may be honoured by Him as Peter was, be prepared to accept correction; the more the correction, the more the greatness!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, open my mind to understand how necessary it is that I accept correction so that I too may become a suitable servant of Yours – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#Correction #Greatness

title: DISCOVER YOUR REAL VALUE
text:
Hebrews 13:8 says that Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever. The Bible also says that Jesus Christ is the Word by whom God speaks to us. This means that whatever God says — whatever that is rooted in God’s Word is permanent, stable, incontestable and untouchable. When you look at your life, you will see that you make life-changing decisions on a daily basis. The question is, are you making the right decision? Unless the decisions we are making are rooted in God’s Word, they won’t stand the test of time. Therefore, deciding to put your trust in Christ Jesus is the most important decision you can make in life. When you receive Him, you will get His idea, know the opinion of yourself and others, work with His project and see yourself the way God sees you. You will see your real value.



If you can’t see your real value, you won’t be able to fulfil the purpose which God created you for. Consider the case of Joseph, he was shown a photograph of his future at a tender age. This photograph is within everyone, it is planted by the Holy Spirit and must be watered before it can produce its harvest. Therefore, we have a role to play because a man can’t discover new oceans if he doesn’t lose sight of the shore. When you believe in your dreams, you will become a man of vision. 



To a man of vision, no matter what happens, there is always a future. That is why when Joseph found himself in the dry pit, he said to himself, “This is not where I belong; I know my real value.” If you are a man of vision, no matter the obstacle on your way, you can never be stopped. 



Finally, if you want to discover your real value, you must see whatever you are doing as an assignment from God. When you do this, you won’t disappoint Him because you will be conscious of the fact that you will return back to Him and give an account of your actions. Therefore, make the most of life by doing things that God wants you to do, because life is too short to waste time on things that have no lasting value.

title: BY HIS GRACE; NOT BY YOUR WORKS
text:
Many times, as humans, we may feel weak or unable to be used by God; that our weaknesses outweigh our strengths. But God’s Word teaches us that we are not insignificant to God and that it doesn’t matter what other people say about us, but what God says about us.  



The good news is that, as God’s children, when we make Him our source and leave ourselves in His capable hands, He will reveal Himself and His strength in our weakness! Specifically, the Word of God teaches us in 𝟐 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐲 𝟏:𝟗, “𝐇𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐮𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐲 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 —𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐞”. 



Therefore, every Christian has a divine purpose, not because of our virtues or our works but because of His grace and the wonderful purpose He planned for us before we were even born! There is something far more important than your present situation – your divine destiny!  



Prayer: “Holy Father, open my eyes so that I can see beyond my weaknesses and may I focus on the purpose You have for my life – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!” #NotByMight #ByHisGrace

title: STAY FIRM IN GOD
text:
The best man in the world can only maintain his integrity and honour as long as God keeps him in it. God chooses what we go through; we choose how we go through it. Being faithful to God does not eliminate adversities. Moses, Joseph and Daniel were all rejected and persecuted by men but God made their troubles work for their advancement. In our spiritual walk with God, there will be good and hard times alike. Consider the case of Job. He was tempted by satan to abandon his God but he never did. At certain periods, we find ourselves being unduly hated and persecuted because of God’s grace in our lives. They will call you names in order to overthrow you but you must not give in — just continue to hold on to God.



Daniel knew that he was in the midst of persecution. He also knew the evil wishes of his adversaries, so he prayed to God not to allow his enemies to triumph over him. His enemies lost no time in plotting evil against him and he also lost no time in continually committing himself to God through prayer. Daniel had firm confidence in God’s ability to deliver him in the face of death. He humbly submitted to God’s will. Daniel’s consistency and faithfulness are a challenge to all Christians today. Therefore, whatever you are passing through, if it is allowed by God as a trial, you should not think it strange and doubt your Guard. Remember that Job did not faint in his faith but stood his ground, knowing that the threats to his life offered him a good opportunity of honouring God before men.



Therefore, as children of God, we must hold on to God. Keep your confession of faith: “Jesus is Lord! Let His name be glorified forever!” when the goings are good or tough. Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, give me the grace to continue to hold on to you in both good and hard times alike! Guide me, Lord, so that my enemies will not triumph over me! In Jesus’ name!”

title: DON’T BE A COPY!
text:
If we observe the world today, we will find that almost all people try to imitate other people. However, God did not create us to be copies, but to be someone with a difference, to be unique in appearance, character and abilities!



More specifically, God’s Word, in the Book of 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟖:𝟏𝟗 – 𝟐𝟎, says the following: “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥. ‘𝐍𝐨!’ 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝. ‘𝐖𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐚 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐮𝐬.  𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐰𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐨 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐬’”. Until then, God was the only King of Israel, the One who ruled over them. He destined them to be a unique nation, but the Israelites wanted to be like all the other nations, ignoring the warnings of prophet Samuel!



Just as God had created the people of Israel to be a unique nation, He has created you to be a unique person! Therefore, if you want to take after someone, do not try to be like others, but begin to be like our Lord Jesus Christ, who not only made a difference with His character but changed the course of the world, in general! How? By following what God called Him to do. If you follow your calling, you will surprise yourself and make a difference in your world! Start following your calling, and not the calling of other people, and you will find that Heavenly success will meet you!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today on, I will stop looking to others for direction, and begin to learn Your ways so that I can accomplish what You created me for – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#BeUnique #BelikeJesus

title: CHOOSE TO BE VICTORIOUS
text:
In our daily battle with the devil, very often we are faced with situations and events that are challenging to manage. We are faced with dead ends and crossroads, capable of determining the course of our lives! It is this intense and constant battle against the enemy that distinguishes the children of God from the children of the world, it is what separates the courageous from the cowards! In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟒:𝟏𝟎 Jesus Christ taught all of us what courage based on the Word of God means, by saying to the devil: “𝐀𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐦𝐞, 𝐒𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐧! 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧: ‘𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐨𝐧𝐥𝐲’”.



Life is not all fun and games but a warfare, and in this warfare, as a child of God, you are called to be victorious! Jesus spoke the Word aloud directly to satan in the wilderness, thus giving a battle plan to Christians on how to defeat satan! Following His example, make the decision to win today by placing yourself on the list of the people of faith!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I ask You to give me the boldness to stand victorious in the face of trials. Give me the grace to be able to stand for my faith in You, using Your mighty Word – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#VictoriousLife #WinToday

title: DON’T PERCEIVE GOD’S SILENCE AS DISAPPROVAL
text:
Life happens in phases. Everyone waits for the whistle or the gun when a race is about to begin, but in many instances in our daily lives, the reverse is true. In an attempt to beat the gun, we discover that we are worse off for it; we pay dearly for it. Many who were in the position of leadership are now in the position of followership because they were pulled back in their quest to make it quick. If you are in a haste to achieve something, you are likely to make costly mistakes that would pull you back, if not down.



Do you feel let down, depressed, or experience disappointment? Maybe you have been praying for long and it seems as if your prayers yielded no result. Do not misinterpret God’s silence as rejection. Who knows what would have happened if your prayer for a better condition had been answered? Delay is not denial. The Bible says God has set the right time for everything He created under the sun. The man at the pool of Bethesda had patience, endurance and perseverance for 38 years before he had his transformation. In Genesis 37, Joseph would have chosen momentary pleasure above long-term benefit if he had been impatient with God’s promise to him and behaved strangely when he met Potiphar’s wife.



Whatever the situation you may be facing, look beyond that situation; there is blessing in it. Look beyond your sickness; there is healing in it. Look beyond your poverty; there is blessing in it. Look beyond your bondage; there is freedom in it.



Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, grant me the grace to look beyond my situation and continue to trust in You because in You, there is freedom, breakthrough and all of Your blessings!”

title: MAKE GOD YOUR ALLY!
text:
Have you ever been in a situation where you feel alone and helpless? What is the appropriate attitude when we are in the midst of such an unpleasant and intense situation?



As God’s children, the proper attitude when faced with bad events in our lives, is to draw even closer to our Creator! After all, afflictions are meant for our spiritual benefit so that we may learn to pray more. Therefore, our trust in God means relying on Him for our present, our future, and everything that concerns us. More specifically, the Word of God mentions in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟑:𝟓-𝟔, “𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠; 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐬𝐮𝐛𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐬 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭”. 



Thus, as you make Jesus Christ your ally in everything that has to do with you, He will direct your steps! Always remember to look beyond your situation, because what keeps us from despairing is not what we see, but what we believe!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I make You my Ally in every difficulty, every trial and every tribulation, I ask You to guide my steps – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#TrustInGod #TheBestAlly

title: Where is Prophet TB Joshua Right Now?
text:
Prophet TB Joshua (June 12, 1963 – June 5, 2021)



A friend came in and saw my TV still tuned to Emmanuel.TV as usual. As we watched a live Sunday service together he asked, “Where do you think Prophet TB Joshua is now?” This is a big and essential question—many people watching Emmanuel.TV, followers of the Synagogue Church of All Nations, SCOAN, Emmanuel partners, every disciple of Jesus, or all of us desire to know what happens to a true believer of Jesus Christ such as Prophet TB Joshua, the Founder SCOAN and late Husband of the present leader Mama Evelyn Joshua.



If the question has been “Where is Jesus Now?” the answer is straightforward for Bible students. Because we know that Jesus is at the right hand of God in heaven as well as everywhere else. Jesus is also in the heart of each believer. Jesus is coming back again. Jesus is omnipresent as God and He is present in believers. Jesus is everywhere. 



Nevertheless, Ephesians (2:4-8) is very relevant to believers, concerning our place in Jesus Christ, now or hereafter. We are on earth right now, but Ephesians 2:6 says that we are seated in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus. That is by faith, every believer is united to Christ who sits in heaven, even though physically, we’re still here right now. Whoever is united with the Lord Jesus is one with Him in spirit, (1 Corinthians 6:17,19). And we are also the temples of the Holy Spirit with Jesus dwelling in us.



Hence it is a true saying that Prophet TB Joshua is with Jesus Christ in heaven right now. The work of God ongoing in SCOAN right now, after TB Joshua has left, is still being performed by the same Jesus Christ dwelling in Evelyn Joshua, and in everyone who believes in Jesus Christ. We are delighted that Evelyn Joshua, also often called Mama Serah, is a Daughter of Encouragement and carrying on in faith. But her husband is with Jesus Christ. Christians don’t become angels when they die in Christ. Jesus has enough angels but He is still working so that everyone will believe and be redeemed to fit the heavenly purpose.



Therefore let everyone learn from the parable of the  Rich Man and Lazarus said by Jesus in Luke (16:19-31). Lazarus died and the angels carried him to Abraham’s side. The rich man also died and was buried; in Hades, where he was in torment. Prophet TB Joshua has run his own race and if anyone has refused to listen to him as God’s messenger, they will still not listen if God sends him back from the dead. We are to believe and pray along. God’s presence, which is greater than we can imagine, is also in SCOAN Arena; and we can’t deny that for Prophet TB Joshua’s labour of love.



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria

title: THE REAL REVOLUTION
text:
People today understand the meaning of revolution as an action against the regime, laws or rules of a society. But there is someone who showed us something completely different: Jesus Christ is the greatest revolutionary that history has ever known! The revolution He made was never against the law, rules or authority, but against evil, misery and unclean spirits! Jesus was a channel of light in a world dominated by darkness, a channel of love in a world dominated by hatred, a channel of freedom in a world in bondage, the bondage of sin. In other words, Jesus was not rebelling against people, but against the enemy of souls, the devil!



So, those of us who believe in Him are called today to learn the meaning of true revolution. In fact, the Word of God declares in 𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟏 “𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐛𝐞 𝐬𝐮𝐛𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐚𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐞𝐩𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐮𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝐆𝐨𝐝”. So, if we want to bring real revolution, instead of fighting the laws or authority, let’s make a difference in our world through our actions and lifestyle, because a good Christian is a good citizen!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to follow Your example as I do good in the world I live in, showing everyone what true revolution really is –  in Your Holy Name I pray, amen!”#Revolution #GoodCitizen

title: We Are Not Alone
text:
When you look around to see what is going on in the world today, you will agree with me that man’s most deceptive enemy is fear. Fear changes our focus, it weakens our desire and determination. Fear is a more deceptive enemy than satan himself. As Christians, we are commanded by God to fear not, for those who are for us to protect us, guide us, fight for us, and defend us are more than those who are against us, to destroy us. Who are they? Heaven says that they are angels who are unspeakably more numerous and infinitely more powerful. The Book of John 4:4 says, “You are of God, little children, and have overcome them because He who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.” This means that men and women of faith are led by an indwelling Spirit of grace, which is greater than he who dwells in the world.



As the Word gets into our blood and grows to gain supremacy over us, we do not need to fear or panic anymore because we are not alone. Since God is with us, we and Him are lifting the load together – fighting the battle together. Who can battle with the Lord? If the Lord be for us, whom shall we fear? We are more than conquerors through Christ Jesus who loves us.



Naturally, our enemies may stand a better chance of victory considering their numbers, credentials, age, experience in warfare, and the instruments at their disposal but supernaturally, we are superior because we are on the Lord’s side, let’s trust in God’s authority and not man’s majority. Fear not for the Holy Spirit who is constantly walking by your side will defeat fear for you today. God fought for David against Goliath and He will fight for you today. He fought for Moses and the Israelites against their enemies and He will fight for you today. Every mountain for your sake shall be leveled. The pillars and foundation of your problem will be crumbled and those things that are against you will be for you today by the power of God.

title: THE KEY TO UNDERSTANDING BLESSINGS!
text:
True gratitude requires us to look beyond our present circumstances – whether they are blessings or difficulties – and look to God, the true source of our blessings. It is easy to thank God when we can physically see and touch His blessings, such as food, money, clothes, good health, family… but what happens when feeling grateful gets difficult?



The heroes of faith, whom we find in God’s Word, suffered great hardship and loss, yet they chose to celebrate and thank God, believing they were blessed. So how did they do this? They simply knew what God’s Word teaches us: “Appreciate God for what He has done in your life, and He will do it again and again and again”. Remember David, a little shepherd who willingly offered to come against a brave warrior, a giant! David, full of boldness and courage, stood before the king and said: “𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐫; 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐫𝐜𝐮𝐦𝐜𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐨𝐝” , according to 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟏𝟕:𝟑𝟔.



Choose today to thank God under any circumstance, as you recall God’s goodness in your life, regardless of how you feel. Never forget that confession born of faith will bring you possession!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, thank You for Your love in my life, Your goodness, and for every blessing You have given me. Take more of my unbelief and give me more of Your faith, so that I will always appreciate you and never lack your unending blessings in my life – in Your Holy Name I pray, amen!”#Thanksgiving #Appreciation

title: BE WHO GOD WANTS YOU TO BE
text:
As children of God, developing an independent mind that is capable of reasoning, is a necessary condition for discovering that beyond our situation lies God’s promise for our lives. The situation of a child of God who knows very well that God has a plan for them, however bad it may seem, is a tonic, a boost to bring them one step closer to their divine destiny! In other words, if you are a man of vision, no matter what constitutes the obstacles on your way, you can never be stopped. Instead of pressure and tension to reduce your vision, it will even enlarge your strategies!



In the Book of Genesis 37:36, the Word of God says, “Meanwhile, the Midianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Potiphar, one of Pharaoh’s officials, the captain of the guard”. If Joseph did not know the purpose of his life, he would be overwhelmed by rejection and depression due to the difficulties he faced. For his entire life his brothers mocked him, when they got the chance they threw him into a pit, in order to kill him and then sold him as a slave. In the process, they sent him unjustly to prison. All this had to precede before God promoted him to king of all Egypt! Therefore, when you feel swamped by the challenges you are going through, remember that nothing happens for nothing and nothing happens by chance, because all things work together for good to those who love God (Romans 8:28)!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, help me to not forget my vision, my divine destiny. Make it the driving force that will make me overcome hardship, just like the heroes of faith did, according to Your Holy Word – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen.” #BecomeGreat #DivineDestiny

title: GOD CANNOT USE A DISCOURAGED SERVANT
text:
There are times in our lives when everything seems meaningless, I mean, when the results we get from all our hard work and hard labour are not corresponding with the efforts we have put into them — a situation whereby we have done all the right things, yet there is no answer. In situations like this, it is easy to get discouraged and give up. But as children of God and members of the household of faith, we must continue to press on because God cannot use a discouraged servant.



When we look at the story of Joseph in Genesis 37:1-36, the Bible says that Joseph was to be a source of freedom to his people but he had to go through imprisonment. He was meant to be a source of provision to his people but he had to go through lack, want and hunger. People of God, if Joseph had been discouraged, he wouldn’t have had the courage to continue to press on in the face of overwhelming negative evidence.



Prophet T.B. Joshua says, “When God gives you a vision and it is opposed by men, do not reduce your vision; stay in faith in Christ Jesus.” What situation are you going through now? Is it poverty, hardship, setback, sickness or disappointment? If it is allowed by God as a trial, we must not think it strange and doubt our Guard. He who desires to be a source of freedom must know what it is to be imprisoned, so don’t be discouraged. He who desires to be a source of provision must know what it takes to face lack and want. Remember, our situation is an opportunity to honour God before men. The world is waiting to see how you handle your situation.



SAY THIS PRAYER: “O Holy Spirit, help me to continue to press on even in the face of life’s uncertainty and discouragement.”

title: SELFLESS LOVE
text:
We live in a society where the concept of selfless love and giving has been eliminated! Love, mutual aid and compassion for our fellow man, are acts we rarely if ever find on our path. But, 2000 years ago, He who represented the concept of love, giving, and selflessness walked the earth as He died and rose again for our sake. His name: Jesus Christ! In the Gospel of 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐𝟑: 𝟑𝟑-𝟑𝟒, Jesus Christ showed all of us what love without limits means: “𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐤𝐮𝐥𝐥, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞, 𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐬—𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐞𝐟𝐭. 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠.’ 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐮𝐩 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐬”.



Today, 2000 years later, our love for our neighbour has become an ‘unnecessary’ habit, and our giving to someone outside our family circle has become a rare occurrence. After all, which God do we worship? Do we worship a God of love? And if God is love, then why do we, as His children, have such a hard time showing love to those around us? Jesus Christ paid the price for our sake, showing everyone what it means to love without limits! Show your love to your neighbour, clothe the naked, feed the hungry, care for the wounded, because Jesus Christ does not know you by your name but by your love!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I ask, as I read this word, that today may be the day that I learn to love without limits and give without expecting anything in return – in Your name we pray, Amen!”#UnconditionalLove #JesusIsLove

title: LOVE: THE GREATEST VIRTUE!
text:
“And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love. But the greatest of these is love”, are the precious words that flow from the Word of God in 𝟏 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟑:𝟏𝟑.



Love is solving other people’s problems with joy, because quite simply, God is love and love is God! You have been called to love your neighbour as yourself, to love and forgive those who have hurt you and to give to those in need without a second thought.



In the Gospel of 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐𝟑:𝟑𝟒-𝟑𝟖, our Lord, though He was flogged, tortured, humiliated and dehumanised before He was brutally murdered, he endured humiliation and degradation because of His love for God’s work and the souls that would be saved through His sacrifice, as well as His belief in His resurrection. The Word of God states: “𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠.’ 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐮𝐩 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐬. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐬𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐦. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐇𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐬; 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐢𝐟 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝’𝐬 𝐌𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐡, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐧 𝐎𝐧𝐞.’ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐮𝐩 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐨𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐈𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐉𝐞𝐰𝐬, 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟.’ 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐚 𝐰𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧 𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝: 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐣𝐞𝐰𝐬”.



If you claim to love God, you must show it by your actions! Every day, you have the opportunity to be a solution to someone’s problem! Learn to sow in the field of giving, and you will see your life change and grow, because Jesus Christ does not know us by our name but by our love! Without a doubt, what makes us human is not our ability to think, but our ability to love! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will come close to You, reading Your Word, that You may take more of my hardness of heart and give me more of Your love – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#LoveWins #Love

title: KEEP THE RIGHTFUL FOCUS
text:
There is more to life than meets the ordinary eye. There are two kinds of truth: sense-knowledge truth and divine-revelation truth. They are usually opposed to each other. We have the eyes of the body and the eyes of faith. The eyes of the body cannot see beyond facts; it takes the eyes of faith to have a special insight into the revealed truth. Those with a scientific frame of mind will not believe unless they see and touch. We live by faith when we recognise our union with Jesus Christ in the Spirit. Those who are controlled by divine-revelation truth are the people that examine all things in the light of God’s Word. On the other hand, we live by sight when we give all our attention to the physical, which is temporary. When you are controlled by sense-knowledge truth, you will be controlled by what you see, what you hear, what others tell you or what your situation looks like. When the eyes of our body focus on what our situation has to say, we begin to see danger and impossibilities. Many have changed the course of the history of their lives through the inability to see beyond their immediate circumstances.



If Job were to look at his afflictions, he would have yielded to the advice of his close relations to curse God. If Meshach, Shadrach and Abednego were to look at the burning furnace, they would have changed their confession for fear of being roasted (Daniel 3:13-23). Your situation does not surprise God because He has the solution. God gave His only begotten Son, Jesus Christ, to pay the debt of your situation, to bring you back into His full fellowship. Jesus Christ has paid the price of total healing, redemption and victory. Therefore, keep your focus! Identify your source! When you are faced with difficult situations, do not fret; have a look of faith to the Cross, where the victory has been provided freely.



As Christians, let us maintain the rightful focus. If you believe God for possibilities out of impossibilities, say this prayer: “Lord Jesus, give me the grace to continue to dwell in You and follow You both in good times and hard times! Give me the grace to keep the rightful focus when faced with difficult situations, because in every situation You are still saying something!”

title: TOMORROW IS A MYSTERY!
text:
Thanks to the unending mercy of our Father God, who does not look at our past to determine our future, we can today envision our future with faith that because of His mercy, we are no longer condemned! Unfortunately, although we all taste the fruits of God’s favour and patience daily, we do not hesitate to reject people because of their weakness.



In 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟔:𝟏, the Word of God points out the following: “𝐁𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐧, 𝐢𝐟 𝐚 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐚𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐬𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐚 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐚 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐝”. God himself prompts us not to reject anyone because of their weakness, but with kindness and patience to bear with them so that they may be corrected!



Tomorrow is a mystery! Thus, the one you judge, reject and consider unworthy to contribute to their correction and improvement today, may one day become your helper! Apostle Paul, for example, who once persecuted the church of Christ, became the man who helped spread the Gospel and still teaches us how to live a holy and pleasing to God life through his God-inspired words! If you reject someone on account of their weakness, you also reject their strength! Therefore, if you know someone’s weakness, don’t reject them. Help them because the person you help today, may be the one who helps you tomorrow!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will stop rejecting people because of their weakness, because You didn’t reject me either! On the contrary, you have not stopped manifesting your strength in my weakness. As I do this, I know that this decision of mine will increase my relationship with You – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Weakness #Rejection

title: DECLARE WAR ON SATAN!
text:
War is a state of armed conflict between societies. In general, it is characterised by extreme aggression and destruction, using tactical military forces. As there is physical warfare, so there is spiritual warfare also, which takes place in our hearts, without ever ceasing. The Word of God has taught us that we live in a world where our enemy will never allow God’s purpose in our life to be fulfilled, without a fight. Even more so, the day you will decide to fully devote yourself to Jesus Christ, you will declare war on satan! Satan strives in every way possible to make the children of God turn away from God, and he rejoices when they feel like surrendering in the midst of war. 



Learn today, though, that God’s plan for your life cannot be fulfilled if you do not fight and do not win your battles, because warfare is essential for your victory! “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐰𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝, 𝐰𝐞 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐫 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝. 𝐎𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐫𝐲, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐬. 𝐖𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐮𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐢𝐭𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐮𝐩 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐥𝐞𝐝𝐠𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭”, according to 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟑-𝟓. Don’t give up! Focus on God God because if you give your attention to God, you are what God says you are, you can do what God says you can do, you have what God says you have.



🙏𝐀𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐦𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐠𝐞, 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐮𝐩 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐖𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I come to You with a humble heart, and I ask of You to equip me with the weapons of the Holy Spirit! Strengthen me and increase me today in Υour faith, Υour love, Υour patience, so I can overcome every battle and every temptation – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#War #DefeatSatan

title: MAKE THE RIGHT CHOICE
text:
In Genesis 1, when God created the earth, it was without form and void. God spoke forth His Word and said, “Let there be light,” and indeed there was light. Whenever God spoke forth His Word and said, “Let there be,” it came into being and so God gave being to heal, to bless, to save. When God gives being to the Word, that Word becomes alive. The evidence was clear – the earth became fruitful and multiplied. The Word of God – a Spirit – spoke, created material things. This means that God’s Word is Spirit and life. It was the very life of God in those Words that brought about creation, including mankind.



When God created man, He gave him the right to life. Within that right was discretion. In other words, Jesus Christ gave man a mind and the ability to choose between right and wrong. In life, man is given the freedom to choose from the many alternatives that surround him. What choice have you made concerning Jesus Christ? Life’s biggest decision is what you do with Jesus Christ. In Luke 10:38-42, Mary made the right choice. Today, our minds are so taken by worldly considerations, that is, the lures and cares of this world, that we don’t have time for God. We are so busy with things on the outside that we fail to spend quality time with God. Mary made the right choice, whereas Martha missed the point. You will never find the time for God’s Word; you must make the time, create the time, work out the time. Mary made the right choice – she took time to sit at Jesus’ feet, I mean she attended to His Word and a lifetime of ignorance gave way to spiritual enlightenment.



Children of God, don’t allow your bad experiences to wipe you out. Don’t allow your situation to mislead you. Remember that it is the very life in the Word that has the ability to change your situation, I mean ability to save, deliver, heal and bless you. Be a Mary of our day and make the right choice. Look unto the Word. By looking unto the Word and acting on it, you bring Jesus onto the scene. Take time to sit at Jesus’ feet; I mean take the time to splash around in the Word and absorb it to discover what God has to say to you each day. When you have discovered what God has made you for and how He cherishes your company, you will discover the true fountain of good living welling up to eternal life.

title: IS FAITH ENOUGH?
text:
We live at a time where our faith and our trust in Jesus Christ are tested… Every day, as children of God, our faith is called to show perseverance before people, situations, and events bigger, even stronger than us. Still, many times we find ourselves in a battle that has already been won, we become spectators in a play we already know the outcome of. Because we are not assured of the power of Jesus Christ in our lives, we start having doubts and asking ourselves if faith is all we need in our lives, if faith is sufficient enough to solve our problems. In 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟏:𝟏 the Word of God says: “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐞”.



Nobody guaranteed that challenges will not come your way in your life! Yet, even when everything around you seem like it’s collapsing, never doubt that Jesus Christ is able to provide the solution that you seek, never doubt your faith – because faith is all you need to be victorious! Stand firmly in front of the giant you have to face, show boldness in the situation ahead, fight your enemy with courage, because when you stay in faith in Christ Jesus, that is when you can hear God’s voice most clearly! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, grant me the faith that moves mountains, grant me the faith the woman who was bleeding for twelve years had, when she met you, the faith the centurion had, and the boldness Peter had – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!” #𝐈𝐧𝐆𝐨𝐝𝐖𝐞𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭 #𝐁𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞

title: RUN FOR THE CROWN!
text:
A weapon often times used on the children of God from the enemy of our souls is making us look back at our past and by that he aims to make us redetermine our future according to our past. Though time and time again God has shown us that He does not look at our past to determine our future, this tactic of the enemy is used almost daily and, unfortunately, it’s quite effective among Christians.



Let us remember Apostle Paul when he was Saul; a persecutor of the body of Christ. We never saw Apostle Paul looking back to where he was coming from, but instead, once he was called to follow Jesus, he started running the good race of faith seeking for the reward, eager to finish the race toward salvation. In fact, aiming to prevent every believer from falling into satan’s trap of looking at the past, he also mentions the secret of his success in 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟑:𝟏𝟑,𝟏𝟒 “[…] 𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝,  𝐈 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐭𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐳𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬”.



This is a priceless lesson given by a man who shook the nations with the fire of the Holy Ghost and the living Word of God! It is high time you stop looking at where you are coming from and start looking at where you are going. We have seen our past and we know what it looks like but the time has come for us to now see our future. It is time to dream the dream and look ahead to all that God has in store for us. Don’t look back! The future is brighter than you have ever expected!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Lord Jesus Christ, I have made the heartfelt decision to not look back anymore and begin to dream about the bright future You have planned for me. Help me and strengthen me that my words and confession may be according to all You have promised to me. Help me not look back but keep pressing towards the crown you have personalised for me – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#GoForIt #Victorious

title: OVERCOME YOUR SITUATION
text:
When you look at your immediate surroundings, you will see satan using man’s unrighteousness as an instrument for his purpose to kill, steal and destroy. As a believer, you must take time to think properly to react diligently to your daily challenges. Unfortunately, many people today react intellectually or emotionally to their situation and they are overwhelmed. If you lose control, you will lose all sense of reasoning and when you lose your sense of judgment, you will fight the wrong battle. Believers may encounter challenges but their situations are not like others. For others, their situation is to impair them, to destroy them, but as a Christian, yours is to improve you, to draw you closer to God. As true Christians, we must learn to see the value in our trials on any challenge that come our way.



Consider what happened to Paul in 2 Corinthians 12:7, when he prayed for the thorn to be removed, you will realise that there are some situations that no amount of fasting and prayers can remove. The Bible refers to those situations as unchangeable events, they can be in the form of sickness, hardship, or failure.  Job’s affliction was an unchangeable event, but he saw his situation as an opportunity to honour God before men. As a believer, whatever situation you are in, there is no real evil in it, because God is aware. When God Almighty is executing His plan in our lives, He allows events that continue to unfold until His purpose is revealed in our lives.



Remember to focus on Jesus Christ in the midst of your trials. If God allows it as a test of faith, don’t think it strange and doubt your Guard. Those who have a clear purpose in life, no matter what comes, always find room in their heart to bless God even when He takes what their life depends on. If you are really committed to God, He will take up satan’s challenges against you. God is powerful and faithful to His faithful ones. No matter the situation, God is aware. Leave it for God, He will not leave you without a solution today, in Jesus’ name! Amen.

title: LEAVE YOUR IMPRINT!
text:
Most people today want to change their lives, they want to succeed, they want to become a positive example for society, but they do not know how. The Word of God has the answer to every question, it is the Light in your path, it is the database of every believer and it gives solution to every unanswered question that may develop within us!



More specifically, the Word of God teaches us in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟖:𝟏𝟗-𝟐𝟎 the following, “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐠𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, […] 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐭𝐨 𝐨𝐛𝐞𝐲 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮. […]”. Indeed, our Lord Jesus Christ showed a multitude of people the way of salvation, as He came into this world with the purpose of changing mankind, by leaving His imprint in a positive way! Every word, every deed, every action, everything He did, was done with one purpose; to spread the mighty name of God throughout the world, so that the world could be saved and the relationship between God and man could be restored!



As imitators of our Lord, drawing valuable lessons from His life and work, we conclude that by adopting a lifestyle that is on purpose provides an opportunity to enrich others by leaving your imprint in a positive way! Don’t waste precious time from your life! Discover the purpose for which God Almighty created you, commit yourself to that purpose, and get ready to change the world by leaving your imprint positively!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord God, as I become the cause of positive change in people’s lives, strengthen me so that I will continue following your footsteps for the rest of my life – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”



PossitiveExample #ChangeTheWorld

title: THE UNITED ARMY OF GOD!
text:
“𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫,” 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧, “𝐰𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐰 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐮𝐬.” “𝐃𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐡𝐢𝐦,” 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, “𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮.” (𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟗:𝟒𝟗)



Jesus Christ never preached denominations during His earthly ministry! In fact, He never rejected anyone! He spoke in simple words and examples, showing the way of forgiveness to reconcile every person with God the Father, under one condition; Accepting Him as Lord and Savior. However, today we see the standard of acceptance that He set being eradicated day by day, since we see more than a few times that Christians, children of God, belonging to the body of Christ, are fighting each other by claiming denominations and other religious terms created by men and not by God…



Faith in Christ Jesus is a universal human right! Therefore, it is time to embrace the mind and will of the Lord, which, as revealed from the book of Genesis to Revelation, is to have friends who have a relationship with Him and not fanatical religious followers! The true meaning of Christianity is a relationship with Jesus Christ, because Christianity is not religion, it is a relationship! Thus, we are all brothers and sisters, Christians, with God Almighty as our Father, regardless of denomination! Are you ready to be an imitator of Christ? Embrace anyone who preaches and helps spread His Gospel, for whoever is not against us is with us, as Jesus Christ preached and taught! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, thank You for Your sacrifice on the Cross of Calvary and for making me a partaker of divine Grace. Help me to become more like You! Take away more of my self-righteousness and give me more of Your righteousness. Illuminate every dark place in my heart with Your Holy light and purge out everything that is not in accord with Your Spirit, so that I may see the power that we who are united through Your Spirit have – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#ArmyOfChrist #UnitedWeStand

title: THE LANGUAGE GOD UNDERSTANDS
text:
Matthew 4:3-4 says, “Now when the tempter came to Him, he said, ‘If You are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.’ But He answered and said, ‘It is written, “Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God”.’” During Jesus’ temptation in the wilderness, He quoted the Scriptures and showed us the proper way to respond to trials and temptations. This means that our confession is important, for the belief in our hearts is released by faith out of our mouths. So, what are you saying about your situation?  



Prophet TB Joshua says there are two languages: the language of the Bible and today’s language. The language of the Bible is the language God uses to create, save and deliver us, while today’s language is the language we use in our business, to correct our children or gossip. Since today’s language does not have God as its source, it fails to accord with God’s Word. Remember that if we resist satan with a lively faith in Christ Jesus, he will flee from us but if we do this by our own words, he will triumph over us. So, we must speak our words from the heart so they can become one with God’s Word, I mean in the power of the Holy Spirit. Words not one with God’s Word will be idle, meaningless, and oftentimes destructive. 



The Holy Spirit inspires children of God to talk, so we will get no result if we do not wait until He speaks through us. The only language God understands is that of the Scriptures. Remember that holy men were inspired by the Holy Spirit as they gave divine messages. As believers, we must be led by God’s Spirit always. In Prophet TB Joshua’s words, “Confession builds the road over which faith carries its mighty cargo.” So, our confession precedes our healing, deliverance, and all of God’s blessings. Therefore, we must be led by the Holy Spirit since our confession gives us possession.



SAY THIS PRAYER: Lord Jesus Christ, help me to say only what I believe in my heart.

title: THE FOUNTAIN OF ETERNAL JOY!
text:
We live in a generation where the material world and vanity have taken over the lives of Christians. The desire for sin, fleshly desires, and the constant pursuit of temporary happiness, are some of the things that torment a large percentage of believers today! But can make us truly happy after all? Can one find joy in earthly – material things? Is there, somewhere, the feeling of endless and continuous joy that man so zealously seeks throughout his life?



If we learn to focus on our relationship with God, we will realise the true meaning of life and see that joy will come effortlessly, automatically and endlessly in our lives! In 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟒, the Word of God emphasizes: “𝐑𝐞𝐣𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐚𝐥𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬. 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐚𝐲 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧: 𝐑𝐞𝐣𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞!”. Make God the source of your joy, your blessing, your strength, because true joy comes loving Jesus, not from the things we amass!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, give me the eternal and endless joy that only You offer! As I decide today to focus only on you, may your unfailing peace and joy forever dwell within my heart – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#TrueJoy #Happiness

title: SEE THE “GIANY” OF YOUR TRIAL FALL!
text:
Many Christians today think and feel that the tests, challenges and temptations they face as they run the good race of faith, are meant to cause them distress, sadness and despair! They believe that God is punishing them for some mistake… Most of the time, however, we forget that what we face as children of God is not to destroy us, but to take us to a new level in life. Our trial has not come to kill us, but to arm us so that we can handle the success that God has prepared for us in the future! In 𝐉𝐨𝐛 𝟏:𝟐𝟐, the Holy Bible states: “𝐈𝐧 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬, 𝐉𝐨𝐛 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐢𝐧 𝐛𝐲 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐰𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠”.



The trial you are going through did not come to kill you, it did not come to destroy you, but it is a result of your choice to follow Jesus Christ without turning back! Never forget that the beauty of our Christian journey is the trials, temptations, difficulties and challenges we encounter on our way to redemption, so, take courage when the test comes! Take courage when the difficulty comes! Be bold and you will see that the giant of your trial will be crushed, in the name of Jesus Christ!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Lord Jesus Christ, Son of David, have mercy on me! Help me to see with the eyes of my faith so that I always know that the trials that come into my life are meant to take me to a new level in life. By faith in your Word, I will persevere and I know that I will see every mountain that rises before me be levelled, in the name of Jesus Christ!”#GiantsFall #Overcomer

title: STAY IN TUNE WITH GOD
text:
Life is a battlefield where only the bold win, after so many battles. As Christians, when God leads us through a battle, it is in our own interest to tell of His goodness, kindness and mercy, thanking Him for not allowing our foes to defeat us. When God gives us His strength, He will always see us through all obstacles. The extent of His care and the strength of His might in our lives weaken, frustrate our foes.



In our walk with God, there will be both good and hard times. Are you sick? God is the Healer! Are you in bondage? God can set you free! Are you oppressed? God is the great Deliverer! Are you in need? God is the great Provider! Jesus Christ has the answers to all problems. We have no refuge than this command of Jesus Christ: ONLY BELIEVE! This is our refuge. We must have absolute trust in God that He is working out the answer. Remember that being faithful to God does not mean not facing persecution, name-calling or oppression. Daniel, Paul, Joseph, Meshach, Shadrach and Abednego were all rejected and persecuted by men but God made their troubles work for their advancement.



Consider the case of Daniel, whose faith was challenged in a new way. He had two options:



i. renounce and deny God, stop doing God’s work, worship Babylonian gods and become the king’s right-hand man with huge rights and privileges.



ii. maintain his stand with God and have his bones crushed by hungry lions.



These were indeed extreme options needing the grace of God to make the right choice. Daniel’s faithfulness and consistency are a challenge to all Christians today. So, whatever you are passing through, if it is allowed by God, never doubt your Guard.



Never a sickness Jesus Christ cannot heal, never a disease He cannot cure and never a problem He cannot solve. So, stay tuned to God in faith. Say: “Lord Jesus, give me the grace to continue to hold on to You regardless of the challenges, persecution and oppression! Let Your name be glorified and praised ALWAYS in my life!”

title: HARD WORK PAYS OFF!
text:
Our Lord, the God of all creation, taught us that for every sowing season there will be a harvest. As with the fruits of the earth, so in our lives, we plant seeds for which we will at some point receive the corresponding reward!In 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟏:𝟔, “[…] 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐥𝐲 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐤 𝐡𝐢𝐦”, God Himself makes it clear that He is the One who rewards those who seek Him with sincerity and diligence and, in fact, He rewards everyone with divine justice that comes from Heaven and not based on human criteria. Many times, however, we fall into the trap of saying: “When will I receive my reward from God?”…



The Word of God reveals through the wisdom of the Creator that you may toil and work hard, but it is God’s duty to determine the time and season of the harvest. You may work and pray fervently, but it is God’s duty to determine the time and season of your reward! Therefore, after you have struggled, laboured, worked hard as a man of faith, God still has to mark it. If the result of your work is good, give God the glory; if it is the opposite, submit your ways to Him because in every situation God is still saying something!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, may the thoughts of my heart, the words of my mouth, and the works of my hands be pleasing before You, and may You always grant me the grace to do Your will. I know that as I unceasingly do what is pleasing in Your sight, the time of my reward will not delay – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#GodsReward #GodsTime

title: A DELIBERATE SINNER
text:
John 5:14 says, “Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, ‘See, you have been made well. Sin no more, lest a worse thing come upon you.’” Man has reasons for doing whatever he does, many excuses for his failings. This makes it difficult to admit and take responsibility for his wrongdoings. You are responsible for your actions, for whatever you give your attention to.



The way Jesus Christ addressed this man shows that the man might have been a deliberate sinner, who knows sin but commits it willingly. In Psalm 51:1-19, the Psalmist took responsibility for his actions. If you make excuses for your sin, your sin will not be excused. Correction makes the future possible. Jesus knows you, your name, thoughts; He hears you when you call and sees each tear.



Remember that when Jesus Christ met this man, He asked him, “What do you want me to do for you? Do you want to get well?” Jesus Christ is asking you the same question now: ‘Do you want to get well? Do you want to be free? Do you want to be delivered? Do you want to be saved?’



Do you want every weapon, design of the enemies against you to fail? Own up to your wrongdoings! Come to Jesus Christ with a repentant spirit and He will accept you the way you are. He will give you a new life and new beginning. Sin is a poison to your soul and spirit. It causes poverty, sickness in your life but when it is pardoned, you will be healed. Jesus gave that warning because He knew that those who are healed, saved from the punishment of sin are likely to go back to sin when the pain is over.



A deliberate sinner must reconsider. Obeying God at first seems difficult because it involves a turning point against your usual way of doing things. If you must resist bad influences, you must stand for what you believe in. If you cannot stand for what you believe, you will definitely fail by it. I pray that God renew us, our mind, spirit and body for His Glory, in Jesus’ mighty name!

title: THE SECRET TO PERSONAL IMPROVEMENT
text:
As human beings, we all desire growth and progress. We want to have the ability to be able to manage problems and situations, however, the question remains: how does growth and progress come about? Is it enough to wait for life itself to favor us, or do we have a role to play?



As we read the story of Joseph in the book of Genesis, we realise how important it is that we play our role, as we wisely manage both the negative and positive situations that arise in our lives. Joseph, being in a difficult situation, recognized that he had a role to play and therefore did not give up by seeing himself as a victim or someone that was being mistreated… Joseph realised that if he managed his difficult situation with wisdom, it would very soon be transformed into a good situation and that was the key that unlocked the bright future God had promised him. Thus, “𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐩𝐡 𝐟𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐚𝐯𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐞𝐲𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐭. 𝐏𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐩𝐡𝐚𝐫 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐢𝐧 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐞𝐝” (𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟑𝟗:𝟒).



Joseph’s case has very significant lessons to teach each of us individually! If there is one thing to keep in your heart is that personal improvement and fulfilment in life come through the continual process of learning from both negative and positive experiences! Therefore, if you truly desire progress to come in every area of your life, handle your trials with wisdom! Stop avoiding challenges because the time has come to embrace them, in order to become the winner you dream of being! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, open the eyes of my faith so that I may see every challenge and every trial I face as a means of training me to endure and become someone with a difference, in your Holy Name I pray, Amen!”#Success #BearTheTest

title: INVOLVE GOD
text:
When you look at life, what do you see? How clearly do you really see your life? Do you see yourself the way Jesus sees you? Proverbs 14:12 says, “There is a way that seems right to a man, But its end is the way of death.” This means that if you don’t want to fail, you must involve God in all you do. When you involve God in any matter, that matter is settled. 



However, who is actually involved in your life? Whoever is involved in the affairs of your life determines who you are during times of uncertainty, crises. I mean, what you become depends on how much you involve God in your matter. Have you taken steps to involve Him more? Have you presented your issues to Him?  The sinful woman in Luke 7 decided to present her case to Jesus. Although she had many weaknesses, character flaws and bad habits that could stop her from presenting her matter to Jesus, she said to herself, “If I could just present my matter to Jesus, I know that it will be settled.” Later, Jesus said to her, “Your sins are forgiven…. Your faith has saved you; go in peace.”



Jesus Christ is a spiritual force that grows and develops in the heart or spirit of man. Let your faith move God, for to know God’s presence is to know His Power. Once you speak the Word of God with faith in your heart over your situation, you have released God’s power over it. Remember that when God moves, power moves and when power moves, we know what follows — your mountain of difficulties, setbacks, afflictions and the like will move and you will see the name of Jesus Christ working in the Spirit, that is, the power and anointing of God working in the Spirit. 



If you have taken God’s Word to heart and truly made it a part of you, it will by its very nature change you, and when it does, you will find yourself called to act upon the Word of God. When we fearlessly act upon the Word of God and joyously cast our every care on Him, victory is as sure as the rising of the sun.

title: BALANCE WORK AND YOUR TIME WITH GOD!
text:
The demands on society and the world today have given birth to a generation of busy people. Everyone is busy trying to make it, trying to be successful, trying to make money and trying to prosper in various aspects of life. Consequently, the virus that plagues many Christians today is the lack of balance between our earthly life and our spiritual well-being. In the process of trying to succeed and prosper, we miss the mark by reducing our time and investment in God’s Word and our relationship with Him. We end up focusing on our careers, our families, our hobbies and the pleasures of life. But it is important to note that if you do not prosper in your spiritual life and you seem to prosper in some other areas it is dangerous; satan will enslave you.



The word of God, in the book of 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝟒:𝟏𝟑-𝟏𝟒 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬, “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐚𝐲, ‘𝐓𝐨𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐠𝐨 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲, 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐚 𝐲𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞, 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐛𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐲.’ 𝐖𝐡𝐲, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐨𝐰. 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞? 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐚 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐚 𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐬.” As we know, many are the plans of man, but God guides his ways. Take the decision today to have a balanced life. A life that does not live on bread alone but by every word that comes from the mouth of God Almighty!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I know that I lack a balanced life and that is what is keeping me from receiving my breakthrough. Please, help me invest in my relationship with You so that I may prosper in my spiritual life – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”



LifeInBalance #BalancedLife

title: THE BEAUTY OF LIFE
text:
Brethren in Christ, Good Morning And Win Today & Forever, in Jesus’ name!



The excellent way to use life is to spend it on something that will outlive us. This means that the beauty of life does not depend on how happy you are, how rich you are or how famous you are, but on how happy or successful others can be because of you. The question you need to ask yourself now is, ‘How many people are happy because of me?’ Yes, how many people are successful because of you? How many people have hope for the future because of you? How many helpless and hopeless people on the streets have you given hope to? We have the orphans, the widows, the less privileged – how many of them are your friends, how many of them do you have their phone numbers? 



Prophet T.B. Joshua says that they are fatherless so that you can be their father, they are lonely so that you can be their companion, they are in want so that you can be their benefactor. As Christians, we know that looking the other way when our neighbour is in pain, poor and helpless is neglecting Jesus Christ Himself. People of God, someone needs something you possess. Prophet T.B. Joshua says, “We might not be equally gifted but God Almighty has done it in such a way that each person has some strength to contribute.” The question now is: What are you contributing to people’s lives? Your contribution need not be money; it could be your smile, love, strength, and time.



When we look at the Book of Luke 10:25-37, the Good Samaritan knew that looking the other way when his neighbour was sick and wounded meant neglecting Jesus Christ. That was why he had committed to helping the injured man, even though the Samaritans would normally have nothing to do with the Jews.



SAY THIS PRAYER: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to do what is right at all times, even though it is contrary to what I naturally want to do.”

title: EQUIP YOURSELF WITH THE RIGHT WEAPON!
text:
It is a fact that dough needs specific ingredients to create and produce a good result. It requires ingredients such as flour, butter, eggs, salt and water… In the same way, our heart needs some ingredients for it to be alert. Our heart needs a foundation, a defense, a response to the insults and threats of the enemy – the written and eternal Word of God, in order to stand firm in faith! Every moment, every second, every passing minute, our heart is thinking thousands of thoughts! If it is not equipped with the Word of God, then, it will surely be equipped with the thoughts of the enemy!



God’s Word warns us in 𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟓:𝟖-𝟗 about the consequences that our heart, our spirit, can face:  “𝐁𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐬𝐨𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐝. 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐦𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐯𝐢𝐥 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐥𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐥𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐞𝐯𝐨𝐮𝐫. 𝐑𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐦 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 […]”. Unquestionably, as Christians, our heart must be active, strong and alert; if not, the enemy of our soul will take hold of it and begin to manipulate our thoughts. So, start meditating on the Word of God, in order to be alert and able to discern which thoughts are from God and which are from the enemy!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I draw near to You, reading Your precious words, come into my heart, dwell in me, and equip me with the fire of Your Word – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#ProtectYourHeart #AlertHeart

title: Freely We Received, Freely We Give – Wiseman Daniel
text:
The scriptural readings to support the message: Genesis 1 vs. 26, Genesis 2 vs. 7, 1 Corin. 29 vs. 13 – 14, 1 Corin. 1 vs. 30, Psalm 24 vs. 1, Matthew 10 vs. 8, Deut. 8 vs. 18, Luke 6 vs 36 -37, John 21 vs 15 – 17, Ephesians 2 vs 8 – 10  and Acts 1 vs. 8. 



God Almighty created man in the beginning from clay and dust in His own likeness and freely breathe the breath of life into man to become a living being. Through that free gift of the breath of life, God Almighty presented to the world mankind.



God has chosen to make you a caregiver, a maker of life here on earth by freely establishing you to lack nothing and want nothing so that you can use those free gifts of wealth, money, popularity, and position to reach out to His People in the society which you are a part. God’s people are the less privileged in society; the orphans, widows, the elderly, and the physically challenged. Freely we received, freely we should give.









Wiseman Daniel reminded ministers of God including himself that the anointing they have received from God, the free gift of the power of healing, deliverance, blessing, prophecy, and the free gift of the power to save that they have received from God made available by grace through the supreme price Jesus Christ paid on the cross of calvary to commission them is not for selfish, classic and material reasons. Freely we received, freely we should give.



Prayer: As your people have come to the awareness that freely they have received from you Lord, give them the grace to give freely in Jesus’ mighty name. Open the flood gates of Heaven and reign blessing upon your people in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, Amen.

title: TURN YOUR CHILD INTO A LEADER!
text:
Great people simply have great habits. But who makes this great start if not the parents in the way they raise their children? 



Habits such as always maintaining a good relationship with God, prayer, giving, selflessness and determination are built in the very first years of a person’s life and are given as a legacy from parents to children. This is how God-fearing parents educate their children, knowing that today they are children, but tomorrow they will be leaders! Leaders who will shape the world and make a difference in it, by letting love and all the divine virtues guide them in their every step, as they were taught by the Word of God. Because the principles in the Word of God are the most qualitative basis for one’s life. The Word of God itself is an analytical guide of wisdom!



𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟕 “𝐑𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐤𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮. 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡”



As we immerse ourselves in God’s Word and act upon it, we become a shining example to our children, who need to make the right choices today in order to become who God created them to be tomorrow. In fact, what you become tomorrow depends on the choices you make today!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, grant me the grace to bring up this precious gift you have given me, my children, with wisdom and with divine enlightenment, so that they will walk in Your ways and in Your commandments – in Your name I pray, amen.#LeadersOfTomorrow #RaisingChildren

title: NEVER LET YOUR CIRCUMSTANCES CONTROL YOU
text:
John 16:33 says: “These things I have spoken to you, that in Me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation; but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world.” Never let your circumstances control you, for Jesus has overcome for you! A man may be sick in body and yet be a candidate of Heaven – or poor and yet be a friend of God. Whatever you may be facing, stay firm and cheerful, for challenges teach us to pray always. Many Christians fret, mutter, lament and gripe about their situation; they are concerned about how they are performing, feeling or being treated. Yet, it is all about the Saviour – Jesus Christ – and not about us.



Your situation says: “You’re not a candidate of Heaven. You can’t achieve anything because you’re a sinner. You’re nothing and won’t amount to anything.” Your situation talks fear and doubt. But instead of worrying and doubting, come to the revelation of what God says about your situation (2 Corinthians 12:1). What you are complaining about may be to prepare you for a new level in life and stop you awhile in order to prepare you well for the journey ahead while strengthening your desire for God.



2 Corinthians 12:8 says, “Concerning this thing – I pleaded with the Lord three times that it might depart from me.” Apostle Paul had a thorn in his flesh and prayed earnestly to God for its removal, beseeching the Lord three times. This means that we must persist in prayer until we get an answer. Remember, that prayer is a salve to every sore, a remedy to every malady. When afflicted with thorns in our flesh, we should give ourselves to prayer. A person who aspires to be the source of freedom must first have experienced hardship. For gold to be gold, it must pass through the furnace of fire. So, whatever situation you are in now, be mindful that it is meant to strengthen your love for God.



Prayer point: O Holy Spirit, make our hearts ready to follow You and bend our hearts to do Your will, in Jesus’ name! Amen.

title: THE REAL MEANING OF FREEDOM!
text:
“𝐈𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐟𝐫𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐞𝐞. 𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐦, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐞 𝐛𝐮𝐫𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐛𝐲 𝐚 𝐲𝐨𝐤𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐬𝐥𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲.” – 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟏



Jesus Christ, with His Crucifixion, redeemed us and broke every bond of sin in our life, so that today we can live a life of freedom. But what is His freedom all about? As we maintain a solid relationship with God, He teaches us, through His Word, how to live freely according to God’s principles and laws!



Worldly pleasures, vanity and fleshly desires are some of what many today consider to be signs of freedom, because they want to serve God on their own terms and conditions. However, this way of believing and worshipping God does not agree with the principles that God’s Word teaches us! When the Word of God refers to freedom, it refers to a free life away from sin and its consequences. Clearly, Jesus Christ has given us a mind and the ability to choose between right and wrong, but we in turn have a role to play… Our role is to honour Jesus Christ with our character, as a sign of gratitude for His sacrifice and for His grace in our lives!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Heavenly Father, help me to understand the true meaning of Your freedom. I pray that I will not become swayed by the kind of freedom the world displays as I choose to make Your Word the standard for my life – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!#RealFreedom #FreeLife

title: The Joy of the Lord is Our Strength
text:
Since the Founder of the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN) left, it seems as if he was able to instruct his wife, Mama Serah, our wife in Arigidi Akoko, now Pastor Evelyn Joshua, to carry on. Prophet TB Joshua must have told his wife saying, “Do not grieve, for the joy of the Lord is your strength” (Nehemiah 8:10). Hence as we gather frequently in SCOAN let us always keep in mind that the Joy of the Lord is our strength. Also continuing in the ministry of SCOAN is continuing in Christ’s mission. This isn’t going to be by might nor by power, but by the Spirit of the LORD Almighty, (Zechariah 4:6).



Witnessing the word of God to people till they understand and come to full repentance remains our mission.  This Word of God when understood will create in us a broken, contrite heart and a receptive mind. This is a big task for us in SCOAN and for every living Church of Christ; preaching the pure word of God in its full power. May God’s Word open our eyes to see the way we have failed God and to truly see who the Lord is. In this awareness, as we celebrate another Christmas without Prophet TB Joshua our real delight shall come in the joy of the Lord. This is because our God is forgiving, gracious, loving and compassionate. Yet our God expects each one to be like Him righteous and holy (Psalm 145:17). He has generously blessed us with a precious Arena of Liberty, where we may worship and be cleaned. We must strive not to abuse this Ground nor defile it. Thence we shall always find the joy, gladness and strength of God we so desire. For God is for us a place of safety, our protecting refuge, our stronghold, our source of joy and strength.



The joy of the Lord is a constant gladness and a cause for rejoicing. It stems from inner strength and our relationship with Him. When Jesus died for us, He restored us to a peace with God that cannot be undone. Our joy rests on God’s joy. This Christmas Season we celebrate the Birth of this King Jesus the source of our hope and joy. Jesus invoked this joy in us when He spoke, “That they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves” (John 17:13).



Merry Christmas and be filled with the joy of the Lord. Emmanuel!



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria

title: MERRY AND BLESSED CHRISTMAS TO THE WHOLE WIDE WORLD !!!🎄🎁
text:
Christmas! One might say that it is perhaps the biggest commercial holiday of the year. Another would say that it is the greatest celebration of selflessness and love! Surely for everyone, Christmas outlines something different, something unique! So, every year, just before Christmas, we begin to do acts of love and giving. We begin to love our neighbour more, talk about Christ more and be more patient with the people around us! But what is the real meaning of Christmas? What is it that we should remember every year just before the birth of the great Saviour? “𝐓𝐨𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝 𝐚 𝐒𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐡𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐡, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝.” (𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐:𝟏𝟏)



Christmas is the starting point for the salvation of the whole world! Therefore, remembering the virtues of the Holy Spirit only on Christmas certainly does not represent a man of faith! This is because faith is a lifestyle! Therefore, every Christmas we should remember that with the birth of the Saviour, faith was born in our hearts. Along with it, love, peace, selflessness, joy and giving were also born! If until today these were not in your heart, it is never too late! This Christmas, receive by faith! 



Merry Christmas and happy holidays to the entire world!

title: DON’T MIX GOD WITH OTHER gods!
text:
Have you ever been told that yoga brings wellness, that astrology provides guidance and that crystal healing works for revitalisation? Have you seen various amulets and charms given for good luck or observed traditions associated with these human creations? Has anyone read your coffee or a tarot card for you?



A positive answer to any of the above questions testifies to man’s turning away from God nowadays… Idols have so invaded the world in the form of seemingly harmless objects or habits, that it is almost impossible to realise that our belief in them nullifies our belief in God.



In Exodus 34:14, the Lord emphasises: “For you shall worship no other god, for the Lord, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God”. Therefore, any object of worship that does not involve God, while being marketed as neo-pagan wellness, refreshment, fashion or recreation, is an idol or a false god… Our God does not need the support or help of other gods! He can do the miracle you are seeking on His own! A time of testing is a time to strengthen one’s relationship with God. Have total faith in God in any situation, and you will see that once you overcome and come out victorious, all the glory will go to the One and Only God. If you mix God with other gods in the midst of your trial, you will not be able to discern the invisible hand of God in your situation!



Are you ready to see the name of the Lord being glorified through your life? Jesus Christ is your only Provider, give Him the main position in your life and see what He will do for you!



𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord of Hosts and Creator of the universe, help me to trust You completely so that all glory goes to You alone! I know that You are a jealous God and You can do everything alone! Let Your will be done!”



#JealousGod#God
