title: THE ROAD TO BREAKTHROUGH IS SIMPLE!
text:
Have you ever wondered what the key to taking your life to a higher level is? The answer is simpler than you think! Simply start giving rather than receiving! And what is it that you can give? Every good thing that the Lord has given you! If you think you haven’t received anything from God, just remember your talents!



Has God blessed you with a wonderful voice? Are you perhaps very good at learning new things? Are you very good at organising? Are you good at teaching others what you know? If you have any of these talents or other ones, it is time to ask yourself how you have positively influenced the lives of those around you with these gifts! If you boast about your talents, but you do not use them to change someone’s life, then you are missing the real purpose for which they were given to you. Our gifts were given to us so that we can contribute in the lives of those around us, for in 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟐:𝟗:𝟔, the Word of God warns us by saying: “[…] 𝐇𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐥𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩 𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐥𝐲, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩 𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲.”



As long as we are alive, one thing will remain forever, and that is sowing and reaping! The Word of God clearly tells us that as we sow our knowledge, our time to teach everything useful that we know in our neighbour’s life, God is pleased because we serve God when we help our fellow brother. When you help your brother’s life change and level up, God will help you too! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, as Your Word says that my genuine service to You is shown when I help my fellow brother, help me use all the talents You have given me for the success of the people around me. As I do this, I know that You will also help me succeed – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#HelpOthers #LevelUp

title: PREPARE THE GROUND FOR THE NEW YEAR!
text:
Calendar-wise, we are at the end of this year and our hope for the incoming new year is uplifted! Every ending encompasses a new beginning within it and New Year’s Eve is the milestone of every year. The questions that arise about the resolutions we made at the beginning of the year and whether we have kept them during the year… However, what we must remember at every year ending is that in order to make a difference in the New Year, we should not solve the problems of the New Year using the old year’s approach.



By letting God go ahead of us every step of the way, we are transformed into a new person. Our mindset changes and, we learn what God’s will for our lives is, which is wonderful! As the Word of God tells us in 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟏𝟕: “[…] 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐠𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐮𝐧!”.



Because in keeping our resolutions, we feel fulfilled at the end of the year, whereas if we fail to keep  them and fail to change our attitude, character and general approach to life, we will always find ourselves looking forward to a fresh beginning at the end  the New Year.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Act in me, O Holy Spirit, that I may keep my resolutions! Help me  fix what I failed to accomplish in the past year and strengthen me, O Holy Spirit, so that I may keep my promises as I run the good fight of faith in the year to come! Guide me, O Holy Spirit, that I may do what is right in Your sight!”#newyear #newlife

title: NEW YEAR, NEW DECISIONS!
text:
One of the most beautiful moments of the year has arrived again! The festive atmosphere, decorations and family gatherings create a beautiful environment of joy and warmth. But we should never forget the essence of this celebration!



Indeed, we celebrate the end of the previous year and the coming of the new one, but what makes the year new is not the change of the year’s digits, but us! In fact, it is the day when we need to do some honest self-examination and see what needs to be left behind in our life, along with the previous year. Our Lord taught us that as children of God we are to walk from faith to faith and from glory to glory, according to 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟑:𝟏𝟖: “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐮𝐧𝐯𝐞𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝’𝐬 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐲, 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐦𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫-𝐢𝐧𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐲, 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭”.



If you are ready for a new level of faith in your life this year, then it is time to ask yourself the following questions: “Who am I? Who do I want to be and what do I need to do to accomplish what God has called me to be in my life? What is it that is holding me back and stopping me?”. The answer to these questions will help you to identify what are the elements and weaknesses that need to be left behind this year and help you to make new decisions to do something new, something you have never done before. It is time to do something different to change your life from failure to success.



Are you ready? If so, then say this prayer🙏:



“Lord Jesus Christ, help me realise my weaknesses, anything that is holding me back and stopping me from fulfilling Your plan in my life. In this new year, Lord, give me the grace to say, “No” to sin and, “Yes” to Your righteousness! Guide my steps and enlighten my mind to make the right decisions – in Your Holy name I pray, amen!”#NewYear #Decisions

title: LET YOUR DOUBTS MOVE YOU CLOSER TO GOD
text:
Doubt is one thing that we all battle and struggle with; even the greatest believers sometimes need help to boost their faith amidst life’s issues, challenges. Take the case of Abraham in Genesis 15:6. Although he believed, he nevertheless wanted a sign to strengthen his faith. Indeed, many great heroes of faith in the Bible had their moments of doubt but that did not detract from their faith; it just meant that their faith was being challenged in new ways.



If you are genuinely seeking salvation from God in the midst of doubt, God will not mind. This is because, in the end, your doubt will move you closer to Him. Some situations in life will challenge your faith and make you doubt your Guard. I mean sickness, disease, hardship, disappointment and the like. However, do not let them draw you away from God but take you closer to Him.



Today, we acknowledge only the immediate goodness of God when we receive a miracle and afterwards forget that miracle. Remember the sickness you had in the past? It was that same sickness that claimed the lives of others, even as many others are still on the sickbed. What is the lesson for us? Never doubt God’s desire and ability to help you! Why? Because He has promised to never leave or forsake you.



When you are struggling with doubt, take time to remember God’s work in your life. As you recall His track record, you will grow confident that a solution is forthcoming, that you will overcome your present situation. Be patient and let God answer your questions at His own time, not yours. God’s time is always the best. He knows you better than you know yourself and He knows what is best for you. Have faith in Him always and, as sure as the rising sun, you will not be disappointed.



Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to hold on to You in good and hard times alike! Help me to continue to trust in You and Your sufficiency, in Your Holy name, I pray!”

title: SMILE! IT LOOKS GOOD ON YOU!
text:
As children of God, we ought to shine as rays of light in this dark world. And what is the easiest way to do that? With a smile! It’s as simple as that!



Don’t be afraid to show your smile, because every smile encapsulates the joy of God within it and it has the power to ease the pain of your neighbour, even if you don’t realise it. Did you know that with just one smile, you can help someone overcome any problem they are going through more easily? Imagine what can happen if you start speaking encouraging words of God, words that build people up, that strengthen their faith, that give them hope! Words that speak love and not hate!



Reading 𝟏 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝟏𝟓:𝟐𝟗, “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐝, 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐌𝐢𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐥, 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐥’𝐬 𝐝𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐫, 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐚 𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐰 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐰 𝐊𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐜; 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭.”, we see King David expressing the joy that God had given him, not caring what the people around him will say! King David knew that it doesn’t matter what people say about you in this life; what matters is what you believe about yourself! Therefore, don’t hide your joy and don’t allow the enemy to steal it from you in any way! Start smiling from today, because it looks good you!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, thank You for Your grace and mercy in my life! Help me not to allow life’s circumstances and the opinions of others to steal my joy, for I know that my joy comes from You, and You know my heart – in Your mighty name I pray, amen!”#Smile #Shine

title: TRUST IN GOD’S AUTHORITY
text:
Sometimes we are confronted with life’s harsh realities. When you find yourself in such a situation, you must tarry awhile and look around to find God’s purpose in your situation, for God is always saying something. Even when He seems to be quiet, He is still saying something. The tougher your trials, the closer you are to your breakthrough. In Daniel 3:15-18, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego were conscious of their faith in God despite serious tension, pressure and threats to their lives. They knew that God would embolden them to face life‘s final deadline. Do not trust in princes, who are mere mortals, for when their spirits depart, they too will return to the ground, their plans coming to nothing. Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God (Psalm 146:3-5).



Today, many have surrendered to their fears even as their hearts long for miracles. Because of tension and pressure, many have abandoned their posts, believing there is no hope, no way, no future for them. Overwhelmed, they see only failure. Are you in such a situation? Never assume God’s ability cannot put you over. Hard times are opportunities to honour God before men. Trust in God’s authority, not man’s majority, so that your focus will be on God always. If you do so, you will be calm, calculated and determined. Always remember that trouble does not require invitation, for the Bible says there will be troubles but they will ultimately be for God’s glory.



Tough times reveal true people of faith – those focused on God and who see trouble as a means of spiritual advancement. Your enemies may strip you of outward beauty and prestige, rob you of your liberty or imprison you but they cannot shut you out from the throne of mercy and communion with God. God’s government and authority are incontestable. When God says yes, no one can say no. His power and majesty are enough to support His authority, so trust in God’s authority only!

title: BUILD A STRONG MARRIAGE!
text:
Why do many marriages today fall apart even though the couple decided together to unite in holy matrimony? What is responsible for this and what are the real causes of a divorce in a Christian couple that believes in this divine union? Marriage is an honorable social institution established by God! It is not something to be taken lightly, but to be done in reverence and fear of God! When a couple decides to get married, their purpose is to stay together until the end and to make God’s Word the standard for their lives. Thus, with God’s eternal Word as their foundation, the couple is called to walk together. Even as they go through trials, they must continue to believe in Jesus Christ!



The All-Knowing God in 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟐:𝟏𝟖 𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐬: “𝐈𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐞. 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐦”. So, while God wants to unite man and woman, the devil comes to do the opposite! He comes to separate, to break the union of two people who were brought together by God, bringing problems, quarrels, fights and arguments… Satan always aims to destroy beautiful families in various ways and, unfortunately, the children of God are unable to see it. However, if we realise that our battle is not against flesh and blood but against principalities and powers that cause tension and pressure in our lives and in our marriage, then we will begin to fight the right battle through prayer!



Trials should not break your marriage, but take it to a higher level! Whatever it is you are facing, don’t give up on your marriage. Crises cannot break the one who relies on God’s strength for everything. Ask God to fill you with grace, mercy and the strength to overcome because if you give up and allow your trials to overwhelm you, they will destroy you! Love and family are important parts of our lives, because as humans we need to love and be loved!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Lord Jesus Christ, as I agree that marriage is sacred, give me a God-fearing heart and help me to lean on Your strength, so that when marital difficulties come, I may overcome them and begin to enjoy Your victories in my marriage – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#StrongMarriage #DivineUnion

title: LEARNING OBEDIENCE THROUGH SUFFERING
text:
Good Morning and Win Forever in Jesus Christ’s name – Amen! Obeying God at first may seem hard until we come to realise that all He is asking for is for our own good – to make life free and full. As Christians, our obedience to God’s Word is the only proof of our faith in Him. As Prophet T.B. Joshua noted, if we who are children of God cannot commit our bodies to God when we are sick, what would be the essence of our faith? If we as children of God cannot commit our businesses to God, in both good and hard times, what would be the evidence of our faith? 



Brethren in Christ, our situation is not like others’. For the people of the world, their situation may be to destroy them but ours is for the glory of God. Who knows what would have happened if your prayers for a better condition had been answered? People of God, hope you know that our situation is an opportunity to honour God before men? The people of the world are waiting to see how you handle your situation.In the Book of Hebrews 5:8, the Bible says about our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, that though He is the Son of the Living God, He learnt obedience through the things He suffered and therefore was made perfect. Brethren in Christ, if the King of Kings, our Saviour Jesus Christ, could go through trials and temptations and learn obedience from them, how much more would be expected of us, His followers? Children of God, what is your situation? Is it poverty, hardship, sickness, limitation, stagnation? Remember that God is using it to preserve you for redemption, to prepare you for that great future. 



In conclusion, people of God, don’t ever let your situation make you doubt God’s ability to put you over; always trust His will and promises for your life. SAY THIS PRAYER: Lord Jesus Christ, help me to continue to trust and obey You, even in the face of overwhelmingly negative sense evidence.

title: BECOME A VESSEL OF RECONCILIATION!
text:
Everyone has someone in their life that did wrong to them or hurt them. The question is: What do you choose to do concerning this issue? Will you allow the pain to take over your heart or you will choose to release that pain and allow God to make justice? Do you want to be right or do you want to be reconciled?



God wants us to cherish our relationships and to make efforts to maintain them, instead of giving up on them when a disagreement, offense, or conflict occurs. The Bible also clearly states that God has committed to us “the ministry of reconciliation”  (𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟏𝟖)



It’s easy to put forgiveness and reconciliation on a back burner, but as Christ worked to reconcile us with God, we should also take up the challenge to be men of peace and reconciliation in our families, relationships and in our world in general.



In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟓:𝟗 Jesus boldly says, “𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝”. In other words, Jesus is saying, blessed are those who work to bring peace, those who make efforts to resolve the conflicts! No matter who is at fault, God is always expecting you to make the first step toward reconciliation and forgiveness! Always keep in mind that forgiveness does not mean ignoring what happened. It does not mean that you have to sweep the dirt under the rug. Forgiveness is an awareness that no one is perfect. Only One is perfect, the One who sacrificed His life for us to be saved, the One without any guilt, who bore the guilt of our sin on His shoulder. By choosing to forgive others, we resemble Him more and more. When you forgive and let go of offense, something will happen to you that cannot be explained by the natural mind because the dividend of forgiveness is freedom.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I come to You and I ask You to make me a vessel of reconciliation. As You have forgiven me, grant me the grace to forgive as well. I choose today to release all the pain, bitterness, and offense and to receive instead Your comfort, Your peace, and Your love, in Jesus’ mighty name!”#Reconcile #Forgiveness

title: TODAY’S PASSPORT FOR TOMORROW’S JOURNEY
text:
God has kept you for a purpose known to Him alone and being alive today is proof that you will still fulfil destiny. The Bible says that when you seek anything for the salvation of your soul, whatever you receive will come with the peace of God and fulfillment in Christ Jesus, so you will lack and want nothing. Our failure to seek things for the purpose of salvation is actually why we have a crisis of faith. We do many things to achieve our goals but remain on one spot because something is restricting us.



When a person believes, he will no longer worry or despair or query God about the past or present. 



Faith reminds us that our sins are forgiven. As an international passport is required for a visa to another country, so is faith to our journey. Psalm 37:25 assures us that God is a righteous Judge and will never forsake His own. But our state of mind is important. Many fearful and worried minds make decisions about tomorrow even when they are living outside the truth of God’s light.



 Remember that God arranges our present, which continues to unfold until His will is finally revealed. Surely, the divine opportunity of today leads us to the mystery of tomorrow, for today is the centre of yesterday and tomorrow. To bless you, God demands your faith today. If you cannot forget yesterday, you cannot have the blessings of today.



What keeps us from worry and anxiety is not what we see but what we believe. The opening of our eyes of faith is the silencing of our worries. When you believe, you will appreciate and recognise the unseen hand of God controlling your affairs and you will see beyond your immediate circumstances. 



In Genesis 22:1-2, God’s command seemed to conflict with His promise for Abraham. The biggest decision in life is what you do with Christ’s instruction now. Make a heart decision today: Trust God, go beyond your past, look forward to the future through His promises, and truly live as it should be in the present by faith.

title: GROWING IN CHRIST’S LIKENESS
text:
As a true Christian, a true follower of Christ Jesus, if you are to know a good life, a successful life, a prosperous life, you simply need Jesus Christ to direct your ways. Christ has no eyes but your eyes to see those who are in need and Christ has no legs but your legs to go to places to bring men to Himself. Your hands, He will surely use to work. You simply need Jesus to direct your ways. Do you do good? Do you show love to others, even those who do not share the same faith with you? Do you help for God’s sake? Do you do good without any condition attached to your goodness? Have you forgiven and reconciled with those who hurt you, who wronged you – I mean those who deeply hurt you?



Much of the life we claim to be living today is not genuine, real; there is so much fake, pretentious, questionable living. 



Conversion is once in a lifetime but Christlikeness is forever. Who are you? At this moment, if Christ Jesus should come to demand from you an account of your life, what would it be like? First, you need to acknowledge your weaknesses and purge yourself by confession and deliverance. Then, you can press on in His time, ways and grace. Be an imitator of your Heavenly Father – growing in His likeness day by day and hour by hour, by loving, helping and giving.



PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, give me the grace to be like Christ Jesus inner my heart, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: FEELING REJECTED??? THIS IS FOR YOU
text:
Are you feeling discouraged and defeated by life’s challenges? It sometimes appears as if everything around us contradicts God’s promises for our lives, bringing confusion and unbelief…This man once faced the same struggles. Despite being met with rejection and setback after setback in his professional life, he found true deliverance in God. As Christians, we are bound to have attacks, because everything close to Jesus receives attack! Nevertheless, this story is a reminder that no matter what obstacles you may face, there is always a way to find peace and happiness.



This powerful confession will leave you feeling encouraged to keep pushing through life’s toughest moments! As you watch, stand in faith, putting on the armour of the Word of God in order to keep fighting the enemy of our soul, in Jesus’ name!



📺 𝐖𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐨𝐧 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐓𝐮𝐛𝐞: https://youtu.be/NWWaLFwMmK0#Rejection #Prophecy

title: BLESSED TO BE SAVED!
text:
How wonderful are the blessings of God in our lives! What great joy we receive when God answers our prayers, tears down our mountains, and splits in two the Red Sea of uncertainties in our life! If we look at the beginning of our lives until today, we will observe God’s protection and goodness thriving, despite the enemy’s attempts to crush us. Nevertheless, we get so caught up in our worldly blessings and possessions that we forget the purpose for which God has blessed us!



It is great to prosper and it is good to enjoy our marriage, our family, our career, and all the blessings God provides so generously in our life, yet, on our last day on earth, none of these will be able to guarantee the salvation of our soul!



God wants you to succeed, but He wants you to succeed with a purpose and as children of God, our first goal and our main concern should be the salvation of our soul! Do not waste the precious time God has given you, indulging in temporal pleasures! Live each and every one of your days for the salvation of your soul, which is the end of our faith, according to 𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟏:𝟗: “𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟏:𝟗: “𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐥𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐬”.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I thank You for the joy of Your salvation and I pray that, as I focus on things that have eternal value, You will give me the grace to reach the end of my faith, in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Salvation #Blessings

title: MORE HASTE, LESS SPEED
text:
For those who are seated by the highway of life, saying: “Life is not fair to me. I don’t get it; I am poor. I have been a Christian for years, paying my tithe regularly but still things are not working out for me; things haven’t changed. I’m supposed to be rich now” – brethren, everything is beautiful in God’s time, yet that time is limited: a time to labour without immediate result and a time to reap the product of grace.



Life is in stages. When it is time to start a race, everybody waits for the blast of the gun or the sound of the whistle. However, in our daily lives today, the opposite is the case for many. In an attempt to beat the gun, we discover that we are worse off for it; we pay dearly for it. As an adage says, “More haste, less speed.” This means that if you are in haste to achieve something, you are likely to make costly mistakes that will pull you back, if not down. Many, while attempting to beat the gun, find themselves entangled with conditions that jeopardize their career and ruin their success in life.



Whatever crisis you may be going through, God is aware. Never interpret His silence as rejection. That situation may be to preserve you so that you can take your future in your hands; it may be to reform you, it may be to prepare you in order for you to take your proper position and possession in Christ Jesus.



PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, give me the grace to continue to wait in God’s presence so His Will can be done in my life, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: IS IT NORMAL TO GET 3 DIVORCES? YOU MAY NOT AGREE…
text:
Sometimes, life can be a series of unfortunate events… Yet how many of them are a matter of bad luck? In this incredible testimony, this woman shares her experience as the devil tried to ruin every area of her life! Disappointment, sickness, as well as an evil presence lurking around her had become a routine for years… With intense pain and fear dominating her life, she sought the face of God who is the only One that will never disappoint us. A divine intervention changed her life in ways she could have never imagined, and the same anointing can do the same for you!



If you can relate to the events that took place in her life, now is the time to claim what was paid for on the Cross; deliverance and healing are available to you! Reach out and receive the kind of peace, hope and love only Jesus Christ can give you, in His mighty name!



📺 𝐖𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐨𝐧 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐓𝐮𝐛𝐞: https://youtu.be/THnLq4lHHE8#Reconciliation #Prophecy

title: HEAR GOD’S CALL!
text:
Most people nowadays are full of insecurity and fear for the future because they make decisions without knowing God’s opinion. However, as a child of God, you were created to act, to think, to plan and to act with God! He is your Creator and He knows better than anyone the reason He sent you on earth. Each one of us has a calling, a special mission from God. Do you know what your calling is? If not, you need direction, not from other people, but from your Creator Himself! Only if you seek guidance from God will you accomplish uncommon and unique things, and your heart will be filled with joy!



Your calling is one that when you discover it, you will feel complete and realise that by following it, you are truly happy. If you do not know it yet, it is never too late! In 1 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟑:𝟕, the Word of God mentions: “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦”. Once the Lord revealed Himself to Samuel, his calling became clear!



Today, because of the lures and cares of the world, fleshly desires, the attraction of the world – pleasure has turned the heart of many from their Creator and although God is calling them, they do not recognise His voice! If you have not yet found the purpose of your life, your calling, it means that you need God more in your life. God speaks to us daily. Thus, pray for Him to open the eyes of your faith in order to hear Him! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me discover my divine calling. Heavenly Father, let what You have chosen for my life be done, according to Your will and not mine. Give me the grace to follow Your plan in my life – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Calling #LIfesPurpose

title: LEARN OBEDIENCE
text: When we learn the purpose God has made us for and how He cherishes our company, life becomes extremely meaningful and completely enjoyable. How clearly do you really see your life? What does Jesus see? God clearly sees the real you, the healthy you, the prosperous you, the you of your dreams. However, what many experience today is not their real value. The cost of obedience is nothing compared to the cost of disobedience but it is not too late for you to begin to believe and obey God’s Word.Hebrews 5:8-9 tells us that Jesus Christ learnt obedience through the things He suffered. He passed through a season of pain in order to create a season of gain. Because Christ decided to learn obedience by the things He suffered, God refined Him through His afflictions. The way a Christian’s character grows through obedience is by facing difficulties and dealing with problems. For gold to prove itself, it must pass through fire. The more fire gold receives, the better or more valuable it becomes. You are Christ’s gold. As Christ’s gold, you must be melted, remoulded and filled before you can be used for every purpose of God. What stage of refinement are you at? If you have been melted, you still need to be remoulded. If you have been remoulded, you still have to be filled before you can be used. It is a builder, a refiner of character. It is meant for your obedience.If you know you are Christ’s gold, make this your declaration of faith: “My situation is a refiner of character. It is removing the impurity of hatred/unfaithfulness/anger from the character of God in my life. I have learnt obedience, love, peace, patience, humility, forgiveness and self-control through the things I have suffered. My character is growing because I am being refined.”

title: Evelyn Joshua & Emmanuel TV Partners Raised £10,000 for Earthquake Victims in Turkey
text:
Pastor Evelyn Joshua and Emmanuel TV Partners raised £10,000 in fundraising for earthquake victims in Turkey



In line with their passion for changing lives, nations and the world, Pastor Evelyn Joshua and the Emmanuel TV Partners reached out to the nation, Turkey with a donation of the sum of Ten Thousand Pounds Through the London Alevi Cultural Centre and Cemevi (IAKMC) a registered charity in the UK. This is to support the nation, as rescue efforts continue in the aftermath of the devastating earthquake that hit some of the cities recently. In a world that cares less, we are called by God to show love just as Christ loved the world and gave His life for it.

title: JESUS’ KIND OF LOVE!
text:
What is love? Is it emotions? Is it a skill? Can you draw it? Does it have a color? Can everyone see it? Many people wonder today… In 𝟏 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟏𝟑, the Word of God points out the significance of love: “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧: 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡, 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞.” 



Love looks around to see who is in need. We will begin to succeed in our lives when the pain and problems of others matter to us! As Christians, the pain of others must be our pain too, because love cares more about others rather than about itself. Love does not want what it does not have, love never boasts, it never underestimates others and it never thinks of evil! Father God was, is, and will always be an inconceivable example of love, since He loved us so much that He sent His only Son to the world, so that we may live through Him!



We serve God when we help our fellow brothers. Helping your fellow brother when he is in need is the best and the greatest investment you can make! One who doesn’t love his fellow human being cannot receive the power of God. The power to heal, the power to deliver, the power to bless. But how can we learn how to live like Christ if we do not love like He does?



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me enough love in order to always walk according to Your commandments. Help me have the kind of love that you showed us, in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Love #LoveIsGreat

title: DO GOOD TO CHANGE THE WRONG YOU SEE
text:
We don’t have to look too far to find things we don’t like in our society. If you look through your immediate surroundings, you will see frightening things: economic oppression, political oppression, financial oppression, injustice and misrule everywhere. Instead of criticising our troubled society, we should do what is good to change the bad we see. The Book of 1 Peter 2:15 tells us that God wants us to do good so as to silence the ignorant talk of foolish people. In the face of all this, let us be known as people who are for the good not just being against the bad. Instead of being against poverty and using insensitive words, you should make a tangible contribution towards the society.



When we see something that needs to be improved, changed or adjusted in our society, we must take responsibility. The Bible says that we should not do wrong for wrong but always do good to change the bad we see. This calls for self-examination, which is one of the keys that Jesus has given to us. If you see something wrong with what you are doing, the result of your self-examination would be self-reproach and the zeal to make correction. The first step towards correction is for you not to put the blame on another person. The question you need to ask yourself now is, ‘Am I guilty of the following: criticising others unduly, using insensitive words, refusing to admit my mistakes, belittling the opinions of others?’. Remember that these things can only wreck relationships and hinder the healing of past hurt. The Lord Jesus Christ wants us to do good to change the bad we see; He wants to see us move from saying words to taking actions, to move from complaining about issues to solving them. Examine yourself today and remember to do good to change the bad you see. 



PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, give me love enough to overlook the mistakes of others, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen!

title: RAISING UNCOMMON KIDS!
text:
Dear parents,If we consider the whole world to be one big stage, in your child’s eyes you have the lead role! For this reason, the Word of God in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟐:𝟔 advises parents by saying: “𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐨𝐟𝐟 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐠𝐨, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐢𝐭”. But what exactly does God’s Word urge us to teach them? Love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness self-control – all the fruits of the Spirit! However, in order to be able to teach these things to our children, we, as parents, must, first of all, obey the Father’s commandments, so that we can be a proper Christian role model for them!



If we could compare children with something, we could say that they are like sponges! They watch and observe us daily, aiming to develop their own personal character as well. They observe our every word, our every action, our every opinion, every minute of the day and they rely on our existence to build their own. Therefore, you, parents, have a role to play! 



Children learn from what they experience. So, if we as parents smoke, we should not be surprised when our child adopts that very same habit. If we speak badly and rudely, we should not be surprised if our children argue and fight with the people around them. If we solve arguments with violence, it will not be a surprise if our children become violent! Inevitably, then, we can firmly conclude that children mirror the parents who raised them! Do you want to set the best possible example for your children? Know that God gave us the Bible to show us the way of salvation and to teach us how to live for Him! Our children are the leaders of tomorrow! Leaders who will make history for the glory of our Lord, Jesus Christ. So start raising the most uncommon children with the help of God’s eternal Word!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, I ask for Your strength to be a proper role model for my children. Help me to obey Your commandments in my daily life, so that I may raise my children with values. Values that can offer hope and change in this world, in this society that lives without faith and hope – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#KidsWithValues #UncommonKids

title: I AM DOING A NEW THING
text:
Each time you remember the mistakes of the past, are you disturbed?  Remember that we are living in a complex and contradictory world where perfection eludes us all. The fact that no one knows tomorrow makes mistakes an inevitable part of our daily life. We have made wrong decisions in our dealings with people, in our places of work and the kind of people we keep as friends. These wrong decisions sometimes make us bitter, depressed and hopeless. Cheer up! There is hope. Yesterday’s failure can become today’s success when God is involved. 



Isaiah 43:18-19 says, “Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.” This means that what people say or think about you does not matter. God can change anyone at anytime and anywhere, because He has a plan for us – a plan to reform you through that mistake and bring you to a new level in life. When you remove the guilt and shame of your past mistakes by focusing on Jesus Christ, you will see the new thing God is doing. You will not consider the past, because Jesus Christ has put an end to your past and given birth to your future. 



PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to see the new thing you are doing in my life, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: MAINTENANCE IS KEY
text:
There are people who complain that they cannot maintain their healing, blessings, financial breakthrough and deliverance. If you had been maintaining the blessing you had received from God right from the beginning of your life, you would not be complaining today. Prophet T.B. Joshua said, “If you have not seen enough and you receive suddenly, you will lose that blessing because you will not know the value of that blessing. God allows you to see enough because He does not want you to lose what you are going to receive.”



In Hebrews 12:8-18, it is written that God trains all of His children. God trains us for two main things: for us to receive and for us to maintain what we receive. Anybody can be blessed but not everybody can maintain their blessings. Maintenance is not about keeping the blessings but about preserving our relationship with the Giver – God. 



Blessings cannot maintain your life but the Source of your blessings can — and that is God! Remember, maintenance is more important than receiving. As Christians, we need God more in blessings than in poverty, because the blessings of God always attract uncommon challenges, persecution, hatred, envy and jealousy from the people to such an extent that it is only God that can see us through. More blessings mean more enemies. Therefore, watch and pray the more to maintain your blessings. PRAYER: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to maintain my relationship with You, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: DON’T FAKE CHRISTIANITY!
text:
Many Christians today take their relationship with God for granted, to the extent that they have stopped playing their role as children of God. They ease their conscience by doing some spiritual deeds but without involving their heart in that matter. But a man can be a Christian in profession and yet not such in heart!



Do you remember the Pharisee from Jesus’ parable in 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟏𝟖:𝟏𝟐? He was comparing himself with his neighbour, the tax collector, saying that he is not like him… The Pharisee was doing the right thing according to the Law, yet, he was not justified before God. That is because those who would come to God must do so with humility and sincerity of mind and not confession in the form of fasting and praying or waving hands in worship, without a thorough reformation of heart and life!



Comparing your Christian life with others and thinking that you are better than them is a trap of the enemy! If it is for you to compare yourself with someone, you should examine your life in the light of the Word of God and compare the way you live your life with the way God instructs us to live in His Word! We should always look at the way He prayed, the way He forgave, the way He loved and had compassion for the people around Him. In this way, you will 𝐧𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐥𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐬𝐨𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝐣𝐮𝐝𝐠𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭. (𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟑)



True Christianity lies in the heart, in the purity of the heart! No matter how many good deeds you do, no matter how much you pray, fast or give offerings to the church, what really matters at the end of the day before God is the motive behind these actions. Jesus Christ came to invite us to a relationship with Him. He did not come to invite us to a religion, nor to follow some certain rules, but to have a genuine friendship and fellowship with Him.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord, I pray that You would grant me the grace to be an authentic Christian, having a genuine relationship with You. I am what I am only by Your grace. In everything I do for You, help me to have the purest motives and honour You with all that I am – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!#Fake #Christianity

title: Happy birthday, Emmanuel TV!
text:
Seventeen years ago, on a day like this, the Lord God made it possible for Emmanuel TV to come into existence through the instrumentality of His servant, Prophet TB Joshua.As we look back through the years, we know that God’s Right Hand of Grace, Favour and Compassion has remained strong upon this gospel channel.



Through Emmanuel TV, we have all joined hands together to make the world a better place by sharing what God has given us with the needy in all spheres of life. We have extended hands of solidarity, fellowship and warmth to those in crises brought on by nature. And, more importantly, we have all contributed in supporting The TB Joshua Ministries to spread the message of love and salvation across the world.



As we celebrate this 17th anniversary of Emmanuel TV — a medium through which millions of lives have been transformed worldwide — we urge you to look beyond your present situation and let your spirit be lifted as you carry on with the work of bringing succour to the suffering.



Happy 17th birthday, Emmanuel TV! Emmanuel TV — changing lives, changing nations, changing the world!

title: THE TRUE MEANING OF POVERTY!
text:
When we see someone who is in a very poor financial situation and has no money to meet his daily needs, then according to the standards set by the society, we call them poor. However, the Word of God surprises us once again, as it teaches us that the man that is poor is not the one without money in his pocket but one without vision!



The Word of God in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟗:𝟏𝟖, states, “𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐡: 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐤𝐞𝐞𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐚𝐰, 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐲 𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐞”. In other words, if we wake up and live a life like all the other people, it is almost impossible for us to become anything more than them. It is almost impossible to become more successful, smarter or happier than them… God Almighty did not create us to do what the majority of people do today! Instead, He called us to do what the best do! He created us to have a vision, to succeed in what He has called us to be! But if you don’t have a vision, then you are a person without direction and if you are a person without direction, daily sadness and dissatisfaction will never cease to characterise your life!



It is never too late to stop being “poor” and enrich yourself with the power that your vision generates within you! Once you discover your vision, you will realise that if you are a man of vision, no matter what constitutes the obstacles on your way, you can never be stopped. Instead of pressure and tension to reduce your vision, it will evenenlarge your strategies.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, give me a vision that will help me to endure my present situation! Help me to become rich with the treasure of my vision – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Poverty #Vision

title: HARD TIMES ARE NECESSARY
text:
The stories of men and women of faith prove that faithfulness to God does not eliminate adversity, prevent problems from coming close or keep temptations away from your life – that having a relationship with God does not cancel crying times or times of battle. This means that we will continue to be confronted with issues that violate our peace, conscience – that we will experience things that are contrary to God’s standard since we are not yet in Heaven. This, indeed, is the highway of life, where tension arises not because we have done wrong but just because we live in a complex and contradictory world – a world ruled by evil desires rebelling against God’s Word, a world that we children of God have denounced. 



Can you see the conflict? Remember that champions are not crowned for desiring to be crowned but for fighting and overcoming their battles. As Revelation 2:9-10 tells us, that you face challenges does not mean you are not a friend of God and that you are passing through hard times does not mean God has forgotten you or that you will die in it. Job never fainted when the wind pulled down his home; he continued to think, talk, act, plan, work and rule with God, for that is the way of a man God created. 



As a Christian, your faith in God should help you stay true to your purpose – I mean, stay focused – because God will not leave you without a solution. Never doubt God’s desire or ability to help you. He has given you plenty evidence to believe Him even when every sense contradicts Him. Remember that David observed how God had delivered him from the lion and the bear before concluding that he would also be delivered from the giant. 



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, give me the grace to bless You in all situations so that I may be blessed by You through my situation, for this hard time is necessary.

title: DON’T BE DECEIVED!
text:
Making the decision to follow Jesus Christ is a decision that requires determination, boldness and courage! But what is it that makes it difficult for us to come to this decision? How is it that we refuse to realise what Jesus Christ did for us on the Cross of Calvary the moment He said, “It is finished!”? In 𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟓:𝟐𝟎, the Word of God explains: “𝐖𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐮𝐬 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐞. 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐞 𝐛𝐲 𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭. 𝐇𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞”.



If we continue to deny our adoption by Jesus Christ, living a life of sin, satan will not lose time to tempt us! Nothing in this life compares to the supreme opportunity we have to serve God. Nothing compares to the unworthy grace of being called children of the Most High God. Even if everything seems to be going well, even though you have abandoned your relationship with God, don’t be too fast to rest! This is because if you don’t prosper in your spiritual life and you seem to prosper in some other areas it is dangerous; satan will enslave you. So make the decision to build a strong relationship with God and soon your life will change, from failure to success and your joy will be permanent!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, Jesus Christ, thank you for your selfless love. Help me today to build a strong foundation in our relationship, for I know that the greatest and most lasting joy comes as I hear and obey your Word!”#Relationship #Deception

title: ABSOLUTE TRUST IN GOD
text:
As men and women of faith, who look beyond (whose focus is beyond) the natural, we have something to be happy about. We have a reason to be joyful. What a God we have to worship; what a Son we have to praise; what a future lies before us. What a hope we have in Jesus! The Gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ is the power of God unto salvation for everyone who believes. Prophet T.B. Joshua said that the design of the Gospel is to break the yoke of satan, thus removing the guilt of sin. In other words, the Gospel is fashioned to transform your life and give you a wonderful new beginning. That Gospel is the sword of the Spirit that makes satan to flee.



Many people today have surrendered to their fears while their hearts dream of miracles, going by the happenings around the world today – people being afflicted with sicknesses and diseases, homes being broken by infidelity, companies being closed down by lack of trust and misappropriation of funds and others. Are you in such a situation? The way out is to express the necessary trust in Christ Jesus. Never for a moment assume that God’s ability cannot put you over. Champions of faith throughout history had to express the necessary trust in God to experience His power. Whatever your background may have been, whatever your upbringing may have been, wherever you are coming from – one thing is certain: once we express the necessary trust in Christ Jesus, His duty will be to raise us from death to life and then to restore our wholeness and fellowship with God. 



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to trust you even when every sense contradicts you.

title: SATAN’S MOTIVE IN TEMPTING GOD’S PEOPLE
text:
The greatest thing satan aims at in tempting God’s people is to overthrow their position before God. As children of God, we must beware of falling into temptation; however, if God allows it, we should not think it strange and doubt the Creator of Heaven and Earth (1 Corinthians 10:13).



The Spirit that descended on Jesus was to humble Him and at the same time to make Him strong. If you rely on your own strength and tempt the devil to tempt you, that is not humility. This is because the power given to us is not to be used at our own will but God’s will. If God were to leave you to your own strength while you are praying for a demon-possessed person, you yourself would end up needing deliverance! 



We must be aware of satan’s tactics; He wants us to cut off our dependence on God. He wants you to stop your duty to God and begin to see Him in a bad light. He wants you to cut off your communion with God and do things by your own strength. We must be careful about falling into temptation but if God allows it, we should not think it strange and doubt the Creator of Heaven and Earth. Let us beware of spiritual pride, which has been the cause of much of the destruction we see in the world today.Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to rely on you for everything, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: DO YOU HAVE REAL FRIENDS?
text:
All of us have people around us that we might consider as our friends, but are they really the ones that the Lord wants us to spend time with? If you look around and examine your life, you will see that most likely your “friends” have the same weaknesses as you. That is because we are likely to search for people that agree with our thoughts, tastes, character and actions! Our weaknesses are like magnets and they attract the exact same weaknesses… We like to hear what we want to hear, we do not want to be corrected and most importantly, we are not ready for the truth…



But, a real man of faith will never surround himself with such friends, because he knows that serving God is to do what the best do! A real man of faith, one that is not influenced by others but by the Heavenly Father, will search for people who will help them in their spiritual walk with the Lord and also help them build a godly character. Such friends will boldly confront your weaknesses and report them to you, so that genuine change will come into your life. In 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟕:𝟓-𝟔 the Bible says, “𝐁𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐫𝐞𝐛𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐝𝐞𝐧 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞. 𝐖𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐚 𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐝, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐧 𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐦𝐲 𝐦𝐮𝐥𝐭𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐤𝐢𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬”. This clearly means that a godly friend speaks truth into your life, even when it is difficult for you to hear it. A true friend loves you and genuinely wants the best for you. They tell you both the good and the bad aspects of your character and help you unfold God’s purpose in your life!



We need good, inspired and well-informed people in order to make it in our respective callings! If the company you keep only flatters and compliments you, then you need to look for some real friends.  If not, it is very easy to think that we are perfect. We need people that will help us become better parents, better Christians, better wives, better husbands, better friends, because “𝐀𝐬 𝐢𝐫𝐨𝐧 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐢𝐫𝐨𝐧, 𝐬𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫!” (Proverbs 27:17).



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Father, send me friends that will help me build my character, that will lead me to salvation. Help me endure the truth and change according to it. Lord, help me be a true friend to others too. Give me the courage to speak the truth and stand for righteousness – in Jesus´ name, amen!#Friendship #Truefriends

title: HAPPY PALM SUNDAY! – 2023
text:
No one would have thought that Palm Sunday, a day of joy and celebration, would become a symbol of the beginning of the passion of our Lord Jesus Christ! No one could have ever imagined that the people cheering and applauding the Saviour’s arrival in Jerusalem would be the same people who sought His death and crucifixion a few days later!



In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟏:𝟗-𝟏𝟏, the Word of God vividly describes the King’s entry in Jerusalem, just a little while before His passion for the eradication of our unrighteousness began: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐝 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐝, ‘𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐚 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝!’ ‘𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝!’ ‘𝐇𝐨𝐬𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐚 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧!’ 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐦, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐞 𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬𝐤𝐞𝐝, ‘𝐖𝐡𝐨 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬?’ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝, ‘𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐩𝐡𝐞𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐍𝐚𝐳𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐧 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐞.’”



If realise that Jesus Christ was the reason that we are now enjoying the joy of Salvation, we will soon understand that there was a divine master plan! A plan that was meant to redeem humanity from its sin! Hence, let today be the day that the race of your personal Salvation starts because Jesus declared the beginning of that race 2,023 years ago!#PalmSunday #JesusChrist

title: THE PIE OF LIFE
text:
There comes a time in life when people begin to understand that they have not experienced true and lasting joy. They realise that life seems to be passing them by and they are just watching it do so. They see that many of their goals have not been achieved and their days are really unhappy. But why is that? If we could compare life to something, we could compare it to a pie consisting of the following slices:1. Career2. Finances3. Natural Environment4. Entertainment5. Family/Friends6. Health7. Love8. Spiritual progress



However, the true joy we seek cannot come unless there is balance in all areas of our lives. Thus, if an area is at a very low level, at some point we will feel great and inexplicable despair and sadness. Our life will not change because we simply hope, but it will change when we are willing to pay any necessary price in order to succeed! The Word of God in 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟔:𝟕 mentions an inviolable rule: “[…] 𝐀 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬. 𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐟𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡, 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧; 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩 𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞.”. This clarifies that God is not unjust and it is the doer of the Word that receives things from God.



Too often we tend to complain and demand that God make things happen, while we haven’t sown at all in some areas, in some of the “slices” of our lives. Are you in need of love? You need to sow love! Do you want good health? You need to sow good nutrition… Do you want success? Then, you need to sow your time and daily activities. Start to sow where you want to reap today and you will see that God always stays true to His Word!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫:  “Lord Jesus Christ, give me Your grace to put Your Word. Make me a doer of the Word and not a listener who quickly forgets, so that real and lasting joy may come into my life – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Pieoflife #GoodLIfe

title: STOP SLEEPING
text:
People of God, don’t be bemused or puzzled by the title of this message. Actually, when we mention sleep, we are not talking about the natural state of rest whereby the eyes are closed and consciousness is lost. No! When we ask you to stop sleeping, we simply mean that you should be spiritually awake and alert! It is pathetic seeing children of God sleeping while the devil is busy working, causing conflict, war, confusion and chaos everywhere, while those called to be watchmen are busy sleeping. 



As a Christian, if you are not praying, you are sleeping spiritually! Prophet T.B. Joshua said, “I may sleep but not spiritually.” Life is spiritual! Life is not fun and games, not a bonding meeting, a playground or an encounter group but a battlefield where only the serious-minded emerge victorious! The serious-minded know the great importance of prayer! If you are not praying, you are not serious-minded! Colossians 4:2 encourages us to continue in prayer. Don’t stop praying! The moment you stop praying, you stop living! Prayer is to the spiritual man what breathing is to the natural man. 



Disappointment in the success of prayer should be an excitement in the duty of prayer! The duty of prayer is based on the sufficiency of God. As children of God, our enemy must not catch us sleeping. A Christian should pray every day and be in an attitude of prayer at all times. Let us be serious-minded! Let us stop sleeping! Let us learn to pray! Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to pray without ceasing, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: EXPERIENCE THE POWER OF RESURRECTION IN ALL AREAS OF YOUR LIFE.
text:
EXPERIENCE THE POWER OF RESURRECTION IN ALL AREAS OF YOUR LIFE.Matthew 28: 5-6The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified. He is not here; He has risen, just as He said. Come and see the place where He lay.



Our Lord Jesus Christ is the significance of resurrection, the true essence and focal point of our worship. He was flogged, crashed and humiliated for our sake but He responded with forgiveness. As children of God, we should come to Him with a free spirit, a spirit that does not hold offence, burden, envy and resentment against others. Let our hearts rise to the things which are above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of the Father, reigning in power, now and forevermore!



“Jesus Christ lives. He never said goodbye” – Prophet T.B. Joshua



Happy Easter from the Emmanuel TV Family!

title: Jesus Christ: The Sinners’ Only Saviour
text:
John 14:6 says, “Jesus said to him, ‘I am the way, the truth, and the life’. No one comes to the Father except through Me’. Jesus Christ is the sinner’s only Saviour, not only because He came and died for our sins but also because He is the Way, the Truth and the Life. As the Way, He is the reality; there is no reality outside Him. As the Truth, He is the source of our strength and the reason for our being. As the Life, He is the end of it and that life is eternal life that is the nature of God. 



Romans 3:23 reminds us that we have all sinned and fallen short of God’s glory. Jesus came to re-establish that glory. He came to restore the relationship and fellowship between God and man. Because He is our Advocate, there is no reason any longer for us to feel guilty. There is no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus. When you have a relationship with Jesus Christ, you will change and become a man or a woman who is directed by the Holy Spirit, not by the idea or influence of others. You will be connected in a unique way. 



The design of the Gospel is to break the yoke of sin and satan, thus removing the burden of guilt and corruption. God so loved us that He planted His best seed in the earth so that peace might abide with men forever. Jesus Christ came down from Heaven and laid down His life for our redemption. Is there anyone wallowing in the valley of sin, unfaithfulness, pain, sickness, hardship, sorrow or confusion? Please look onto the Cross, believe and call on the name Jesus Christ and you will be saved. 



Prayer: Lord Jesus, have mercy on me, and position me for your glory and attention! Amen!

title: REJOICE! CHRIST IS RISEN!
text:
Christ is risen! Happy Easter! Friends of Jesus Christ, rejoice! Jesus Christ is risen and He defeated death! 



“[..] 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐝𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐝? 𝐇𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞; 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐧!” 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐𝟒:𝟓-𝟔. 



Our King, Jesus Christ, paid the ultimate price for humanity’s redemption in order to deliver us from sin and its consequences. His death, however, was not the end, but the beginning! Jesus Christ was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness – by His resurrection from the dead!



Through His resurrection, there is fullness of grace and certainty of safety for all believers here on earth even beyond the grave! 



As we celebrate the resurrection of our King, may His resurrecting power flow in your life and may it revive every dead area of your life – in the name of Jesus Christ! #Easter #DeathIsDefeated

title: DO YOU HAVE A HIDDEN AGENDA?
text:
Hidden agendas go back to the first days of man with satan’s deception in the Garden of Eden. Satan’s motive was NOT to make mankind wise, but instead, have mankind reject the instructions of God! The Bible has a lot to say about our motives. A motive is an underlying reason for any action. 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟔:𝟐 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬, “𝐀𝐥𝐥 𝐚 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧’𝐬 𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐦 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃.” Because the human heart is very deceitful (𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟏𝟕:𝟗), we can easily fool even our very own selves when it comes to our motives. We can pretend that we are doing some certain things for God or the benefit of others, when in reality, we have selfish reasons or an ulterior motive. Regardless of what people look like, do or say, one thing is sure: “[…] 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝. 𝐀 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬. 𝟖 𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐟𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡, 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧; 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐰𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐩 𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞”. (𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟔:𝟕-𝟖)



A man can be a Christian in profession, but yet not such in heart… But God is interested in our motives even more than our actions. We can keep our motives pure by continually surrendering every part of our hearts to the control of the Holy Spirit. When we allow Him to control every part of us, then our desire is to please Him and not ourselves. Our flesh constantly clamours to exalt itself, and only when we walk in the Spirit we will be able to resist those fleshly desires!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Father, make me a channel of shining light where there is darkness. Expose any evil and replace it with Your Spirit and Truth. Let every contrary motive be cast out, in the name of Jesus! Fix my heart and reshape it for Your Glory! Let my heart, my body and soul surrender to Your will and may my life become an instrument of the Holy Spirit – in Jesus´ name, amen!#HiddenAgenda #Motives

title: MOVE GOD
text:
Faith relates solely and exclusively to two realities: God and His Word. When you are talking about the Word, you are talking about the foundation of the throne of God. The Word “believe” is made simple when we know that it is acting upon the spoken Word of God. This means that faith is not abstract; faith relates to a heart that believes God through ordinary circumstances. Therefore, faith should be demonstrated or practised in difficult and perilous circumstances.  



The first step of our work of faith is to stop our own work and rest in God’s love, wisdom and power. Once you believe and pray in His name, Jesus takes over! As we begin to do the Word, He begins to do in us and through us. By looking into the Word and acting on it, we bring Jesus on the scene. Acting on the Word then makes Jesus Christ real to the believer. Ask the Seven sons of Sceva and they will tell you that ordinary words cannot move God, cannot bring Jesus on the scene. God does not need our words to move Him into action; He has His own way of implementing His will in the universe. The power of God is to be exercised not according to our own will but according to God’s will. 



Therefore, learn to take God’s Word to heart and truly make it part of you. That way, it will by its very nature, change you. And when the Word changes you, you will find yourself moved by the very life of God and the life of God will make things happen.



Say this prayer: “Oh Holy Spirit, take more of me and give me more of You – more of Your love, strength, peace, faithfulness and righteousness! Give me the grace to act and dwell in Your Word and truly make it a part of me!” Amen!
