title: BIBLE VS SCOIAL MEDIA
text:
Today, social media are a dominant part of the life of people in modern society. Through them, we can communicate, interact and receive information from numerous online platforms. To what extent is their use, however, beneficial to a child of God?



The information we receive daily from social media platforms is a lot. Advertisements, photographs, and also role models of a life far from God, can be the cause for a Christian to lose his focus on God and fill his heart with the cares of this world. The Word of God is a source of wisdom and knowledge and in 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟏𝟏𝟗:𝟏𝟎𝟓 it states: “𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐚 𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐩 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐦𝐲 𝐟𝐞𝐞𝐭, 𝐚 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐡”. In other words, God Himself reminds us that His Word alone should be the guide of our lives… In Him lies our hope, the light in a world dominated by darkness.



Unfortunately, however, wasting precious time in the chaotic world of social media, our will to devote time to the Word of God is becoming less and less, whereas our spirit is in need of receiving an instruction, a direction from the Creator! If we haven’t been able to succeed in our lives so far, it’s because we’re spending our time on the wrong ground. The Bible, however, teaches us that when we plant wrong seeds a wrong harvest will come… It is not too late to put your life in order and above all in balance! Start giving God the attention He deserves and see if your life will stay the same!



🙏🏻𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me from now on to devote more time to Your Word. Heavenly Father, give me the grace to plant good seeds in my life so that I may reap Your blessings in the future, in Your Almighty name I pray, amen!”#PlantGoodSeeds #WiseChoise

title: THE PLAN OF SUCCESS
text:
God wants us to pray, walk, run and do things not like the people of this world. This is so because we are in this world, but we are not part of it. Heaven is the final destination of every child of God. The plan of success God almighty wants us to follow is summarized in the Book of Joshua 1:8. 



As Christians, we know that satan can also give what God gives but they are counterfeits. When God gives you money and good health, it comes with peace of heart but when satan gives you what seems to give you apparent peace, he takes with his left hand what your life depends on. Prophet TB Joshua gave us three steps to having good success:



1) Keep the Word in your mouth. If the Word dominates your heart, it will dominate your mouth and when it dominates your mouth, it will influence your conduct and character and whatever you do will be permanent and have good success.



2) Meditate on God’s Word day and night. Meditation in God’s Word is a visit with God. Meditation is the process of thinking deep on what you have heard and read in the Bible. Without meditation, God’s Word cannot become part of you. Meditation brings revelation. Once your hands and mouth are in one accord, then you begin to tap into God’s blessings.                                                     



3) Doing what the Word says. Remember that our obedience to God’s Word is the only proof of our faith in him. Don’t forget that our faith in God’s Word must be tested against facts and experiences, before it can be said to be genuine.

title: BLESSING WITHOUT HEALTH IS CRISIS
text:
“An apple a day keeps the doctor away”, is a parable we use to emphasise the importance of maintaining healthy eating habits. A healthy diet is a leading factor for our body to fight off every sickness and disease. Yet, what happens when instead of nurturing our bodies in a right and healthy way, we damage it with smoking, alcohol, or with other unhealthy habits?



The answer always comes from the Word of God in 𝟏 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟔:𝟏𝟗-𝟐𝟎: “𝐃𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐥𝐲 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐆𝐨𝐝? 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐰𝐧; 𝟐𝟎𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐚𝐭 𝐚 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐜𝐞. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐬.”



As humans, we are a spirit, we have a soul and we live in a body! Ever since the beginning of creation, God gave us everything we need in order to live a good life; a life of good health and prosperity. However, we are so focused on receiving God’s blessings and we barely take care of our health. What we forget, though, is that blessing without good health is crisis because you cannot enjoy it! Our body belongs to God and thus, we need to take good care of it! Starting today, take care of your health on a daily basis and you will see that you will live a joyful and content life in Christ Jesus!



𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today, I will start taking care of my health, my body and my spirit. Give me the joy to enjoy Your heavenly blessings in a life of good health and prosperity – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”



#StayHealthy #EatHealthy

title: GOD IS ABLE
text:
Ephesians 3:20-21 says, “Now to Him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to Him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.” 



We live in a wicked world and there are enough reasons to be troubled. I am here to tell you that there is a greater reason not to be because our God is able. God is behind us and backing us up, so that in everything, we can overcome through His divine power. God is who He says He is, nothing can stop Him from being God; nothing can overthrow Him from His throne. God and His Throne are backing up every word of a true believer. This assurance gives us a quiet and restful confidence.



Distance is not a barrier for God because His Word searches and finds us every time. God does not need our words to move Him into action. He has His own way of implementing His will in the universe. The power of God works not according to our own will but according to His Will. Remember that the power of God is made manifest when His Word comes into our heart and the Spirit acts on it. Therefore, take your position in the believer’s authority and watch God take control of your situation; He is ABLE!!!



Prayer: Oh Lord, give me the grace to continue to trust in your ability to save, deliver and bless me, in Jesus’ name! Amen!!

title: GOD HAS ORDERED ALL
text:
Colossians 1:16 says, “For in Him all things were created: things in heaven and on earth, visible and invisible, whether thrones or powers or rulers or authorities; all things have been created through Him and for Him.”



‘God has ordered all’ means everything we have is actually only being borrowed from God. Everything comes from God and everything you will receive in the future will come from Him. It appears that all is of grace because all our spiritual advantages are from Him. What do have you? What item or material do you own? It all came from Him. This means that our faith, our conversion, our eternal salvation are not mere products of any natural ability or power; no man should boast. They are not brought to pass by anything done by us; therefore, all boasting is excluded. He who glories must not glory in himself but in the Lord. 



Whoever is great among men, it is God’s hand that made them so and whatever strength we have, it is God that gave it to us. We ought to acknowledge God in all spiritual things. Every good thought, every good purpose and every good work – to His grace from whom we received it. When you are placed on top of a horse, remember those who cannot ride on donkeys. The privileged should remember the less-privileged.



God has ordered all so that the whole shall appear to be of grace. When you approach God in prayer, picture yourself as the created. Don’t dictate to God – heal me, bless me, deliver me. You should not allow your situation to dictate your prayer. He knows you more than yourself. Remember that Jesus lives; He never said, “Goodbye”. 



PRAYER: “Oh Holy Spirit, grant me the grace to pray according to the will of the Father!”

title: BREAK THE CHAINS OF YOUR PRISON!
text:
Many times difficulties and poverty make us feel like we are living inside a prison. Nevertheless, this prison could be created by our very own selves. Prisons can be created by the feeling of inferiority, isolation, guilt or by completely giving up on life. Apostle Paul was also trying to be free from the prison created by our human body, as he said, “𝐎 𝐰𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐈 𝐚𝐦! 𝐖𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐦𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐛𝐨𝐝𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐡?”, in 𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟕:𝟐𝟒.



Our freedom starts within our hearts, as the first place to be victorious is in our spiritual life and in our mind because victory does not start around us, it begins within us! Thus, take heart, for your freedom is not far! Start investing in your spirit by filling your heart with the Word of God that will equip you with the spirit of freedom and victory, which will break the bars of your prison today! Are you ready to be set free? If yes, pray with the following words:



🙏 “Lord Jesus Christ, even though I’ve been in prison up till now, I believe that Your power can set me free! Come with Your power and shake the foundations of my prison – in Your holy name I pray, amen!”#Besetfree #Freedom

title: WHAT IS YOUR STRENGTH?
text:
Philippians 4:13 says, “I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.”



The Bible explains that everyone God created has their own measure of strength. We may not be equally gifted, but one thing is clear; God designed it in such a way that everyone has some strength to contribute. What is your strength? Your strength could be money, talent, love. Whatever area you are strong in, that is what the Lord will use to bless others through you.



We are one another’s strength. No one can succeed alone, we need good people, informed and inspired people to make it in our respective callings. How do you use your strength to improve the lives of those around you? Many of us today come around people for selfish, classic and material reasons. We keep company with some people only because of what we can get from them and not what we can contribute. Don’t come around people because of what you can get alone but also because of what you can give.



How can you know your strength? Whatever you consistently do that uplifts you and others around you is your strength. You just need self-examination to discover this strength and build it, so as to contribute positively to the lives of others and the society of which you are a part. God Almighty cherishes our little efforts towards contributing positively to the lives of others, if it comes from the heart. So, wherever your strength lies, use it genuinely to contribute positively to the lives of those around you, your society and the world at large.



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, give me the strength needed for the tasks you want done, in Jesus’ Name. Amen!

title: Celebrating Pastor Evelyn Joshua: Continuing the Legacy of TB Joshua | SCOAN
text:
General Overseer, Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN), Founder of  Emmanuel TV Team, Prophet TB Joshua and wife, Evelyn Joshua



Pastor Evelyn Joshua, the esteemed leader of the Synagogue, Church of all Nations (SCOAN), has been an epitome of strength, grace, and dedication since assuming her role. As the wife of Prophet TB Joshua, the founder and General Overseer of SCOAN, Mummy Evelyn Joshua has not only admirably carried forward her husband’s vision but has also made significant strides in her own right. Recently, she returned from a momentous crusade in Spain, demonstrating her unwavering commitment to spreading the message of faith and hope. Her continuous dedication and determination is a testament to her steadfastness in carrying forward the legacy of her husband, Prophet TB Joshua.



Let us delve into the profound impact of Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s leadership, the successful crusade in Spain, and the pride her late husband would undoubtedly feel.



Continuing the Legacy of Prophet TB Joshua



I can’t miss words to say that, Pastor Evelyn Joshua has embraced her role as the leader of SCOAN with unwavering strength and grace. Her leadership skills and deep spirituality have been instrumental in guiding SCOAN during this transitional period. As the wife of Prophet TB Joshua, she is no stranger to the profound impact the ministry of SCOAN has had on countless lives around the world. Despite the immense responsibility she shoulders, Pastor Evelyn has shown remarkable resilience and commitment to continuing the work of her late husband. Her compassionate leadership style and deep spiritual insight have been instrumental in maintaining the legacy of Prophet TB Joshua and its mission of healing, deliverance, and spiritual upliftment.



The Crusade in Spain



The recently concluded crusade in Spain stands as a testament to Pastor Evelyn’s remarkable leadership and her commitment to spreading the message of love, faith, and salvation. Through her dynamic preaching and anointing, the crusade witnessed a powerful outpouring of the Holy Spirit, leading to countless miracles, healings, and life-transforming encounters. Pastor Evelyn’s passion for souls and her unwavering dedication to the ministry were evident throughout the crusade, leaving an indelible impact on all who attended.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s crusade in Spain, 



Prophet TB Joshua’s Pride



Undoubtedly, if Prophet TB Joshua were here today, he would be immensely proud of his beloved wife’s accomplishments. Having worked closely with him for years, she imbibed his teachings, imprinted his love for humanity, and embodies the virtues he held dear. Pastor Evelyn’s commitment to this vision, her unwavering faith, and her genuine love for humanity has carried forward the torch of SCOAN’s profound work. Her compassionate leadership has inspired not only the congregation but also countless individuals across the globe. Prophet TB Joshua’s legacy lives on through Pastor Evelyn’s unwavering commitment to the core values of SCOAN, and she continues to stand as a shining example of his teachings and principles.



Congratulating Promise Joshua



In the midst of celebrating Pastor Evelyn’s achievements, we must also extend our warmest congratulations to Promise Joshua, Pastor Evelyn and Prophet TB Joshua’s daughter. Promise’s graduation from Columbia University in New York, with a master’s degree in Public Administration, is a testament to her exceptional academic prowess and dedication. We applaud her remarkable achievement and wish her great success as she embarks on a promising career, carrying the values instilled by her parents and the rich heritage of The SCOAN.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua and Promise Joshua 



Pastor Evelyn Joshua, the leader of SCOAN, has exhibited exemplary leadership in the face of immense responsibility. Her recent successful crusade in Spain and the achievements of her daughter Promise are a testament to her unwavering commitment to continuing the legacy of Prophet TB Joshua. With her leadership, SCOAN remains a beacon of hope, healing, and transformation for countless individuals around the world. We celebrate Pastor Evelyn’s remarkable journey and extend our heartfelt congratulations to Promise Joshua. May their endeavours continue to inspire and impact lives for generations to come.



Emmanuel!! God is With Us!!!

title: 𝐇𝐄 𝐖𝐈𝐋𝐋 𝐍𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐑 𝐑𝐄𝐉𝐄𝐂𝐓 𝐘𝐎𝐔!
text:
Rejection is a word that even upon hearing it can cause fear and discomfort to many. Many times, it can be bitter and difficult to handle for someone trying to find direction from the people around them. One thing is for sure: no one can be liked by everyone or receive love and acceptance from everyone. One may experience an intense rejection from an employer, a partner or even from their own family and start to think that they are not worthy of being loved and feeling insecure, constantly carrying negative thoughts. Many people carry these unpleasant feelings from childhood, while others, at some point in their lives, have felt lonely and desperate because of the rejection they received from the people around them.



The best example of how to deal with rejection is given to us by our Lord Jesus Christ Himself. He received rejection and contempt from people, especially from the people that were from the same place with him and from His brothers and sisters. Yet, whether they accepted Him or rejected Him, Jesus remained steadfast in God’s purpose for His life; He knew that the Father would never reject Him!



Your co-workers, your friends, your own relatives may have closed the door on you, but Jesus Christ will always have His arms open for you! 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟐𝟕:𝟏𝟎: “𝐓𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐦𝐲 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐬𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐦𝐞, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐦𝐞”. Your privilege as a child of the Heavenly Father is that nothing can separate you from His love! Because when God sees you, He sees something else that everyone ignores!



𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the strength to forgive anyone that rejected me and keep any form of bitterness out of my heart. Help me to move forward with Your love as the foundation and to base my hope on Your acceptance, in Your almighty name I pray, amen.”#Rejection #GodLovesYou

title: DO NOT IGNORE THE PROCESS
text:
Hebrews 12:5 – 8 says, “… My son, do not despise the chastening of the LORD, nor be discouraged when you are rebuked by Him; For whom the LORD loves He chastens…”



God Almighty disciplines us as a process to strengthen our desire and determination for Him, to reform us and keep us for a new level in life. Today, everyone wants to be great but not everyone wants to go through the right process. If you are in a haste to achieve something, you are likely to make costly mistakes that will pull you back, if not down.



If you ignore the process and focus only on the result, you may likely not have the patience to differentiate between God’s supply and satan’s bait. If it is God’s processing, the result will stand the test of time. Do not ignore the process; God is treating you as His own. God Almighty sometimes allows us to go through some dark moments as a process so that when the light finally comes, we will be matured enough to maintain it. God is trying to build character now so that when you get to the place of destiny, you won’t crack and explode and lose it all. 



God wants us to prosper in all areas of our lives. He does not want us to succeed financially by losing ourselves to conditions. He does not want you to lose your peace or your sleep. So, if you follow the right process and don’t get result, don’t worry. You are about to get the mother of results. Don’t get disappointed, God is preparing you for something greater than what you are seeing. All you need to do is to remain patient and allow Him to make things happen in His time.



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to trust You, even when every sense contradicts You, in Jesus’ Name. Amen!

title: HOLD TIGHT ON YOUR CALLING!
text:
There are some questions that have been on the minds of many people for generations. These questions must be answered because they determine whether we will fulfil what God has called us to do in life. However, no one will answer them for us, but only we can answer them for ourselves. These questions are as follows:



1) Who am I? 2) What is my calling, my purpose in this world?



If we do not know these answers, the first step in knowing our calling is to get to know God better by reading His Word, which is a tool in the hands of the Holy Spirit to increase us and provide us with everything we need to succeed in life! 



A great example is the case of Joseph. In the Book of 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟒𝟏:𝟑𝟗, 𝟒𝟏 𝐰𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝: “𝐒𝐢𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐨 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐚𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮. […] ‘𝐈 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐛𝐲 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐞 𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭.’” From a very young age, Joseph was aware of who he was and what his calling was in this world. He remained faithful and devoted to God, despite the difficult situations he went through. He did not give up even when his brothers sold him as a slave or when he was thrown into prison. He kept his hope in God! He knew which God he was serving! He didn’t change his vision, but his approach… He didn’t let his dream sink, he believed that if he played his role correctly, even in difficult situations, God would fulfil His purpose in his life! Indeed, it turned out that everything he went through was for his spiritual benefit, so that he could maintain the position of influence he was subsequently given! 



You were created to create, you were created to be a channel of blessing to the world! There is nothing God created without a purpose! Each and every one of His creations was made with a purpose; discover yours! Once you discover it, keep it in the forefront of your mind and the sky will be your limit!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, give me Your grace to devote myself and read Your Word daily, so that I may know who I am and what is the purpose I was created for in order to fulfil it – in Your almighty name I pray, amen!”#Destiny #LifePurpose

title: Success starts with boldness
text:
Genesis 39:9 says, “There is no one greater in this house than I, nor has he kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”



We live in a complex and contradictory world; every day we are challenged by issues that violate our conscience. We face them not by choice but because challenges prove our faith in God. As life’s biggest decision is in what we do, if the decisions we make each day are not rooted in God’s Word, they won’t stand the test of time. 



The uniqueness of your challenge is the uniqueness of your greatness. Ask Joseph, and he will tell you that it takes boldness to say no to sin and yes to righteousness. Ask the Good Samaritan in that Book of Luke 10, and he will tell you that it takes boldness to show love and to shun hatred. If you are going to serve the Lord in truth and in faith, be prepared for times when you will be tested. Remember that successful people don’t just drift to the top; it takes focused action, personal discipline and lots of energy to make things happen every day. No matter the obstacles you encounter, there is a zeal to move forward.



Are you experiencing failure? Regardless of how you have tried and failed, you are alive to try again because Jesus Christ motivates us to try again and again. Learn to use the name of Jesus Christ in the power of the Holy Spirit, in accordance with the Scriptures, and discover the very secret that shook the whole world through the Apostles. 



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, beloved of my soul, enlighten me, guide me and tell me what I should do. Help me to resist fear at all times, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: A LIFE WELL SPENT! – The Second Anniversary Of TB Joshua
categories: PROPHET TB JOSHUA CALL TO GLORY
text:
Today, as we commemorate the second anniversary of the passing of the great Prophet of God, Prophet T. B. Joshua, we reflect upon the profound impact this remarkable individual has had on our lives and the world at large. It is a time to honour the teachings, wisdom, and compassion that defined the life of this extraordinary Prophet and to carry forward the torch of his divine legacy.



The Prophet’s life was a proof of power of faith, humility, and love. He served God as a guiding light, illuminating the path to righteousness and inspiring countless souls to live a life of virtue and devotion. His words continue to resonate with timeless wisdom, providing comfort to the weary and guidance to the lost. His message of peace and compassion continue to remain as relevant today as it was during his earthly life.



As we honor the Prophet’s memory, let us also express our gratitude for the blessings he brought into our lives. His teachings have provided consolation during times of hardship, guidance during moments of doubt, and hope when all seemed lost. May we always cherish the invaluable lessons we have learned from him and share his wisdom with future generations.Indeed, “The greatest way to use life is to spend it on something that will outlive it!” – T. B. Joshua



Share with us in the comments section below how your life has changed through Prophet T. B. Joshua’s teachings and divine wisdom.#TBJoshuaLegacy #TBJoshua

title: FREEDOM FROM FEAR
text:
When you take a close look at your immediate surroundings, what you see is frightening: fear, frustration, anger, anxiety, discouragement and distress on people’s faces regarding the uncertainties of life. We are in the end times of pervasive fear, a destructive tool of satan that robs millions of a victorious life. Many have lost the battle not because of the giant they faced but because of the giant they feared. Many have even died, not because of sickness but because of fear of that sickness.  



Fear weakens your resolve, determination and willpower. Fear brings torment, anguish and anxiety. Fear freezes your potential. Fear causes your hope to shrivel and die. Fear increases the size of your enemy mentally.   



When we begin to harbour fear, we give place to the devil. Do not give place to fear because what we fear may come upon us. Jesus knows there will be times when fear will overwhelm us: the fear of loss, failure, false accusations, sickness and disease. Jesus does not promise to keep us free from trouble, but promises us enough grace to stand and resist the troubles that cause our anxieties, cares and unnecessary fears. Therefore, we must learn to get above our fears even when it seems impossible to get above our troubles.   



In 2 Kings 6:17 – “And Elisha prayed, “Open his eyes, Lord, so that he may see.” Then the Lord opened the servant’s eyes, and he looked and saw the hills full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha. The opening of our eyes of faith is the silencing of our fears.  



We must deal with our fears before they deal with us. Everyone has a giant. Yours could be sickness, disappointment, failure etc. It’s not the giant you face but the giant you fear that conquers you.   



This should be your confession when you are faced with fear: “I refuse to take counsel with fear or to entertain a doubt. As a Christian, my fear is unnecessary and my doubts are unreliable. Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I fear no evil because God is involved. Even in the midst of the uncertainties of life, I can face tomorrow because He lives.”

title: The Second Anniversary Of Prophet TB Joshua’s Passing: “The TB Joshua I Knew”
categories: PROPHET TB JOSHUA CALL TO GLORY
text:
It is always spiritually uplifting whenever I reminisce about Prophet TB Joshua. Those who were unfamiliar with him or chose not to get to know him, yet found solace in speaking negatively about him, were unequivocally mistaken. And they remain mistaken to this day.



I had the privilege of meeting him on several occasions, each time in close proximity, one-on-one. Arigidi Akoko is also our shared community, which made it even more exceptional to have met him and to have been entrusted with various responsibilities concerning the children.



The Prophet TB Joshua I knew was:




A devoted family man, deeply loving and compassionate, unreservedly generous, a true Nigerian, and a quintessential African man.



A faithful preacher of the true and complete Word of God. He lived the Word of God, exemplified it, and demonstrated that God is as close to us as our very breath. He was a man of fasting and prayer, teaching and expounding on the concept of unceasing prayer.



A man of peace who refused to hold onto offense. He preached and instructed his followers, disciples, and viewers that harboring offense could impede their access to the throne of grace.



A man who came to nurture the vineyard of God. All his teachings, healings, prophecies, and deliverances were performed in the name of Jesus, using the Word of God. TB Joshua did not seek to establish a new foundation but to build upon the foundation already laid by Jesus Christ.



An evangelist of the Word. During one meeting, he summoned me and introduced me to a group that had attended the same gathering. This group hailed from SCOAN Lokoja, Kogi State. SCOAN Lokoja, which still exists, was among his earliest ministries until he settled in Lagos. The group requested his personal attention and regular visits, and he responded by sending his evangelists periodically. My specific assignment was to evaluate the place and provide a report. Prophet TB Joshua maintained satellite stations worldwide for his ministry, and we must now support our new leader, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, in this evangelistic endeavor.




Therefore, as we commemorate the second anniversary of Prophet TB Joshua’s passing, let us not forget his love and his pragmatic approach to the philosophy of evangelizing the world by “changing people and changing the world.” While Prophet TB Joshua may have departed from us physically, he has left behind a profound and impactful ministry that will engage us until the return of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ (1 Thessalonians 4:16-17). When we gaze at the sky on that day, Temitope Balogun Joshua will be soaring to meet the Lord. It is our responsibility to ensure that we are also there in the sky, ready to meet the Lord Jesus.



We join our voices in proclaiming to the righteous, “It shall be well with you. You shall eat the fruit of your actions” (Isaiah 3:10). The Lord will always deliver the righteous from every trouble (Proverbs 11:8), in the mighty name of Jesus.



“Help, Lord, for the godly man ceases to be, for the faithful disappear from among the sons of men” (Proverbs 11:8).



Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi, University of Ilorin, Nigeria

title: Posthumous Birthday TB Joshua By Wiseman Harry
text:
Today, on Prophet T. B. Joshua’s heavenly birthday, we offer our heartfelt gratitude for the blessings he bestowed upon us. His teachings challenged us to examine our hearts and strive for spiritual growth and as we continue to abide in them, we pray that God will give us the grace to be more like him and our Father.



Though his physical presence is missed, we find peace in knowing that he has returned Home, because death to a believer is his release from the imprisonment of this world and his departure to the enjoyment of another world. Therefore, we take comfort in the assurance that his soul is at peace, united with the eternal love and grace of God.



On this memorial birthday, we remember the miracles he performed, the compassion he showed to the needy, and his unshakeable focus on the things from above, the things of God’s Kingdom. His life undoubtedly continues to serve as a reminder that the highest motive for serving God is the desire to please Him!



May his soul continue to rest in perfect peace, in Jesus’ mighty name!#TBJoshua #HappyBirthday

title: FIGHT HATRED WITH LOVE!
text:
Have you ever thought about what is the right response to those who hate you? Have you ever thought about what is the right answer to those who provoke you with their behaviour and their character? The Holy Bible has shown us many times that the way to fight the poison called hatred is found in the antidote called love! In 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟒𝟓:𝟓, the Word of God says, “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐰, 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞; 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐦𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞.”



It’s time to learn how to fight hatred, rejection and the bad attitude of others against you with boldness, just like Joseph did. The Word of God reminds you today that people will challenge you, question you, try to get you off track. But, do not yield to the temptation to act out of character! Turn their hatred into love and, then, you will certainly see that the sky will be your limit!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, fill me with the key called love, the antidote that heals all relationships and wounds! Help me think, speak and act with love – in Your name I pray, amen!”



Love #Hate

title: MAN’S REJECTION
text:
As a child of God in the world of men, you are bound to be attacked, rejected and hated. Fear not, for God can use any foolish thing to release you into your divine future. The Book of Ecclesiastes 3:1-10 makes us understand that life is in stages: A time to be born, a time to grow and a time to face persecution. Each stage serves a purpose. As a Christian, our values must be tested against facts and experiences. This is the only way we can identify those who are genuinely sincere in their relationship with God. 



Our Lord Jesus Christ passed the test and the Anointing began to flow proving that persecution is a tonic to the anointing. When you are persecuted, count it all joy for your chance of victory is at hand. We must not think it strange if some of our best friends avoid us and there is no one to run to. Have you been framed by your colleagues in the office and finally given a sack letter or have you been handed a divorce letter or quit notice to get out of your apartment?  Don’t despair, the end has not come; the best is always yet to come for you as a Christian. 



Those who are rich in every sense of the Word understand that life is a learning experience. We are to reign with Him when the goings are good and when they are tough. Our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ was constantly misjudged but He was not discouraged knowing that being misjudged is the last stage before supernatural promotion. The persecution we suffer at the hands of our detractors causes us to be known all over the world. Indeed, man’s rejection provokes God’s direction. When man rejects you, God will start to direct you. You with God are majority.



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to see the rejection I face in the light of God’s Word, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: DON’T BE CONTROLLED BY YOUR FEELINGS!
text:
Pressure, tension, stress … Whether in your workplace, at home or anywhere else, these are some of the feelings we face whenever we are in an environment that takes us out of our comfort zone! How can a child of God successfully handle such situations without getting out of character?



As with every other important question of life, the answer is found in the Word of God, as it is written in 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟔: “𝐃𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐱𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐛𝐲 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐬𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐫𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐆𝐨𝐝”. It becomes obvious, therefore, that only through the relationship we maintain with our Creator, God, can we have true peace in our hearts! As you read the Word of God in a spirit of truth-seeking and pray to Him, you can overcome every toxic and inhospitable environment!



Therefore, all you have to do is dive deeper and deeper into your relationship with God. Engage your heart with God’s Word, which you have read attentively, slowly and repeatedly, and it will begin to influence your conduct and character!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will invest in the depth of my relationship with You and, as I do this, I know that You will also invest in the breadth of my success – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Pressure #Anxiety

title: DO NOT OFFEND TOMORROW
text:
Real love forgets wrong so that there will be hope for the future. You have to forget wrong and love because a servant today can be a leader tomorrow; your enemy today can be your saviour tomorrow. 



Tomorrow is a mystery. Since tomorrow is a mystery and we don’t know what will happen next, we have to be very careful today, so that we do not offend tomorrow. You cannot explain tomorrow because God is tomorrow; He owns the future. God does as He wills; He can take unlikely people, including those that are undeserving to the palace. He does as He wills. Tomorrow is a mystery and what you are doing today can offend tomorrow. Offence opens the door to satan and when you hold a grudge against your brother because he offended you, you have already grieved the Holy Spirit. If God says you should not hold offence, you have to be very careful regarding it. As much as you can, try to live peacefully with your neighbours because tomorrow is a mystery. 



Remember that God promised to set a table before you in the presence of your enemies. If you kill your enemies, how will they see the table the Lord will set before you? Enemies are there to strengthen us in our Christian life. Attacks from the enemy are meant to strengthen our Christian life and our desire and determination for God. The more they attack you as a Christian, the more you should pray and draw closer to God. 



Say this prayer: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to love my enemy as myself. I leave all to You. I let go of grudges, offence, resentment and anger, in Jesus’ name!” Amen!

title: FIGHT PEER PRESSURE!
text:
People of the same age, abilities or social position in a group are considered peers. From a young age, we have been taught to overcome peer pressure and not follow the crowd when our friends are doing things that we should not be doing. However, despite the repeated warnings we have received in the course of time, we tend to do what is wrong, hoping to fit in. The Word of God in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟎 strictly warns us about following the ways of sinners, “𝐌𝐲 𝐬𝐨𝐧, 𝐢𝐟 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐭” (𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟎). While it is natural to want to be accepted by peers, gaining that acceptance by compromising God’s standards and ways leads us to disobedience…



Following God’s ways automatically means that we decide to leave aside the things of the world. Apostle Paul clearly says in 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟎, “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐦 𝐈 𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐯𝐨𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐞𝐧, 𝐨𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝? 𝐎𝐫 𝐚𝐦 𝐈 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐦𝐞𝐧? 𝐈𝐟 𝐈 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐫𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐦𝐞𝐧, 𝐈 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚 𝐛𝐨𝐧𝐝-𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭”. Those who stand firm for righteousness principles are stronger than they may realise! They stand for what they believe and always aim to be a positive influence for those around them, through the wisdom given to them by the Word of God. 



When you have a relationship with Jesus Christ, you change and become a man who is directed by your Heavenly Father, not by the influence of others! In this way, you can also help others because they will feel your strength. Let the people around you see your Godly standards by consistently living in them for the glory of God!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I decide to stand for your righteousness and do what is pleasing before You and not men. Give me the grace to leave aside everything that is not according to your Word, in Jesus’ name I pray. Amen!” #Peers #Righteousness

title: MIRROR YOUR LOVE FOR CHRIST ON OTHERS
text:
Trusting and obeying God’s Word is the only way to be happy in Jesus. Christ asks us to obey God’s Word by loving our neighbour as ourselves. He didn’t say, “Love only Christians”, but “Love your neighbour as yourself”. Who is your neighbour? Your neighbour could be your friend, your enemy or those who don’t share the same faith with you. The Bible commands you to love them all.



The Book of John 13:34 – 35 tells us that our love for others is an expression of Christ’s love for us. For as He loves us, so we are to love others. The love Christ has for us is what gives us the enablement to love others. Without His love and without Him loving us, we have no love to love. His love for you is meant to be expressed in your everyday living. This means that you are loved to love others, blessed to bless others, and saved to save others.



Mirror Christ’s love for you on others. Is your life a reflection of Christ’s love for others? Have you done good to change the bad you see? Hear Jesus saying to you today, “What you do to the least of your brothers, that you do unto Me”. Jesus is telling you to love without expectation today.



Prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, help me to love enough to overlook the mistakes of others.

title: THE ONLY IMPERISHABLE TREASURE
text:
Man tends to act as if he is going to live forever, and thus, many times he spends his days on earth consumed with acquiring money or other material possessions. The Word of God, however, teaches us that the blessings of the world enrich the body temporarily; the blessings of Christ enrich the soul for eternity.



For a person who is not relying on Jesus Christ and His sufficiency, a time will come in his life when he will be unsatisfied and will try to fill his inner emptiness, either through entertainment or buying goods for himself in order to depress his feeling of discontentment. Undoubtedly, we all know that all material goods are temporary and subject to the ravages of time. In fact, the wisest king who passed in the history of mankind, Solomon, after trying all the goods, pleasures, wealth, and glory that one can taste in this life, concluded that everything, except keeping God’s commandments, is in vain.



In one simple but so instructive phrase, the Word of God in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟔:𝟐𝟏 states: “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨.” Your treasure can be anything you love to an extraordinary degree, such as your spouse, your children or your job, and there is nothing wrong with that. However, it is only a matter of time before the cares and blessings of this world distract you from the Giver of our blessings if we are not focused on Him constantly. We must not forget that the only thing that will live forever is our soul, our spirit. 



What is it that has the main position in your heart? If you replace every worldly desire in your heart with what God desires and give Jesus Christ His rightful place in your life, then you will enjoy true joy, peace, and contentment.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, expose every hidden sinful desire I may have and fill me with Your Spirit, so that I may desire to serve You and please You through my faith in You, in Your holy name I pray, amen.”#Treasure #Soul

title: THE TIME IA NOW
text:
Today, many want to change but they want to do it at a more convenient time. Many desire salvation but they are waiting for the right time. If you want to be a Christian, if you want to be saved, the time is now. Do not wait for a more convenient day because that day may never come. Do not wait for an appropriate time to change, because it may be too late and costly.



Life is too short to waste on things that have no lasting value. How do you live your life today? Are you living to please God? In order not to come to the end of your days saying, “I should have been this, I could have been that” now is the time to start living a life that is in line with God. Prophet TB Joshua knew the value of time and made the most of it by totally submitting to God for everything. Today, his legacy is a positive example for us all and generations yet unborn. What would be your legacy when you run out of time? Will it be a positive example or a tragic lesson? The answer to this depends on what you do with time now. Think about it.



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to live my life for You, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: GOSSIPING – AN INSIDIOUS SIN!
text:
So-called social commentary, or simply gossip, is one of the most insidious sins we commit. It is something we hate in other people, but we do not react when we find ourselves falling into this trap. We often take part in a conversation and it is not easy to distinguish whether it is a simple conversation or gossip. So, we simply and easily get carried away and as a result, we sin without even realising it! Relationships as well as years of friendships have been destroyed because of this sinful habit, which many of us consider innocent social commentary.



𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟑𝟗:𝟏: “𝐈 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐰𝐚𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐦𝐲 𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐤𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐦𝐲 𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐬𝐢𝐧; 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐚 𝐦𝐮𝐳𝐳𝐥𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝'”. Negative commentary, in order to joke at someone’s expense, spreading assumptions about the lives of others without their knowledge or approval, accusations, in order to share our pain with someone familiar to us, and spreading confidential information to a person who is not concerned with a particular matter, are some forms of gossip that cause anger, bitterness and pain, while they also damage human relationships. The Word of God contains several references to gossip, babbling, and even punishment as a consequence of meddling in other people’s affairs. The words we utter unnecessarily, even if we repent, can still negatively affect a person, so, we should be very careful when we speak.



As a child of God, you must remember that your words have the ability to attract or drive people away from you. So, we must be careful with our words so that we avoid the sinful act of gossiping. Moreover, by gossiping, we waste valuable time and energy that could be channelled into something productive. Our Lord Jesus Christ is the example to follow. While He was healing the sick, some people accused Him, but He, instead of speaking bad about them, prayed. Let us surrender our weaknesses to the Lord and pray that He will become a strength in them.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace not to sin before You in my words, thoughts or actions. Help me Father, that I may not babble, and fall into the trap of needless, sinful chatter – in Your Almighty name I pray, amen.”#Gossip #Sin

title: LEAVE IT FOR GOD
text:
For those who are seated on the highway of life, worrying about tomorrow, despairing about life’s uncertainties, and murmuring about life’s problems, there is good news for you. We serve a God who oftentimes brings good out of evil; He uses unpleasant circumstances to uncover His mighty grace and promise in the lives of His people. Joseph was a man who faced rejection from his own people, but God used his rejection for his advancement. What is your situation? Are you rejected, disappointed, or abandoned? Are you in pain and don’t know what life will bring? Leave it for God. Nobody can replace God’s plan for your life.



We fail to realise that God is helping us build character now so that when we get to the place of destiny, we will not crack, explode and lose it all. God has purposefully kept us in the dark concerning future events so we can always be alert, watchful, and prayerful. 1 Corinthians 1:27 teaches us that God sometimes works most wisely and most powerfully in a way directly opposite to human expectations. Do not allow your situation to weigh you down. A real Christian depends upon God’s grace and puts his trust in Christ alone. It is this grace that gives us hope that no matter the situation, the best is yet to come.



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to see beyond my present situation, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: HUMAN MEDITATION VS BIBLE MEDITATION
text:
If anyone tried to count the thoughts he has throughout the day, he would surely fail. The human mind can have thousands of thoughts per day. Different studies have shown that the vast majority of these thoughts are negative and repetitive! Our thoughts can lead us closer to God’s blessings or deny us the blessings of God. Therefore, think positively and positive things will happen to you. Think negatively and you will see that you’ll encounter unpleasant situations. 



𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟑:𝟕: “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐬 𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐤𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭, 𝐬𝐨 𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐞”. A negative meditation in the mind is enough to bring fear, anxiety, panic, doubt, and eventually, setback and destruction. However, we are called to God’s kind of lifestyle! It is a lifestyle of positive thinking, positive talking and positive actions, because a man’s life is what he thinks about all day long. In other words, our life cannot go beyond the level of our thoughts!



As a Christian, you ought to meditate on God’s Word daily and consciously, that is willingly, and then change will be certain. Your mind will change, your life will change, because His Word has the ability to quicken us spiritually and helps our spirit govern our senses! It is clear that if you make His Word an integral part of you, something wonderful will happen! You will see yourself called to act! You will realise that It has the power to save, deliver and heal! Therefore, starting today, allow the Word of God to touch every part of your heart, and you will see that your character will start transforming into the character of Jesus Christ!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, help me read Your Word daily and meditate on it, so that my mind, my heart and my entire life will be renewed, in Your holy name I pray, amen!”#Meditation #BibleReading

title: WITHIN YOU
text:
We are created after the image of Jesus Christ; we are made in our hearts to be like Him. This means that your appearance does not matter. What matters is what is within you. What matters is your thoughts and words, that is, your capacity to believe. How do we transfer what is within us to the outside? By meditating on God’s Word day and night. Meditation will bring revelation and the greater the revelation, the more the development of God’s Word in your heart. This gives birth to belief in your heart. The more the development of God’s Word in your heart, the greater your capacity to believe. 



As a Christian, you are what you are because of your capacity to believe in Christ. What you are able to do is based on your capacity to believe in Christ. If what is possible for you in Christ is not possible for me, then something is restricting me. What is restricting us is not on the outside but within us. If it were to be on the outside, money, property, position and human sympathy would have solved the problem. As Christians, we should be controlled by the One within us. When you are controlled by the One within, your direction would not be determined by what the situation looks like, what is happening around you. This translates to everyday victory in spite of the numerous oppositions.



Prayer: “Lord Jesus, strengthen my capacity to believe so that whatever happens around me will not determine my direction.”

title: Pastor Evelyn Joshua Carries Forward the Legacy of Prophet TB Joshua with a Remarkable Living Water Service
text:
Pastor Evelyn Joshua



On Friday, 28th July 2023, the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN) witnessed a historic event as the charismatic and visionary Pastor Evelyn Joshua led the extraordinary Living Water Service. The atmosphere was electric with numerous local and international visitors flocking to the service, seeking healing, deliverance, and blessings. As the wife of the late prophet TB Joshua, Pastor Evelyn Joshua has taken on the mantle to continue his legacy, and the service was a testament to her dedication and devotion. With an overwhelming display of miracles and testimonies, the event left attendees inspired and grateful for the profound impact Pastor Evelyn Joshua is making in the lives of countless people worldwide.



The passing of Prophet TB Joshua in 2021 left a void in the hearts of millions, as he had touched lives through his unwavering faith and boundless compassion. As the spiritual leader of SCOAN, his legacy remained a guiding light for the church community and those he had impacted. Stepping into the role of leadership, Pastor Evelyn Joshua proved herself as a capable and compassionate successor, carrying forward the values and teachings of her late husband.



The Living Water Service, an event deeply cherished by Prophet TB Joshua, exemplified his commitment to bringing hope, healing, and deliverance to people of diverse backgrounds. Pastor Evelyn Joshua gracefully embraced this responsibility and organized the service with utmost dedication, ensuring it maintained the same spirit of love and empathy that her husband had instilled.







The Living Water Service, known for its immense spiritual significance, attracted a vast congregation of both local devotees and international visitors. The SCOAN premises buzzed with energy as individuals and families sought spiritual breakthroughs and divine blessings. Despite the large gathering, the aura of unity and devotion was palpable.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua presided over the service with an air of humility and spiritual authority. Her genuine desire to connect with people on a personal level was evident, as she fervently prayed for a lady with foul spirits, laying hands on her with unwavering faith.



Miracles unfolded, and testimonies of healing and deliverance poured forth, validating the profound impact of the Living Water Service and the faith that surrounded the event.



The late Prophet TB Joshua, known for his benevolence and passion for humanity, undoubtedly looked down from heaven with pride as he witnessed the Living Water Service unfold. The joy of seeing his beloved wife, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, continue the work they both held dear must have been immeasurable.







Through her tireless efforts, Pastor Evelyn Joshua has proven that she is not merely carrying a torch but lighting up new paths of compassion, faith, and healing. Her unwavering dedication to continuing the work of her late husband has touched countless lives and brought hope to those in need. It is safe to say that Prophet TB Joshua’s legacy is in compassionate hands, and the impact of his life’s work continues to reverberate through the world.



The Living Water Service on Friday, 28th July 2023, was a momentous occasion that brought together people from different corners of the globe in pursuit of spiritual solace and miracles. Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s remarkable leadership and dedication to continuing the legacy of her late husband, Prophet TB Joshua, shone through in every aspect of the service. The healing, deliverance, and testimonies shared by attendees were a testament to the enduring impact of her prayers and faith.



As the SCOAN community and admirers of Prophet TB Joshua’s work, we extend our heartfelt gratitude to Pastor Evelyn Joshua for her selfless service and for allowing herself to be a vessel of God’s love and compassion. In fulfilling this sacred duty, she has truly earned the admiration and pride of her late husband, who undoubtedly watches over her with joy from heaven.



May the Living Water Service and the ministry of Pastor Evelyn Joshua continue to be a source of healing, hope, and inspiration to people around the world, carrying forward the legacy of Prophet TB Joshua for generations to come.

title: RESIST TEMPTATION
text: “How did I succumb to temptation?  Why did I not stand for what I believe? How come did I not remain pure in a tempting environment? How did I allow this to happen?”. These are some of the questions that go through our minds every time the devil tempts us. We forget our relationship with God and that temptation is the presence of evil, causing us to fall into sin! But why do we find it so difficult to resist sin?The Word of God, in 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟏𝟑, states:  “𝐍𝐨 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐞𝐩𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐝. 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐟𝐮𝐥; 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐫. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐝, 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐚 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐭”.Undeniably, when you have a relationship with the Heavenly Father, no temptation will be able to bring you down, because you will stand on what the Almighty God says and not on what your fleshly desires and pleasures ask of you! It becomes absolutely clear that if you aim at your spiritual growth and not at what the world offers you, even if satan comes to tempt you, you will be able to say, “No” to sin and, “Yes” to the righteousness of God!  If you are not out for material and political gains but to do God’s work, you will overcome your temptation.Therefore, learn to aim at God’s work, and not at material and political gains, and you will see that you will be able to resist temptation, you will be able to remain pure in a sinful world, and then the sky will be your limit!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today, your work is my goal. I know that as I keep my focus on you I won’t fall into the net of temptation, amen!”#Resist #Temptation

title: GOD IS WITH US!
text: Emmanuel means “God is with us.” We like responding to the greeting, but do we really understand the meaning? Why is God with us? We need God because we are weak. Our weakness is not in terms of physical strength, material wealth, worldly position, or fame but spiritual abilities. If we are not weak, we will not need God to be with us. Today, many are no longer conscious of sin. We find it hard to acknowledge and admit our wrongdoings. The greatest love Jesus Christ has given us is the opportunity to correct our mistakes! Prophet T.B Joshua said “To identify and acknowledge our weakness is victory in itself. If we mean it with all our heart, the job is half-done. It is fifty percent of the victory; the remaining fifty percent, leave it for God.” This means that acknowledging your weakness is the first step towards repentance. When we repent, we receive forgiveness. Do not hide your sin, admit it and work tirelessly towards mending your ways, strive towards righteousness. When we run to God with our weaknesses, He is always ready to accept us as we are and clothe us with forgiveness.PRAYER: Ask God to give you the grace to live above your weakness. Ask God to speak strength into your weakness. Your life will not remain the same, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: SAY NO TO SIN!
text:
The heart, according to human anatomy, is the most important organ of the body. Its connection with the other organs and its functions are impressive in number. But what is the case of a Christian’s heart? What is it that God is looking for in a human heart? In the Bible, we see that God has always shown mercy to people who kept their hearts pure and did not fall into sin! He showed mercy to people who had a humble heart and managed to stand before Him with integrity. In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟏𝟎:𝟏𝟔 the Word of God states, “𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐚𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐨𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐝 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐧𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬 𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐬”.



Remaining steadfast in a world that constantly challenges you to sin and do things that are not in line with God’s Word seems impossible. However, there is a way to resist sin and keep the wisdom of God within us because we have been given His Word! God’s Word is the believer’s map and it always reminds us that the Almighty One is walking beside us! As long as we fill our hearts with his Word, sin will have absolutely no power over us because God will be with us. When God is supporting your position, you have the authority to say “No” to sin and “Yes” to righteousness!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, give me the strength to resist sin and do Your will, even when everything around me causes me to sin. Walk beside me through Your Word and I am confident that victory will always be on my side!



Resist #Sin

title: FORGIVENESS BRINGS FREEDOM
text:
The Book of Colossians 3:13 says, “Bear with each other and forgive one another if any of you has a grievance against someone. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.” The question you need to ask yourself is: who has wronged you? Remember the Lord’s prayer – “Give us this day, our daily bread and forgive us our sin as we forgive those who sin against us.” In other words, ‘If I don’t forgive those who wrong me, don’t give me this day my daily bread.’ Daily bread means the essentials of life; all you need to live for Him.



Regardless of the circumstances, whether you are wrong or right, whether you are the accuser or the accused, whether you are the offender or the offended, to live in the freedom that God desires for you, you must forgive and let go of the offence. Many keep battling with stagnation, limitation, disappointment, and setback because they are victims of the trap of unforgiveness. The knowledge that you have sinned and been forgiven creates mercy and compassion towards others. Don’t allow sin and confrontation to tear down your relationship with God. Always have it in mind that no man or woman is perfect.



Prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, help me to love enough to overlook the mistakes of others.

title: Mammoth Crowd Welcomes Wiseman Daniel to Zambia: A Divine Encounter Awaits
text:
In a spectacular display of faith, unity, and anticipation, a mammoth crowd converged at the Kenneth Kaunda International Airport to extend a warm and heartfelt welcome to the revered spiritual leader, Wiseman Daniel. This remarkable event marked the beginning of a transformative spiritual journey for the Christian nation of Zambia.



With a harmonious symphony of melodious songs and intricate traditional dances, the people of Zambia showcased their enthusiastic reception as they embraced the arrival of Wiseman Daniel, a man of God renowned for his prophetic insight and miraculous healing abilities. This grand welcome was a testament to the power of faith and the shared belief in the divine presence of Jesus Christ.



Wiseman Daniel’s visit to Zambia was not a mere coincidence but a result of a divine revelation he received from Almighty God in September 2022. As he touched down at the Kenneth Kaunda International Airport in Lusaka, he brought with him a profound message and a mission entrusted to him by the Master, Jesus Christ. His arrival was a reminder that when God speaks, the wise listen.



During an insightful interview with Mwebantu TV, Wiseman Daniel emphasized the importance of love, forgiveness, and generosity in preparation for the forthcoming Zambia for Christ crusade. He urged the attendees to extend their hearts to their neighbors, forgive those who have wronged them, and share their blessings with others. According to him, these acts of kindness are pivotal in maintaining the blessings bestowed by God.









“I am here to commend the efforts of fathers, mothers, brothers, and sisters who have been waging war against the kingdom of darkness in Zambia. Let us join forces to form a mighty front against the forces of darkness,” Wiseman Daniel stated passionately, signifying the collective responsibility to uphold the light of Christ.



The anticipation for the Zambia for Christ crusade has been building up, with the prayer line registration concluding on August 9th. The event, scheduled for August 11th and 12th at the prestigious National Heroes Stadium in Lusaka, promises to be a divine convergence of souls seeking healing, deliverance, and spiritual upliftment. The following days will feature a pastor’s conference on August 14th, culminating in a charity event that encapsulates the spirit of giving and sharing.



Wiseman Daniel’s mission is clear: to serve the people of God by preaching salvation and ministering deliverance and healing. As he embarked on this sacred assignment, he expressed his humility and dedication to showcase Jesus Christ as the true healer and deliverer. With unwavering faith, attendees are urged to anticipate the move of the Holy Spirit, as the anointed servant of God channels God’s healing power during the event.



Amidst the excitement and anticipation, Wiseman Daniel’s visit has united people from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and nations, all converging under the banner of faith and hope. The message is clear: Jesus Christ is already present, overseeing the proceedings, and orchestrating divine intervention.



As the nation of Zambia readies itself for this life-changing encounter, it is with bated breath that attendees and observers alike await the fulfillment of their expectations. Through the streams of media and the physical presence of those who will gather at the National Heroes Stadium, the promises of healing, deliverance, and salvation are set to manifest.



Indeed, as Wiseman Daniel’s visit unfolds, the reminder that Elohim, the mighty God, resides within us all becomes more potent. Let the journey of faith, healing, and divine revelation begin!

title: Day 1 Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel: A Journey of Miracles and Transformation
text:
The long-awaited day has finally dawned upon us. The National Heroes Stadium in Lusaka is flooded with expectant souls, eagerly anticipating the first day of the Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel. With hearts filled with faith, they enter the stadium, believing that their entrance today will not be the same as their exit by the end of this remarkable day.



A diverse assembly of believers from across Zambia and different corners of the continent have gathered to partake in this divine convergence. With excitement and readiness to receive the touch of God through His vessel, Wiseman Daniel. The atmosphere is charged with an aura of expectancy, as attendees anticipate the profound transformations that God is about to work in their lives.



The diversity of nationalities present enhances the unity of purpose. The followers and believers, driven by the common grace entrusted upon Wiseman Daniel by the Almighty, have journeyed from Southern Africa to gather under the banner of the Zambia for Christ Crusade. The fervent belief that God’s power transcends geographical boundaries is palpable.



To those joining from around the world, remember that distance is no obstacle for the omnipresent power of God. The stadium, packed to capacity and beyond, resonates with the collective energy of believers. They are here not merely as spectators, but as witnesses to the divine move of the Spirit of God. ELOHIM’s presence is undeniable; it fills every corner, ready to pour blessings and miracles upon those in attendance.



Apostle Jacob, the Zambian host, encapsulates the essence of this spiritual journey with the powerful words, “Before expectation, there is anticipation.” He urges everyone to hold fast to their faith, to expect miracles, and to let go of any doubts. The anticipation is met with a revelation that God has blessings in store for each individual, a promise that holds true for those gathered in the stadium and for those connected from afar.









The air is electric with worship, praise, and fervent prayers as Wiseman Daniel takes the stage to minister. He opens a gateway to the place of Calvary, the divine intersection between God and humanity through the sacrifice of Jesus Christ. Attendees are reminded that this place offers healing, deliverance, salvation, and blessings. The benefits are not bestowed by Wiseman Daniel, but by God Himself.



Testimonies of miraculous healings and transformations abound. Mrs. Veronica Baitsheni from Namibia shares her journey from a place of physical limitations to freedom. Mrs. Sukoluhle and her family recount their deliverance from spiritual bondage. Ms. Betty Motsisi’s story of deafness being replaced by healing echoes with the power of God’s touch. Mrs. Ednard Mboya’s journey from lumbar scoliosis to liberation is a testament to God’s healing hand.



The atmosphere is charged with prayers, praises, and prophecies. The power of healing flows as Wiseman Daniel lays hands on the sick. The stadium reverberates with spiritual energy as the masses pray for the nation’s deliverance from afflictions and bondages.



The Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel is more than an event; it’s a spiritual awakening. It’s a testament to the boundless power of faith and the limitless reach of God’s grace. Lives are transformed, chains are broken, and testimonies of God’s goodness and miracles are witnessed by all.



As Day 2 approaches, the fervor intensifies. Attendees prepare their hearts for another day of divine encounters, believing that God’s power will continue to flow and change lives. The Zambia for Christ Crusade is a beacon of hope, a celebration of faith, and a reminder that the power of God is at work, transcending boundaries and transforming lives.



Day 2 Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel: A Continuation of Miracles and Divine Encounters

title: Day 2 Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel: A Continuation of Miracles and Divine Encounters
text:
The excitement remains palpable as the dawn of Day 2 arrives at the Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel. The National Heroes Stadium once again becomes the epicenter of divine manifestations and spiritual transformation. The crowd gathers early, ready to experience the continued outpouring of God’s blessings and miracles.



The international visitors, filled with joy and anticipation, embody the collective hope that this day brings. The atmosphere is charged with an aura of expectation, a sense that something incredible is about to unfold. As the worshippers take their places, they do so with the understanding that today is a day of divine appointments and divine interventions.



The host, Apostle John, sets the tone for the day with a message of reconciliation and restoration. He reminds the congregation that the heart is where God plants His seed, where the transformative power of Jesus Christ is deposited. The analogy of the prodigal son resonates deeply – the journey back to God’s embrace, the realization of being found in Christ, and the understanding that forgiveness and love are central to God’s plan.



Wiseman Daniel, driven by divine guidance, delivers a powerful message centered around the concept of the “Place of Calvary.” This is a place of divine reconciliation, where God’s love and grace bridge the gap between humanity and the Creator. The benefits of this sacred place include healing, deliverance, salvation, and blessings. Wiseman Daniel emphasizes that these benefits are not granted by him, but by God Himself.









Even before the official commencement of the day’s activities, the power of God is evident. Instant healings begin to unfold as attendees experience liberation from various afflictions. The atmosphere is electric with the energy of faith, prayer, and divine intervention. As Wiseman Daniel moves through the crowd, touching and praying for individuals, the manifestation of God’s power is undeniable.



As the mass prayer ensues, the stadium resonates with declarations of freedom, deliverance, and healing. Chains are broken, sicknesses are vanquished, and lives are transformed. The stage is set for a continuation of the miraculous, a continuation of the outpouring of God’s grace.



Throughout the day, the stories of healing, deliverance, and transformation continue to pour in. Nataize Masenge, a young girl plagued by scoliosis, experiences a miraculous healing. Christine Banda, who suffered from severe pain after a COVID-19 vaccine, receives instant relief. Rosemary Lungo, who struggled to walk, walks freely after a touch from Wiseman Daniel.



Wiseman Daniel’s ministry is marked not only by his anointed words but also by his actions. He dances in celebration of the remarkable acts taking place – healings, deliverances, and divine encounters that change lives forever. The presence of Jesus Christ is tangible, and the congregation basks in His glory.









As the Zambia for Christ Crusade draws to a close, Wiseman Daniel extends his gratitude to all who have been part of this extraordinary journey. The transformation witnessed within the stadium’s walls, the liberation from afflictions, and the miracles that have unfolded are a testament to the power of God and the unwavering faith of the believers.



The Zambia for Christ Crusade with Wiseman Daniel is not just an event; it’s a spiritual revolution. It’s a profound display of the boundless love of God, the transformative power of faith, and the manifestation of miracles in the lives of those who believe. The impact of this crusade will continue to resonate in the lives of those who have been touched by God’s grace. As the echoes of praise and worship fade, the testimonies of healing and transformation will remain etched in the hearts of the attendees. The Zambia for Christ Crusade is a testament to the unshakable foundation of faith, the eternal presence of God, and the promise that His power knows no bounds.
