title: THERE IS POWER IN FAITH!
text:
We live in turbulent and dangerous times, where hearing bad news is our daily routine. The lives of millions of people are filled with worry, anxiety and fear for tomorrow. However, we must not forget that our faith is tested daily through these situations. The Word of God teaches us that anyone who walks by faith will have trials, but trials and temptations are the soil in which the man of faith flourishes.



! It is these situations that help us strengthen our relationship with God. So, as a child of God, whatever your situation is, however hard it may seem, remember that it is for your spiritual growth and progress!



Let us take the example of David from the book of 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟏𝟕:𝟒𝟔, when he was faced with the giant Goliath. Seemingly unable to defeat Goliath the giant, he did not hesitate for a moment! On the contrary, he said: “𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐝𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈’𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐟𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐝𝐚𝐲 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐦𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐢𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐚 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥.” David had every reason to be afraid, however, he chose to focus on God and not on his external situation. In other words, he put his faith into action, and God’s power prevailed!



It is obvious that we need God all the time, not only when something very important happens to us or when something we cannot handle. Because big situations happen occasionally but little situations happen all the time. Faith manifests itself in small things in our daily life! Our faith is our connection to God. Believe and receive salvation, believe and receive healing, believe and receive permanent freedom, in the name of Jesus Christ!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me the strength to put my faith into action and leave tomorrow’s problems to the one who bore all problems on the Cross of Calvary – in the mighty name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#Power #Faith

title: A TRUE BELIEVER
text:
The Book of James 1:2 – 3 says, “My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into various trials, knowing that the testing of your faith produces patience.”



As Christians, we may have challenges, but our challenges are not like others’, they are meant to strengthen our desire and determination for God. True believers greet challenges as friends because they know the value in challenges. That situation that looks impossible, there is value in it because there can be no promotion without examination. A true believer does not listen to the panic of the moment but must find the quiet voice of counsel of the Holy Spirit.Challenges are meant to connect you to the future you desire. When we listen to the Holy Spirit, He will protect us from the pitfalls of the enemy. The value in challenges is meant to help explore possibilities making us look deeper because when times are stable and the sea is calm, no one is really tested. Apply yourself to your work and duty as a Christian soldier. Begin to see the value in your challenges and you will be connected to the future you desire in Jesus’ name. Prayer: Lord Jesus, free my heart to follow You, give me wisdom to know Your truth.

title: THERE’S COMFORT IN LOSS!
text:
Are you dealing with the pain of having lost someone? Have you buried a loved one or lost a relationship with someone you considered to be a life-long partner? Are you experiencing the weight of having to start all over again? Or is the pain so deep that it has changed your perspective in life — and now just to avoid the risk of going through the pain again, you’ve decided from now on to go at it all alone? Losing someone you love is particularly difficult for anyone. The pain of loss can cause someone to ask, “God, Why? Why did you allow this to happen? Where are you?”.



God understands the language of sighs, and tears, meditation, earnest heart desires and wishes of the man or woman of faith. In 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟑𝟒:𝟏𝟖 the Word of God says “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭.”



While you might be under the weight of failed expectations and pain, you must know that our heavenly Father is closer to you than ever, and He gives us the grace of enablement to endure whatever life may bring. But beware! Our enemy, satan, the architect of all pain, takes delight in deep hurt and uses it to distort our vision, to bring us to view God and ourselves in a bad light. Make no mistake! Satan wants us to curse God while under trial, pain, and affliction and be numbered among those abandoned to wander this life aimlessly, without hope, and without direction.



Receive courage! Take a step back and wait to see what God has to say about the situation, and don’t allow the enemy to make you lose your focus! When we accept adversity, enduring every pain, then we would learn what we should know and our grief will turn to gain.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, you are not a man that lies, and Your Word says that Your sheep know Your voice”. Grant me ears to hear, and eyes to see what You have to say about my situation. Position me where You would be interested in everything I do and say. Locate me, Lord, in Your mercy and comfort me in my affliction. Speak to me with healing in Your Words and fix the things I didn’t know were hurt – In Jesus’ mighty name. #Comfort #Loss

title: MEDITATION BRINGS REVELATION
text:
The Bible is the Christian’s guide for belief and practice; it contains the Truth. When you read your Bible, you are hearing God talk. The more you read your Bible, the more you understand yourself and this God who created you. The Bible is given to us to simply invite us. God Almighty is inviting you to His Word through His Word by His Spirit. Will you honour that invitation today?



It is one thing to read and it is another thing to meditate. Reading helps us to keep the Word in our memory, while meditation helps us to keep the Word in our heart. The Word of God is a treasure that produces great riches in the lives of those who meditate on it, not those who only read it. The Word of God becomes a part of you only by meditation. To meditate is to think more deeply in silence; it is to focus only on one thing: God’s Word. Meditation is the tool, weapon for making the Word of God effective in a Christian.



Meditating on the Word is communing with God, because the Word is God’s contact with us and our contact with Him. Every instance of genuine meditation brings a response, and that response can be a shout of joy, confession, thanksgiving, prayer or praise. The Word (Bible) in your hand carries you, via meditation, beyond sense knowledge to revelation, where you get results. This means that you need to mind what you take in because your input determines your output. Feed your spirit everyday so that God can have His way in your life.

title: TRUE SUCCESS COMES FROM ABOVE!
text:
When we see someone succeeding in an area of life, many of us compare ourselves and say, “Look at my friend’s business, I want to do the same!” — not knowing that you might be born to be successful in some other area in life. We change our destiny and become second, imitating someone else, when we were born to be first in another area. Many of us strive to be successful financially, working hard each day, forgetting to feed our spirits in order to build a character that will enable us to handle the demands and temptations that come along with the financial achievement and success we so much dream of and desire. History is filled with those who reached the peak of their careers, but because of some weakness, in a short time, they lost it all. Why? Because life is a marathon, not a sprint; and there is no shortcut. Character comes first so that when we arrive at the place of destiny we will not crash and explode and lose it all. In 𝟐 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝟐𝟔: 𝟓 the Bible reveals about King Uzziah: “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐙𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐡, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝: 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐬 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃, 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫”. True success comes from God and, therefore, His Word is our guide to true success. Remember, God Almighty did not create us to do what the majority of people do today! Instead, serving God is to do what the best do! He created us to have a vision, to succeed in what He has called us to be! But the first place to be victorious is in our spiritual life and in our mind because victory does not start around us; it begins within us! No matter what stage you are in life, it’s never too late to get God involved.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, here I am! I wish to put you first. Position me where you’ll be interested in everything I do and say–being my personal coach, and CEO. Grant me the grace of enablement to know just what to do – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Divine #Success

title: YOU ARE GOD ALL THE TIME
text:
There are times when we think the world around us is coming to an end. In such critical situations, we know those who are true Christians. Some people try to figure God out through their feelings, even though the Bible teaches us that our quality of faith is measured by our attitude to God, particularly in hard times.



In the light of Job’s experience, we can see that trouble does not require any invitation before it comes. So, when trouble comes unexpectedly, how do you handle it? Job saw his hard times as a reason for believing in God, just as he had also seen good times as a reason for believing in God. This is why he did not sin by charging God with wrongdoing. Instead, he fell to the ground in worship and said, “The Lord gave and the Lord has taken away; may the name of the Lord be praised”. This means that if you handle your hard times with care, they will soon turn to good times.



If gold must be gold, it must pass through fire. Anytime you are face to face with uncommon challenges, do not lose heart. They may be to prepare you for the uncommon blessings that are waiting ahead of you, because uncommon blessings always attract uncommon challenges. When you know this as a child of God, your confession will always be, “Whether You save me or not, I will continue to serve You, because I know You are my Saviour! I know You are God all the time!”

title: The Crusade in Kenya by Pastor Evelyn Joshua: A Divine Feast of Blessings
text:
Pastor Evelyn Joshua




The spiritual atmosphere in Nairobi, Kenya is about to be electrified with divine energy as Pastor Evelyn Joshua and the Emmanuel TV Team gear up to host a monumental crusade at the Kasarani Moi International Stadium on the 13th and 14th of October 2023. This event promises to be a spiritual banquet where all are invited to partake in the blessings and miracles that the Lord Jesus Christ has in store for His people.



With free entrance for all at the Kasarani Moi International Stadium, this crusade is a testament to the inclusivity of the gospel message. No one will be left out from experiencing the profound touch of God’s grace and the transformative power of His love.



The event will be broadcasted live on Emmanuel TV, starting at 12 PM East Africa Time (EAT). For those unable to attend in person, tuning in to the live broadcast will allow them to connect with the powerful ministry of Pastor Evelyn Joshua and witness the divine outpouring of blessings in real-time.



The theme for this crusade is inspired by Psalm 23:5, which states, “You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies…”. Indeed, the season has come for Kenya to feast at the banquet of the Lord Jesus Christ. The promise is that God will prepare a table of blessings in the midst of life’s challenges and adversities. It’s a time for families to experience healing, for businesses to encounter breakthroughs, and for individuals to find deliverance in their lives.









As we gather to receive from the Lord, we are reminded of the words of Jesus in John 15:16, “You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit — fruit that will last — and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you.” The crusade in Kenya is a manifestation of this divine appointment, a moment when God’s people are chosen to bear lasting fruits of blessings, miracles, and transformation.



Kenya, a beautiful nation with a rich tapestry of culture and history, is poised for a spiritual revival. The prayers, worship, and teachings during the crusade will undoubtedly leave a profound impact, ushering in a season of unprecedented blessings and favor. With hearts open and faith ablaze, the people of Kenya can expect to witness a transformation in their lives and the nation as a whole.



In the name of Jesus Christ, the crusade in Kenya is set to be a historic event, a divine feast of blessings that will touch the hearts and lives of all who attend or tune in. As Pastor Evelyn Joshua and the Emmanuel TV Team lead the charge, Kenya shall not remain the same. The season of harvest has arrived, and the nation is poised to receive God’s abundant grace and favor. Come one, come all, and partake in this extraordinary moment of spiritual renewal and transformation.

title: kICK DEPRESSION OUT!
text:
Depression, an issue that has quietly reached pandemic proportions nowadays.  In fact, even in modern societies it is a taboo subject, especially for men who should always appear strong and emotionally unaffected by the difficulties of life, according to social standards, but also for many children of God.  As a result, many people, mistakenly believing that death will redeem them, unfortunately, even go so far as to take their own lives…



It may be that the various crises experienced by humanity in recent years have played a catalytic role in the mental state of people, however, one of the reasons that has led many Christians to depression is that they have distanced themselves from God, the Creator.  Today people desire wealth, nice houses, nice cars or a beautiful family more than having a strong relationship with God. Of course, there’s nothing wrong in having goals and wanting a good life, but we all need to keep in mind that real joy and satisfaction in life comes when we put Jesus Christ in the main position of our heart! In fact, our failure to give Jesus Christ His proper place in our heart is responsible for the crisis of our faith!



Unfortunately, when man is facing various problems in different aspects of his life, he can easily become vulnerable and overwhelmed psychologically and mostly spiritually, if he does not know that the reason why a man should live is for the glory of God! You should learn today that even if you can’t control your situation, you can still control your behavior!  The Lord Himself invites you to come to Him in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟏𝟏:𝟐𝟖-𝟑𝟎: “‘𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐞, 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐮𝐫𝐝𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭.  𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐦𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐤𝐞 𝐮𝐩𝐨𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐦𝐞, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐬. 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐦𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐤𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐲 𝐛𝐮𝐫𝐝𝐞𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭.”  So take courage, don’t give up!  God has a wonderful plan for your life and wants you to overflow with joy and contentment!  Trust Him, and you will not be disappointed!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father God, I ask you to remove every burden from my soul and fill me with Your joy and peace that surpasses all understanding.  Come into my heart, make it Your dwelling place  and breathe into me a new breath of life, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”  #Depression #MentalHealth

title: THE RIGHT DECISION
text:
Hebrews 13:8 says, “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.” This means that whatever is rooted in the Lord Jesus is permanent, stable, incontestable, and untouchable. Life is all about taking tough decisions. For example, when people insult you, you can either ignore the insult in the spirit of forgiveness or retaliate in any manner you may choose. When you are in dire need of help, you can decide to run to God or run to your worldly friends. The issue is whether you are making the right decision. Unless the decisions we make are rooted in God’s Word, they will not stand at the time of great need. 



Deciding to put your trust in Christ Jesus as your Lord and personal Saviour is the most important decision you can make in life. In other words, life’s biggest decision is what you do with Jesus. When you receive Jesus Christ, you will get His ideas, know His opinion of yourself and others, and work within His project. Man cannot discover new oceans if he does not lose sight of the shore. When Joseph found himself in the dry pit, he made a personal decision. You are a man of vision; no matter the obstacles on your way, you can never be stopped. For you to discover your real value, you must make a personal decision to follow the way of God. Remember to see whatever you are doing as an assignment from God. You should also make the decision for life today, because it is your decision today that will determine your result tomorrow.



PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, help me to rely on you for everything, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: CHERISH YOUR MARRIAGE!
text:
We live in a world in which divorce is something very common…The divorce rate around the world is 4.08 per 1,000 married people. It is becoming more widespread in today’s society and has become a major source of stress and depression, affecting people’s mental and physical health. 



Many Christian families nowadays are dealing with all kinds of challenging situations which bring conflicts, misunderstandings, disputes, and eventually, make them take into consideration the option of divorce. But, before God, marriage is a lifelong relationship that should never be broken by human action.“𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐢𝐯𝐨𝐫𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐟𝐞,” 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥, “𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐯𝐢𝐨𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭,” 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐀𝐥𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐲 (𝐌𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢 𝟐:𝟏𝟔). God’s perfect will is to protect society and future generations by protecting the sacred bond of marriage. God is willing to give couples the help needed to sustain their marriage or to reconcile with one another, as long as they also choose to seek His help and walk in His path.



Minor conflicts must be resolved in love, and must not be allowed to cause a rupture in the holy relationship of marriage. As true believers and genuine children of God, we should remember that the fact that we disagree on a certain issue should not break our union or our friendship because there is always a way out in Christ Jesus.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Father, God, I ask for Your divine intervention in my marriage. I come to You with humility and sincerity of heart and I want to ask You to forgive me for all my wrongdoings towards my partner. Please, give me the grace to love and cherish the person You have blessed me with, to forgive his/her mistakes as You also do the same with mine. I know that it is never too late to ask for Your help and I believe nothing is impossible to You – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!#Marriage #CoupleGoals

title: Value Your Trials
text:
Proverbs 3:11–12 says, “My son, do not despise the chastening of the Lord, nor detest His correction; For whom the Lord loves, He corrects, just as a father the son in whom he delights.” Do not be discouraged when you go through difficult situations. Oftentimes, God uses foolish things to draw us closer to Himself. What we might consider to be a bad experience can be the turning point we need for our breakthrough. Ask Joseph, and he will tell you that the rejection he suffered was the turning point he needed for his future; what his brothers meant for evil, God turned it around for good.



Your place of destiny requires you to be strong-hearted. Take note that God is always on time; He is never too late and never too early. He is building character and rightful focus in you to mature you and prepare you to maintain your blessing when it comes. When you know the purpose of your situation, whatever happens midway will not dictate your direction since it is meant to strengthen you. As a believer, your situation calls for thanksgiving; praising God should be your attitude towards trials because when trials come, your promotion is near. We urge you today to pick yourself up and repair your relationship with Jesus Christ.



PRAYER: “Father, draw me nearer to you so I can know what you are saying about my situation, in Jesus’ name!” Amen!

title: THE MOST EFFECTIVE COACH!
text:
The necessity of the coach in sports is important and the same thing also applies in our Christian walk. The coach undertakes the preparation of the athletes and takes care of their physical condition, so that they have the best possible performance during the competitions.  Therefore, depending on each sport and the athletes he has taken over, the coach is responsible for their preparation, their program and their training. His job is to advise, encourage and guide!



As Christians, the necessity of a coach in our lives is essential so that he can help us finish the fight of faith! Hard training, that is, difficulties, challenges and temptations, are not intended to destroy us, but to take us to a higher spiritual level.  Their proper management is the training we receive for our spiritual benefit!  The Word of God in the 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟏𝟏 emphasizes,  “𝐍𝐨 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐦𝐬 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐩𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐟𝐮𝐥. 𝐋𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧, 𝐡𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫, 𝐢𝐭 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐚 𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐲 𝐢𝐭”



Therefore, if you allow Jesus Christ to become our personal coach in everything today, you will be asked to see what is not yet seen, hear what is not yet heard, say what is not yet said, do what is not yet done. Thus you will finish the good race of faith and your success will be certain.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, I ask you to become my personal coach and help me finish the good race of faith successfully as I submit to Your divine training – in Your Almighty name I pray, amen!”#LifeCoach #TrainHard

title: GOD’S PROCESS
text:
Genesis 17: 17 & 19 say: “Then Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, ‘Shall a child be born to a man who is one hundred years old? And shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bear a child?’ 19 Then God said: ‘No, Sarah, your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac….’”



Today, everyone wants to be great, but not everyone wants to go through God’s process. God’s process matters; it will help you maintain the result you get from Him. If the process you go through is not in line with the ways of God, the result will not stand the test of time. If you ignore the process and focus only on the result, you may likely not have the patience to differentiate between God’s supply and satan’s bait. To become God’s person, you must follow His process. God wants us to prosper in all areas; He does not want us to succeed only financially while losing ourselves to conditions. 



It is in the mind of God to answer prayers even when He seems not to respond immediately to our petitions. So, if you are following the right process and seem not to be getting results, don’t get discouraged; God is preparing you for something greater than what you want. All you need to do is to be patient and wait upon the Lord, Who will not leave you without a solution. Those that laugh at you for your patience will testify about your result. 



PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, help me to follow Your process, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: RESPECT YOUR PARENTS!
text:
By looking up the word “respect” in the dictionary, we will learn that it is the process of honoring someone, showing care, affection or concern for their needs or feelings. Today we unfortunately notice that there is a lack of respect, not only towards our fellow human beings, but even from the children to the parents who brought them into this world…



The map of the believer, the light on our path, the Word of God, teaches us in the 𝐄𝐩𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟔:𝟏: “𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧, 𝐨𝐛𝐞𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭. ‘𝐇𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫’—𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐞—  ‘𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐠𝐨 𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐞𝐧𝐣𝐨𝐲 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡’”. But what is the reason  children do not honor and respect their parents? The answer is that man is rebellious from the very first day he is born and human rebellion makes us do things against God’s instruction! It causes us to disrespect the principles, authorities, laws, and rules that God has set. However, God’s Word teaches us that the way of obedience is the way of blessing! Thus, if we want to see the blessings of God in our lives, and if we want to experience something we have never experienced, we must do what we have never done before!



Don’t waste any more time! Start showing more respect, more care and more love to the people who brought you into this world from today, regardless of the mistakes and choices they have made in their lives, and you will see that your life will change radically!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will learn to respect my parents more, and treat them according to the teachings of Your Word. As I do so, I know that I will receive heavenly blessings, amen!”#Respect #LoveYourParents

title: THE WORDS IN OUR MOUTH
text:
The words you speak determine the life you enjoy. Words are not cheap. Love and disunity begin with words. Your future is in your words. Words created the world and words create your world. This means that the words you speak determine the kind of world you will live in. The words you speak can create blessings or curses, for your words have no neutral force.



What has your usual conversation been like? Is it life-giving or destructive? Many of us do not realise that the words of our mouth either imprison or free us. You cannot rise above your words, for they are the standard of your faith. When you talk about failure, failure increases its grip on you. When you talk fear, fear increases its grip on you. Your words control and dominate you because they express your thoughts, which are the seeds of your life. Whether we realise it or not, we are sowing words.



We are to sow good seeds. Just as Jesus said in Luke 8:1, we can sow the Word of God. The Word of God shows you God’s way of thinking. It renews your mind and tears down the obstacles that prevent you from freely receiving all that Christ has already purchased for you. God’s promises become real and living as we confess them. If you are sick or poor, the answer is in confessing God’s Word. Speak God’s Word today and watch God take over.



DECLARATION: “God is who He says He is. I am who God says I am. God can do what He says He can do. I can do what He says I can do. God has what He says He has. I have what God says I have.” Emmanuel!

title: CHOOSE TO BE HAPPY!
text:
We all have friends, family members and acquaintances who no matter what happens or no matter what comes their way, their smile and joy never fades off their face. What do these people do differently? Is there a magic pill that always makes you happy and joyful? Are these people supernatural beings?



In this life, everything has to do with choices and what you choose to focus on. Those who are sad have chosen to be sad and have consciously chosen to focus on the various things that make them sad.  On the other hand, those who are happy have chosen to be happy and have chosen to focus on things that bring them joy. If we claim that we are Christians, then we should not only believe the Bible verses that suit us… Bible verses like, “𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐚 𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞    𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐲 𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐞𝐬. 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐭 𝐦𝐲 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐨𝐢𝐥; 𝐦𝐲 𝐜𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐬”. (𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟐𝟑:𝟓). We should also embrace and apply Bible verses like “𝐑𝐞𝐣𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬”. (𝟏 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟏𝟔-𝟐𝟎)



When your life is under threat, choose to be happy and see what will happen next! God is faithful and His will for you is to be happy with everything that he does in your life daily. As you choose to be happy, you will see that you will be filled with overcoming power from above. You will see that you will have the divine power to see beyond the trials and tribulations that may come your way. Always keep in mind that when satan wants you to cry and you laugh, you defeat him!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus, fill me with your overcoming joy! Help me focus on the countless blessings in my life and not on satan’s deceitful lies – in Jesus’ name I pray, amen!#BeHappy #Choices

title: MAY GOD’S PEACE REIGN!
text:
We are deeply saddened by the recent terrorist attack against Israel, an act of violence that has caused pain and suffering to innocent civilians. Our hearts go out to the victims and their families, who are enduring such a tragic and senseless loss.



Our thoughts are with the people of Israel during this challenging time, and we extend our sincere support to all those who are affected by this tragedy. We stand united in the belief that the fact that we disagree on a certain issue should not break our union or our friendship because there is always a way out in Christ Jesus.



You are not alone in this difficult moment, and we are here to offer our support, sympathy and prayers in hope for a future where such acts of violence are replaced by God’s lasting peace.



🙏Prayer: Lord Jesus we commit to you the country of Israel and we pray that Your peace, mercy, and favor reigns in this difficult moment. We know that nothing can escape Your control as we steadfastly seek Your face and surrender this case into Your able hands – in Your Holy name we pray, amen!#StopTheWar #Israel

title: Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s Record-Setting Event Echoes Across Africa – By The Tribune
text:
The Synagogue, Church of All Nations, a beacon of spiritual enlightenment and community engagement, has announced its upcoming revival programme “The Crusade in Kenya With Pastor Evelyn Joshua.” This transformative event is set to take place from 13th and 14th October 2023 at the iconic Keserani MOI International Stadium, Nairobi, the largest sports center in East Africa.



The much anticipated two-day crusade , a first of its kind in Kenya, has been reckoned to be historical by the National Council of Churches of Kenya (NCCK) as the event is expected to draw a massive 60,000+ audience filling the seats at Kenya’s National Stadium, making her the first and only personality to ever hold an event of such magnitude.



It has been reported that people are already trooping in to Nairobi from neighboring countries of Tanzania, Uganda, Ethiopia, Sudan, Somalia and even as far as South Africa days before the commencement of the crusade yet more people from outside the continent continue to indicate interest because of its significance.



Commenting on the event, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, the leader of The SCOAN, shared thus: “The two-day crusade in Kenya is holding in furtherance of God’s will for this Commission and mankind; for the salvation of souls and fulfilled destinies. We are also undertaking a charity programme as part of our mission. This is by God’s instruction in His grace, mercy and favor that the nation of Kenya should partake in the blessings associated with this divine assignment”.



The passing of a visionary leader is undoubtedly a challenging time for any organization, especially when that leader has left an indelible mark on the hearts of millions. Such was the case when the renowned Nigerian televangelist and founder of The Synagogue, Church of All Nations (SCOAN), Prophet T.B. Joshua, transitioned to eternity. However, in the face of this immense loss, the mantle of leadership has been seamlessly transitioned to his wife, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, who has undoubtedly exhibited remarkable strength, resilience, and leadership qualities to carry forward the legacy of her late husband.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua, affectionately known as Mama Evelyn, has been reported to be a pillar of strength in the wake of her husband’s demise, as she stepped into a role that demanded not only spiritual guidance but also organizational leadership. Leading a large religious organization like The SCOAN is no small feat, but Pastor Evelyn Joshua has shown and continues to show remarkable organizational acumen. She has worked to strengthen the administrative structures of the church and foster a sense of unity and collaboration, upholding the sense of community that has been a hallmark of the church.



As one of the few women leading a global church, Pastor Evelyn has dispelled gender stereotypes, especially within the religious sphere, showcasing exceptional leadership that exemplifies the qualities of a true trailblazer.From 2022 onwards, she has effectively managed numerous impactful Prayer Gatherings and Crusades across nations such as Ghana, South Africa, Spain, and Zambia. Additionally, she led charitable missions to regions like Pakistan, Turkey, Ukraine, Bolivia, as well as flood-ravaged areas in South-East and South-South Nigeria in 2022.



Continuity in spiritual leadership is crucial for any religious organization, and Pastor. Evelyn Joshua has embraced this responsibility with grace and dedication. Building on the foundation laid by her late husband, she has continued the mission of The Synagogue, Church of All Nations, emphasizing the core values of love, faith, and humanitarianism. Her unwavering commitment to the teachings of Prophet T.B. Joshua has ensured that the spiritual journey of the church remains steadfast.



Prophet T.B. Joshua was known not only for his spiritual teachings but also for his extensive philanthropic work, which Pastor. Evelyn Joshua has solidly taken up in this regard as well, ensuring that the charitable activities of The SCOAN continue to impact the lives of the less privileged. From providing food aid to supporting education and healthcare initiatives, she has continued the legacy of compassion and benevolence that defined her late husband’s ministry.



The transition of leadership from the late Prophet T.B. Joshua to Pastor. Evelyn Joshua is a testament to the strength and resilience of both individuals. As she continues to lead the congregation, Pastor Evelyn Joshua stands as a beacon of hope, ensuring the legacy lives on in the hearts and deeds of those who follow the teachings of The SCOAN.



The forthcoming 2023 Kenya Crusade offers a unique opportunity for the people of Kenya and other global attendees to experience the powerful influence of the divine in their lives through the anoiniting of Pastor Evelyn Joshua.



For more information on the crusade, visit: http://www.evelynjoshuakenya.com



Sources: tribuneonlineng.com

title: YOUR HEART NEEDS FORGIVENESS!
text:
There are not a few who believe that by being indifferent and ignoring those who have hurt them, they are free from the burden of bitterness and unforgiveness… Indifference is not forgiveness, but can be seen as a kind of reaction in cases of deep insult and injustice. However, as children of God, we are taught that we should love those who hurt us and give countless opportunities to those who wrong us. In fact, Jesus Christ in Matthew 6:14, knowing how fragile human relationships are and wanting to teach us that forgiving others is not an option, but a necessary condition to receive God’s Divine forgiveness, emphasised: “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐥𝐲 𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮”.



Forgiveness does not mean ignoring what has happened, it does not mean that you sweep the dirt under the rug. It’s an awareness that no one is perfect! Forgiveness is knowing that your heart is the place where God dwells, and if you choose to pollute it with things like unforgiveness, the only one who gets hurt is you. If you believe that your heart, the house of God, is more valuable than your ego and your pride, you have a role to play today! Being indifferent and ignoring a person does not mean that your heart is free, because only forgiveness brings true freedom! Are you ready to let go of the past and move forward? If so, pray with these words:



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord Jesus Christ, I know that the condition of my heart before you is far more important than any offense and any bitterness. Lord, I refuse to be offended in order not to offend You and I refuse to hold unforgiveness in me because I need Your forgiveness. Give me the strength to be able to forgive those who hurt me. Help me to overcome the trap of the devil and overcome evil with good – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!#Forgiveness #Heart

title: You Have A Role To Play
text:
God has kept you until now for a purpose known to Him alone. This is why your being alive today suggests that you will achieve your goal. However, you have a role to play. The Bible says that when you seek anything for the salvation of your soul, whatever you receive will come with the peace of God. When you know that beyond your present situation is joy, you will have the strength to stand. It is only upon God’s strength that we can go forth, marching towards the throne He has set for us, but we have a role to play.



We must learn to put Christ in His proper place because when a person believes, he will no longer worry. Faith brings in restfulness. It reminds us that our sins are forgiven, therefore we have nothing to be worried about or hunted by. Faith is a lifestyle of trusting in God for what is next. As Christians, we need to see our situation as a builder of faith. It is the divine opportunity of today that leads us to the mystery of tomorrow. The success of your life depends on your role.  When you believe, you will appreciate and recognise the unseen hand of God that controls the affairs of men. The biggest decision in life is what you do with the instructions of Jesus Christ today. Make a heart decision in the present to benefit of the grace you need for tomorrow.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to always follow your instructions in everything I do, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: PLAN YOUR LIFE!
text:
Have you ever wondered why you find it so hard to make it and become great even though you try and struggle every day? One of the reasons most people sit in their setback is because they don’t have a plan in life…



The Word of God in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟒 states the following: “𝐀 𝐬𝐥𝐮𝐠𝐠𝐚𝐫𝐝’𝐬 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐬𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝”. In other words, the person that folds his hands will not have any record! If we don’t play our part every day, if we don’t devote our energy, our time and our effort to what we want to achieve in life, we will see no change and, thus, no success! God did not call us to live a life of laziness and apathy. God has called us to live a life of success and to be able to achieve things in our life we have to follow some steps and, of course, a plan! Successful people did not just drift to the top. It takes:• focused action, • personal discipline • and a lot of energy every day to make things happen



Therefore, you must start planning your life today, because the secret of tomorrow’s success lies in the activities you do today! Stop putting off your responsibilities, and start planning your life, because God honors those who plan!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will set a plan in my life, and I know that as I do this, Heavenly success will visit me – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#PlanYourLife #Success

title: The Legacy Continues: Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s Impactful Crusade in Kenya
text:
In the wake of the call to glory of Prophet TB Joshua, the global Christian community was left with a void. However, the torch of his ministry and benevolence is being brilliantly carried forward by his wife, Pastor Evelyn Joshua. Her recent Crusade in Kenya, held at the Kasarani Moi International Stadium, has not only continued the legacy of her late husband but has also demonstrated her strong commitment to righteousness and charitable works.



Prophet TB Joshua would undoubtedly be proud of the great work his wife is doing. The Synagogue, Church of All Nations (SCOAN) is, without a doubt, in safe hands. The anointed ministry continues to touch lives and bring hope to the masses.



The Crusade in Kenya, which took place on the 13th and 14th of October 2023, was a demonstration to the enduring message of love, faith, and healing. The event welcomed people from all walks of life, offering them a divine encounter with blessings, healing, and spiritual awakening.



Days after this monumental crusade, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, along with members of the Emmanuel TV team, embarked on a mission of righteousness and compassion. On Tuesday, October 17, 2023, they journeyed deep into the heart of Masai country, situated over a hundred kilometers from the Kenyan capital, Nairobi. Daily essentials, including food, clothing, and other necessities, were distributed to a community in Kajiado County. Additionally, the community received a generous donation of 500,000 Kenyan shillings, an act of benevolence that deeply touched the hearts of the local residents.



The charity event was not only a blessing to the Masai community but also garnered the appreciation of top county officials who were in attendance. Their presence underscored the significance of this humanitarian gesture in touching the lives of Kenyan citizens.



For the people of the Masai community, the receipt of daily essentials was a rare privilege, and their gratitude shone through as they were overwhelmed by this unexpected act of kindness. This mission was a testament to the words of Jesus in Matthew 25:35-36: “For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in, I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.”









But the acts of charity and righteousness did not end there. On the same Tuesday, October 17, 2023, Pastor Evelyn Joshua met with Kenyan government officials to make a significant contribution to environmental regeneration and ecological sustainability. She donated 25,000 USD and led the initiative to plant 20,000 trees across the country.



This tree-planting initiative is a powerful symbol of the commitment to preserving the Earth for future generations. Pastor Evelyn Joshua, alongside esteemed officials like The Right Hon. Speaker Okeyo Ngodi, Hon. Ibrahim Ouma, Hon. Brian Mulama, Mr. Edward Gichacha, and Hon. Ababu-Terrah Namwamba, has set an inspiring example of environmental stewardship and the importance of protecting our planet.



In these actions, Pastor Evelyn Joshua has not only continued the work of her late husband but has also solidified her own legacy of righteousness, compassion, and benevolence. The impact of her crusade in Kenya and subsequent charitable activities serves as a shining example and a lasting message of love and faith that transcends generations. The legacy continues, and the world is watching with admiration and gratitude.

title: A Good Christian
text:
Are you a Christian? If yes, have you ever seen anything wrong with what someone else is doing? How best do you correct the person in a Christian way? How best do you honour Jesus Christ in your correction? Is it by speaking negatively about the person without love and care? The Bible says that a Christian’s life is a disciplined life because it is based on God’s Word, which gives an excellent moral standard. God’s Word reflects His character. Remember, God’s Word teaches us to do what is good to change the bad we see. Let us be known as people who are for good and not only against bad. 



Many people are too quick in pointing out others’ weaknesses, whereas the Bible instructs that instead of criticizing others, we should show by example. A little example can have a big influence. Many give orders and instructions but refuse to obey God’s instructions in righteousness. If you find yourself condemning others, ask yourself this question, “Do I practice what I preach?” Jesus never strived to be good; He simply was good. He did not labour to appear truthful; He was truthful. He did not struggle to have a good reputation; He had character. What does this mean? This means that only your character can testify to your confession of Christ. The Bible says to accept Jesus is to accept the nature of God. One good can cancel a million wrongs.



As Christians, we should be known by our love. The Bible says that love is the greatest Christian virtue. Therefore, instead of criticizing our society and fellow men, let us do what is good to change the bad we see. Let us walk in the light of love. May God give us the Grace to do so in Jesus’ name!

title: A DIVINE PARTNER!
text:
Man by nature is a being who seeks companionship. God created us, a man and a woman, to become strength to each other. Since the creation of Adam, God made things in a way that no one would feel alone on earth. In 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟐:𝟏𝟖: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐈𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐞. 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐦.'” Unfortunately, however, in our times, more and more people are choosing to live alone or couples end up on separate roads. Why does this happen?



The Word of God teaches us that in order for a couple to live in harmony, each one must have a personal relationship with their creator and respect His principles. This is something that most people overlook or even ignore, whereas it is the key to a successful relationship! God has given us advice through His Word, so that we can become suitable partners, but also to be able to discern who would be a suitable life partner for us. A man who shows love, respect, loyalty, appreciates teamwork and mainly aims to obtain Jesus’ kind of character is a suitable life partner. A happy home does not just happen. It is built with Jesus Christ at its foundation! 



By keeping our unity with our creator, we can be vigilant so as not to make the wrong choices, but also ask Him to indicate to us who is the partner He has chosen for us! God cares about the partner we choose, because he is the one that we will walk along with us as we strive to fulfill our mission here on Earth. Are you in the process of finding the right partner for you? Don’t be discouraged! Be patient, because God’s answer is not for those who are in a hurry!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord, bring into my life whoever will add and multiply to it and close the door to anything that is not in my benefit, in your mighty name I pray, Amen. “#Life #partner

title: NO REASON TO RUSH
text:
Hebrews 6:11–12 says, “And we desire that each one of you show the same diligence to the full assurance of hope until the end, that you do not become sluggish, but imitate those who through faith and patience inherit the promises.”



We are living in a very impatient generation – people want to have everything now, forgetting that being impatient can be costly. When we are impatient, we tend to disregard the fact that there is time for everything. God has set an appointed time for everything that has to do with us. God’s response is not for those in a hurry. We should be patient and let God answer us on His schedule because everything is beautiful in His time. You may be great, but without preparation and time that greatness will not stand the test of time. You may be blessed, but without preparation and time that blessing will fade away. As Christians, our tools are patience, perseverance and endurance. How can your genuineness be confirmed if we don’t see your tools? 



Don’t misinterpret God’s silence as rejection. The moment you think of a shortcut, satan is there to provide you with one. The first thing that happens when you take a shortcut is that you will be on your own – no God, no guide, no protection, no direction! Satan can easily strike you; rather than moving to your destiny, you would be moving away from it. Our political associations can’t help us; neither can our friends. Only Jesus can help us – and at God’s appointed time. When that time comes, you will progress with very little or no personal effort – without any stress, pressure or tension. You will just move because God has already prepared the way. People of God, there is no competition in destiny; wait patiently for the Lord and submit to His Will. God’s time is the best.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to stay in You and remain in You, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: THE POWER OF COMMITMENT!
text:
When we receive Jesus Christ as our Lord and Saviour, we must understand that confessing Christ is not the only thing that is required. Receiving Him also means thorough commitment, steadfastness and also accordance of our words and actions. We cannot commit to Him with half-hearted devotion and then expect His blessings and promises. That is because God is committed to those who love and obey His commands (𝐃𝐞𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐨𝐦𝐲 𝟕:𝟗). 



In 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰 𝟏𝟏:𝟔, the Bible says “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐥𝐲 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐤 𝐡𝐢𝐦”. It’s impossible to grow in faith without commitment. In fact, commitment is required for any success! When we obey God and live a life that pleases Him, completely committed to everything His Word indicates, we cannot help but attract God’s favor and blessings. A genuine commitment to God and His Word cannot help but lead to divine promotion! 



Remember that only the doer of the Word receives things from God! Thus, our words and actions should tell the truth of what we believe. As trees are known by their fruits, so men are known by their actions (𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟕:𝟐𝟎). It is easy to confess your faith in God, but at the end of the day, actions speak louder than words!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, give me a greater understanding of Your heart, so that I may know You and commit to You the way I should as a true child of Yours. Give me the grace to commit to You and follow You in spirit and in truth, as I choose to do everything in accordance with your Word –  in Jesus’ name I pray, amen!”#Commitment #Devotion

title: Heaven Is with You
text:
John 15:11 says, “These things have I spoken unto you, that My joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.”



We live in a world ruled by the majority and we are, therefore, compelled to follow it. We cry when we see people crying even though we are not sad. We even shout when we are not excited. When the pastor says, ‘Rise up for prayer’, we pray even though we don’t have faith. You won’t meet Jesus when you imitate others, because faith is not imitation. If you continue to look outside for miracles, you will never find it, because faith is within; it is of the heart.



Prayer is the shortest route between the heart and God. A believer’s heart is the prayer room—the contact point for the Holy Spirit. This heart can also be a contact point for evil spirits if it is disturbed, anxious or full of offence. What we nurse in our hearts happens in time. This is the reason why you find yourself in the failure realm, even though you did not confess failure. Satan wants you to be sad because it gives him free entrance into your heart. You are often looking and never finding, asking but not receiving answers, knocking but the door is not opened because you have not discovered God’s presence within you. God can only enter your heart when you have joy.



Are you a believer? There may be a reason to be worried or afraid but there is a greater reason not to be. That reason is not far from you or beyond your reach, because what you are looking for you have already. That knowledge alone brings joy — that joy is the path to God.



Prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, restore that which is missing to make my joy complete—that awareness that Heaven is with me, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: THE WISEST CHOICE!
text:
In most religions and spiritual traditions around the world, God is considered the highest power and the creator of heaven and earth. However, in the modern society we live in today, various “gods” have taken this position… Gods like technology, science and career! But can all of the above fill the void left by the lack of spiritual life and relationship with the True God? In the book of 𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟖:𝟏𝟐, God’s Word states: “𝐋𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐞, 𝐉𝐚𝐜𝐨𝐛, 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥, 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝: 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐡𝐞; 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐚𝐬𝐭”. 



God in Ηis Word speaks clearly to us about the role Ηe should have in our lives. However, we all have the right to choose. Thus, whether we replace the role of God in our lives with various carnal pleasures that the world offers is entirely up to us. This is because, the choices we make determine whether we are children of God or children of satan… Every day, we come into contact with tempting things and pleasures that can very easily make us leave God aside, however, the decision still remains ours. God is willing to give us everything we need to live for Him, as long as we are also willing to follow him 100%. What will you choose?



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to walk in Your ways and follow Your works. Help me to always have You in the main position of my heart and never be tempted to replace You with the vanities of this world – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#WiseChoice #Decision

title: WALK THROUGH YOUR FEARS
text:
As Christians, our lives should depend on God’s Word because it is the final authority. One word may speak today and another may speak tomorrow, but God sends each of them straight into our lives. It takes the spiritually minded to focus on God’s Word in the midst of life’s calamities. We often act more like God’s enemies than His friends when we cannot see beyond our immediate situation. As Christians, even when we don’t see immediate results for our prayers, we must remain assured of God’s ultimate promise. 



Abraham had genuine faith. Genuine faith finds encouragement in that which is discouraging. God’s Word is real, authentic and forceful; it searches us and finds us. When you take God’s Word to heart and truly make it a part of you, it will, by its very nature, change you. Once you doubt your Guard, your zeal to pray, your dependence upon God and your communion with Him will reduce. Remember that when you run out of rope, it is time to grab at faith. And the work of faith is not a risk but a sure and practical act. We must walk through our fears and discouragements by looking at them as life lessons. When discouragement comes, don’t stop; just dig deep and fight it through. When fear hits, speed up the attack. When your battle is getting tougher, you are getting closer to your breakthrough — and your solution is just a moment away.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to know You the more and to know Your will for me. In Jesus Christ’s name, I pray! Amen!

title: GRACEFULLY AGING!
text:
Many adults struggle with the idea that they will grow old at some point. The fact that our body becomes weaker and weaker over time, leads them to despair. As a result, as the years pass by, they gradually give up on life. However, for those who are united with Jesus Christ, aging creates more hope than fear, as they know that growing older is a blessing! As we grow older, we gain invaluable experience, knowledge, wisdom and we also become a source of inspiration for younger generations!



We cannot control how easy or difficult our old age will be, but with steadfast faith in God’s unchanging love and care for us, we will face our “golden years” with courage and anticipation! 𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟔:𝟒 “𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐚𝐠𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐢𝐫𝐬 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐡𝐞, 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮. 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐮𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮”. No matter how advanced our years are, the Lord has promised that he will not abandon us. His grace enables us to grow old in peace, knowing that aging is the path that leads us to His glory!



When God called Moses to free the people of Israel from Egypt, He knew very well that Moses was 80 years old. This proves when God sees you, He sees something else that everyone ignores and that’s why God gave him the strength to carry out the mission He had assigned to him! Age is just a number. Since the Lord has already mapped out the plan of our lives from the moment He placed us in our mother’s womb, all that remains is to trust Him and move forward with Him throughout the years of our lives. That is the only way we can have the physical and spiritual strength to carry out our own personal mission from God successfully for His glory.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, give me strength, physical and mental, to face the trials of each day with courage, give me the grace to walk according to Your will all the days of my life, in Your Almighty name I pray, Amen”.



#Aging #Grace

title: The Call of God
text:
Mark 10:49 says, “So Jesus stood still and commanded him to be called. Then they called the blind man, saying to him, “Be of good cheer. Rise; He is calling you.”



When blind Bartimaeus heard that Jesus was passing by, he shouted immediately, “Son of David, have mercy on me”. He kept on seeking the attention of Jesus Christ, even though he was discouraged by the people around him. He was unmoved and simply ignored his distractors. Jesus called unto him, asked what he wanted and said, “Go your way; your faith has made you well.” The story of blind Bartimaeus (Mark 10:46–52) encourages us to keep on seeking the face of God, not minding the distractions until He calls us. 



The more you seek God in your hard times, the better improved the fruit of your prayer life is. This is because when you take God’s Word to heart and truly make it a part of you, it will by its very nature change you. Remember that when your battle is getting tougher, you are getting closer to your breakthrough and your solution is just a moment away.  We are to bless the name of God in the face of tests and trials, keep seeking His face and let Him answer us in His own schedule, not ours.



Prayer: Lord Jesus Christ, give me the grace to seek You continuously in the face of temptations, tests, trials, tribulations, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: LET IT GO & GROW!
text:
Most of us have experienced the pain of betrayal, rejection, and other hurtful behavior from people we love or trust. In these moments, forgiveness is hardly our first choice of response. Many times not even the second that comes to our mind… On the contrary, one of the first reactions we have towards the people who hurt us is anger, revenge and hatred… However, what exactly is forgiveness and why do we owe it to everyone? Is it just accepting a person’s apology and forgetting the past, pretending like nothing ever happened?



The Word of God constantly speaks to us of forgiveness without limits, a forgiveness that Jesus Christ Himself showed us on the Cross, when with a heart full of love He said: “[…]: ‘𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠’. […]”.(𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟐𝟑:𝟑𝟒)



With this act of His, at the time of His unjust crucifixion, Jesus Christ taught us that even when the world wrongs us, hates us and mistreats us, we have no right to hold a grudge! When you forgive and let go of offence, something will happen to you that cannot be explained by the natural mind. We forgive in order to have peace and to allow love to rule our hearts, as our Lord did! Are you ready to let love lead? Begin to forgive and have a free heart, and you will see that you will enjoy Heavenly blessings with joy and gratitude to the Creator who always provides for you!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: Lord, Jesus Christ, I want to learn to forgive, I want to learn to let go of offense and move forward with You by my side! Help me to do what is right before You, without putting my ego and arrogance above You – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!#LetItGo #Forgiveness

title: The Real Thing
text:
1 Thessalonians 5:23 says, “Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely; and may your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.”



Man is a spirit being, a divine person possessed of spirit, soul, and body. The real thing about man is not his body but his spirit and the first place we are to prosper is our spiritual life. The sure way to spiritual maturity is to hear and obey the Word of God continually. In John 14:26, the Lord Jesus Christ informed us about the person of the Holy Spirit and His role in our lives. There must be a corresponding power to do anything of God and the Holy Spirit gives us that power.



The Holy Spirit is a Divine person, and He is obtained as a gift from God upon repentance and baptism. Repentance is being deeply sorry for sin, being committed to a new way of life—from unrighteousness to righteousness. Repentance is the only hope of receiving God’s mercy and the Holy Spirit is the only means of growth in our Christian life. Our attitude and conduct will not change until the Holy Spirit gives birth in us a picture of what He is looking at when He sees us. He sees a person in the image of God, a person created to succeed, prosper and multiply. Only the Spirit of Christ can set us free from a life of meaningless activities, so take care of your heart, which is the real thing about you.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, come into my heart and help me to know You more, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: THE BRAVE’S DECISION!!!
text:
Making the right decisions in life as God’s children is a process that demands faith and complete trust in God. It is a process through which we have to align our choices with what God has prepared for each one of us. Nevertheless, in our everyday life, we find it extremely difficult to make the right decisions. In the course of making a resolution, it is crucial to listen to our conscience! God communicates with us through our conscience, and carefully obeying this inner voice that guides us in the right direction is a big step towards being able to make decisions that are pleasing to God!



In the book of Proverbs 16:9, the Word of God says, “A man’s heart plans his way, but the Lord directs his steps.” It is important to realise that the choice of doing the right thing is not always an easy one. Those who do not have the wisdom of God choose the smooth road of recklessness, while the wise involve God in their every decision, allowing Him to direct their ways! The wise are those who insist on doing God’s will, they insist on doing what is right while having the voice that echoes loudly within as a lead, their conscience, which is the very instrument the Holy Spirit uses to guide them.



If you are wondering what it is that makes us soldiers of Christ in readiness, the answer is simple: A resolve to do whatever proper thing it takes separates the weak from the strong!



Prayer: “Lord, Jesus Christ, help me make the right decisions for my life, help me remain steadfast in my resolutions as I learn and faithfully follow Your ways and Your works – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#RightDecision #BeBrave

title: An Independent Mind
text:
In the world today, there are three basic categories of people: those that make things happen, those that watch things happen, and those that wonder what happened. Those that make things happen are those that make a difference in their world; they have no time to compare themselves to others. Their aim is to reach for something higher, something new. Those who watch things happen are those who look to others for direction. They cannot think for themselves; I mean, they have no independent mind. Those who wonder what happened are those who live out their lives unnoticed, uncelebrated, and in obscurity. They see things happening—people moving, times changing—but they stay just there, sitting, wondering, crying, and complaining. Which do you belong to?



The Lord Jesus Christ is our role model; He knew who He was and what He was about. He had an independent mind and examined all things in the light of God’s Word (John 7:11–18). Having an independent mind is a confirmation that we are on the right path because without knowing God’s opinion, you can be a Christian and yet be controlled by satanic devices. Remember, satan always uses our situation to tempt us. When we wallow in self-pity, we are magnifying the adversary above our Heavenly Father, thus destroying our own confidence in God’s Word. As Christians, we ought to know the mind of God because what God says about our situation is what we need at all times.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me an independent mind. A mind that examines all things in the light of God’s Word, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: SCOAN’s 2nd Thanksgiving: A Global Celebration of Faith and Legacy
text:
Sunday marked a momentous occasion filled with joy and celebration as members of the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN) and well-wishers worldwide gathered to express gratitude for God’s faithfulness and grace during the 2nd Thanksgiving anniversary.



This significant event aimed to commemorate the reopening of the ministry following the passing of its revered founder, the God’s General Senior Prophet TB Joshua, on June 5, 2021. It also served as a platform to rejoice in the remarkable works of God, which continue to flourish under the new leadership of Pastor Evelyn Joshua.



The vibrant celebration attracted a massive turnout of members, well-wishers, guest artists, and invited guests from across the globe, adorned in a dazzling array of colorful attire. Pastor Evelyn Joshua, radiantly dressed in a simple yet elegant pink ensemble, expressed heartfelt gratitude in her speech to God, ministers, and church members who stood by the church through challenging times.



Assuring the congregation, Pastor Evelyn Joshua pledged that the new administration would steadfastly uphold the legacy of Prophet TB Joshua, emphasizing that “The legacy of Prophet TB Joshua shall live forever.” Drawing inspiration from Psalm 107:1, she encouraged everyone to give thanks to God, emphasizing His enduring goodness and mercy.







Expressing profound appreciation to Emmanuel TV Partners for their invaluable support, Pastor Joshua highlighted various activities undertaken by SCOAN throughout the year. These included special meetings at The Prayer Mountain, outreaches in Ghana, Spain, Zambia, and Kenya, as well as numerous charity events in various parts of the world. The woman of God commended the different groups within the church for their faithfulness, contributing to the church’s continual progress in God’s grace.



The Thanksgiving service featured performances by high-profile Gospel artist Christina Shusho from Tanzania, who captivated the audience with her beautiful Swahili rendition. Guest artiste Akintayo Akinwande presented a medley of Nigerian praise songs, and SCOAN youth showcased choreography as a dance offering to God, illustrating a message by Prophet TB Joshua.



The service also included captivating clips showcasing God’s goodness in various dimensions. Distinguished guests, including Bishop Micheal Fleming of Church On The Street, a charity based in the United Kingdom, added to the grandeur of the thanksgiving service.



The congregation, representing diverse backgrounds and nationalities, joyfully danced to the altar with their thanksgiving offerings, accompanied by uplifting songs from the SCOAN Chorister. All attendees left the service feeling enriched, blessed, and filled with joy, as the church continues to thrive under the capable leadership of Pastor Evelyn Joshua.

title: YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITY!!!
text:
There are many responsibilities that a person bears in life. From a young age, we are called to manage various situations and carry out our obligations. However, there is one responsibility that is more important than any other, and that is the responsibility we have to the Creator of the universe!



In the Word of God, where the answer to every fundamental question of life is found, the Lord made sure that every child of His knew what their responsibility to Him was! More specifically, in Joshua 1:8, the following is stated, “Keep this Book of the Law always on your lips; meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful”. As children of the Most-High God, we must not forget that our relationship with God must be mutual! In order to keep His promises in our lives, we must take our responsibility to Him seriously! As Christians, our key responsibility in life is to trust the Holy Spirit, to keep His Word in our mouth, in our heart and in every conversation!



With an honest self-examination we can easily determine whether we are successfully fulfilling our responsibilities and obligations to God Almighty. Do you want to experience blessings, prosperity and a good life, confident that the Lord is supporting you? To prosper in your ways and behave wisely, start taking God’s Word seriously, as if your life depends on it, and you will find that God will also guide you on your path of success!



Prayer: “Lord, strengthen me to do what is right before You daily and not to forget that our relationship must be mutual, so that I may see Your hand at work in my life – in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#PlayYourRole #MainResponsibility

title: ASK AND IT WILL BE GIVEN
text:
The Book of Matthew 7:7–8 says, “Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives, and he who seeks finds, and to him who knocks, it will be opened.”



This is Christ’s encouragement to pray and His assurance that your prayers will be answered. What an encouragement that God listens to you when you pray and a confidence that He is working out the answer. If you know that God listens to you when you pray, then your prayer must be followed by an attitude of faith—an attitude of absolute trust in God that He is working out the answer.



Faith is expecting God to do what He promised. He promised to fill you with His strength and power, to give you a new life and future, to heal you of your infirmities and diseases, and to bless you beyond measure. So, do not doubt your faith but instead doubt your doubts, for they are unreliable. Whatever news comes to you about your business, health, family, or career, do not be afraid because, beyond that unpleasant situation, beyond that hardship, and beyond what you are going through, there is the solution—Jesus Christ. Look to Him!



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to focus on the Lord Jesus Christ, to focus on Him and Him alone, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: Wiseman Harry Happy Birthday 55th Wishes To Mummy Evelyn Joshua
text:
The Synagogue, Church Of All Nations Thessalonica, would like to wholeheartedly wish a very happy birthday to an incredible woman who enriches the lives of many every single day, Pastor Evelyn Joshua!



On this special day, we want to take a moment to honour your unwavering dedication and leadership. Your ability to bring light into the lives of those around you is a true testament to God’s love working through you. Your genuine willingness to be a channel of blessing proves the quality of your character. Truly, it’s a joy to celebrate the remarkable person you are!We would thus like to express our deepest appreciation for your positive impact and commitment to making the world a better place by unfalteringly spreading the Gospel of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ!



Here’s to a day filled with love and joy! May God Almighty continue to strengthen your spirit and give you blessings, fulfilment, and moments of joy. We believe that the journey ahead will be even more rewarding as you keep on uplifting the children of God all around the globe, in the name of Jesus Christ!#HappyBirthday #PastorEvelynJoshua

title: Happy 55th Birthday to Pastor (Mrs.) Eveyn TB Joshua
text:
Happy 55th Birthday to Our Beloved Pastor (Mrs.) Eveyn TB Joshua



It is our privilege and honour to congratulate our beloved sister-in-law, and the woman in the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN), Pastor Evelyn Joshua on her 55th Birthday. The entire SCOAN family and the family of TB Joshua are in a joyful mood and celebration with you. 



May the Almighty God continually strengthen and help you in all your endeavours for the Church and the children.  May God uphold you with His righteous right hand.



Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, (Luke 16:11). We thank God for the trust God has placed on you to hold forth and lead the entire SCOAN family Church at this crucial time. 



May God bless you, bless the children and keep you. May God’s light shine upon you and be gracious to you. May you feel God’s presence within you always and may you find peace.– Numbers 6:24-26Happy Birthday Prof. R. A. Ipinyomi

title: AGE IS NOT AN OBSTACLE!
text: The biggest limitation you can put on your life is your age! Most people, especially the elderly, believe that at a certain age a person ceases to be productive. As a result, they do not go after any further development or progress in their lives. However, God’s Word teaches us that life has no limitations, except those that we ourselves create!Notably, in the book of 𝐄𝐱𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐬 𝟑:𝟕-𝟏𝟎, it is stated: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐞𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐲 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭. 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐜𝐫𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐬𝐥𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐬𝐮𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠. 𝐒𝐨 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐮𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐮𝐩 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐚 𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐦𝐢𝐥𝐤 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐲 […] 𝐒𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐰, 𝐠𝐨. 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐨 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐨𝐡 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐦𝐲 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭.’ 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐆𝐨𝐝, ‘𝐖𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐦 𝐈 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐈 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐠𝐨 𝐭𝐨 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐨𝐡 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐄𝐠𝐲𝐩𝐭?’” While God saw a leader in Moses, Moses, on the other hand, saw his age as a barrier. Is God perhaps calling you to carry out your divine mission here on earth, but you see your age as a hindrance?Remember that no one is too young or too old to follow God’s work through! Thus, everyone, regardless of age, can continue to dream, grow and aim for an even greater vision! In other words, no one grows old by living a certain number of years. People can grow old at 16 if they give up their ideals, let their minds become confused by pessimism, or allow worry, despair, fear or anxiety to stop them from making important decisions about their lives! Don’t allow your age to stand in the way of your calling! It is never too late to obey God’s instruction! title: The Heart We Possess
text:
The Book of 2 Kings 6:15–16 says, “And when the servant of the man of God arose early and went out, there was an army, surrounding the city with horses and chariots. And his servant said to him, ‘Alas, my master! What shall we do?’ So he answered, ‘Do not fear, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.’”



Just like Elisha’s servant, many are influenced by what they see, what they hear and what their circumstances look like. Their hearts are in the direction of the majority; they follow the majority instead of God’s authority. Their decisions are dictated by their feelings; when they feel good, they will come to church and praise God, but when they feel bad, they start to see God in a bad light. Do your words glorify God? Is your speech profitable to others? Vain and idle talk is a product of a vain and idle heart because, out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.



If you want to know what kind of heart you possess, look at the way you talk in your daily activities. Your words reveal the kind of heart you possess. God has entrusted us with a treasury. It is the words that reveal what is in the Treasury. It is the character of a good man that he has a good treasure in his heart and from there he brings forth good things. Your words shall be evidence, either for or against you, on the last day. Children of God, do not just fill the air with idle talk; seek His grace, for no one can speak good words without God’s grace.



Prayer: Oh Holy Spirit, help me to speak edifying words, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: The Year of A New Name
text:
The Book of 1 Chronicles 4:9–10 says, “Now Jabez was more honourable than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, ‘Because I bore him in pain.’ And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, ‘Oh, that You would bless me indeed, and enlarge my territory, that Your hand would be with me, and that You would keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!’ So God granted him what he requested.”



There are many people who have chosen names for themselves because of the situation, trouble, confusion and pain they are going through now. The name Jabez meant pain, but the bearer prayed for God’s intervention. When he realised the story behind his name, he prayed to God and God granted his request. God Almighty Himself renamed people and after such change came a new life, a new direction, a new focus, a new way, a new purpose and a new hope for their lives. The name Jacob was first given but was later changed to Israel by God for destiny’s fulfilment. Many biblical characters had their names changed before they could worship or relate to their God. Their names became prayer points because they underwent a life-changing spiritual transformation. They experienced God’s goodness and favour in the face of life’s challenges. May your God be known, worshipped and praised, in the name of Jesus!



As a child of God, your name must be affiliated with God. Your name is your identity; it must be who you are. Christians were named because of their Christ-like nature. By their fruit, they were known and it was revealed who they were. For you to be able to scale through this year, 2024, you need to let go of offence, pain of the past, unforgiveness and everything that is not good before God. Let your relationship with God today be taken to another level, another dimension, because God Almighty has given you a new name. Because of Christ Jesus, your name is sweet, lovely, beautiful, wonderful, blessed, gracious and joyous. Declare this and see the Lord make your year the same!



Prayer: Ask God to anoint your heart so that you may continue to do good and walk in His light.

title: YOU NEED HIM 24/7
text:

𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐦𝐞𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐥𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐨𝐱𝐞𝐧; 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐭 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡 𝐫𝐮𝐥𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐝𝐨𝐦 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐞𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐇𝐞 𝐜𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐬.’” Through this biblical passage, it can be grasped that the reason King Nebuchadnezzar was with the beasts of the field for 7 long years was to realise that he needed God all the time! Because, he thought he could do everything by his own power, yet, satan attacks you where you believe you don’t need God!



You therefore need God in everything you do in your daily life, because big situations happen occasionally, but little situations happen all the time! So, beginning today, start to include Him in everything you do, and you will see that the sky will be your limit!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will stop relying on my own strength, and will henceforth rely on You, and as I do this, I know that You will prosper my ways – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#YouNeedGod #DependOnGod
