title: PRAY BEFORE YOU HELP!
text:
The school of management is something that concerns most people today. God wants you to go through this school, and He grades you daily to see if you can stand in whatever you do in the future. Yet, unfortunately, the majority of people, having been involved in a lot of addictions, end up losing in an instant what they have been trying to gain for years.



The Word of God, in 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟏𝟓:𝟏𝟏-𝟐𝟒, says that: “𝐍𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐠𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐨𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐝, 𝐬𝐞𝐭 𝐨𝐟𝐟 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐚 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐬𝐪𝐮𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠.” The prodigal son had to go through this school before realising that life is not a playground; it is a battlefield where only the serious minded are victorious! If the father had helped his prodigal son while he was leading his squandering life, then he would not have received the necessary lessons that life itself would have taught him!



Through this biblical passage, we understand that before you start helping someone, pray that God will show you if that person is the person you should help. God wants to put some people through a lesson before they receive help. When you help someone that God does not want you to help at the present time, the blessing will not come. You are not sent to everyone, but to someone. It is that someone that God will send you to that you need to help.



So, before you help someone, pray and listen to the voice of your conscience. Because your conscience is the very instrument that the Holy Spirit uses to guide you!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I begin to help other people so that their lives move forward, help me to do what is right in Your sight, and so that my life moves forward – in the name of Jesus Christ, I pray, amen!”#Help #Pray

title: TRUE SUCCESS TAKES TIME AND PREPARATION
text:
Have you been worrying about your future, wondering if you are too young to be used by God or too old to be successful? Remember Samuel, a small boy who, right from childhood, became the mouthpiece of God. What about Moses, whom God used to rescue the Israelites from slavery? Their stories teach us that no one is too old or too young to succeed in life, just as no one is too good or too bad to qualify for God’s grace. The issue is whether you are prepared for what God wants you to be. 



Nowadays, many seem to desire their duties but are hardly ever prepared for them. Many seem to desire to know what they must do to receive from God but are not prepared to do it. 



As a child of God, you must remember that life is not fun and games; it is warfare where only the serious and spiritually minded are victorious. True success takes time and preparation. If we can work hard to ensure that our business, marriage and other endeavours succeed, should we not also prepare to follow Christ wholeheartedly daily? When we recognise who we are before God, we will see the need to always consider His will in everything we do, everything we say and in every plan we make.

title: A Rebuttal to J. Lee Grady’s Unsubstantiated Claims Regarding T.B. Joshua

title: WHAT THOUGHTS CAN DO
text:
From the beginning of humanity, an invisible war has been waged, a war which is invisible. The results, however, are visible anywhere we look. We are talking about the battle of the mind, where billions of people right now are fighting a war without even realising it! How? As they contemplate every thought that goes against God’s Word, that is, thoughts of fear, revenge, doubt, etc…



The Bible teaches us that every thought that is not based on His Word is mathematically certain to lead to destruction and loss. For example, there are people who believe that plotting evil against your neighbour is not something bad, but something normal, necessary for survival, one might say. Others think about where to have fun after work all day long…



𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟖: “𝐅𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲, 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐞, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐛𝐥𝐞, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐞, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐲, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐝𝐦𝐢𝐫𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞—𝐢𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐬 𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐫 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐡𝐲—𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐤 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐬𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬”. 



Just because your mind has the ability to think, doesn’t mean that everything it thinks is right! You need God’s Word to act as a filter in your mind so that you know the origin of your thoughts. If you don’t feed your mind with His Word, then the devil will feed your thoughts, thoughts that will lead you to unwanted situations.



We therefore understand that our thoughts are not to be taken lightly, because they have the capacity to bring blessings or deny blessings. Therefore, begin to meditate on the Word of God consciously, and you will find that you will gain an independent mind, making yourself fit to be used by God!



𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I realise that life is a battlefield where only the serious minded are victorious. Help me, Father, to reject every thought that is not based on Your Word, so that I too may become an overcomer! In the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen.”

title: HOW DO YOU REACT TO SIN?
text:
Luke 18:13–14 says, “And the tax collector, standing afar off, would not so much as raise his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’ I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and he who humbles himself will be exalted.”



The tax collector took the position of a sinner. He was troubled because of his sin and was remorseful, so he pleaded for God’s mercy and forgiveness. In Luke 18:10, we saw the posture of another man, a Pharisee. While he was praying to God, he compared his sin to others, thereby trying to justify himself. Which one are you? How do you react when you sin? Your reaction towards sin will show whether you are a Christian or not.



The Book of Romans 3:10 says, “…no one is righteous not even one.” He that does evil, whoever he may be, will certainly pay for his sins. A Christian never has joy when he commits sin. We are to take a posture of repentance, owning up to our sin and not point accusing fingers at others to justify our sin. As Christians, we know that sin brings reproach while righteousness exalts; therefore, our reaction towards sin should indicate remorsefulness. This is because our reaction shows how much we have allowed Christ’s nature to influence our conduct and behaviour.



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to acknowledge my sins and seek Your forgiveness, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: Rebuttal to openDemocracy’s Article on TB Joshua and SCOAN Former Disciples
text:
Prophet TB Joshua and Disciples




In response to the openDemocracy article on TB Joshua and SCOAN, it’s important to note that there might have been no need to respond to their piece. However, this response is being crafted solely for record-keeping and to provide support to those who may be struggling in faith or misinformed, while also acknowledging the potential biases and implications of the source. The openDemocracy article, which claims to have conducted a six-month investigation, raises concerns about the late Prophet TB Joshua and his disciples. However, it is crucial to thoroughly examine the validity of their findings and assess the objectivity of their reporting. One significant aspect to consider is openDemocracy’s affiliation as an advocacy group for the rights of homosexuals and lesbians. As believers, we can discern the potential implications and biases that may arise from such a perspective. It is essential to keep this in mind while evaluating their claims and allegations. Furthermore, it is worth noting that openDemocracy was the entity that petitioned YouTube to block the Emmanuel TV Christian channel. Their petition was based on concerns related to deliverance and testimonial videos involving individuals from the LGBTQ+ community. This fact should be recorded and considered when considering the potential influence of their advocacy in shaping perspectives.



The article in question asserts that several former top-ranking members of SCOAN have claimed to witness or experience abuse. However, it fails to provide substantial evidence to support these allegations. Without verifiable proof, it becomes imperative to exercise caution and avoid drawing conclusions based solely on uncorroborated testimonies. The potential for misinformation or personal vendettas cannot be overlooked when evaluating such claims.



The credibility of the sources cited by openDemocracy is questionable. It is essential to evaluate the motives and biases of those making the accusations. The lack of a balanced representation, including perspectives from current members or individuals who had positive experiences within SCOAN, raises concerns about the objectivity of the investigation.



The article mentions a collaboration between openDemocracy and the BBC, which resulted in a documentary that serves as a basis for some of the claims made. However, it is crucial to note that this documentary has been discredited for fabrication and staging. The inaccuracies and false narratives presented in the documentary highlight the need for discernment when considering the allegations against Prophet TB Joshua and SCOAN. Relying on credible information and thorough investigations is paramount to ensure a fair judgment and prevent the dissemination of sensationalized narratives.



While the article focuses primarily on alleged abuses and criticisms, it overlooks the positive impact of Prophet TB Joshua’s ministry. His humanitarian efforts, charitable works, and positive influence on the lives of millions worldwide are integral parts of his legacy that deserve recognition. Ignoring these aspects presents an incomplete and biased portrayal of SCOAN and its founder.

However, these ministries might be perceived as threats only to the kingdom opposing them—the kingdom set to diminish in the face of God’s glory and divine influence.



Moreover, it is essential to recognize the broader impact of Prophet TB Joshua legacy beyond the false allegations highlighted in the openDemocracy article.



Prophet TB Joshua’s ministry was marked by a global reach, impacting millions of lives with its unique blend of Pentecostalism and televangelism. In essence, portraying Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s crusade in Nairobi, Kenya as questionable overlooks the sincere efforts to carry forward the spiritual legacy established by Prophet TB Joshua. While skepticism might be a healthy approach, it is important to avoid dismissing God’s ability to heal and deliver through His faithful servants. Such a hasty dismissal is misleading. title: TRUE FRIENDSHIP
text:
Reading the Bible, we can tell that it is more than obvious that having friendly relationships is in accordance with the Word of God, since even God Himself used to spend time with Adam and Eve in the garden of Eden. 



Another strong example of a strong friendship is the one found in 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟐𝟎:𝟒𝟐, between David and Jonathan. The Bible says, “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐉𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐆𝐨 𝐢𝐧 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞, 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐰𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐡 𝐬𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠, ‘𝐌𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐲 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐬, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫.’”



Yet, in the days we live in, with everything that is happening around us, is it easy to trust people and be able to call some of them friends? If we lend a sensitive ear to what God has to say about the people we are surrounded by, we will be able to discern those who are friends in need and there are friends indeed!



True friendship is based on giving and taking! If one of these parts is missing, then the relationship is problematic and certainly not based on Jesus Christ!



If we are around self-centred people, we will probably find ourselves focused on ourselves and our personal needs. On the other hand, if we are friends with people who find pleasure in giving, before long, we will follow their example and be givers, too.



Thus, it is crucial and beneficial to spend time with someone who really likes to hear from God, someone who is eager to know what the Holy Spirit is saying in every situation. 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, I leave my relationships up to you. Bring people in my life that I can spend time with—people who will positively influence me and deepen my relationship with You. Help me add to their lives, and be a positive influence. In the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen.”#𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐞𝐅𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩

title: GOD’S SPECIAL GIFT TO US
text:
Matthew 4:3–4 says, “Now when the tempter came to Him, he said, “If You are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread. But He answered and said, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.’”



Just as Jesus responded to satan with God’s Word, so should you respond to your situation. I mean, the answer to whatever situation you are passing through is in God’s Word—His special gift to humankind. When Jesus was tempted, He did not fall into self-pity; instead, He quoted God’s Word, the eternal Word. As a Christian, your answer to everything is in the Holy Bible. God’s Word must not only be committed to memory but must also become an integral part of us.



The Bible can become an integral part of us only when we devote ample time to studying it.  When you study God’s Word, you must be carried along by the Holy Spirit. When we are carried along by the Holy Spirit, then we receive answers. Are you sick? Are you worried? The answer is in God’s Word. When you know the answer is in God’s Word, you will talk Scriptures in every situation. Holy men were carried along by the Holy Spirit as they spoke God’s Word.. So, when you quote the Bible, you are quoting the Holy Spirit. As Christians, we must learn to quote Scriptures in every situation or circumstance in which we find ourselves. We must speak God’s Word over everything because God’s Word is our weapon.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the grace to make your Word an integral part of me. In Jesus’ name, I pray. Amen!

title: THE POWER OF DAILY BIBLE STUDY!
text:
If we ask anyone what motivates them to drink water or eat food on a daily basis, they will answer that they do not need motivation to do something their life depends on. It is the exact same with our spirit and the Word of God. Nevertheless, many Christians struggle to stay motivated to read the Bible…



Though life provides enough reasons to coerce us to open the Bible, there seems to be an issue of consistency. Though God’s children desire wisdom, many rely on a rotation of excuses in order to skip reading the Word of God. You might belong to the category of people who just do not feel as close to God any more, or you might be too tired to read and understand what the Lord is trying to tell you. Whatever might be the case, you should keep in my mind that God will not open the door of wisdom to the one who keeps his Bible shut! If Job himself, a man who passed through dreadful tribulations, declared: “[…] 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐝𝐚𝐢𝐥𝐲 𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝” (𝐉𝐨𝐛 𝟐𝟑:𝟏𝟐), then we should be able to look beyond our mental condition and acknowledge the importance of allowing God’s Word to influence us every single day!



If you desire more of God, it should be impossible to forget that He does nothing without His Word and everything He wants us to know to go about life is written in it. You can keep praying, asking Him to speak to you, yet you forget that you have a role to play. God wants a mutual relationship with you, so you have to be available, with your eyes and heart wide open to His Word!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, thank You for giving me the chance to know You better through Your Word. I know that I will hear Your voice more clearly if I remain consistent in my Bible study. Fill me with more hunger for Your Word and help me be steady in reading it, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#BibleStudy

title: THE PEACE OF CONSCIENCE
text:
“And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone…” (Mark 11:25). The Bible here says, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive him because the great thing that God requires, that God looks at and requests is the heart.



Psalm 66:18 says, “If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.”



The Scriptures we have above show that the great thing that God looks at and requests is the heart.



‘If I had cherished sin in my heart’ means that there is some degree of sympathy with sin.



In order to pray effectually, there must not be anything between us and God. But our relationship with God depends on what we think upon our adjustment to one another. When your focus is on God, you will never be moved by what your situation has to say. Your focus will be on what God has to say about your situation. If Joseph’s heart was troubled in the dry pit, he would not have survived the situation. Remember Peter at the seaside, remember the man at the pool of Bethesda for 38 years, remember Hannah. So, do not allow your heart to be troubled.



Whatever situation you are facing now, the question you need to ask yourself is: Am I a Christian? That settles the matter.



Matthew 5:8 says, “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.” Here, holiness and happiness are fully described together. What this text is saying is that the heart must be purified by faith and entirely for God. We must lift up to God not only clean hands but a pure heart.



Right now, ask the Holy Spirit to breathe in you so that your thoughts may be holy, act in you so that your works may be holy and strengthen you so that you may defend what is holy.

title: SPEAK LIFE!!!
text:
As children of God Almighty, our words are powerful. What we choose to say is connected to what we feel or think, and if we observe our lives, what we’ve confessed has become, at some point, flesh and blood. They can be positive, happy words, but they can also be words of anger, fear, and other negative emotions.



For our words to have spiritual substance and not be worthless, in other words, to ensure God’s support, they must spring from firm faith, like that of David. David spoke the Word of God with faith in the 𝐁𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟏𝟕:𝟒𝟓, by saying to Goliath: “𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐦𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐬𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐣𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐈 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐀𝐥𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐲, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥, 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝”, and the giant was defeated! Goliath’s weapon was his physical strength, David’s, however, was from within him, there was power in his mouth which was released with the faith he had in his heart! It was the Word of God that came in faith from David’s lips, that produced a spirit of victory in him! If he did not speak the Word in faith, then the Word would be inert and destructive.



We confess what we believe and we believe what we confess. What do you confess today? That you are sick, or healed? Poor, or blessed? Weak, or strong? If you want to change your situation, stop talking negatively and start talking positively, because our words have the capacity to make and unmake! We need to learn to say that all is well in our lives, even when it is not, and all will be well, because as children of God, better is never good enough, but the best is always yet to come!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, give me the strength to daily speak words that will build my life up, in easy and tough situations, words that work miracles, because I know that what I choose to speak creates the bridge to my future, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#PowerFromWithin #VictoryThroughFaith

title: The Essencd of Challenges
text:
Job 2:9-10 says, “Then his wife said to him, ‘Do you still hold fast to your integrity? Curse God and die!’ But he said to her, ‘You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. Shall we indeed accept good from God, and shall we not accept adversity?’ In all this Job did not sin with his lips.”



Job’s response to his situation in the midst of his challenges shows the condition of his heart. I mean, his response shows the true content of his heart. As Christians, our challenges are not meant to destroy us but to prepare us for a new level in life. Challenges reveal the true nature of man’s heart. If Job’s relationship with God were based only on the material things he possessed, he would have cursed God when they were taken away. Instead, Job praised God amid his challenges. 



Job gave a response in faith (Job 1:21). Just like Job, our response to challenges should be, “May the name of the Lord be praised”. Job understood the essence of challenges. Job knew that challenges are meant to improve us, to strengthen our relationship with God. Challenges are meant to cause us to go closer to God, not move away from Him. Challenges are meant to increase our desire for God; as Christians, the more challenges we face, the better equipped we are for the future. Therefore, no matter the challenge you are facing, stay true to God and draw closer to Him.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the grace to honour You in my challenges. Give me the grace to draw closer to You, in Jesus’ name. Amen.

title: BBC’s Attempt to Tarnish Prophet TB Joshua’s Legacy Falls Flat
text:
Prophet T.B. Joshua




It’s been two and a half years since the passing of the revered Prophet TB Joshua, and yet the BBC seems relentless in its pursuit of discrediting the legacy of this esteemed man of God. Despite their attempts to tarnish his reputation, the indelible mark of his benevolence and compassion for humanity persists, echoing through generations.



TB Joshua was not just a good man; he possessed one of the kindest hearts, overflowing with love and empathy for his fellow human beings. His legacy is intertwined with acts of cheerful giving and a genuine desire to assist those in need.



Simplicity and absolute humility defined TB Joshua’s character. A radiant beacon during his lifetime, he embodied the true essence of Christ’s image. This is the unwavering belief in the man TB Joshua, whose life reflected the principles of love, kindness, and selflessness.



The stories concocted by the BBC stand as nothing more than baseless fabrications. They starkly contradict everything TB Joshua represented throughout his life. Those who truly knew TB Joshua are left perplexed, questioning the origin of these unfounded allegations.



Since his transition to glory in 2021, TB Joshua has found eternal rest with the Lord. It’s a caution to the BBC – let TB Joshua rest in peace. Cease the attempts to besmirch the legacy of a man whose life was dedicated to serving humanity and spreading the message of love.



In the face of these ill-conceived narratives, TB Joshua’s legacy remains unblemished, upheld by the countless lives he touched. The BBC’s futile attempts to cast shadows over his memory only serve to highlight the enduring impact of a man who lived for a cause greater than himself.



WARRI -By Isaiah Ogedegbe

title: Unveiling the Truth: Racheal’s Controversial Journey within SCOAN – A Closer Look
text:
Rae, Enthralled by Legions of Darkness 




In this exploration, we delve into the narrative surrounding Racheal, one of the accusers featured in the controversial staged and fabricated BBC documentary targeting Prophet TB Joshua and the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN). Understanding her background sheds light on the complexities of the accusations and the motivations behind her actions.



Racheal’s familial context becomes crucial in comprehending her trajectory. Her father, Nicholas Holmes, assumes significance in this narrative, as his role becomes instrumental in her eventual departure from SCOAN and the adoption of a blasphemous stance. Racheal embarked on her SCOAN journey seeking deliverance. However, what remains undisclosed is the reason she remained under the stronghold of her demon, now Legions even after her first deliverance.



The reasons for Racheal’s journey to SCOAN was a deeply ingrained problem known at the SCOAN as the ‘Spirit of Women,’ manifesting as an attraction to individuals of the same sex (Lesbianism). Seeking a solution, her family took her to SCOAN for spiritual intervention and deliverance. Following the deliverance sessions with Prophet TB Joshua, Racheal experienced a transformation—her previously intense desires for individuals of the same gender come to an end. Filled with gratitude for this newfound freedom, she expressed her interest in becoming a disciple at SCOAN’s headquarters in Lagos, Nigeria.



Prophet TB Joshua, trusting in Racheal’s sincerity, transformation and show of genuine repentance, accepted her as a disciples and bestowed upon her numerous responsibilities within SCOAN. Her commitment and devotion were acknowledged as she was anointed as a Junior Prophet, attaining the second-highest rank in SCOAN’s hierarchy under Prophet TB Joshua. This elevation showcased the level of trust and goodwill the Prophet extended to Racheal.



However, unknown to everyone, a sinister plot was unfolding. Racheal, in collaboration with her father, who held a position in the accounting department as the head, was clandestinely orchestrating the embezzlement of church funds from the SCOAN London branch in the UK. The very trust bestowed upon her by the Prophet was exploited for personal gain, revealing a hidden agenda that would later impacted Racheal profoundly.



How Racheal Loses her Deliverance – The Sins Of The Father



Despite undergoing deliverance that seemingly freed Racheal from her struggles with same-sex attraction, a disconcerting chapter emerged when reports surfaced of her engaging in sexual molestation of fellow female disciples within their living quarters at the SCOAN. Disturbed by these revelations, the affected individuals brought the matter to Prophet TB Joshua’s attention, prompting swift action.



In response to the reports, Prophet TB Joshua decided to send Racheal back to her parents in the UK. Acknowledging her repentance and plea to return, she was eventually welcomed back into the Church. However, Prophet TB Joshua, still perplexed by the recurrence of Racheal’s previous behavior, initiated an inquiry that would unearth a shocking revelation.



The Prophet discovered a deeply troubling collaboration between Racheal and her father, Mr. Nicholas Holmes, who held a significant position as the head of the SCOAN UK branch’s accounting department. It was unveiled that they were embezzling funds meant for the SCOAN UK branch, with Mr. Holmes allegedly indulging in extravagant lifestyle that he was found of purchasing new car often during this illicit collaboration.



Prophet TB Joshua, in response to this breach of trust and financial malfeasance, made the decision to remove Mr. Nicholas Holmes from the accounting department, replacing him with another individual, Mr. Samuel Durojaye. This decisive action, however, triggered a vehement reaction from Racheal. Fiercely loyal to her father, she adamantly declared that if her father was to be removed from his position, she would sever ties with the ministry of Prophet TB Joshua.



Racheal Now Rae, Enthralled by Legions of Darkness




“When an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it. Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order. Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation.”
Mathew 12:43-45 (NIV)



In the aftermath of this conflict, Racheal left SCOAN without undergoing the second deliverance she so evidently required. The scripture makes us to understand in Matthew 12:43-45 (NIV) that a person can lose her deliverance due to sin and be repossessed by even more and worst demons. Racheal presently is under the influence of legions of demons – Possessed by the Multitudes of Infernal Spirits far worse than before her coming to the SCOAN. Contrary to her claim that SCOAN’s deliverance is ineffective, the underlying motive for her departure was her vehement objection to her father’s removal from the accounting department.



It is crucial to dispel the narrative propagated by Racheal, emphasizing that her lack of deliverance was not due to any inherent flaw in the deliverances taken place in the SCOAN. Let the fruits of SCOAN’s impact speak louder than the distortions created by one individual’s misguided actions. Healing and deliverance are real and authentic for those who believe and seek them with genuine hearts.

title: AVOID THE TRAP OF LOOKING BACK!
text:
We all desire to succeed in life, however it is not our wishful thinking that will make our dreams come true, but a proper focus. It is easy and sometimes tempting to look back into our past and begin to recall the times we failed. Certainly, looking back means you can’t look forward at the same time. You may have experienced setbacks and pain in life, but take heart because there is something much more important than your past; your goals and your dreams!



Take for example the story of Peter, the disciple of Jesus Christ. For a whole night he was trying to catch some fish, but he failed. This failure, though, did not just happen, nor did it happen for nothing. In 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟓:𝟑-𝟔, when the Lord told Peter to cast his nets back into the water, the latter replied, “𝐌𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫, 𝐰𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐢𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠; 𝐧𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐭 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐭.” Peter initially confessed his failure to Jesus, that is, he looked backwards, but quickly changed his perspective and looked forward with a proper focus. The result? “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐚 𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐧𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐢𝐬𝐡, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐧𝐞𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠.”



In other words, it was Peter’s failure that led him to a bigger catch, not just of fish but of people as well! Today, the focusing on the unpleasant past has prevented many from realising their dreams. The moment you forget about yesterday and look forward you will see awesome changes! As a Christian, disappointment sometimes serves to keep us for a new level in life! Behind your situation lies God’s purpose for your life; make it real!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, give me a proper focus and give me the grace to stop looking to the past because it is dangerous, in the holy name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#𝐑𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐅𝐨𝐜𝐮𝐬 #𝐃𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐋𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐁𝐚𝐜𝐤

title: THESE HARD TIMES ARE NECESSARY
text:
In both the Old Testament and the New Testament, we find ample proof that being faithful to God does not mean a complete absence of adversity. Tension arises not because we have done wrong but because we live in a complex and contradictory world — a world ruled by evil desires that are opposed to God’s Word. Have you ever seen a soldier questioning why the enemy is attacking him? Most likely not, for the soldier knows that he is on the battlefield!  So, why should we Christian soldiers question God over our attacks, our struggles with sickness, our encounters with opposition? 



Never for a moment allow yourself to sit back and wallow in self-pity, for a man may be sick and yet be a friend of God and a woman may be poor but be a favourite of Heaven. Don’t allow your situation to rule you or dim the eyes of your faith. Never doubt God’s desire or ability to help you. For example, David never questioned why a giant was challenging his future; David simply ran to represent God on the battlefield. It was on the battlefield that David recalled how God had delivered him from the lion and the bear. He concluded that God would deliver him from the giant as well.                                                 



May God give you the heart to bless Him in your situation so that you may be blessed by Him through your situation, for these hard times are necessary.Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to see things in the light of God’s Word, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: WHEN YOUR PRAYERS SEEMS UNANSWERED!
text:
Man desires and asks God for prosperity and health. He desires to be free from his problems and nightmares. If these words characterize you, as a man and a woman of faith, take heart, for the delay in answering your prayer does not mean that God is not aware, or that your request has been rejected. Look deeper, and you will see that your response when you are disappointed, hurt, embarrassed, wrongly accused, sick, or persecuted, matters to Jesus – your response determines your future!



Let’s take the case of the Canaanite woman in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟏𝟓:𝟐𝟏-𝟐𝟖 as an example. Ostensibly, Jesus Christ ignored her and then rejected her. Her patience and perseverance, however, caused the Lord to admire her genuine faith! The result? What seemed like a rejection from God, was simply a test for her, which she successfully passed, receiving the miracle she was seeking!



Jesus Christ does not discriminate! He especially loves those who are able to exercise great faith under great trials and temptations. Your situation, however unpleasant, is designed to build the character of Christ in you. In other words, when we accept adversity, enduring every pain, then we will learn what we should know and our grief will turn to gain! 



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father God, give me the grace to steadily uphold Your purpose for me. Here I am, Lord; use me in my situation to honour Your name, in the Almighty name of Jesus I pray, amen!”#Prayer #Persistence

title: THE SECRET OF BLESSINGS
text:
John 3:16 says, “For God so loved the world that He gave His only begotten Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have everlasting life.”



Regardless of the size of what we possess, everyone has something to give. Take the case of God, who gave His only Son to humankind. He planted Jesus in the earth to produce uncountable sons and daughters. Remember that you are born again today because of that Son. We are who we are today because God gave us His only begotten Son. The people of the world believe that there is more gain in receiving than in giving. However, as Christians, we know that it is more blessed to give than to receive. We give every good thing the Lord has given to us—everything God has blessed us with. This is because we need each other’s strength and each other’s love.



It is not only about what we give but also how we give it. What matters is our manner of giving and our attitude towards giving. Cain and Abel both had something to give, but the difference was in their attitude towards giving. Abel gave to glorify God, to honour God and to do God’s will. Cain gave to glorify himself and dishonour God. We should give with humility and cheerfulness. In these perilous times, we should learn to give more—more of our time, more of our strength, more of our love—to those in need around us.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the grace to give with love and humility, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: YOU WERE CREATED TO BE A WARRIOR!
text:
Like every human being on earth, you face various difficulties in your daily life. And yes, problems are a reality, but they are not the truth. The truth is that Jesus Christ came so that you may have life, life in abundance!



Unfortunately, however, many Christians seem to buckle under the pressure of their challenges… This happens because when a man is not focused on God, he is doomed to see life from the wrong perspective. This is true for the children of God who do not know that the challenges they go through are to determine where they are spiritually. However, faith focuses on Jesus Christ and not on our problems! It focuses on winning, on success, and not on defeat or failure!



An example of a man who at the time of his trial was focused on God, is David in 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟏𝟕:𝟒𝟓-𝟒𝟕: “𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐞, “𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐦𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐬𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐣𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐈 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃 𝐀𝐥𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐲, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐈𝐬𝐫𝐚𝐞𝐥, 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝. 𝐀𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐠𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐲 𝐬𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐫 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐬; 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐎𝐑𝐃’𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐬”. On the outside, David was not ready to fight Goliath. He knew, however, that the Lord was standing by his side! This makes us understand that when God is involved in your battle, your victory is assured because the extent of His care and the strength of His might in our lives weaken and frustrate our adversaries.



So we see that the Lord never promised to keep us away from challenges, but to see us through them! Therefore, embrace your battle, for He who desires triumph or victory must be ready to embrace war because triumph or Victory is a product of warfare.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father God, it’s time to disconnect from the fear in my life, it’s time to do what I was created to do; to overcome! Take away more of my fear and unbelief, and give me more of Your faith and courage – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen.”#𝐁𝐞𝐀𝐖𝐚𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐫 #𝐊𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐎𝐮𝐭

title: TOTAL COMMITMENT TO JESUS
text:
Joshua 24:15 says, “And if it seems evil to you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve, whether the gods which your fathers served that were on the other side of the River, or the gods of the Amorites, in whose land you dwell. But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.”



We cannot separate warfare from salvation because true salvation puts us into direct conflict with satan. The moment we make a true conversion to Jesus, satan hates us the same way he hates Jesus. By identifying yourself with the Lord Jesus Christ, you have made satan your bitter enemy. When Jesus Christ purchased us, we became aliens to the things of this world. As a result, our heart is always in constant conflict between good and bad.



Doing something as a matter of commitment to God does not involve any condition attached. Your commitment and genuineness of faith must be tested because a man may confess to be a Christian but may not be such in heart. When your loyalty towards God is in conflict with money, position, relationship or comfort, you are likely to sit on the fence and become indifferent. Such was the case of the children of Israel when they entered the Promise Land. There was a conflict in their hearts between the flesh and spirit whether to give God total commitment or not. Joshua urged the Israelites to give total commitment to God. Therefore, no matter what happens today, make a total commitment to Jesus, for He is your salvation. 



Prayer: Lord Jesus, strengthen my zeal and determination for you, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: THE SHORTEST ROUTE!
text:
Many of us are used to getting frustrated and giving in to negative emotions if the answer to our prayer is not when or what we want. However, we should know very well that God’s answer is not for those who are in a hurry, but for those who endure. Also, the Lord, being the loving Father that He is, may not always give us what we want, but He always gives us what we need. Yet, because of our impatience, if God does not answer us in the way we want, we begin to grumble against Him and give up.



However, the Word of God in𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟖 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬, “𝐓𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐈 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐦𝐞.” Apostle Paul’s persistence in prayer, even though God revealed to him that His grace was sufficient, shows the way for us today. Apostle Paul thus makes it clear to all Christians that if an answer is not given for the first prayer nor to the second, we must hold on and hold out till we receive an answer. Apostle Paul did not surrender the weapon of prayer because he wanted to be delivered from the thorn that was in his flesh. He prayed over and over again until he received the answer he needed from God.



Undoubtedly, a break from prayer is a break from faith, and a break from faith is a break from God! Therefore, do not take a break from prayer, but seek His face daily, because prayer is the shortest route between us and God!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will pray daily to You, for Your will to be done and not mine, and I know that my life will go to a new level – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#Pray #GrabOntoFaith

title: JESUS WWNTS YOU FREED!
text:
Mark 11:25-26 says, “And whenever you stand praying, if you have anything against anyone, forgive him, that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses. But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your trespasses.”



Many keep battling with stagnation, limitation, disappointment, and setbacks because they are victims of the trap of unforgiveness. The way of obedience is the way of freedom. God commands us to forgive, and we obey Him when we forgive others. If you refuse to forgive, then you disobey God. Forgiveness does not mean ignoring what is happening; it does not mean sweeping the dirt under the rug. It is being concerned about our offenders and their relationship with God. An unforgiving attitude not only destroys your relationships but also poisons your soul and robs you of your blessings. 



The knowledge that you have sinned and been forgiven creates mercy and compassion towards others. Don’t allow sin and confrontation tear down your relationships or pull you apart; instead, see the confrontation of sin as a means of coming together, growing together, and being prepared together. If God were to keep count of our wrongs, you and I would not be here today. Always have it in mind that no man or woman is perfect. In each of your prayers to our Heavenly Father, you must be able to say, “I know of no one whom I do not heartily love.”



PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, help me to see beyond the mistakes of others, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: HAPPY PALM SUNDAY!!! -2024
text:
Our Lord Jesus Christ entered the city of Jerusalem seated on a donkey. In doing so, He fulfilled the prophecy found in the book of the Prophet 𝐙𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟗:𝟗: “𝐑𝐞𝐣𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐥𝐲, 𝐃𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐙𝐢𝐨𝐧! 𝐒𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭, 𝐃𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐞𝐦! 𝐒𝐞𝐞, 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐨𝐮𝐬, 𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐥𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐧 𝐚 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐤𝐞𝐲, 𝐨𝐧 𝐚 𝐜𝐨𝐥𝐭, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐚 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐤𝐞𝐲.” This symbolises the ultimate act of humility and obedience to His Father. Our Lord knew very well what was to follow; His crucifixion. However, He was determined and willing to sacrifice His life on a Cross for my sake and for yours! Such was His purpose; He was not aiming at material or political gain, but at the salvation of our souls!



Today, as you reflect on Jesus Christ’s love for you personally, ask yourself, how have you responded to that love? May you give Him His proper position in your heart from now on, and, in other words, love Him for who He is— the Saviour, the Deliverer, the Redeemer, and the King of kings!



#HappyPalmSunday #TrueHumility

title: GOD’S KIND OF JUSTICE!!!
text:
Offering sacrifices is quite common among Christians today, in order to show that they want to please God or to show their repentance for their sins. In modern times, of course, we are not talking about animal sacrifices, as they were in the Old Testament, but about different kinds of sacrifices.



For example, many believers will once sacrifice their free time or sleep to read the Bible or pray. Others may give a sum of money to a charitable cause. However, if this action is not accompanied by genuine love for the Lord, then it is in vain, for we exalt ourselves and dishonor God. While the Word of God teaches that when we humble ourselves for the sake of Christ, He will exalt us in His hour and in His time.



A strong example of two opposite cases of people can be found in 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟒:𝟑-𝟕 ‘‘𝐈𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐢𝐥 𝐚𝐬 𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝. 𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐀𝐛𝐞𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠—𝐟𝐚𝐭 𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐤. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐟𝐚𝐯𝐨𝐫 𝐨𝐧 𝐀𝐛𝐞𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐂𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐟𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐟𝐚𝐯𝐨𝐫. 𝐒𝐨 𝐂𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐲, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐭. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐂𝐚𝐢𝐧, “𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐲? 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐢𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐜𝐚𝐬𝐭? 𝐈𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐨 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐜𝐜𝐞𝐩𝐭𝐞𝐝? 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐢𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐝𝐨 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭, 𝐬𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫; 𝐢𝐭 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐫𝐮𝐥𝐞 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐭.’’ Abel gave in faith. Ηe gave trying to do God’s will, trying honour Him and glorify Him. Whereas, Cain gave to honour himself and dishonour God, and so it turned to sin against him.



The Lord first looks at the heart of every man and that is why he rejected Cain’s offer. Likewise for God’s children today, no matter what we offer in His work; our money, our time or anything else, the Lord is just and will reward us based on our obedience, not our sacrifice, because, no state of being is as rewarding as living in tune with God.



🙏Prayer: “Lord Jesus Christ, cleanse my heart from every evil purpose, because Christianity is found in the heart, in the purity of the heart. Help me, Lord, that my life may be pleasing to You, in Your holy name I pray, amen!”#Justice #Obedience #Sacrifice

title: Whatever Is Rooted In God Is Permanent
text:
Hebrews 13:8 says, “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.”



For our faith to be consistent, it must be based on something more stable than feelings, and that is God’s Word, which is the same yesterday, today, and forever. Making Christ Jesus as your Lord and personal Saviour is the most important decision you can make, knowing that He is incomparably more reliable, more dependable, and much stronger. When you receive the Lord Jesus Christ, you will be able to access His ideas, see life as He sees it, and see yourself the way He sees you. Joseph was shown the photograph of his future (Genesis 37:5,9-11). That incredible photograph of tomorrow is planted within our hearts by the Holy Spirit. Just like Joseph, we have a role to play; we must be rooted in God’s Word so as to bring this glorious future to pass.



Man cannot discover new oceans if he does not lose sight of the shore. Keep on meditating on God’s Word and you will soon become a man of vision. To a man of vision, no matter what happens, no matter what comes, there is always a future. When Joseph found himself in the dry pit, he was not worried but kept holding on to what God told him. He was focused and determined. Instead of succumbing to the pressure and tension you are facing, leave it for Jesus because He will not leave you without a solution.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to live my life for You alone, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: THE DAY YOUR PAIN BECAME HIS!!!
text:
Good Friday is the day when we should remember that our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, did not just suffer for us… He suffered with us! On this day, the weight of our burdens became the burden of One. Are you experiencing physical or emotional pain? He experienced it first, so we could find joy where there is sorrow, healing where there is sickness, and freedom where there is bondage!



𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟑:𝟏𝟕: “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐒𝐨𝐧 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐇𝐢𝐦.”



Truly, His crucifixion prepared the way to our reconciliation with our Heavenly Father, so we should not merely remember this day as a story of agony, but we should embrace it as a testament to the redeeming power of love! Good Friday is a promise of renewal. It is a promise that even in our darkest hours, the Cross is where pain met grace, so our own suffering can be radically transformed.



Therefore, today, rather than giving into despair caused by our situation, let us look to the Cross with a heart filled with gratitude, and let us thank Jesus Christ for the most profound act of love in history!#GoodFriday #PowerOfLove

title: HE TURNED THE CROSS INTO A CROWN & THE TOMB INTO TRIUMPH!
text:
An empty grave, and a stone rolled away– this is the single piece of evidence that astounded Christ’s enemies because no one before Him – or after Him – had ever defeated death. Therefore, we should rejoice, because in His resurrection lies the assurance that no darkness can extinguish the light of love and no despair can undermine the promise of a new beginning! 



Indeed, in His resurrection, we find not only salvation, but also the strength to endure life’s perils! What cross are you carrying today? Is it setback? Disappointment? Jesus can turn it into a crown! What tomb have your dreams fallen in? He can turn that tomb into triumph!



𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟏:𝟑: “[…] 𝐈𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐲 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐮𝐬 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐛𝐢𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐝!”



So, just as Jesus Christ is risen, we encourage you to let your heart rise and seek the things that are above. For just as He conquered death, you can conquer your worries too! This Easter, may your heart be filled with hope and peace, remembering that no matter what trials you are facing, you do so with the promise of ultimate triumph!#HappyEaster #DayOfVictory

title: THE TOOL OF DISCERNMENT!
text:
Advances in technology levelled up the role of information and news. Today, at any given moment we have access to any information we desire. But how do we know what is reliable, valid, and true, and what is not?



Thus, in an era where lies dominate the world, we, as children of God, are called to live according to the revelation of the Holy Spirit, that is, according to His truth, which is found in the Word of God. 𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟒:𝟏, “𝐃𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐟𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐬, 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐟𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐩𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝.” We live in a world full of darkness and deception, but God has empowered us with a spiritual gift, the discernment between good and evil. We should not base our beliefs according to human philosophies or ideas, but according to the Word of God! Man’s judgement is based only on what is seen, heard, and on what the circumstances look like. This kind of judgment is limited and cannot understand God.



Seeking and finding the truth, which as we said exists only in the Holy Bible, equals living a life of freedom, free from fear. Remember, satan hates an independent mind. It’s time to make God’s Word the database for your personal opinion!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, may Your truth dwell in the hearts of all Your children! Help us, Lord, to discern between what is good and true and what is bad and false, in the almighty name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#𝐃𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 #𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐭𝐡

title: CHRIST HAS GIVEN US VICTORY
text:
1 Corinthians 15:56 – 57 says: “The sting of death is sin, and the strength of sin is the law. But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.”



Our Lord Jesus Christ has given us victory by conquering death so that we might reign in life with Him. Our Lord Jesus Christ paid the price for our sins so that we might be free. This victory is a rare opportunity given to all believers for us to experience a new beginning. Jesus Christ’s victory is the joy of a true believer. His death and resurrection brought about the new life we enjoy today. Having life in abundance, He brushed aside our unworthy past and brought us to the living God. His resurrection has made a way into eternal glory for us and has offered us victory. 



He conquered death so that we may live. He conquered sickness to give us good health. He conquered poverty to secure abundance for us. Begin to take your place in the believer’s authority and start confessing this victory over your life, over your situation — and see it become a reality.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, thank You for taking my place in death. Thank You for Your gift of life. Thank You for giving me victory, in Jesus’ name. Amen!

title: GIVE YOUR NEIGHBOUR ANOTHER CHANCE!
text:
Since you live in this world, disagreements or even arguments with other people are inevitable. Surely, in the course of your life, you will also meet people who will sin against you, intentionally or not. 



And this is a trap of satan where many fall today – including Christians. That is, they do not forgive other people’s sins. But learn that when you are holding offenses such as bitterness, anger, hatred, pain of the past and so forth, you are building a wall. A wall that doesn’t only isolate you from others, but from God as well.



In 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟏𝟖:𝟐𝟏-𝟐𝟐, Jesus Christ makes it perfectly clear, “𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬𝐤𝐞𝐝, ‘𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐈 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐦𝐲 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐦𝐞? 𝐔𝐩 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬?’ 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐬𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝, 𝐈 𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐲-𝐬𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬.” It is, therefore, extremely important to forgive, not just because we need forgiveness, but because no one can succeed alone. We depend on others to succeed in our respective callings.



Therefore, to improve your relationships, learn to give people another chance!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father God, teach me Your opinion about me and about the people around me. Empower me so that I can forgive and give others another chance, just as You always give me another chance, in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#Forgiveness #ImproveYourRelationships

title: THE GRACE TO LEARN AND MOVE ON
text:
Philippians 3:12 says, “Not that I have already attained, or am already perfected; but I press on, that I may lay hold of that for which Christ Jesus has also laid hold of me.”



The Lord has given us the ability to learn from our mistakes and errors. There are errors you committed in the past that would have led to your death; many others did the same but are not alive today. This proves that we are able to learn from mistakes and move on. As far as there is flesh, as far as you are not yet perfected, mistakes will come, but you should learn from them and move on. Our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, never promised to keep us away from mistakes; however, He has given us the grace to learn lessons and move on. He never promised to keep you away from all these challenges, but He promised to see you through them. If gold must be gold, it must pass through the furnace. If you must be a Christian, there is a process. What it takes for gold to be gold is what it takes for you to be a Christian. Your character must be tested in real situations. Each challenge moves you either forward or backward. To make a change, you must take a stand on God’s Word, accepting that the assurance of His salvation will help you to maintain that change. 



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, take more of me and give me more of You! Give me more of Your love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, humility, and self-control, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: FAILURE BRINGS YOU CLOSER TO SUCCESS!
text:
People’s greatest successes are the result of hard work, patience, persistence, big risks, and many failed attempts. The number of failures doesn’t matter as much as the lessons learnt from them! As any successful person would say, the road to success is anything but easy. The secret of those who succeeded is that they never gave up! A man with a vision never gives up, no matter how many failures he has. Think of a person you admire – an athlete, an entrepreneur, anyone. It’s easy, looking at their life, to be lulled into the illusion that they got to where they are today without ever facing hardships or making mistakes. The reality, however, is that failure is a part of life, but what matters is our reaction when it comes.



Let us take Peter’s life as an example, reading from 𝐋𝐮𝐤𝐞 𝟓:𝟒-𝟕. If Peter had caught many fish that day, he probably would have missed the opportunity to meet Jesus Christ. Thanks to his failure, he encountered the Lord, and everything else that followed! Of course, Peter did not stay put, but directly obeyed the instruction of Jesus to cast his nets again. In other words, he faced his adversity according to the instruction in righteousness that was given to him. This teaches us that disappointment sometimes serves to keep us for a new level in life! 



Failures can bring forth opportunities that otherwise might have never come our way. Therefore, let us not underestimate the doors failure can open for us. However, there is one crucial requirement: we must recognize our mistake, accept it, see what we have learned from it, and dare to try again! No one said that our road will be paved with rose petals, it isn’t written anywhere in the Word of God; what is written is that Jesus Christ will be with us all the days of our life, and with God on your side, you can face life’s final road with courage!



🙏Prayer: “Father, help me to not be discouraged every time I fail. Help me realize that mistakes are not a sign of failure, but the lever to my success, and that the road to success goes through difficulties first, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#Failure #Success

title: WE ARE CHRIST’S REPRESENTATIVES
text:
Galatians 2:20 says, “I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me. And the life I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.”



When you gave your life to Christ, when you said no to your life of sin and made the ultimate decision to follow our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, you became His representative here on earth. As a man born of the Spirit, as a believer, you are a representative of Christ. As His representatives, we must mirror Him because He is our standard. I mean, if we say that Christ dwells inside of us, we must speak it, act it and show it because our life is the greatest sermon.



For us to represent Christ, we have to be conscious of His presence in our lives. When we are conscious of Christ’s presence, we will be moved to do only what pleases Him. How we live then matters because we are expected to live right. For us to live right, we must be willing to let go of everything that will hinder our relationship with God. I mean, we must be ready to pick up our cross and follow Him. We must strive every day to know Him more so that we can become more like Him; this is the only way we can represent Him. 



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the grace to know You more, the grace to be more like You, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: GRACE or WORKS?
text:
Man has a tendency to look at external characteristics whenever he is looking for some cooperation or some kind of companionship. Unlike the grace of God, which does not look at color, origin, gender or age. God has made everything in such a way that everything is a result of His grace!



In more detail, the Word of God in 𝐀𝐜𝐭𝐬 𝟗:𝟏-𝟔, states: “[…] 𝐒𝐨 𝐡𝐞, 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐞𝐝, 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐝𝐨 𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨?’ 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦, ‘𝐀𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐨 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐝𝐨.’” Apostle Paul, while he was not one of the twelve disciples of Jesus Christ, and in fact was a fanatical persecutor of His church, Saul became the Apostle Paul, a useful vessel in the hands of God! Undoubtedly, then, Jesus Christ did not come for the righteous, but for sinners!



If one deserved God’s grace, then it would not be called grace, it would be called wages! God therefore chooses grace over works! If the weak come to Him, He is ready to help their weakness, as He would help the strong. He knows our limitations, so He chooses grace! This, then, is the mystery of God’s grace, because no one deserves it, but God gives it to everyone! Almighty God takes unworthy, sinful, unusual people, clothes them with His glory and puts them in His Kingdom for eternity!



Jesus Christ did not consider Paul’s past and He will not consider your past either. Jesus knows how undeserving of His grace we are, that is why He has decided to brush aside our past in order to determine our future. So what counts more? God’s grace or human works? Get ready to receive His grace, in Jesus’ name!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will learn to lean on Your strength, and not on my knowledge, my degrees, and my experience, and I know that as I lean on Your strength, You will guide and protect my paths – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray -amen!”#𝐔𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐞 #𝐇𝐞𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐞

title: HOW TO READ THE HOLY BIBLE
text:
Today, many approach the Holy Bible as they do other books. It is easy to see that they do not know the difference between the Holy Bible and other books. The Holy Bible is the letter inspired by the Spirit of God. Holy men were carried along by the Holy Spirit as they wrote the Holy Scriptures. This means that the Holy Spirit is the author of the Holy Bible, and you must be carried along by the Holy Spirit as you read the Bible so that you can bring the Word to reality. When you read the Holy Bible without the help of the Holy Spirit, you are reading history, past events, stories. Therefore, we should seek the attention of the Holy Spirit, for it makes the Bible a powerful tool for us.



God speaks to us through His Word by His Spirit. He calls you through His Word by His Spirit. The Holy Spirit is the communicator and our heart is the contact point. The Holy Spirit cannot communicate with a heart full of bitterness, hatred or bad feelings towards others. You may read the Bible a hundred times, but if you do so while holding grudges against anyone, the Bible will be of no meaning to you. We should read the Bible with devotion. We should keep meditating on it until it becomes a reality. Read it slowly, repeatedly and attentively. You must also free your heart to follow Him, for only a free spirit can attract the Spirit of God. 



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, free my heart to follow You, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: THERE IS STRENGTH IN UNITY!
text:
Many people find themselves in relationships that are not rewarding and they tend to give up on those relationships before even giving them a chance to settle and grow. Nevertheless, the way we leave the old relationship is the way we enter the new one, and if the bitterness of separation stays in our heart, every bond we try to build will be inevitably infected.



The Bible teaches us otherwise! In 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟕:𝟏𝟕, we find the key: “𝐀𝐬 𝐢𝐫𝐨𝐧 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐢𝐫𝐨𝐧, 𝐬𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫.” Hence, when our relationships are under great strain and conflict, we should remember what God thinks about it! In times of great distress, He uses the tension to speak strength in our lives, to mature us and make us better people. Although the enemy of our soul will try his best to bring offense and cause us to pull back, the truth is that no one can succeed alone. We depend on others to succeed in our respective callings!



Even our Almighty Saviour had 12 disciples to carry out His mission, letting love lead Him, despite the weaknesses they had as human beings. So, think back. Were there any relationships that would have turned your life around for the better, yet they failed due to adversity? Do not fall for satan’s tactics anymore! Whatever the cause of trouble is, as His genuine followers, we must let go of bitterness and look beyond it, because there are blessings coming! We must let go of offense and let love lead us in every relationship instead! 



So, are you ready to look at your relationships from Christ’s point of view?



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, You are the Healer of wounds both inside and out. Heal any disappointment in my life and erase the bitterness from my heart. Lord, grant me the wisdom to navigate my relationships with understanding and compassion instead of unforgiveness and anger, in Jesus’ name, amen!”#BuildThatBond  #Relationships

title: WE ARE KNOWN BY OUR LOVE
text:
1 Corinthians 13:13 says, “And now abide faith, hope, love, these three; but the greatest of these is love.”



We have prayed and hoped, but the thing that is yet to be applied is love. Since the greatest is love, you need to make the greatest sacrifice. A Christian is known by his love, first to God and then his neighbour. Your neighbour could be your enemy, those who don’t share the same faith with you. Despite that, you are commanded to love them all. This is because we begin to succeed in our lives when the problems and hurts of others matter to us.



Love is always there to act, no matter what happens, no matter what comes. Love cares more for others than for self. Love does not look down on others, love is not proud, love is determined, love does not give up, love loves without condition. A person who does not love others cannot be entrusted with the power of God, for he will misappropriate it, misuse it to hurt himself and others. As Christians, if we say love abides in us, we will not hesitate to show love to those who need it; we will look around to see those who need our love. We will be mindful of how we treat those around us. Therefore, stop meditating on your weakness and start loving Jesus; in other words, start loving your neighbour. Stop pointing fingers at the economy and start loving Jesus; in other words, start loving your neighbour.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to love unconditionally. Help me to love the right way, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: The Holy Spirit, Our Helper
text:
John 14:26 says, “But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all things that I said to you.”



The Holy Spirit is our Helper; He is the backbone of Christians. You cannot represent God or be involved in His projects without the help of the Holy Spirit. If you decide to stay in the Word, live in the Word, abide in the Word and become totally saturated with the Holy Scriptures, you will find yourself not just flowing but overflowing with the Holy Spirit. 



The Holy Spirit is wise, for He is the Spirit of wisdom; He is true, for He is the Spirit of Truth. Do you want your personality to be like Jesus? Engage your heart through meditation. Mediate and reset your belief thus: “O Holy Spirit, take more of me and give me more of You.” When you begin to engage your heart, you will not go where Jesus is not welcomed. The more you meditate on what you read in the Bible and turn it over and over in your heart, the more your spirit acts upon the Word. Have you taken hold of your heart? If you can get hold of your heart, the sky is your limit. The real prayer is to engage your heart. By the time you get hold of your heart and engage it through meditation, you will be filled with the Holy Ghost. Therefore, take control of your heart and give your heart to meditation. Stay in faith and don’t let anything get you out of it.



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, open the eyes of my faith that I may see your protecting hand over my life; open my heart to your faith, Word and Spirit, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: TEACH BY EXAMPLE!
text:
There is confusion in the world today, and as we know God is not a God of confusion but of order. The reason for this confusion lies in the fact that the world has drawn so far away from God and the countless biblical teachings that permeate the pages of the Bible. God gave us the Bible to show us the way of salvation and to teach us how to live for Him. In its pages, we find both positive and negative examples of behaviour and choices, and we are called to freely make our own choices, knowing in advance the consequences of each one. Positive examples are tremendous motivators for success just as negative examples are tremendous motivators for failure.



In 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟑:𝟑-𝟓 we read: “𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐆𝐨𝐝; 𝐬𝐨 𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐭 𝐮𝐩 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐞𝐚𝐥, 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐨𝐟𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐥𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐝 𝐚 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐥 𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐭. 𝐀𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭, 𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐰𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐰𝐚𝐬𝐡 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐢𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐬’ 𝐟𝐞𝐞𝐭, 𝐝𝐫𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐰𝐫𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦”. In the above verses, we see our Lord Jesus Christ during the Passover, doing something that seems surreal according to today’s standards, which is that while He knew that the time of His ultimate sacrifice was approaching, He knelt and washed the feet of His disciples in an unparalleled act of service to the fellow man. Being God and clothed in human nature, Jesus Christ is the supreme example of humility and service. Thus, we are called today not only to serve our fellow man, just as we would do with ourselves, but to show our self-sacrifice and love, just as our Lord taught us by His example. You should not do what the many do, but what the best do!



🙏Prayer: “Increase me in love, οh God, that I may love my neighbour as myself and become an example to others through my life and my choices. Keep me humble and obedient to your laws and teachings and make your Light shine through my life, amen!”#TeachByExample #LetJesusGuideYou #BeTheLight

title: CHOOSE JOY, NOT JEALOUSY!
text:
If you ask any child of God what the strongest force in the world is, they will tell you that it is love. In 𝟏 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟒-𝟖, God’s Word gives us an extensive explanation of what love stands for. And sometimes, we tend to forget one of its greatest enemies: jealousy. 



Jealousy is not as innocent as we think. It is not simply wishing for what others have. If we constantly feed on it, it leads to a vicious cycle of comparison and dissatisfaction. It is a tool satan uses to make us sad and disappointed upon realising that we do not have what our neighbour has, yet what you are feeling right now is as a result of your focus! If you focus on what you are lacking compared to others, it is only natural to feel left out, forgotten by God. 



Nevertheless, in the book of 𝐄𝐱𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐬 𝟐𝟎:𝟏𝟕, the Bible states, “𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐜𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐧𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐫’𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐞; 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐜𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐧𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐫’𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐟𝐞, 𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐭, 𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐥𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐭, 𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐱, 𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐤𝐞𝐲, 𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐧𝐞𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐫’𝐬.” Although we have needs as human beings, and we need resources to make it in this world, this command is essentially for our own good!



Indeed, if we have a look at the story of Abel and Cain, it is easy to understand that jealousy will draw us towards destructive behaviours. It will make us foster resentment, there will be no more room left for love to take root, and God cannot reside nor encourage a covetous heart. Envy also reflects a lack of gratitude, because no one can deny that the Lord has not blessed us already! Every day, He gives us a million reasons to be thankful, but we will never be able to appreciate any of them if we do not stop comparing ourselves to others as if life is an endless competition.



Therefore, if you want to be happy and feel content, shift your perspective and acknowledge the Lord’s sovereignty. And rest assured, when you say “no” to jealousy, you stop the devil from manipulating you with his lies, and you will find that thankfulness is a path to a more abundant and fulfilling life!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, I pray for Your strength and guidance to overcome jealousy. Help me focus on Your blessings and teach me how to cultivate a heart of gratitude. Lord, do not let me forget about Your daily goodness, so I can fight against any negative feeling, in Jesus’ name!”#𝐉𝐨𝐲𝐎𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐉𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐮𝐬𝐲 #𝐆𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐞

title: TRUE FREEDOM
text:
Galatians 5:1 says, “Stand fast therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and do not be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.”



Freedom is the lifestyle of every child of Heaven because it is for freedom that the Father of Light gave His only Son, Jesus Christ, to set the captives free and bring them out of darkness. We are free as long as we stay on track under the check and conduct of the Holy Spirit. Our freedom is the ultimate prize that satan aims to take from us, and he uses our situations and weaknesses as his principal weapons. The moment we lose focus and use our freedom to entertain our fleshly desires and indulge in sin, we are plunging ourselves into self-destruction. 



True freedom is the ease of heart and peace of conscience derived from walking with the Lord. When you are free, your spirit is sensitive and alive to the Spirit of God. You need a free spirit to connect with Heaven. If your spirit is troubled by the lures and cares of this world, it loses its sensitivity and is useless as an instrument to act upon the Word of God. In the midst of hardship, persecution, trials, and temptation, let God’s Word be your roadmap because the Word of God is the tool of freedom in the hands of the Holy Spirit. We must therefore be led by the Spirit of God and depend upon Him for strength and assistance, laying our soul under His influence and control. 



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to walk in Your freedom for the rest of my life, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: FOCUS ON THE COMFORTER
text:
1 Corinthians 1:3–4 says, “Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort, who comforts us in all our tribulation, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any trouble, with the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.”



If one’s faith must grow, it must start little. Everything good and wonderful demands time and preparation. If something big starts big, it calls for concern. This is why Jesus was not bothered when Nicodemus came to Him at night (John 3:1–3). He knew that if one’s faith must grow, it must start little. If satan reminds you of your past failures, don’t hesitate to remind him of God’s promises to you in the Holy Scriptures. The Word of God dwells in your present and future. Many of us talk about our battles instead of the One who is fighting for us. People focus on their enemies instead of their Comforter. Today, we respond to reason instead of the Word of God. Acting on the Word is letting Christ act through you. Acting on the Word gives you an opportunity. No matter how we master the Scriptures without acting on it and without true obedience to what we read, we will still remain spiritual babies. 



When we obey the Word of God that is spoken by the Holy Spirit, we will grow and mature in times of conflict and suffering, because trials are the soil in which faith flourishes. As the Word dominates your mouth, one day it will pay off, for the Spirit will bring it to your heart. This will help you to discuss the One who is fighting for you instead of your battle. It will help you to discuss your faith instead of your doubts. It will help you to focus on your Comforter instead of your enemy. Remember, the Word takes the place of the unseen Christ. The Word becomes a part of you by meditation. Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to focus on You alone, in Jesus’ mighty name! Amen!

title: LONELINESS IS NOT YOUR PORTION!
text:
There is no doubt that we have all experienced difficult situations, arguments, quarrellings, even rejection by other people in our lives, as well as a number of people have even been physically, emotionally or verbally abused by others, causing them emotional trauma. This may have caused you to have a – false – belief about yourself that you have no value, that you do not deserve to be loved by other people, or even that you will live forever alone.



If you find yourself in the above lines, then this text was written for you! Regardless of what you have been through, what you have been told, what they have done to you, or what you have done in your past, your future can be great! That’s because it is not what men say about you that really matters in this life; It is what you believe about yourself that matters. The only reliable source of information about yourself is the Word of God, which states that you were made according to His image and likeness, and that you are precious in His sight! In 𝐄𝐜𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝟒:𝟗-𝟏𝟎, we read: “𝐓𝐰𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐧𝐞, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐚 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐥𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐫: 𝐈𝐟 𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐟𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧, 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐮𝐩. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐩𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐟𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐮𝐩”.



If you consider that God has given you His best on the Cross, Jesus Christ, He can certainly satisfy the desires of your heart, yet you have a role to play! First, if you have not already done so, you must forgive the one or the ones who have hurt you, because you too need forgiveness from God. Next, you have to make the Word of God an integral part of yourself by consciously and repeatedly studying and meditating on it. This is how, you will truly know your worth and abilities in Christ. Last but not least, mind your words! Your words are capable of drawing people towards you or driving people away from you.



It is time to see yourself under the light of God’s Word, you were not created to walk alone! And remember, when God sees you, He sees something that everyone else ignores.



𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫 🙏: “Heavenly Father, I want to see myself through Your eyes, through Your love, grace and mercy! Help me to tear down every negative image I have of myself because it is false, in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#𝐋𝐨𝐧𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 #𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐀𝐫𝐞𝐍𝐨𝐭𝐀𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐞
