title: THE WALK OF FAITH
text:
2 Corinthians 5:7 says, “For we walk by faith, not by sight.” 



It is common nowadays for people to believe that the walk of faith is risky because many base their Christian experience on what they see and feel. The walk of faith is not a risk but a sure and practical act. If a person has not received the teaching of the Scriptures, if he has not been grounded in the Word of God or the promise of the Holy Spirit, forcing himself to do such act is indeed a risk because faith comes when the Word of God prevails over the thinking process. 



Every time God gives us faith, He gives us the evidence of faith – an absolute trust in Him that He is now working out the answer. Acts of faith are but acts of self-surrender – putting an absolute stop to your work, way, reasoning and resting in God’s love, wisdom and power. The fact that Jesus Christ died on the Cross of Calvary makes it unnecessary for us to complain, suffer or lament. The very foundation for receiving answers to our prayer is to base our faith on the fact that Christ Jesus died for us. Healing, deliverance, salvation and all of God’s blessings have been paid for and offered freely at the price of great suffering. Receive them by faith! They are yours for the asking. 



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to know You more that I may trust in You, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: YOUR GOAL IS YOUR COMPASS!
text:
As long as we are living on this earth, we will all experience days, weeks, months and maybe even years that come with enormous challenges— poverty, hatred, persecution, insults, and so on so forth. Yet the truth is that when we look beyond these challenges, beyond the storm, we will be confident and determined to achieve anything we put our minds to!



Nevertheless, amid life’s uncertainties and struggles, it is easy to lose heart. So, what should we do as believers when such circumstances arise and our goal seems to be drifting far away? In 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟐𝟗:𝟏𝟏, the Word of God reassures us of one thing we often forget: “𝐈 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐚 𝐟𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞.” This is a promise! Thus, by looking beyond your present obstacles, instead of quitting the fight, you will know who you are before God’s eyes and what He has in store for you! 



Though the path may seem daunting at times and though there are things that will make you lose your motivation, when you know you are who God says you are, you will stay focused on your goal alone and nothing can change your focus! Therefore, let your goals become your compass and faith your guiding light, for the plans laid before you are filled with infinite blessings that are simply waiting for you to reach them!



🙏Prayer: “Lord Jesus, open the eyes of my heart to see the dream You have created me for. Thank you for giving me a goal and for revealing Your good plans for me through Your Word! Give me the grace to be inspired by You, to be led by You, to be influenced by You alone, in Jesus’ name!”#FocusOnYourGoals #PurposefulLiving

title: THE LIVING WORD OF GOD
text:
Hebrews 4:12 says, “For the Word of God is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, and of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.”



Believers are uncommon people; we are uncommon because the Word of God on our lips prevails over the law of nature. God’s Word, which is our standard, carries us into His very presence and we operate in the dimension in which He operates. God said, ‘Let there be light,’ and the whole universe came into being by His Word. Jesus is the Word by whom God speaks to us today. Jesus is the living Word. The Word is our contact with Jesus and the Word is His contact with us. He is with us in the Living Word.



A man can be a pastor by profession but not such in heart. When you accept Jesus as your Lord and Saviour, you have the very presence of God in your heart through the Holy Spirit. Christ has no place in a life that is not dominated by the Word. Joshua 1:8 teaches us that dedication and discipline are the fruits of victory. Dedicate your heart to the Word. Your thoughts must reflect your belief. Your words must reflect your belief. Your actions must reflect your belief. That is the process of believing. We are made spiritual only when we live in the Word and the Word lives in us. Read the Word, yield to the Holy Spirit and you will be Christ-filled.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me faith enough to always believe in your Word, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: THE PATH TO FINANCIAL HEALTH!
text:
When God blesses us, He blesses us for a purpose. And when it comes to our finances, He wishes to teach us responsibility. And although it is essential to understand that money should not be our only motivation, it certainly impacts our lives significantly.



Too often, the desire for wealth can lead to reckless and ill-considered financial decisions. God’s will is to lavish us with everything we need for a comfortable life, but He also calls us to become the managers of our blessings – including our finances. For this reason, the Word of God offers a wonderful piece of advice! In 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟏:𝟓, it is thus written: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐟𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐚𝐬 𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐩𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐲.” In other words, budgeting, savings, and thoughtful planning are not only practical skills, but they also demonstrate our faithfulness in taking care of what has been given to us! Just as Joseph’s foresight ensured the survival of an entire nation during famine, our wise stewardship can provide stability and improve our lives! Truly, life does not just happen to us. It is all about the choices and how we respond to every situation. 



Notably, to respond to every situation, our choices must be aligned with God’s Word, so that we are able to draw wisdom. Our Heavenly Father will always want to help us face hardship, but we must also use what we have with prudence. Therefore, as Christians, let us seek more of His guidance because through responsible financial management, we not only honour God, but we can additionally uplift others by becoming a shining example!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father God, I thank You for blessing me generously and for the opportunity to honour You with my resources. Grant me the discipline to manage my finances with discernment. Teach me Your ways so I can plan for my future, and guide me towards the right choices, in Jesus’ name, amen!” #𝐅𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐢𝐚𝐥𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐭𝐡 #𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠

title: A LIGHT THAT STILL SHINES!!!
text:
People of God, today, we commemorate the third anniversary of the passing of a true and remarkable servant of the Most High, Senior Prophet T.B. Joshua. Thus, it is an opportunity to remember the lessons he taught us through words and works alike.



It is a time to remember his teachings and the example he set for millions of believers all over the world through God’s grace, as they continue to resonate within us, guiding us to a life of service and commitment to God’s truth. Prophet T.B. Joshua’s life stands as a testament to the power of obedience to God’s will, and it proves that true greatness lies not in power or wealth, but in the willingness to serve all people with an open heart and a compassionate spirit, as the Word of God teaches. Truly, his legacy will keep reminding us of the value of humility and selflessness as he dedicated himself to uplifting others and spreading the message of love, no matter what challenges may come ahead.



As we pay tribute to his life, let us give all thanks to God Almighty for allowing us to become witnesses of His majesty through the works of one man. We praise Him for the Prophet’s lasting impact that touched countless souls and left an indelible mark on the world. Indeed, “𝐒𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐝𝐨!” – Prophet T.B. Joshua. May his example continue to shine brightly and inspire generations to walk in the path of righteousness! 



We encourage you to share in the comments below the ways in which Prophet T.B. Joshua’s teachings and wisdom have influenced and enriched your life!#𝐓𝐁𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐜𝐲 #𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐩𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐓𝐁𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚 #𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐋𝐞𝐠𝐚𝐜𝐲𝐋𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬𝐎𝐧

title: WALK IN THE LIGHT
text:
1 John 1:7 says, “But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ His Son cleanses us from all sin.”



Our Father is the Father of Light. He is Light and He is in the light. Since He is in the light, we are commanded to walk in the light. The Word of God is Light; therefore, a believer is one who walks in the light. Do you walk in the light of God’s Word? Do you walk in joy, love, peace and comfort? When you walk in the light, you will not walk in difficulty, sickness, or poverty. When we walk in the light, we complain no more, we worry no more, and we fear no more.



One cannot walk in the light when the Word does not prevail in one’s life. Has the Word of God prevailed over common sense and thought processes in your life? Or are you still trying to figure God out with your natural mind? As long as you walk in your situation, you are walking in darkness. Many believers live as common men. You begin to live as a common man when your testimony is that of difficulty and lack. Jesus has no place in a life that is not dominated by the Word. The Word dominating you is the Lordship of Christ in you. Let us be conscious of Christ’s presence in all that we do, and by faith, set the Lord before us. See Him who is invisible and have Him present in our minds as we fight the battle against the senses, knowing that when we walk in the light, God looks at us as if we had never sinned. 



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to walk in the light, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: ALIGN YOUR DESIRES WITH HIS WILL!
text:
“Follow your desires!”, is a message we often hear in today’s culture. It’s promoted all over social media, television, movies, music… They say if we just listen to our fleshly wants, we will find joy and contentment. But we know different! 



In 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟏𝟕:𝟗, the Bible says,  “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐥𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐝, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐢𝐭?”  We must therefore be careful not to base important decisions on only what we crave for. Our desires can be temporal and misleading, and they might eventually drag us far away from God’s will. This is why we should not rely on them, but we should allow God’s Spirit to open our eyes, so that we will not become greedy. Surely, God is willing to give us all we need, but He may not give us all we want, because man’s needs are unlimited. 



Fortunately, God does not abandon us in our struggles with harmful or sinful tendencies. Instead, He provides us the grace and strength we need to resist sin when it crouches at the door of our hearts through the Holy Spirit. But we have our own role to play! By exposing ourselves to the Word of God, our mind can be renewed and transformed. When this happens, our desires will also be influenced positively – so much so that there will be no room for what the flesh chases after!



It is essential to remember that our Father in the Heavens knows what we need better than us. He wants us to feel satisfied, but we will never truly be that without obeying to His will, simply because we are made in His image. So, do you want a better life? Start prioritising God’s will above all!



🙏Prayer: “Lord, guide my heart so that it wants what You want. May Your will become my will. May Your desires for me and my life enter my heart, so that I might receive Your joy, in Jesus’ name, amen!” #GodsWill #MansWill

title: HE WAS BORN WITH A MISSION!!!
text:
On this day, 61 years ago, a man was born who was to become a channel of salvation for millions of people around the world, the Prophet T.B. Joshua. His goal and his vision was clear – for everyone to know that Jesus Christ is not only Alive, but also able and willing to drive the darkness out of our lives and lead us into His glorious Light! 



Although he is no longer between us, but in the Father’s arms, his teaching, his charity work and above all his love for the Lord and for His fellow man continue to accompany us and be a shining example for the children of God. All it took was one man with a vision and a mission – to bring the Fire of the Holy Ghost back into the world! 



We will be forever grateful to the Most High for the Prophet T.B. Joshua’s relentless dedication to the teachings of Jesus Christ and his unparalleled desire to selflessly serve mankind. His example continues to inspire generations, and his mark remains indelible in a world desperately seeking people who make a difference and can lead others toward the Light. 𝐕𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐭 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐞, and his life truly testifies to that – a life as a ray of light, hope and faith, full of acts of kindness and charity that knew no bounds! 



As we honour the memory of the Prophet T.B. Joshua, let us carry forward his work of compassion and service and thus, his vision for a better world. May we too, the sons and daughters of the Most High God, follow in his footsteps, having a deep love for God and His Word, so that his legacy may continue to inspire and positively impact countless lives, making the name of Jesus Christ be glorified in all nations!#𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐩𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐓𝐁𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚 #𝐀𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐞𝐒𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐟𝐇𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲 #𝐀𝐋𝐢𝐟𝐞𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐭

title: JESUS CHRIST, OUR ONLY SOURCE
text:
In the journey of life, impatience is always very costly. Most of our mistakes happen because of impatience. Many want fame, popularity, wealth, and possessions at all costs, not minding the source. Your source can either be Jesus Christ or satan.



Who is your source? The blessings of this world is a fading thing, so also is the life on which it is bestowed. Satan is a master deceiver; whatever that is sourced from him comes with conditions and ends in misery. When satan gives you something that looks like a solution with his right hand, he takes it back from you with his left hand—usually something your life depends on, something you cherish most.



Jesus Christ is the best Source—in fact, our only Source. Whatever that is not sourced from Him cannot stand the test of time.



Today, many don’t want to wait for God’s time; everyone wants to take shortcuts, and in doing so, they find themselves in costly and regrettable situations.



Be patient and let God answer you on His schedule and not on yours. God’s timing is perfect, His time is the best, and His schedule is always on time. The basis of your relationship should not be the blessings you receive but rather the Source of the blessings, which is Jesus Christ. So, make Him your Source, for whatever comes from Him will stand the test of time.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the strength and grace to make You my only source, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: HUMAN REBELLION!
text:
By looking up the word “rebellion” in the dictionary, we will see that it is uprising against the legal authorities! Man by nature is a rebel, not only against human authorities, but many times against His Creator!



In more detail, the Word of God says in 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟑:𝟔–𝟏𝟗, “𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐬𝐚𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐟𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐲𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐫𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐢𝐬𝐝𝐨𝐦, 𝐬𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐨𝐤 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐢𝐭. 𝐒𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐠𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐮𝐬𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐢𝐭. […] 𝐓𝐨 𝐀𝐝𝐚𝐦 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, “𝐁𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐈 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮, ‘𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐢𝐭,’ “𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐩𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐭𝐨𝐢𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞.” Undoubtedly, Adam and Eve disobeyed the instruction given to them, and by their act, they rebelled against God Almighty, losing the privileges they had in the garden of Eden!



It becomes clear that human rebellion causes us to do things that are against God’s instructions! It is our sinful and rebellious nature that prompts us to make wrong decisions, which in turn lead us to undesirable results. Whenever we are tempted or in a dilemma and do not know what decision to make, let us not consult ourselves, but follow God’s instructions found in His Word! Because God has given us a mind and the ability to choose between right and wrong! Choose to do the right thing, choose to obey and not rebel against God’s instructions, and you will see that the blessing, the breakthrough and the healing you are looking for will come your way!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will stop murmuring and rebelling against the instructions You give through Your Word, and I know that as I obey Your precious words, breakthrough will come in my life – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, Amen!”#Rebellion #StopDisobeying

title: GOD’S LOVING HAND
text:
Hebrews 12:5-6 says “… My son, do not make light of the Lord’s discipline, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you, because the Lord disciplines the one He loves, and He chastens everyone He accepts as His son.”



God has adopted us as His sons and daughters so that we may inherit the same privileges with Christ. As we walk towards His eternal hope for us, we often fall on the way due to immaturity. Immaturity plays a big role in our present state – being unable to maintain balance and keep a stable approach to what comes our way every day. It takes maturity that comes from faith to realise that our responsibility to God is a commitment and fellowship with Him. This means that we are all God’s children in need of His correction.



Many times we complain of the discipline we receive, but how many times do we as children embarrass our Heavenly Father and hurt Him by our behaviour, our disobedience? Do you know how much pain we have caused Him, how much we have disgraced His name by our worldly attitude? If you say you believe Jesus but do not obey or submit to His process, can you say you are truly a believer? Many claim and present themselves as children of God, but very few behave as one. Because of His Love for us, He sometimes uses our situation to build character in us. He sometimes uses our circumstances to draw us closer to Himself. Let us therefore submit to His process that we may walk in His way and live according to His standard.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, draw me close to You. Help me to follow Your process that I may become more like You, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: THE ILLUSION OF NEUTRALITY
text:
In today’s society, there is a tendency to remain neutral -to the degree of apathy more than often- towards the things that happen around us. Unfortunately, this category consists of the majority of people.  However, is this mindset appropriate for the children of God?



According to the book of 𝐑𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝟑:𝟏𝟓, which states: “𝐈 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐝𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐧𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐨𝐭. 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫!”,  no such life stance is unacceptable for a Christian. Life is not an encounter group, a bonding meeting or a playground; life is a battlefield where only the serious-minded are victorious. With that being said, that is how we ought to face life; not being indifferent to the evil and injustice around us, but standing for what we believe in. 



The neutrality that pervades many -either because they do not want to get uncomfortable or because they are afraid to take action- is an extension of defeat and ruin, because on our last day here on earth we will not be accountable only for the mistakes we have made, but also for the times when we knew what was right and did not do it.



Therefore, take action in your life! Stand for your faith in the Lord and be willing to make the most of the time that was given to you on earth by Heaven, for the person that folds his hands will not have any record.



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me to have an unquenchable zeal for You and be serious-minded, so that I may be victorious in every spiritual battle, until You crown me with the crown of victory, amen!”#𝐓𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝 #𝐌𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐇𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲 #𝐋𝐢𝐟𝐞𝐈𝐬𝐀𝐁𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐥𝐝

title: THE NUMBER 1 ENEMY OF PROGRESS!
text:
Who wouldn’t want to discover a quick and easy way to solve all of their problems? To be free of struggling, without spending time or working hard to make it in life? Perhaps many people would wish they could do that, but in our journey of faith, we are reminded that we have an active role to play in our success. 



As Christians, although we are called to rely upon God to face life’s challenges, He will not do what we can do for ourselves! Depending on the Lord does not exempt us from hard work and effort before we reach the finish line. The Word of God, in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟒, highlights the importance of diligence and perseverance:“𝐀 𝐬𝐥𝐮𝐠𝐠𝐚𝐫𝐝’𝐬 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐭𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐬𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐝.” Based on this, we understand that an idle person may daydream about what they want, what they wish to accomplish, but it is impossible to attain those goals because of procrastination, and even laziness. Those two might be easy, but they produce nothing except slow decay…



On the other hand, a disciplined person is much more likely to achieve their goals and become a problem-solver! In fact, the strong are determined to do whatever possible and proper thing it takes to get their goal! God’s plan for us involves both faith and action. While we trust in His providence, it is also our duty to put in the work without succumbing to the temptation of procrastination!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, strengthen me to resist procrastination. Help me take on my tasks with determination and a willingness to thrive! Grant me the diligence to work tirelessly for Your glory and give me a courageous heart to deal with life’s challenges, in Jesus’ name!”#BeatProcrastination #Discipline

title: TRUST GOD IN YOUR TRIALS
text:
Jeremiah 29:11 says, “For I know the thoughts that I think towards you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you a future and a hope.”



Life is a journey filled with challenges, uncertainties, and unexpected turns. We are faced with unexpected difficulties in our health, relationships, and other aspects of our lives on a daily basis. It is during these times that we may question God’s plan for us, wondering if He has forsaken us. In the midst of our struggles, it is crucial to remember that God’s plan for us is always good and not evil. The great apostles had to go through tests and trials before experiencing divine promotion.



In Job 23:10, we understand that what we are going through as Christians are tests meant to mature us. That trial you are going through—it may be sickness, disease, disappointment, failure, setback—serves as a platform for your divine promotion. Joseph faced a series of trials, but he didn’t lose his focus; his focus was on God and His promises. His unwavering faith and integrity led to his promotion from prisoner to a position of authority in Egypt. The story of Abraham and Sarah teaches us to find comfort in God’s timing, trusting in His promises even when circumstances seem unfavourable. Prophet T.B. Joshua faced numerous trials, challenges, and name-calling, but his resilience and unwavering faith in God allowed him to navigate those storms. The situation at hand may look like it is delayed, but it is not. Remember that men of purpose do not concentrate on where they are but on where they are going.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to believe in You even in the midst of my trials, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: LOVE – THE EVIDENCE OF FAITH
text:
1 John 4:20 says, “If someone says, ‘I love God,’ and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who does not love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?”



In a world full of violence and offence, we are commanded to love just as our Saviour loves. As Christians, our expression of love shows our faith and proves our faith. If you love God as you claim, then you must love your neighbour. Man, if he truly loves God, must show concern to the just treatment of his neighbours. This means that faith brings man to God and love brings Him to man. That is, faith brings us to God but love keeps us in God. 



The people of God are to be known for their solicitude for those whose social and economic status exposes them to exploitation and oppression. Our gifts should be used as an act of worship to God through giving to others. Love shows that we are born of God and that we know Him. Our love for God is shown by our obedience to His commands. He has commanded us to love our neighbours as we love ourselves and to do good to those who hurt and persecute us. Remember that the love the Bible speaks of is not that we wait to be loved but that we choose to love first. In a world full of darkness, let us be that channel of love where hatred, unforgiveness and offence abound. 



PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, make me a channel of love where there is hatred, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: PREACH WITH YOUR LIFE!
text:
In a world often divided by different beliefs and ideologies, our role as the children of the only Living God is to spread the Good News of the Gospel. But does this mean we should go about it through forceful persuasion or is there another way of proving that Jesus Christ lives?



Many think that by quoting the Bible and talking about Jesus, we will draw souls to Him, but the truth is that we can preach a better sermon with our lives than with our lips! In the book of 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟓:𝟏𝟔, the Word of God encourages us to be a good example, so that the name of the Lord will be glorified: “𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐬𝐨 𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐦𝐞𝐧, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧.” In simpler terms, God calls us to become living testaments to His power and His existence itself! Therefore, we ought to strive for integrity, humility, compassion, and goodness in all we do rather than imposing our own belief. 



For the people around us, we might just be someone who reads the Bible, and that is exactly why they will be observing how we treat others and even how we do our job to understand who the God we serve is! So, if your goal is to promote faith and become an ambassador of love, a frontline soldier of Christ, you can achieve it by doing exactly what He did – leading a life of service because, instead of criticizing others, we should show by the way we live, that Christ lives in us!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, help me so that my actions may be louder than my words! It is my desire to leave a positive impact on others’ lives, just as You did! May the fruits of Your Spirit manifest through me, in Jesus’ name, amen!” #LoveSpeaksLouder #BeTheLight

title: JOY IS A CHOICE!
text:
Being truly happy is easier said than done. A lot is going on in the world and our personal lives at the same time, and that makes it easy to feel down and lost… The following statement might sound controversial, but it is a fact: Joy is not an emotion, but a choice!



The Word of God, through the Apostle Paul’s God-given wisdom, sheds light on this very important part of human life, in 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟏𝟏-𝟏𝟐: “𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐢𝐧 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐢𝐫𝐜𝐮𝐦𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬. 𝐈 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐧𝐞𝐞𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐲. 𝐈 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐮𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐟𝐞𝐝 𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐮𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐲, 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭”. Even though Apostle Paul was imprisoned, persecuted, and scorned for the Gospel’s sake, he knew that true joy comes from loving Jesus, not from the things we amass! To put it simply, being happy was a conscious choice of his, as whether he was going through good times, or facing times of hardship, his joy transcended material possessions and circumstances. 



Similarly, we should also learn to be content in every situation. Even if we are surrounded by people who support us, and we are going through times of prosperity, we should not rely on things, people, money, and relationships to be happy. Instead, we should embrace the secret of contentment that the Apostle Paul discovered, which is a contentment deeply rooted in Christ Jesus. Emotions, possessions, and relationships are all fleeting things that might fail us sometimes – something our Lord and Saviour will never do! Thus, let us focus on loving Him more and more, and be rest assured that joy will be an integral part of our being!



🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, I know that my happiness is my responsibility, but I thank You because I have the best source for it: You! Help me to love, honour and follow You wholeheartedly in order to be filled with never-ending joy! Give me more of Your happiness and take more of my doubt, despair and anxiety, amen!#𝐄𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐞𝐉𝐨𝐲 #𝐁𝐞𝐉𝐨𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐬 #𝐉𝐨𝐲𝐈𝐬𝐀𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐢𝐜𝐞

title: GREATER UNDERSTANDING OF GOD
text:
Psalm 66:10 says, “For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us as silver is refined.”



In our spiritual walk with the Lord, there are good times and hard times alike. God refines us because our weaknesses hide where there is no heat of trial and temptation. Your response to the heat of temptation or trial determines your future. The circumstances of life are meant to cleanse and separate us from impurities such as anger, bitterness and unforgiveness. Ask God all the time to help you in the midst of difficulties, as He did with Joseph.



God sometimes works through our difficulties, sicknesses, afflictions and setbacks to take us to the throne. If you had not gone through that pain, who knows what would have happened to you. Now it is time to ask God to give you a greater understanding of His heart. You need a greater understanding of His heart to know that God is aware of what you are going through. If not, you will keep looking for alternatives, whereas God is working through your circumstances of life. As Christians, we must remember that there is a time and season for everything. Anytime you are going through challenges, please ponder on the position of God about the situation before you comment. Truly, God uses situations for a good purpose in the end. When your enemy kicks you or lies against you and you respond, satan will hit the more; however, if you ignore him and don’t mention anything about him, it is always very painful to him. Silence is the best answer for your enemy. It is time for you to see adversity as a friend, not an enemy, because God works through the circumstances of life to take us to our place of divine destiny.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the grace to believe and to trust in You in my trials, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: CALLED TO SERVICE
text:
Ephesians 2:10 says, “For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them.”



As a believer, a member of the household of faith, you are called to be a steward. The Lord created you and gave you an assignment of stewardship, an unconditional service to mankind as a representative of God here on earth. Every believer is a proclaimer; every Christian is a missionary. All who have received should give, for it is more blessed to give than to receive. There is no one quite like you, for we are all endowed with our own unique ability—something good, beautiful and wonderful within that needs to be transferred to the outside to meet the needs of others. The spiritual gift of every believer requires them to minister others, who are also required to minister to them; in other words, we are one another’s strength.



God has given us a purpose and that purpose is service to one another, for we are all a part of one body; indeed, as iron sharpens iron, so does one person sharpen the other. To know your purpose here on earth, you must draw close to God because whatever you claim to be doing for God is only a reflection of the relationship you have with Him. As Christians, we are called to lifelong service. This is our obligation and we must be prepared to render our unconditional service to those who need it every day. 



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to strengthen my relationship with You. Help me, Lord, to fulfil my purpose here on earth, in Jesus’ name! Amen.

title: FIX WHAT IS BROKEN!!
text:
Most people today are in broken relationships, as they have found themselves in a situation where a mistake, a misunderstanding, or a simple disagreement was enough to lead them to disaster! 



On the critical issue of relationship management, the Word of God states in 𝟏 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟒:𝟐𝟎 that: “𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐥𝐚𝐢𝐦𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐚 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐚 𝐥𝐢𝐚𝐫. 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫, 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐧, 𝐜𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐞𝐞𝐧.”  So, it is quite obvious that our relationship with God depends, far more than we think, upon our adjustment to one another Unquestionably, no one can succeed alone. We depend on others to succeed in our respective callings. You need your fellow man to make it in life! Therefore, do not reject anyone because of their weakness, because in doing so you will also reject their strength! 



Remember that as children of God, our union with Christ is the basis of our unity with one another! The cause of broken relationships is our failure to realise and accept that there is no perfect person on this earth! Therefore, if you have been rejecting your fellow man so far, it is time to rebuild your relationship with God, and in doing so, your love for Him will overflow to others! To improve in your relationships, learn to give people another chance!



🙏Prayer: “Lord, help me from today to stop rejecting my fellow men because of their weakness, because I know that if I reject them, then I reject their strength and my breakthrough. Lord, give me the strength to give them opportunities, just as You give me opportunities in my life every day – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#FixWhatIsBroken #Unity #ImproveInYourRelationships

title: DON’T IGNORE GOD’S PROCESS
text: Genesis 21:6 says, “And Sarah said, ‘God has made me laugh, and all who hear will laugh with me.’”God Almighty disciplines us as a process to reform us, to keep us for a new level in life and to strengthen our desire and determination for Him. Today, everyone wants to be great, but not everyone wants to go through God’s process. Remember that if you are in a haste to achieve something, you may likely make costly mistakes that will pull you back, if not down. If you ignore God’s process and focus only on your immediate result, you may likely not have the patience to differentiate between God’s supply and satan’s bait. The process helps you maintain the result. If the process you go through is not of God, you might not be able to maintain the result. However, if it is of God, the result will stand the test of time. Do not ignore the process; God is treating you as His own. He is processing us now through the heat of trials so that we will be disciplined enough to maintain ourselves when we get to the place of our destiny. It is in the mind of God to answer prayers; even when He seems not to respond immediately to our petition, He is still saying something. Don’t get disappointed when He seems to be silent; He is preparing you for the mother of miracles. All you need to do is to be patient. Those that laugh at you for your patience will testify to your result. Because you are waiting patiently on God and are following His process, you will rejoice, in Jesus’ name. Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to believe in You in the midst of my trials, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: BEAR FRUIT!
text: Many times we call Christians believers, but often, we are more like unbelieving believers. We find it easy to trust our parents, friends, the bank, or even the government more than we trust God and His promises in the Bible. However, it is wiser to only trust Someone who has no beginning and no end!In 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟓:𝟓 the Bible says, “𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐞; 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐡𝐞𝐬. 𝐈𝐟 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐧 𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐦𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭; 𝐚𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐦𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠”. The word “nothing” leaves us no space to think other than that we are dependent on Him for everything! If you catch yourself discussing your problems more than the One who can solve them, thinking about your barriers more than the One who can help you overcome them, doubting more than believing in His promises, then you have to realise that your heart is not filled with the Word of God, thus you need to take action, because when we plant wrong seeds a wrong harvest will come! In order to plant good seeds in your life, you must embrace the Word of God as the most effective instrument for change, with multiple examples of people and their lives for us to learn by in it. Then, the Holy Spirit can bring peace into your heart and once peace takes over you, then there is room for change, room for blessing, and room for you to prosper!🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I understand that I lack trust in You. Open the eyes of my heart Lord, so I see the freedom in surrendering all my problems to You and that my heart is filled with Your peace and understanding, so I bear much fruit for Your kingdom – Amen!”#TrustGodsPlan #StayConnectedWithGod #BearFruit

title: DON’T BE A COPY!
text: God promises to make us someone with a difference! This is because God created us to be unique in our appearance, character and skills.The Word of God, in 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟖:𝟏𝟗-𝟐𝟎, states that: “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥. ‘𝐍𝐨!’ 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝. ‘𝐖𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐚 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐮𝐬. 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐰𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬, 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐨 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐬”. Up to that time, as can be understood, God was the king of Israel. He destined them to be a unique nation, but the Israelites wanted to be like all other nations, disregarding the warnings of Prophet Samuel. God wants to make us people with a difference, the question is, do we want to make a difference in our world, or would we rather be like everyone else? If the former is true, then we should do what no one else has ever done!Looking around to imitate what other people are doing is a trap we fall into, instead of listening to our heart and what God puts in it. Jesus Christ has given us a mind and the ability to choose between right and wrong! Therefore, choose to listen to God’s voice, that is, your conscience, and make decisions that will make you someone with a difference; in doing so, you will surprise yourself and make a difference in your world!🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, starting today, I will follow my heart and make decisions that will make me someone with a difference! Give me the strength to stand firm in my decisions, so that I don’t become a copy of those around me, and help me to keep walking on the path that You have set out for me, so that the best may come in my life – in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#𝐒𝐭𝐨𝐩𝐁𝐞𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐂𝐨𝐩𝐲 #𝐂𝐡𝐨𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐖𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐲 #𝐋𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐓𝐨𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭

title: FOLLOW HIM AT ALL TIMES
text: Matthew 18:4-5 says, “Therefore whoever humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven. Whoever receives one little child like this in My name receives Me.”What is the first thought that strikes your mind when you wake up? Is it thoughts of peace and comfort in God’s Word or is it the contrary? The Bible encourages us to be humble as little children, to emulate the Christlikeness of little children. In their innocence, children follow instructions without questioning and they trust implicitly, never doubting. They also do not argue when they make mistakes and are quick to ask for forgiveness when they sin. Like children, we should be open about our sins and weaknesses and lay them bare before the feet of Christ. If you make a mistake, as we all do sometimes, do not run from God but run to Him. The difference between you and others is that you already have a relationship with God Almighty, so you can go back to Him about your behaviour. He will help you get back on your feet, forgive you and help you not to make the same mistakes again. Jesus Christ is the sinner’s only Saviour. He is the reason and purpose for our being. The Lord Jesus Christ will only consider our request when He sees in us the attributes of a faithful follower and a willing servant—attributes that are essential characters of true disciples (2 Chronicles 7:14).Prayer: Lord, help me not only to run but to run with a purpose. Help me to follow You on the way, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: DO NOT SABOTAGE YOURSELF!
text: The self-destructive syndrome is any behaviour, that is harmful or potentially harmful toward the person who engages in the behaviour. The reason some people suffer from self-destructive syndrome is that they cannot forgive themselves for the wrong choices they have made in their lives! Therefore, not only do they not do anything to change their lives, but they try to make even more mistakes, hurting themselves even more! When your mind sabotages you, you are not productive. It tends to slow you down and tell you that you can’t make it in life… However, the Word of God, is here to change your thinking, as it states in 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟏𝟑 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭: “𝐈 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐨 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧𝐬 𝐦𝐞.” If you think like a failure or talk like a failure, then failure will certainly not stop conquering your thoughts! As a child of God, you were created to think, speak, and act positively! Phrases like: “That’s not possible! I don’t know that! I can’t do that”, must be deleted from your thoughts! Undoubtedly, victory does not come from changing your outward appearance, it comes from changing your thoughts and words. The first place to be victorious is in our spiritual life and in our mind because victory does not start around us, it begins within us.  Therefore, start prospering in your spiritual life today by studying His Word, and you will see that you can indeed do all things through Christ, Who is empowering you!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, from today I will study Your Word daily, and as I do, cleanse me, sanctify me, and help me to get a positive way of thinking! Strengthen me to hold on to my resolutions – in the name of Jesus Christ, I pray, amen!”#SelfSabotage #YouCan

title: TAKE CARE OF YOUR HEART!
text: Proverbs 4:23 says, “Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.”Your heart is the realm of desires and feelings; guard it. Guard your heart in the storms of life. Guard your heart when everything looks unsteady around you. God wants us to be unmovable, steadfast and firmly believing in His promise for our lives during trials and temptations. If you are always conscious of the problems around you, you can never be conscious of the presence of God. The story of Elisha and his servant in 2 Kings 6:15–17 is a good example. Elisha’s servant was conscious of the enemies around him but was not conscious of the protection he was under until his eyes of faith were opened.Guard your heart because satan’s target is to get your heart and his focus is to capture your heart and create confusion. A person of faith whose heart is guarded by the Word of God, who walks by faith and not by sight, will always confess God’s promises for them in the face of adversity. Guard your heart because it is the seat of your will, desires and emotions; it is the fountain of all you do. Christ is saying to us today that we will face trials and persecution. But He also urges us to be of good cheer because He has overcome the world. Our role is to guard our hearts with all diligence, continue to read the Holy Scriptures with devotion, meditate on His Word and pray without ceasing.Prayer: Lord Jesus, open my eyes of faith to see Your protecting hand over my life, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: STOP HIDING!
text: It has become a constant habit for most of us, trying to hide the things we consider that prevent us from gaining the sympathy and acceptance of those around us. Thus, we fail to recognise the trap into which we fall, which is actually depriving us of God’s presence in our daily lives and our purposeful change, because we fail to realise that dirty as you may be, Jesus can still cleanse you. And He will!Indeed, Satan knows our past and acts as a spy, constantly seeking to find a way to remind us of our unworthy past and drive us away from God, making us feel shame, guilt and condemnation. In the Word of God though, in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟖:𝟏𝟑, we read: “𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐫, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐲.” Therefore, what you should focus on is that it is not your weakness that matters to God, but your willingness to get out of it! The only way for you to get out of your weakness is to initially acknowledge it as an obstacle to obtaining all that God has prepared for you and then confess it, as, until a person is willing to admit that he is a sinner in need of salvation, he cannot experience freedom from guilt, fear, inferiority and condemnation, which are four major problems that rob Christians of their blessings.Our failure to admit our wrong prevents our harmony with God, thereby creating an invisible barrier between us and God. Thus, make the decision today to stop hiding and start being more honest with God! He already knows everything and has already paid for the entirety of your past, so start accepting your freedom and start seeing your character, your life and everything that has to do with you change for the better, so that the rivers of blessings may flow into your life!🙏Prayer: “Lord Jesus Christ, I come before you with a contrite spirit as a sinner, unworthy of Your presence. Cleanse me from my sin and help me overcome my weakness, so that Your name may be glorified through my life and souls may return to You, amen!”#StopHiding #StartConfessing #SeeYourLifeChange

title: THE CROWN OF LIFE
text: James 1:12 says, “Blessed is the man who endures temptation; for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord has promised to those who love Him.”The tools of engagement during times of trials and temptations are patience, perseverance, endurance, and forbearance. How will your genuineness for God be confirmed if we can’t see your tools? Perseverance is an essential instrument for our faith. Patience, perseverance, endurance, and forbearance are the tools of a genuine Christian. Many people today are in a hurry to solve their problems and won’t know when the help they are receiving is from God or the devil. When we face tests of faith, we sometimes look for alternatives and shortcuts because we are too impatient to wait for God’s time. As Christians, men and women of faith, delay is not denial. Don’t misinterpret God’s silence as rejection. Even when He seems to be quiet, God is still saying something.At God’s appointed time, you will progress without any personal effort, stress, tension, or pressure. You will just move because God has already prepared the way. He is there with you in your trials and tribulations. He may not respond immediately because He is testing your patience. He wants to make sure that by the time you get to your place of destiny, you will not crack, explode, and lose everything because you don’t have enough preparation. Don’t give up! Just wait on God; we cannot push Him around or instruct Him the way He should go. We must submit to His will, and in God’s time, everything is beautiful. In the end, you will receive the crown of life He has promised you.Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to submit to Your will. Give me the grace to patiently wait for Your time, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: STRONGER TOGETHER!
text: People, as social beings, have always wanted to associate with people with whom they share common interests, desires, or goals. So inevitably, many Christians tend to associate with other Christians to spend some of their time and enjoy themselves.Although there is nothing wrong with the above, the majority of believers miss the point, which is that you are because I am, and I am because you are, as Prophet T.B. Joshua taught us. To paraphrase the last sentence, we can say that no one can succeed alone. We depend on others to succeed in our respective callings.The proof of the above is also found in the Bible, specifically in 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟐𝟒-𝟐𝟓,“𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐮𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐬𝐩𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐝𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬, 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐮𝐩 𝐦𝐞𝐞𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫, 𝐚𝐬 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐝𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫—𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐃𝐚𝐲 𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐚𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠”. It is the inalienable right, but also the divine duty, of every believer to help his brother in whatever he needs. Remember, our position in Christ Jesus is enhanced each time we help someone in trouble!Therefore, look deeper into your relationships, and you will surely realise thatyou have something in your possession or a positive element in your character that can help your brother, and vice versa! 🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father God, from now on I will not look at my relationships with the people around me superficially, but in depth. I ask for Your grace so that my life will become a solution to someone else’s problem, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”#𝐔𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐞𝐝𝐓𝐨𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 #𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐫𝐓𝐨𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫

title: DISCOVER YOUR STRENGTH
text:
Matthew 25:40 says, “And the King will answer and say to them, ‘Assuredly, I say to you, inasmuch as you did it to one of the least of these My brethren, you did it to Me’.”



The Bible explains that everyone God created has their own measure of strength. We may not be equally gifted, but it is clear that God designed it such that everyone has something to contribute. Your strength could be money, wisdom, talent, love, or a smile. Whatever is your area of strength, that is what God will use to bless others. Many come around people for selfish, classic, and material reasons. They keep company with people because of what they can get, not what they can contribute. Don’t come around people because of what you can get alone but also because of what you can give. We should see this as our duty because the Bible says that everyone God created has their own measure of strength.



To discover your strength, you must examine yourself thoroughly in the light of God’s Word. Self-examination is paramount to discovering this strength. You need to do this daily to build it so you can contribute positively to the lives of others. God Almighty cherishes our little efforts towards contributing positively to the lives of others, particularly when it comes from our hearts. Wherever your strength lies, use it genuinely to contribute positively to the lives of those around you, and you will see the promises of God for your life come to fulfilment.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to always bring joy and peace to the lives of people around me, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: OBEY GOD, BLESS HUMANITY!
text:
Obedience, a word that has been preached many times among Christians. And, indeed, knowledge is not the way to blessing, but obedience to our Heavenly Father is. In other words, it is the doer of the Word of God that receives things from God. But, how many of us have really realised that our obedience to God not only benefits us but also those around us?



The Bible cites such an example in 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟔:𝟏𝟒-𝟐𝟐: “𝐒𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐜𝐲𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐨𝐝; 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐦𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐩𝐢𝐭𝐜𝐡 𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐮𝐭. 𝐓𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐡𝐨𝐰 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐝 𝐢𝐭: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐡𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐜𝐮𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐠, 𝐟𝐢𝐟𝐭𝐲 𝐜𝐮𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐫𝐭𝐲 𝐜𝐮𝐛𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡. 𝐌𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐭, 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐛𝐞𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐮𝐛𝐢𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐠𝐡 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝. 𝐏𝐮𝐭 𝐚 𝐝𝐨𝐨𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐥𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫, 𝐦𝐢𝐝𝐝𝐥𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐮𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐤𝐬. 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐠𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐰𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐲 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐬, 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐡 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐭. 𝐄𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐧 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐡. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐦𝐲 𝐜𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐫𝐤 – 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐬’ 𝐰𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮. […] 𝐍𝐨𝐚𝐡 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦”. If Noah – the only righteous man of his time – did not do exactly as the Lord had instructed him, we would speak of disobedience on his part. And, of course, the fact that he was faithful to God, while all the rest were swimming in the pool of sin, stands as proof that our obedience to the Lord is a blessing for other people as well; without Noah and his family there would be no man on earth!



Therefore, it is easy to conclude that our obedience to God can have a positive impact on your family, your city, your country and the whole world! May you make a heart decision today and become a doer of God’s Word!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, I now know that my obedience or disobedience towards You also have an impact to the people around me. Help me now to make the decision to follow You faithfully and permanently, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray – amen!”.



𝐎𝐛𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 #𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐇𝐮𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲

title: THE ACT OF SURRENDER
text: Proverbs 3:5-6 says: “Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.”In today’s world, where everything seems unsettled and unstable, where change is constant, many end up worried. The uncertainties that come with the gift of life cause us to worry and doubt God’s promises for us. As Christians, the Bible is the standard for our lives; it is our means of survival during temptations and trials. The Bible assures us that the Lord will give us rest for our souls, and we find that rest when we surrender everything to God. We find rest when we lay everything at His feet—not just our worries or troubles but also ourselves—without withholding anything. When we withhold a part of ourselves from God, we give the devil an opportunity to strike.Total surrender to God is acknowledging that we have no power of our own. This is simply the act of letting go and letting God take control of everything. Total surrender to God is possible when we believe in Him and realise that God is reliable. The act of continuous surrendering is letting go of yourself and acknowledging that there is someone greater than you. This simply means that we must choose to submit everything to God every day. As Christians, let us lay everything at God’s feet, including ourselves; this is how we find rest.Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to trust You more. Help me to surrender everything to You, in Jesus’ name! Amen!#TBJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy#SurrenderToGod #FaithInGod #ChristianFaith #TrustInGod #ChristianEncouragement #SpiritualGrowth #BiblicalWisdom #AcknowledgeGod #StandardForLife
