title: ARE YOU A TRUE LEADER?
text: In today’s world, leadership has become synonymous with influence and power. It seems that everyone is after gaining followers. However, whether it’s in our professional or personal life, leadership can be achieved effectively and ineffectively. That is because true leadership is not merely about having others follow you; it’s about leading with integrity, purpose, and wisdom that springs from God’s Eternal Word!As 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐:𝟔-𝟖 reminds us, “𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐬𝐝𝐨𝐦; 𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐇𝐢𝐬 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐡 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐥𝐞𝐝𝐠𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠; 𝐇𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐮𝐩 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐬𝐝𝐨𝐦 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐮𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭; 𝐇𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐚 𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐞𝐥𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐤 𝐮𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐥𝐲; 𝐇𝐞 𝐠𝐮𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐣𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐜𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐟 𝐇𝐢𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐬.” True leadership is grounded in His principles, so when we follow them, we are equipped with the necessary tools to lead righteously and efficiently. His Word thus teaches us that leadership is not about being served and giving orders, but it is about serving others. It is about walking in justice with compassion towards the people we influence, just as our Lord Jesus Christ during His time on earth.So, as you reflect on today’s word and your journey as a leader, consider where your strength comes from. In a world that values talent or charisma, over character, make God your source of strength and do not rely on your own abilities alone, because only when God is the source of your strength, no one can be against you! 🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, make me the leader you destined me to be! Help me become a leader of positive influence that will change people’s lives forever, and grant me the wisdom to lead according to Your standards, with purpose, love, and integrity, in Jesus’ mighty name!”#𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐞𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩 #𝐒𝐞𝐞𝐤𝐆𝐨𝐝𝐬𝐖𝐢𝐬𝐝𝐨𝐦

title: AS A MAN THINKETH
text: Proverbs 23:7 says, “For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he ….”What is going on in your heart? Are you thinking of your present challenges or God’s promises to you? As a Christian, the content of your heart matters a lot to God. Our thoughts have the ability to limit who we are, what we can do or what we can become. When you think right, you are training yourself to act right. When our mind is focused on our problems, they are magnified, but when we think about God’s provision for our problems, His answer is magnified. As a man thinketh in his heart, so is he.The greatest source of human trouble is bothering and worrying about tomorrow. In Matthew 6:34, the Bible says, “Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about its own things. Sufficient for the day is its own trouble.” You cannot just get rid of negative thoughts by rebuking them. You should also replace them with Godly thoughts. Any fleshly effort you make towards resisting negative or sinful thoughts actually strengthens the hold of such thoughts on you. The best way is to replace them with the thoughts of God. Have you been thinking about your past, your failures, your mistakes, your challenges? Now is the time to feed on the Word of God, which contains His promises for you. You must meditate on the Word so that you will have the kind of faith that believes that delay is not denial. God’s time is the best, and at God’s time, everything is beautiful.Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to focus on You alone, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: HE IS YOUR REFUGE!
text: No matter who you are, where you live, or what you have accomplished, at some point in your life, loss becomes a reality. It is an inevitable part of living, loving, and growing, and although the burden of grief can get too much to bear, God is a loving and kind Father who is ready to mend your wounds.Indeed, when we lose someone dear and important to us, grief is a normal human response. It might come in different forms and it can be expressed in many ways, but as children of God, in the midst of anguish and sorrow, He is our comfort. God understands the language of sighs, tears, meditation, earnest heart desires and wishes of the man of faith. So, in times of mourning, we are not alone in pain, as the Bible assures in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟓:𝟒: “𝐁𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐧, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐝.”God promises to wipe away every tear from our eyes as long as we look for Him. When we are crushed and broken-hearted, His compassion will be there to guide us through the journey of healing after suffering loss. Therefore, if you ever feel that hope is lost, remember that Jesus Christ is the hope and He will give you the strength to endure and the peace to move forward. Open your heart to Him through prayer, for He is always there to make good on His promises!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, in the middle of grief, I thank You for surrounding me with Your love at all times. Lord, help me face loss with courage and trust in Your plans, and be my refuge when I feel lost, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I pray, amen!” #𝐆𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐟 #𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐭 #𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬𝐈𝐬𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐑𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐠𝐞

title: DO NOT BE CONTROLLED BY EXTERNALS
text: 2 Kings 6:15-16 says, “And when the servant of the man of God arose early and went out, there was an army, surrounding the city with horses and chariots. And his servant said to him, ‘Alas, my master! What shall we do?’ So he answered, ‘Do not fear, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.’”The Bible says that it is for freedom that He sets us free. The freedom the Lord gives releases us from the bondage of sin and from the control of things that seem to contend God’s place in our lives. When we are controlled by power on the outside—what is seen—we lack the quality of being stable. In the case of Jesus, the people’s unbelief was based on what they saw on the outside. They only saw Jesus as the son of a carpenter; they saw Jesus as the son of Mary, a boy who grew up with them. What they saw, what they heard, what their circumstances looked like constituted an atmosphere of unbelief. Under such an atmosphere of disregard and unbelief, it was difficult for Jesus to be at His best for them.If you are controlled by what you see, what you hear, what you feel, what your circumstances look like, you can never be constant in your relationship with Jesus. As Christians, we are inspired internally by the Holy Spirit. This divine ability will not be developed instantly because growth takes time. Proper judgment and discernment take a lifetime of personal experience with God to develop. Yet, when they are developed, they become permanent. If we have the Holy Spirit, we have the means to control ourselves and thus be free from external control.Prayer: Lord Jesus, give me the grace to be focused on You and not be controlled by what I see or hear, in Jesus’ name! Amen!

title: YOU CAN!
text: In life, we are bombarded with trials and difficulties. Sometimes it feels like the cycle never ends, or even that it gets worse! It is so easy to get discouraged when you are overwhelmed with the unpredictabilities of life, not knowing what tomorrow may bring. God is playing His role every day to fulfill His promises in our lives, so we should also play our role in learning how to encourage ourselves!In 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟑𝟎:𝟔, we read: “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐥𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐝, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐤𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐮𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐠𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐝, 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐦𝐚𝐧 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐝𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬. 𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝”. When we read this story in the Bible we can understand that King David was lonely in this situation and the only source of life and strength he found was Jesus. It is very important for us to understand that there will be times when there will be no one around us to help us carry the weight of pain. But if we start taking the responsibility of our happiness, we will develop the hunger to accomplish our dreams, because when you begin to take responsibility for your problem, you will begin to think of what you can do to get out of it! One sure way to invite encouragement in your life is through prayer and spending time in His presence by reading His Word. Also, being around people of the same spirit can only benefit you, since the company you keep is usually a reflection of the strength you reap – as iron sharpens iron – especially in discouraging times. Moreover, worshipping the Lord can only lift you up in hard times, if you do so earnestly and it is a very beneficial habit to cultivate.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me not feel discouraged. I know I can do all things through Υou who strengthen me, so teach me how to strengthen myself, as You did in times of pain and may your presence never leave me, in Jesus’ name, amen!”.#𝐄𝐧𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 #𝐈𝐂𝐚𝐧 #𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬𝐈𝐬𝐌𝐲𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡

title: YOUR CALLING
text: Ephesians 4:1–3 says, “I, therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you to walk worthy of the calling with which you were called, with all lowliness and gentleness, with longsuffering, bearing with one another in love, endeavoring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.”When God made man, what mattered to Him was not his mental or physical disposition but one who would be a stakeholder in His master plan. Every man has a divine cause to fulfil in God’s master plan. Every man born into this world came with a calling. Today, when we hear the word calling, the first thing that comes to mind is ministry—the work of God. Your calling is not limited to ministry. Our fathers of faith were called by God, but not all were called into ministry. Your call is a solution to a problem. Have you discovered your calling? Are you doing what God has called you to do? The first step in knowing your calling is to get to know God better by reading His Word. The Word of God is our roadmap, the guide, the director for our life. Whatever you are called to do, do it well, as unto the Lord. Are you called to teach? Teach well! Are you called to preach? Preach well! (Colossians 3:23). Remember that what you do through God is your calling; whatever God accepts you to do through Him is also your calling. Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to know You more; help me to know my calling in life, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen!

title: Rebuttal: TB Joshua’s Widow, Pastor Evelyn, Thrives Despite Claims of Struggle to Lead SCOAN
text:
Pastor Evelyn Joshua at The SCOAN Prayer Line Section




A recent article by Vanguard newspaper made several false claims about Pastor Evelyn Joshua and her leadership of the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN) after the passing of her husband, Prophet TB Joshua. While we are not against true constructive criticism, it’s important to address these misleading statements and show the real progress SCOAN has made under her guidance.



Despite what Vanguard reported, SCOAN continues to be a place of healing and deliverance, just as it was when Prophet TB Joshua was alive. People still come to the church for healing and to experience God’s power, and many are leaving with testimonies of miracles. Pastor Evelyn Joshua has successfully continued her late husband’s work, ensuring that the church remains a powerful spiritual center for worshippers.



The church’s charitable works have also continued strongly under her leadership. SCOAN is still involved in many charitable activities, such as helping the poor, supporting orphanages, and providing food and aid to people in need. This shows that Pastor Evelyn is dedicated to maintaining her husband’s legacy of love and care for the less fortunate.



Contrary to claims in the article, Pastor Evelyn Joshua has not struggled to maintain SCOAN’s international standing. In fact, she has led several successful international crusades. For example, she led healing and deliverance events in Kenya and Spain, drawing large crowds. She is also set to lead another major crusade in Argentina this October. These events show that the church’s global presence is still strong, and thousands of people around the world continue to be touched by SCOAN’s ministry.



The Vanguard article also wrongly stated that SCOAN’s presence in Nigeria has weakened. However, under Pastor Evelyn’s leadership, the church has even expanded locally. One key achievement is the reopening of the SCOAN branch in Akure, Ondo State, which had been closed for years. This move brings SCOAN closer to more Nigerians, especially those at the grassroots level.



This local expansion, along with strong leadership at SCOAN’s other branches, shows that the church is not only thriving internationally but also growing locally.



Finally, the claim that Prophet TB Joshua’s legacy is fading under Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s leadership is completely false. She has done a remarkable job of continuing the vision of her husband. She has managed to lead the church with humility and grace, keeping the focus on God’s work. Her calm, steady leadership style is helping to keep SCOAN’s mission alive and well.



While constructive feedback is always welcome, the recent article by Vanguard online news gave a false impression of SCOAN’s progress. Pastor Evelyn Joshua has done an excellent job leading the church, both locally and internationally. SCOAN is still a place of healing, deliverance, and charity work, and its influence continues to grow.



Evelyn Joshua has not only protected Prophet TB Joshua’s legacy but has also strengthened it, ensuring the church’s future remains bright.

title: GOD IS NOT FAR!
text:
Life has become fast-paced for most of us. Although we are blessed with a family, a home, a job, good health, and countless privileges that everyone takes for granted, we get caught up in the busyness of life sometimes. So, even if you love God and you wish to be close to Him, how many times have you found yourself too tired to read your Bible and pray?



It is easy to postpone the study of the Word of God after a long, exhausting day of work and hectic schedules, but it is difficult to carry the burden of our conscience. That is because some Christians count their time with God as another task on their to-do list. Nevertheless, the voice of our conscience is there not because we are obligated to draw close to God, but because we need to draw close to God!



If you realise you fall into this category of people, do not lose heart and do not distance yourself from your Heavenly Father! 𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚 𝟏:𝟗 reminds us of His promise: “𝐇𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐈 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮? 𝐁𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐨𝐮𝐬. 𝐃𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐟𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐝; 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐝, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐠𝐨.” This verse is a direct encouragement from Him, but when we are led by our intellect, feelings and emotions, we may confess faith in the Word but keep denying it in action. In other words, when our feelings tell us that we’re too tired or too busy, God calls us to move beyond those limitations.



God is not far, but He will always want you to know Him better, and hold onto Him like a lifeline instead of an imposed duty. He has already proved His love for us by sacrificing His only Son, and it is now up to us, His genuine children, to prove our commitment to Him! Therefore, choose to seek Him despite fatigue and distractions, and you will be able to embrace His promise to be with you wherever you go!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I want to spend every day knowing You better by spending time with Your Word. Help me not to be led by my emotions, but by my desire to have a deeper connection with You. Draw me close to You and help me know You are always next to me, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”



𝐒𝐩𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐖𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐆𝐨𝐝 #𝐆𝐨𝐝𝐈𝐬𝐋𝐨𝐯𝐞

title: IT IS NO OVER!
text: Philippians 3:13-14 says, “Brothers and sisters, I do not consider myself yet to have taken hold of it. But one thing I do: Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.”When you are driven by Christ’s Spirit of hope, what you see, what your circumstances look like and what people do or say concerning your relationship with God cannot affect your vision. No matter what constitutes obstacles on your way, you can never be stopped. This is so because a man of vision is always full of faith, humility, modesty and perseverance, which are his essential characteristics.The transforming power in this promise of hope encourages us to strive toward where and who we desire to be, knowing that we are included in God’s master plan for His creation. When you know where you are going, whatever happens to you midway cannot change your focus. Therefore, let us follow the path of good. Blessed is the man who follows this path, for even in darkness, light shines upon the upright. Such people are strong because they rely upon God for vindication, upholding, provision, refuge and salvation. They persist in doing good, not allowing external pressure to change their conduct. As people of faith, our desire to serve God and do the right thing should be strengthened by the situation that we are facing. PRAYER: O Holy Spirit, help me to see Your Saving Hand in my situation, in Jesus’ name! Amen!#TheSCOAN #PastorEvelynJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy #Salvation #GodsPlan #Perseverance #WinThePrize #RiseAboveChallenges #HolySpirit #ChristianEncouragement

title: Evelyn Joshua’s Argentina Crusade A Journey of Faith and Miracles
text:
By Dare Adejumo



As the highly anticipated Evelyn Joshua Crusade, organized by the Synagogue Church Of All Nations (SCOAN), draws near, the atmosphere in Latin America is charged with excitement, hope, and expectations of spiritual revival.



Set for October 11th and 12th in Resistencia, Chaco Province, Argentina, the crusade promises to be a transformative event for the continent, with people traveling from far and wide to witness the power of God through Pastor Evelyn Joshua.



In Argentina, anticipation is palpable. Local communities, as well as attendees from neighboring nations like Chile, Bolivia, Paraguay, Brazil, and beyond, are flocking to the registration center at Centro Cristiano De Avivamiento.



Alejandro Paz, a local teacher and environmentalist, said, “Many now understand the spiritual roots of life’s problems, and the ministry of TB Joshua has always held deep respect here. Pastor Evelyn Joshua is continuing that legacy with grace.”



The excitement is not limited to individuals. Argentina’s hospitality industry is booming, with hotels in the region experiencing unprecedented bookings. Establishments such as Howard Johnson, Amerian Casino Gala, and Hotel Atrium are fully booked in anticipation of the influx of international visitors.



Dr. Cesar Joepuin Prieto, a gynecologist, commented on the significance of the crusade, saying, “Our nation is undergoing a spiritual restoration. The timing of this event aligns perfectly with Argentina’s efforts to embrace godliness for a better future.”



Attendees from other Latin American countries, like Mexico and Brazil, are also buzzing with expectations.



Raul Marquez from Mexico said, “We are hungry for the anointing of Pastor Evelyn Joshua. TB Joshua’s ministry remains a testament to God’s glory, and we expect miracles.”



Pastor Robert Acosta, a prominent Christian leader in Argentina, shared his excitement, saying, “Before his passing, TB Joshua spoke of a crusade in Argentina. Now, we see the Holy Spirit moving even before the event has begun. Pastor Evelyn Joshua is carrying the torch forward, and we are ready to experience God’s power in a way we’ve never seen before.”



The event, hosted at Portal Del Cielo (Door of Heaven), Latin America’s largest gathering space, is expected to draw thousands. Despite the scale, SCOAN maintains its foundational principle of refusing to collect offerings or accept material support for crusades, focusing solely on spiritual impact and charity.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua, describing the event as a “journey of love,” emphasized that this crusade is God’s project for Argentina, and its purpose is to bless the nation. 



SOURCES: https://www.newsmakerslive.org/evelyn-joshuas-crusade-ignites-latin-america-a-journey-of-faith-and-miracles/

title: YOU ARE UNIQUELY MADE!
text: Have you ever paused to truly consider how unique and extraordinary you are? There are moments in life when we may feel inadequate, unloved, or even believe that we are unworthy of love. Yet, these feelings stand in stark contrast to the truth that God has spoken over us. The Bible, in 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟏𝟑𝟗:𝟏𝟒, declares, “𝐈 𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐘𝐨𝐮, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐟𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞.” This powerful verse is a reminder that you were crafted by God’s own hands, with intentionality and love that surpasses all understanding.Each one of us is a masterpiece, uniquely designed by our Creator. Our differences—whether in personality, choices, abilities, or even the pattern of our fingerprints—are all part of God’s magnificent design. No two people are alike, and this diversity is a testament to His purpose. He didn’t make a mistake in creating you; He gave you life with a specific purpose in mind, tailored just for you.It’s easy to fall into the trap of comparison, looking at others and feeling as though we don’t measure up. But remember, your journey is unlike anyone else’s! We each have a special role to play in God’s master plan, a role that no one else can fulfill for us. The essence of our existence is beautifully expressed in the understanding that I am because you are, and you are because I am! This profound truth invites us to embrace our individuality while recognising our connection with others. Therefore, let your perspective shift! Begin to see yourself and everyone around you through the lens of God’s boundless love, and let today be the day you stop comparing yourself to others!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I humbly come before You, seeking Your guidance on this journey You have set before me. May Your Word light my path, and may my heart be filled with trust in Your perfect plan for my life. Strengthen me, Lord, to walk in the truth that I am fearfully and wonderfully made, and that Your love for me is immeasurable. Amen!”#𝐆𝐨𝐝𝐬𝐋𝐨𝐯𝐞 #𝐖𝐨𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐥𝐲𝐌𝐚𝐝𝐞

title: Historic Christian Revival in Argentina: Over 80,000 Experience Divine Miracles at SCOAN Crusade
text:
More than 80,000 people gathered for a two-day crusade organized by the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN) in Resistencia, Argentina. The event took place on October 11 and 12 at the Portal Del Cielo (meaning “Door of Heaven”) and was led by Pastor Evelyn Joshua, the wife of the Prophet TB Joshua.



The crusade was filled with divine healing, salvation, and deliverance. The crowd was beyond imagination. They came seeking to be filled by the Holy Spirit and received more than they expected. God never disappoints those who trust in Him.



During the crusade, people from Argentina and neighboring countries, such as Chile, Uruguay, and Brazil, experienced a powerful move of God. Many came with various challenges, including diseases, paralysis, drug addiction, and mental illness. Numerous testimonies of healing and deliverance were shared as participants witnessed people freed from the grip of demonic forces.



The event was not limited to the venue. The crowd was so large that the surrounding fields, covering about five acres, became overflow areas for the participants. Some people even arrived a day before, spending the night in the cold just to attend the crusade.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua shared a message of hope and encouraged the people to trust in God’s love. She assured them that God was ready to bless their lives and urged them to maintain a close relationship with Him. Quoting from the Bible, she said, “Without genuine love, God cannot entrust anyone with His power.”



Watched Video Here: 









The event was described as a “dream fulfilled” for many who were seeking divine intervention in their lives. Pastor Evelyn’s words brought comfort to the thousands who attended, as she emphasized that God never fails those who sincerely put their faith in Him.



In addition to the Argentine locals, the crusade attracted participants from other South American countries. Leaders from different nations expressed their joy at being part of the event. Pastor Willy Gancia from Brazil said, “We are happy to witness this move of God here in the hand of Pastor Evelyn Joshua. This is a new beginning for the land of Argentina.”



Similarly, Fredi Marcel Bianchi from Uruguay stated, “The presence of God here is real. We know that God is with this ministry.”



The crusade was a major event for Argentina, and many dignitaries attended, including government officials and community leaders. Guillermo Alejandra, a local leader, said, “This is a great event in our lives. I am happy to witness the crusade. It’s a blessing for the Argentines.”



This crusade has sparked new hope for Christian revival in Argentina and the rest of Latin America. Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s ministry has rekindled the spiritual fire in a country where apostolic movements had been quiet for some time. As the crusade concluded, many people left with renewed faith, healing, and a deeper connection with God. The event marked the dawn of a new Christian era in Argentina and beyond.

title: MAKE GOD FAMOUS!
text:
The Word of God in 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟓:𝟏𝟒 and 𝟏𝟔, says about the children of God, “𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝. 𝐀 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐛𝐮𝐢𝐥𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐚 𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐚𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐝𝐝𝐞𝐧 […]𝐈𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐲, 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐝𝐞𝐞𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐠𝐥𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐟𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐅𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧.” If we observe what is happening in the world, we see that we live in the end times. Every day, social media bombards us with bad news, wars, and disasters. As Christians of course, the struggle for survival is not a personal challenge, but one against God. It is an opportunity to honour God before men. We also live in times when humanity sees evil as good, and good as evil. In this dark age, the light of Jesus Christ must shine! As His ambassadors, now is the time to stand up for what we believe!



If there is anything the world can see and admire in our lives, it is the blessings of God. But without faith, no one can maintain the blessings of God! You don’t have to be a pastor to make God famous, but you do need to stand for what you believe without shame. You must stand for the truth of the Word of God and live by His truth and His righteousness. Then the Lord will stand for you, and your life will spread the scent of Christ in society, drawing more souls into the Kingdom of God, for they will see that the source of joy and peace you enjoy is Jesus Christ!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, give me Your grace not to be ashamed of the gospel of Jesus Christ, for it is the power of God unto salvation to everyone who believes, so that Your light may shine through my life, glorifying Your name, in the name of Jesus Christ I pray, amen!”



SpreadHisGlory #MakeGodFamous #ProclaimHisGoodness

title: THE No 1 QUALITY OF A FRIEND!
text: As we immerse ourselves in the Word of God, we clearly understand that friendly relationships are in the will of God for His children. From the very beginning, we even see God Himself spending time with Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden, fostering a relationship with humanity. The way we choose our friends, however, matters…The greatest example of friendship in the Bible is the one between David and Jonathan. Despite their differences in their background and their social status, with David being a shepherd and Jonathan a prince, they had one thing in common—their faith in God. And that is the greatest thing they shared! In 𝟏 𝐒𝐚𝐦𝐮𝐞𝐥 𝟐𝟑:𝟏𝟔, we read, “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐥’𝐬 𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐉𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐰𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐃𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐝 𝐚𝐭 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐡 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩𝐞𝐝 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡 𝐢𝐧 𝐆𝐨𝐝.” This passage reveals the highest quality we should seek in a friend: someone who strengthens us in the Lord, especially in times of trial and hardship. Ιndeed, by their fruit, character and attitude to life we know who the children of God are: They are never anxious about anything.Therefore, the friends we choose should be those who uplift and inspire us in our walk with Christ. They should be individuals who encourage us to grow closer to God, instead us guiding us towards habits and things that do not please the Lord. So, as we choose our friends wisely, let us seek those who will walk with us in faith, and in turn, let us be the kind of friend who strengthens others in their relationship with God!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I leave my relationships in Your mighty hands. I pray that you bring people my way that I can spend time with—people who will have a positive influence on me and deepen my relationship with You. Help me add to their lives and be a positive influence as well. In the name of Jesus Christ, I pray. Amen.”#FaithAndFriendship #TrueFriendship

title: RENEW YOUR MINDSET!!!
text: With everything that goes on in our lives, it’s easy to lose control over our thoughts. Our minds are a battleground, and without discipline, we may unknowingly allow negativity, doubt, and fear to take root. But just as an athlete trains their body, we must train our minds to focus on what is pure, true, and in line with God’s Word.Our thoughts have power. As Proverbs 23:7 says, “For as he thinks in his heart, so is he.” Whatever we think, we eventually become. A mind filled with fear and negativity reflects a heart that has lost focus on God. But a disciplined mind, filled with His truth, reflects faith, peace, and strength. The enemy knows the importance of our thoughts and he uses them as a weapon to weaken our faith. If we allow our minds to wander without restraint, we become easy targets for confusion, anxiety, and doubt. However, as believers, we have been given the tools to resist. Part of this armour is the ability to control our thoughts and bring them into submission to Christ.Disciplining your mind requires intentional effort. It’s not just about avoiding negative thoughts but replacing them with God’s promises. When faced with doubt, remind yourself of His faithfulness because thoughts are like currents moving in the air. They are capable of drawing you towards God or driving you away from God. When fear creeps in, declare the truth of His protection! Like Jesus in the wilderness, we must speak the Word of God with authority and bring every thought captive to His truth!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, I acknowledge that I need Your strength to discipline my mind. Help me take every thought captive and bring it into obedience to Christ. Teach me to reject negative thinking and replace it with Your promises, so that my mind may be a reflection of Your truth. In Jesus’ name, amen.”#Faith #TrustInGod #RenewedMind

title: GOD LOVES YOU! DO YOU?
text:
God loves us not because we are perfect, but simply because we are His. In the same way, we are called to love God with all our hearts, not only in moments of joy and abundance but also in times of difficulty and hardship. 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟑𝟏:𝟐𝟑, encourages us by saying: “𝐋𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝, 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐟𝐮𝐥 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞! 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦 […]”. This verse reminds us that our love for God should not be conditional nor sporadic, but rather rooted in a deep trust in His faithfulness.



Often, when trials arise, we are tempted to murmur and complain, questioning why we face such struggles. But we must remember that God, our Loving Father, does not allow anything to happen without a purpose. Every difficulty, every challenge, is part of His divine plan to strengthen our faith and draw us closer to Him. Remember Job, remember Joseph! Both heroes of faith lost everything they held dear unexpectedly, yet their love for God Almighty never disappeared! Their examples, therefore, should remind us that those who bless God in their trouble or difficulty prove their sonship.



When we bless God, even in hardship, shows that we truly belong to Him. It is in these moments that our faith is tested and refined, proving the genuineness of our trust in God. We must recall all the good things He has done for us, the times He has carried us through difficult situations, and the countless blessings we have received. So, our response should be one of love, faith, and gratitude, no matter the season we find ourselves in!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “My Heavenly Father, forgive me for not showing my love for You enough. Lord Jesus Christ, no matter the circumstances, You are still my Saviour, Healer and Redeemer. Help me to stop complaining in the face of struggle, and instead, give me the grace to worship You even more and confess my love for You even louder, in Jesus’ name!”



LoveGod #TrustInGod

title: DON’T STOP ENCOURAGING YOURSELF!
text: In a world full of turmoil and trouble, it is necessary to have people around us who love, support, and encourage us when we need it; people who add to our lives. However, that is not always the case. In times when we are alone, and feeling desperate, we need to draw encouragement from something much deeper than the words of our fellow man – our faith in God as the thing that keeps us from despairing is not what we see but what we believe.Jesus tells us in John 16:33, “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world, you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.” Jesus is instructing us to find the peace we need in Him. Not in other people, not in things. In order to get this peace though, you need to believe in His finished work on the cross and stop listening to the lies of the enemy who came to steal, kill, and destroy our lives. If you are tired of feeling helpless and dismayed all the time, all you need to do is believe and confess God’s promises over your life. Believe that even though you have many reasons to be discouraged, you have many more reasons to be encouraged!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, open my eyes of faith to see that I’m not alone. You are always with me! You are always ready to walk me through the challenges of life. Remind me of Your promises over my life. Help me find encouragement in your Word and remain peaceful all the time – amen!”#Faith #Encouragement #GodsPromises

title: THE PROCESS OF BELIEVING
text: Romans 10:10 says, “For with the heart one believes unto righteousness, and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.” Many profess Christianity, proclaiming Jesus as their Lord and personal Saviour when they do not believe Him in their heart. The Bible  warns us that it is not enough to profess Christianity; God’s Word says that we must also believe in Christ. People oftentimes judge others by outward appearance, but the Lord looks at the heart. God values our faith because it makes us one with Him. Righteousness is a gift from God — a gift for those who confess and also believe. Believing means, you are no longer ignorant and that you now have the knowledge of truth. By believing, trust comes – acceptance of the truth in the midst of your heart. Jesus has paid the price for us; all you need to do is to believe. When you speak right, you are training yourself to think right. When you think right, you are training yourself to act right (Joshua 1:8). This means that you must speak only what is in accordance with God’s Word. It is God’s desire to bless you, but you must first speak His Word and do what the Word says. Your thoughts must reflect your belief. Your words must reflect your belief. Your actions must reflect your belief — that is the secret of success.  If your heart and mind are filled with God’s Word, you will speak the right words and you will be a wonder to your world. Emmanuel! Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help my heart and my mouth to act only in accordance with You, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen! #FaithJourney #Righteousness #GodsWord #Transformation #ChristianLiving #DivineGuidance #SpiritualGrowth #instagood #trending #viral #TBJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy #EmmanuelTV #TheSCOAN

title: STRIFE IS DESTRUCTION!
text: In 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟏𝟑𝟑:𝟏 the Bible says, “𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐆𝐨𝐝’𝐬 𝐩𝐞𝐨𝐩𝐥𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐧 𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲!”This is the way God wants His children to live, which means the opposite would be exactly what the enemy wants. Therefore, he uses one of his weapons, strife, to keep Christians away from the will of God. Strife can take the form of an argument or being silent, refusing to say a word to the person you feel angry at, as the dictionary defines an angry undercurrent that is difficult to recognise. This may be the most dangerous form of strife, as it is impossible to identify. As a child of God, once strife gets in your heart, you open the door to satan to come and take control of your life. However, God has instructed us to love one another as love is the greatest weapon against hatred and division, while the harbouring of the spirit of unforgiveness breaks our communion with God.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me stay away from strife, fill my heart with your heavenly love that supersedes everything, in the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#TheSilentTreatment #Strife #Disunity

title: SCOAN’s Year of Triumph and Thanksgiving: Reflecting on 2024
text:
The Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN) marked its end-of-year Thanksgiving on December 8, 2024, with gratitude and celebration for a year filled with challenges, victories, and significant milestones. Under the leadership of Pastor Evelyn Joshua, the church not only withstood trials but also emerged stronger and more united.



The year 2024 began with a major storm when the BBC aired a fabricated and staged documentary targeting Prophet TB Joshua and the SCOAN. The accusations were baseless, yet the media uproar tested the faith of the congregation. Pastor Evelyn Joshua handled the situation with unwavering grace and wisdom. Her actions not only deflected the attacks but also brought the church closer together. What was meant to divide and weaken the SCOAN ended up uniting its members, strengthening their resolves, and faith in God.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s leadership shone brightly throughout the year. The year saw remarkable spiritual and charitable achievements. Pastor Evelyn Joshua led a powerful revival and charity outreach at the SCOAN branch in Ghana. The event was a demonstration of the church’s commitment to spreading the gospel and extending a helping hand to those in need. In addition, the iconic Living Water Service took place at the SCOAN`s Headquarter—a hallmark of SCOAN’s spiritual ministry—brought about deliverance, healings, blessings and numerous divine encounters to countless worshippers, reminding them of God’s enduring presence in the Synagogue, Church of all Nations (SCOAN).



Beyond Africa, Pastor Evelyn Joshua and the SCOAN team took the gospel to new heights with a revival in Argentina. This historic event was accompanied by a Living Water Service and a significant charity initiative in the South American nation. The revival in Argentina brought together thousands of believers, igniting faith and transforming lives through the power of God’s words, healings and deliverances.



Despite the challenges faced throughout the year, SCOAN recorded a series of spiritual breakthroughs and triumphs, demonstrating the resilience and unwavering faith of its leadership and members. Pastor Evelyn Joshua’s leadership has been instrumental in maintaining the legacy of Prophet TB Joshua, ensuring that the ministry continues to grow and impact lives worldwide.



As the church reflects on the year 2024, it is evident that Prophet TB Joshua’s vision and legacy lives on. The ministry remains a beacon of light, hope, faith, and love, standing firm as a mark of God’s faithfulness. The Prophet would undoubtedly be proud, watching from his place in God’s kingdom, as his wife and the church he founded carry forward his mission with dedication and grace.



With hearts full of gratitude, SCOAN gives all glory to God for a successful year, confident that the best is yet to come.

title: NO ROOM FOR COMPLAINTS!
text: It’s tempting to complain when things don’t go our way. Frustrations at work, unmet expectations, or even bad weather can stir up grumbling in our hearts. But as followers of Christ, we’re called to live differently.“𝐃𝐨 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐠𝐫𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐫𝐠𝐮𝐢𝐧𝐠, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐛𝐥𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐮𝐫𝐞, ‘𝐜𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐫𝐞𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐟𝐚𝐮𝐥𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐚 𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐩𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧.’ 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐚𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐥𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐤𝐲 𝐚𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝 𝐟𝐢𝐫𝐦𝐥𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞.” – 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟐:𝟏𝟒-𝟏𝟔. When we complain, we focus on what’s wrong instead of on God’s goodness. This not only robs us of joy but also tarnishes our testimony to others. Complaining contradicts the hope and faith we proclaim, or that we should proclaim, especially when we openly share our beliefs with others. If we truly believe, then we ought to keep in mind that words carry weight and power. The words you speak determine the life you enjoy. So, when we speak words of complaint, we feed dissatisfaction in ourselves and others. But when we speak words of gratitude and courage, we cultivate peace and joy. Choosing not to grumble is more than a discipline—it’s a declaration that we trust God’s sovereignty, even when life feels unfair or uncertain.When you’re tempted to complain, pause and ask God to give you a new perspective, and most importantly, remember how much Jesus Christ suffered on the cross of Calvary for you to have a life full of wonderful things! Choose gratitude over grumbling, and watch how your life will never be the same!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, forgive me for the times I complain instead of trusting You. Help me to guard my words and reflect Your goodness in all I say and do. Let my life shine brightly as a testimony of Your grace and faithfulness. Amen.”#GratitudeOverGrumbling #Thankfulness

title: KNOWING GOD IS TRUSTING HIM
text:
1 John 4:16 says, “And we have known and believed the love that God has for us. God is love, and he who abides in love abides in God, and God in him.” 



To know is to rely on and to rely on is to know. It is impossible to rely on or trust in who you do not know. God Almighty helps us when it comes to the issue of faith by showing us His nature. Our Father shows us His nature and His Divine abilities because He wants us to know that He is Reliable. He acknowledges that we must know that He is reliable. We trust God when we know that He is reliable and trustworthy. This understanding comes when the nature of God has been revealed to us. The revelation of the Love of God comes through His only begotten Son, our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, the man who died that we might live. The Bible says in Romans 10:17, “So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God”. It is through this Word that we know God in Truth and in Spirit. In Truth because He is the Way, in Spirit because He is the Life. It is when this truth is revealed to us that we know God and can rely on Him. He is called Truth because He does what He says, He does what He has promised and never turns back on His Word. This truth endures forever; it is a solid foundation that prevails no matter the situation. People of God, the more you know God, the more you can rely on Him. We know Him by His Word. Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to know You more that I may put my trust in You, in Jesus’ name! Amen! #KnowingGod #TrustingGod #FaithInGod #TrustHim #SpiritualGrowth #Inspirational #instagood #trending #viral #TBJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy #EmmanuelTV #TheSCOAN

title: REMEMBER WHO IS WITH YOU!!!
text: To anyone facing challenges or pain, know that you are not forgotten. In moments when the weight of life or the past feels overwhelming, remember that God is always on His throne!Unfortunately, in this world, there are many people who have experienced abuse whether it be verbal, physical, emotional, or domestic. If you are one of those people, know this: God sees you, understands the depth of your troubles, and He wants you to believe that even though human beings might disappoint, Jesus Christ never will! No matter who or what caused your pain, remember what 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟏𝟒 says: “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐆𝐨𝐝, 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐥𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐝; 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐠𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐟 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝. 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐯𝐢𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬.”!This verse proves that God is steadfast in His care for us. Truly, if you had to distance yourself from those who are supposed to love you the most, the truth is that shepherds often lose some of their sheep to perish, but our Lord Jesus Christ has vowed that none of His sheep shall perish, not even one.Therefore, you are not defined by what has happened to you, but by the incredible worth and love that God places on you. Don’t waste another moment! Run to Jesus and confess that He is working to bring restoration, peace, and joy into your life, even when it feels difficult to see!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, thank You for being a good and loving Father. Right now, help me release forgiveness and break free from any pain holding me back. Strengthen my heart, restore my joy, so I can look towards the wonderful future You’ve planned out for me. I trust in You! Amen!”#NotAlone #GodsLove

title: PUT YOUR TOTAL TRUST IN THE LORD
text: Proverbs 3:5 -6 says, “Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.” As Christians, our path to the throne cannot always be rosy; we are bound to experience loss, alongside moral, economic, and social uncertainties. Troubles sometimes come not because we have taken any wrong steps but because we are living in a complex and contradictory world. Those who are rich in every sense of the word know that life is a learning experience. Sometimes the challenges we face may seem to be in direct conflict with God’s promises in our lives. However, each time we feel disappointed, we must learn to put our trust in the Lord. In every situation God has something to say. No matter how great your trouble is, it should not prevent you from praying; instead, it should make you pray the more, fast the more, and trust in the Lord the more. Jesus is the Way, not a way. Jesus is the Truth, not a truth, and Jesus is the Life. Therefore, put your trust in God in every trial: the greater the trial, the greater you become. Those who bless God in their trial will be blessed by God through their trials. If you do not pass your test, you won’t be promoted. Your test qualifies you for promotion. Your promotion qualifies you for a reward and your reward increases the flow of your joy. Let your situation move you closer to God and not away from Him! Emmanuel! Prayer: Lord Jesus, I believe; help my unbelief, in Your Holy name! Amen! #TrustInTheLord #FaithOverFear #DivineTrust #HopeInGod #BelieveInHim #WalkByFaith #trending #viral #TBJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy #EmmanuelTV #TheSCOAN

title: AN UNSHAKEN JOY!
text: Joy is a divine gift from God to each one of us, offering us a deep sense of contentment and hope even in the hard times of trials. Unlike fleeting happiness, which depends on worldly factors and pleasure, true joy is related to our relationship with Christ and the promises of His precious Word! Life can be challenging, tough, and harsh at times, as the trials that daily occur in our lives may make us feel overwhelmed and tired. Yet, our joy has to remain steadfast because it is anchored in something far greater than the temporal- it is anchored in the eternal promises of God.The joy that God gives us is not just a fleeting emotion but also a source of strength that sustains us through the ups and downs of life. It is the deep assurance that no matter what we face, God is with us, and He is working all things for our good. In the book of 𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟓:𝟏𝟑, the Bible says that: “𝐌𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐟𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐣𝐨𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐡𝐨𝐩𝐞 𝐛𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐥𝐲 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭”. Why do you always worry when a problem comes your way? Why do you find yourself feeling unhappy? Instead of those negative feelings, REJOICE because Jesus loves those who are able to exercise great faith under great trials and temptation. Indeed, God clearly says in this verse that if we put all our burdens upon Him, He will fill us with his everlasting and unending joy.Take a moment to reflect on the source of your joy. Does it depend on your circumstances, or is it rooted in the eternal promises of God? Consider how you can draw nearer to Christ, who is the wellspring of joyfulness, and hope, and ask Him to fill your heart with His peace and contentment, no matter what challenges you may be facing.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me to keep my eyes fixed on You, especially when life is difficult. May Your joy be my strength, and may I always find contentment in Your presence, knowing that You are faithful and true. Fill me with Your Spirit so that I might reflect Your joy to those around me, bringing hope and light to a world in need. In Jesus’ name, amen!”#DontLoseYourJoy #StayHappy

title: INTEGRITY EQUALS PEACE!
text: In an uncertain world, where trust is hard to find, people often seek security. The Bible offers profound wisdom on this: “𝐖𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐠𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐤𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐲, 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐬 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐝 𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐝 𝐨𝐮𝐭” (𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟎:𝟗). This verse highlights a timeless truth—the connection between integrity and true security.Walking in integrity means living with honesty, transparency, and moral uprightness, aligning our actions with the values God calls us to uphold. It is about consistency, matching our words with our deeds, even when no one else is watching. A life of integrity creates a firm foundation, offering peace of mind and freedom from the burden of hiding or covering up wrongdoing, even if we are tempted to act out or make excuses for them. And remember, when we humble ourselves for Christ’s sake, He would exalt us in His own time and season.And not only that! When we walk in integrity, we experience confidence, knowing that we are living truthfully, and the stain of guilt has no place in our heart. This also strengthens our relationships—with God and with others. Integrity serves as a safeguard, protecting us from the turmoil that dishonesty brings. In contrast, a lack of integrity leads to insecurity, anxiety, and the consequences of deceit…In conclusion, choosing integrity means choosing a path of peace and alignment with God’s Word. It allows us to stand firm, knowing that our lives reflect truth and honour, just as Christ did!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father in Heaven, I come to You with a humble heart, seeking Your guidance and grace. Help me to walk in integrity, living a life that reflects Your righteousness. Strengthen me to be honest, faithful, and upright, even in the face of challenges and temptation. May my life bring honour to You, peace to my heart and security to others. Amen.”#Security #LiveWithIntegrity

title: The Unintended Positive Effects: BBC Documentary, SCOAN Unity, and the Legacy of Prophet TB Joshua
text:
It has been a year since the BBC aired its fabricated and staged documentary targeting Prophet TB Joshua and the Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN). While the documentary aimed to discredit the late Prophet and the Church, it inadvertently led to several positive outcomes, showcasing the enduring strength and unity of SCOAN’s global community.



This article marks the first in a series celebrating the one-year anniversary of SCOAN’s victory over the falsehoods propagated by the BBC documentary. Through these publications, we aim to give more exposure to the truth and reflect on the powerful legacy of Prophet TB Joshua.




Unity Among SCOAN Members: One of the most notable outcomes was the unshakable unity that emerged among SCOAN members worldwide. Faced with adversity, the Church community came together, strengthened by a shared purpose and commitment to their faith. This unity has become a testament to the enduring legacy of Prophet TB Joshua.



True Disciples Speaking in Unison: Despite the storm of allegations, true disciples, members, and workers of Prophet TB Joshua raised their voices in unison. They stood firm in defending the Prophet’s teachings and the values of the Church, showcasing unwavering loyalty and faith in the face of challenges.



A Resurgence of Popularity: Ironically, the BBC documentary fueled a renewed interest in Prophet TB Joshua’s work and legacy. People who were previously unfamiliar with the Prophet’s ministry began revisiting his teachings, philanthropy, and acts of kindness, resulting in a resurgence of global attention on the positive impact he had on millions of lives.



Reminiscing the Prophet’s Good Works: The controversy prompted many to reflect on and celebrate the remarkable life of TB Joshua. His dedication to helping the less privileged, healing the sick, and bringing hope to countless individuals continues to inspire people worldwide, far outshining the negativity portrayed in the documentary.



Increased Online Engagement: The documentary also led to a surge in traffic to websites and platforms dedicated to TB Joshua’s teachings and legacy, such as the “Watched TB Joshua” site. This increase in engagement reflects a growing global curiosity to learn more about the Prophet’s life and the mission of SCOAN.



A Rekindled Interest in Legacy: The unintended publicity surrounding the documentary rekindled interest in Prophet TB Joshua’s spiritual journey and mission. Discussions about his teachings and the continued work of SCOAN under the leadership of Pastor Evelyn Joshua have been reignited, ensuring that the Prophet’s legacy remains alive and impactful.




The fabricated BBC documentary, intended to tarnish the image of Prophet TB Joshua and SCOAN, instead became a catalyst for positive change. It united the SCOAN community, brought global attention to TB Joshua’s legacy, and reinforced the resilience of the Church in the face of adversity.



As we celebrate this victory, let us remember the enduring impact of Prophet TB Joshua’s life and continue to uphold the values and teachings that have touched the hearts of millions around the world.

title: Why Is the BBC Obsessed with Prophet TB Joshua and the SCOAN?
text:
One might wonder why a media organization like the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) would have so much interest in Prophet TB Joshua and the Synagogue, Church of All Nations (SCOAN). Why are they so obsessed with tarnishing the image of a man whose life and ministry had such a positive global impact? Even after the Prophet’s passing, the BBC remains relentless in its efforts to discredit him.



To understand this, we must look at the role of BBC Africa. It is widely seen as a tool of the British government, often used to spread negative narratives about Africa to the world. Its primary aim seems to be reinforcing negative stereotypes about Africans and their leaders, undermining the continent’s achievements. The BBC has become infamous for staging questionable investigative reports that often damage the reputations of prominent African figures.



The BBC has a pattern of targeting anything good that comes out of Africa, especially when it doesn’t align with British interests. This raises the question: why does Prophet TB Joshua remain a target, even after his death? Could it be that his achievements posed a threat to British imperialist narratives about Africa?



The late Prophet TB Joshua was one of the greatest men to come out of Africa. His influence and impact, even in the global context, remain unmatched. For a long time, certain groups have worked to paint Africa as a place where nothing good can emerge. Seeing a man like Prophet TB Joshua rise to international recognition undermines that false narrative.



The greatness of TB Joshua challenges the image some in the West wish to project about Africa. His humanitarian works, spiritual leadership, and the lives he transformed stood as proof of Africa’s potential. Unfortunately, instead of celebrating his legacy, some media organizations, like the BBC, have focused on spreading falsehoods.



Did you know that the British government once sent a spy to SCOAN under the guise of being a disciple? Why would a government feel the need to monitor a church leader if he wasn’t seen as a threat? This shows how determined they are to tarnish his name and legacy.



The BBC’s fabricated documentary about TB Joshua and SCOAN claimed to care about women. Yet, they remain silent about the ongoing grooming gang scandal in the UK. For years, it has been revealed that men of predominantly Pakistani heritage have sexually abused underage girls in northern England. Despite public outrage, British lawmakers recently blocked a national inquiry into the scandal.



Even worse, OpenDemocracy, an organization that worked with the BBC on the documentary against TB Joshua, has dismissed the grooming gang crisis as a “far-right conspiracy theory.” Why are the BBC and their partners silent about the British women and girls affected by this scandal? Why won’t they investigate or give these victims a platform? Could it be because some powerful politicians, police officers, and civil servants are implicated?



It is time for the Church to stand up and speak out against media organizations like the BBC, which seem focused on spreading disinformation about great African leaders and men of God. Prophet TB Joshua’s positive impact continues to be felt around the world, yet they focus on lies from disgruntled individuals seeking to profit from his name.



The BBC should be held accountable for their double standards and their obsession with discrediting an African leader who brought hope and healing to millions. The Church must unite and defend the legacy of Prophet TB Joshua while exposing the harm caused by such biased media campaigns.

title: LISTEN, LOVE, AND BECOME BETTER!
text: How many times have you been corrected for something you were certain was right and became bitter about it? Not only that, listening to others is one of the simplest yet most powerful ways we can show love and serve others. It is more than just hearing someone’s words—it is about giving them our full attention and understanding, while examining everything under the light of God’s Word. This is an important part of being a follower of Christ, who calls us to love one another. title: Ajoke: A Story of Betrayal and Lessons as We Celebrate SCOAN’s Victory Over BBC Falsehood
text:
Ajoke: The Daughter of Perdition 




As we mark one year of victory over the fabricated BBC documentary targeting Prophet TB Joshua and the Synagogue, Church of All Nations (SCOAN), it is vital to reflect on lessons learned from stories like that of Ajoke. Her tale serves as both a warning and a call for discernment in extending kindness and trust.



Ajoke’s story began with an act of compassion. Abandoned as an infant on the premises of SCOAN, she was found by Prophet TB Joshua. Out of love, the Prophet reported the case to the police and, with their approval, adopted the child. Alongside his wife, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, Prophet TB Joshua welcomed Ajoke into their family, giving her the love, care, and opportunities her biological parents denied her.



Ajoke grew up in a nurturing environment, surrounded by care and guidance. Yet, as she matured, she began to drift from the values instilled in her. She engaged in rebellion, theft, and inappropriate relationships at a young age. Concerned for her future, Prophet TB Joshua corrected her in love, but Ajoke misinterpreted his guidance as oppression. This misunderstanding led her to voluntarily leave the SCOAN premises.



The Betrayal



Contrary to claims made in the BBC documentary, Ajoke was not forced out of SCOAN; she chose to leave. Yet, in a shocking twist, she became part of the conniver of falsehood against the man who had given her a second chance at life. The BBC documentary featured Ajoke making claims that were later debunked by video evidence released by the SCOAN.



Ajoke had falsely asserted that she was Prophet TB Joshua’s biological daughter, a claim that was proven untrue. Prophet TB Joshua had foreseen the potential for betrayal and had documented Ajoke’s rebellious actions and her adoption process. The evidence released by SCOAN included videos and police reports that verified Ajoke’s adoption and exposed her false accusations.



Watch the evidence here:




Rumble Video



YouTube Video




A Year of Vindication



As we celebrate the one-year victory of SCOAN over the BBC’s falsehoods, Ajoke’s story highlights the importance of discernment. Prophet TB Joshua’s foresight in documenting her actions and her adoption status protected his legacy and the truth. Despite her betrayal, the church emerged stronger, and her falsehoods were exposed.



Ajoke’s betrayal offers profound lessons about human nature, gratitude, and loyalty:




Gratitude Is a Choice: Ajoke’s actions demonstrate the dangers of ingratitude. Despite being rescued and loved, she chose to repay kindness with betrayal, illustrating the unpredictability of human behavior.



The Need for Discernment: Prophet TB Joshua’s meticulous records remind us to seek divine guidance in extending kindness. Not everyone who receives help will respond with gratitude.



Loyalty Over Fame: In today’s world, temporary fame and financial gain often overshadow loyalty and values. Ajoke’s actions might bring her attention now, but her betrayal will not be forgotten.




Ajoke’s betrayal is part of a broader narrative of attacks on SCOAN and Prophet TB Joshua’s legacy. Yet, these challenges have only strengthened the church. The one-year anniversary of SCOAN’s victory over the BBC documentary is a celebration of resilience, truth, and unity under the leadership of Pastor Evelyn Joshua.



Ajoke’s story is a lesson for believers to be cautious in their acts of kindness, seek divine guidance, and always act with love and loyalty. As we celebrate SCOAN’s victory, let us remain steadfast in truth and pray that our good deeds are met with gratitude, not betrayal.



May the lessons of Ajoke’s betrayal remind us to stand firm in faith, choose discernment, and trust in God’s ultimate justice. Prophet TB Joshua’s legacy remains unshaken, a testament to the enduring power of love, forgiveness, and truth. Amen!

title: THE PERFECT TRUST!
text: Trust is a mutual sense of security and reassurance that develops when people know they can rely on each other. It is based on the belief that the person with whom one is interacting will act responsibly and truthfully. However, this is not always the case…It is safe to say that many of us have trusted people who ultimately did not keep their word, whether they were family members, friends, or business partners. Why does this happen? And why is it that every time we face a serious disappointment, we turn against and blame God Almighty? Because, quite simply, whenever we are at the crossroads of a major decision, we don’t seek God’s opinion, but do what seems most appealing, most convenient, and when failure comes, we don’t question who we trusted.This problem, however, should not become the reason we lose our relationship with the Lord. In fact, it is our failure to give Christ His proper position in our heart that is actually responsible for the crisis of our faith. So when you prioritise your friends, your work, and anything that makes you happy, if those things fail you, you will find yourself alone and helpless. Indeed, in the book of 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟏𝟕:𝟓, we read: “𝐓𝐡𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝: ‘𝐂𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐦𝐚𝐧, 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐝𝐫𝐚𝐰𝐬 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐭𝐡 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐟𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐡 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧𝐬 𝐚𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝.’” Therefore, it is time to realise that even though it is our duty to love all people, we must trust only God and have Him first in our hearts! 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, thank You for being Faithful and True. I ask forgiveness for my weakness in trusting You and putting You first in my heart. Today, I know that trusting You and seeking Your opinion on every matter is the best decision I can make! In the name of Jesus Christ, amen!”#LoveEveryone #TrustOnlyGod

title: KEEP THE FAITH!
text: When Jesus comes back a second time, will He find any faith left in the world?Faith is a concept that is generally misunderstood and often ridiculed, as we live at a time where everything has become so materialistic and automatic. But what exactly is faith and how does it factor in? Faith is the necessary ingredient and prerequisite that allows miracles to happen! Wishes can become reality as long as they are according to God’s divine will and in His perfect timing! We are often mistaken that God does not want to bless us or does not hear our prayers, but this is far from the truth! As the Bible teaches us, we should not rely on our own understanding, because many times we are impatient and unwise, hence blocking our own breakthrough. 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟑:𝟓-𝟔, says: “𝐓𝐫𝐮𝐬𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐧 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠; 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐰𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐬𝐮𝐛𝐦𝐢𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐡𝐢𝐦, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐦𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐩𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐬 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭.” Faith claps before the miracle, so in order for you to receive the results you wish for, you first must plant those kind of thoughts in your mind, then cultivate that specific mindset -using faith as the fertilizer- because your thoughts are capable of bringing you blessings or denying you of blessings and words are the bridge to your future! As long as you always have God in His proper position, which is first in your heart, blessings will flow like a river towards you! 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, thank You for always being the One in control, for guiding my steps and protecting me from mishaps and my own bad choices. Help me be more patient, wise and prudent, so I do not hinder You working in my heart and bringing Your perfect will into fruition for my life, soon! Amen”.#KeepTheFaith #Faith #LampToMyFeet

title: THE REQUIREMENT FOR SALVATION
text: Romans 10:9 says that “if you confess with your mouth the Lord Jesus and believe in your heart that God has raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.”Many people have gone astray today, even those who once had a relationship with God. They now ask questions driven by the desire and hunger stemming from the fact that they have not truly experienced God. Prophet TB Joshua observed: “Until you experience God, there will be dissatisfaction in your life, a sense of hunger to know what life is all about and a desire to know what happens after life is over.” These desires make us ask questions such as: Are we truly saved? How can we be saved? To obtain what you desire, you must do what is required. To receive salvation, you must meet the necessary requirement. The only thing required for us to be saved is to believe. Believing is the requirement for salvation. Christ has completed the work for us on the Cross; all that is needed is for us to accept it and take possession of it. As Prophet TB Joshua also noted,  “Believing is possessing. The instant you believe, it is yours.”  The problem of believing is made simple when we know that it is acting on what God has spoken. We truly believe God when we trust that His Word has accomplished what it promises to do.  Farmers are perfect examples. When they plant their seeds, they do not go back every day to till the ground and check if the seed is germinating. They simply trust in nature, believing that the seed will grow. If a farmer can trust nature without a definite promise, we should be able to trust the God of nature. Finally, belief is the only condition for answered prayers. We only truly believe God when we accept His Word and trust that He will fulfil what He has promised to do.Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to trust implicitly in Your power, in Jesus’ name! Amen!#Salvation #TBJoshuaQuotes #devotional #PowerOfBelief #GodsWord #PrayerLife #SpiritualGrowth #SavedByGrace #DailyDevotion #BibleTruths #GodsPromises #trending #viral #TBJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy #EmmanuelTV #TheSCOAN

title: GOD SEES SOMETHING IN YOU!
text: Many times, we feel incompetent or inadequate to accomplish our dreams and goals. We all go through moments of doubt, but when you look in the mirror, remember that God sees something you may not be able to see yet! Moments of weakness are opportunities for growth. Instead of being overwhelming, they can be a starting point for personal development when we face them with patience, encouragement, and faith. Moses is a prime example. When God called him to lead His people out of Egypt, he was hesitant, saying he was not qualified because of his inability to speak (𝐄𝐱𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐬 𝟒:𝟏𝟎-𝟏𝟑). Although he doubted and had no faith in himself, God promised him: “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐠𝐨; 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐬𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐤 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐬𝐚𝐲.”Similarly, we often create a false image of ourselves because of failures or comparisons to others. But God sees in us the potential that we do not see. Like Moses, he sees something unique and precious in you. And when Moses obeyed, he did not fail. Instead, he learned God’s ways and delivered His people from the Egyptians! Unless you decide to look at life from God’s point of view, you would live a defeated life and you would go to the grave prematurely. Indeed, if you do this, you will be able to overcome your weaknesses and use your potential. Failure is not the end, but part of the path to success. Like Moses, you can learn, grow, and achieve great things! 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Holy Father, thank You for being faithful to Your promises and seeing beyond my limitations and weaknesses. Strengthen me so that I can reach the bright future You have planned for me! Help me to believe that I am what You say I am and that I can do what You say I can do, in Jesus’ name!”#Victory #GodsPointOfView

title: THE LANGUAGE OF GRATITUDE!
text: Gratitude is a powerful force that has the ability to transform our relationships with those around us. In 𝟏 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟏𝟖, Apostle Paul reminds us to: “𝐆𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐤𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐢𝐫𝐜𝐮𝐦𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬; 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐢𝐬 𝐆𝐨𝐝’𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬.” This verse encourages us to cultivate a heart of gratitude, not just in our prayers to God, but also in the way we interact with the people He places in our lives. Gratitude isn’t just a feeling we should keep to ourselves; it’s an attitude that should be expressed in our words and actions.Just think about it: When was the last time you showed your appreciation to your family, friends, to those who stood with you in times of hardship and sorrow? Simple words like “Thank you,” “I appreciate you,” or “I’m grateful for what you did” can go a long way in building and strengthening relationships. Truly, your words are capable of drawing people towards you or driving people away from you! Letting others know we’re thankful doesn’t just uplift them; it also reminds us of the blessings God has given us through them. By openly expressing gratitude, we not only glorify God but also become instruments of His love and encouragement to others.Whether it is through heartfelt words or a warm, loving smile, do not miss any opportunity to show how thankful you are to the people around you! Starting today, let yourself become a tool of kindness and appreciation in His hands!   🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, thank You for Your abundant blessings and the people You have placed in my life. Teach me to be mindful of the power of my words, and may I use them to encourage, uplift, and show appreciation, in Jesus’ name, amen!”#Appreciation #Relationships

title: THE END IS NEAR… SO IS GOD!
text: In a world that has so rapidly blossomed in terms of technology and science within a few decades, one could hope that happier, safer times are ahead for humanity. Yet all we see on the news is wars, political conflicts, mass manipulation, natural disasters, and economic turmoil… On top of all of this, although people should look for the light – God’s light – many are even turning against it, shaming and rejecting it with all of their might. Christianity may sometimes be slandered, sacrificed at the altar of earthly pleasures and the worship of things that have nothing to do with His Kingdom. So, when we are constantly pressured to consume content that does not glorify God and instead causes fright in societies, how can a child of God uphold his or her faith? The answer is that it honours God to believe Him even when every sense contradicts Him, and He promised to honour those who honour Him! Truly, the Word of God, timeless and full of wisdom as it stands, states the following in 𝟏 𝐓𝐢𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐲 𝟒:𝟏-𝟖: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐥𝐲 𝐬𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐨𝐥𝐥𝐨𝐰 𝐝𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐛𝐲 𝐝𝐞𝐦𝐨𝐧𝐬. […] 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐠𝐨𝐝𝐥𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐯𝐚𝐥𝐮𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬, 𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐬𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐛𝐨𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞”. In other words, it is precisely in these moments of darkness that our faith can shine and lead us to salvation!Let this message serve as a beacon of hope! As violent as the waves that threaten to overwhelm humanity might appear, we can find solace in our Father’s embrace, for He promised to be by our side as long as we seek more of Him and less of the world. The world may tremble and collapse, but it’s a temporal residence, and we are not alone. Keep honouring God with your life, and He will be your anchor!🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I know my faith is not in vain! You are still King! Even while everything around me shows that I should not follow You, I will continue to seek Your face for the rest of my life. Help me draw closer and remain devoted to You no matter what happens, in Jesus’ name, amen!”#TheEndIsNear #SeekHisFace

title: WILL YOU DRINK FROM IT?
text: The prayer of many Christians is to receive the Holy Ghost, but the Bible teaches us that only those who drink of the cup of His suffering are ready to be baptised with His baptism. Even for the early disciples, when the mother of the sons of Zebedee knelt before Jesus with her two sons, asking that they be co-heirs with Him, He replied “‘𝐘𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐨𝐧’𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐚𝐬𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠,’ 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦. ‘𝐂𝐚𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐮𝐩 𝐈 𝐚𝐦 𝐠𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐤?’”. (𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟎:𝟐𝟐)The cup He was referring to was the suffering He was about to endure to redeem humanity. The same message given to the early disciples is the same message Jesus is giving to anyone who is making this request today: only those who share in the fellowship of His suffering are ready for His baptism. Those prepared for such a position must pass through many lessons in the University of God, earning degrees both in praise and rejection, in honour and persecution, in hardship and prosperity, in sickness and health, in unpopularity and in fame. The good news is that He has already provided the enablement for the hard times, as with God all things are possible.Anyone who desires triumph or victory must be ready to embrace war because triumph or victory is a product of warfare. Just as a drop of honey attracts insects from everywhere to come and eat, in the same way, blessings of any form attract attack without invitation; and the attack is proportionate to the greatness of the crown. The greater the crown the greater the attack. If this principle is not understood, one may query and complain when trial and temptation come. A good servant, however, will be just like their master!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, grant me the grace to pass every course; that of honour and that of humiliation, that of hardship and that of prosperity. Prepare me to be the vessel to receive and maintain the baptism of the Holy Spirit, and let rivers of living water flow through me, amen!”. #HolySpiritBaptism #DrinkFromHisCup

title: THE UNCOMPROMISING DEMAND
text: Romans 1:17 says, “For in it the righteousness of God is revealed from faith to faith; as it is written, ‘The just shall live by faith.’” God has good promises for us, but many have not yet taken hold of them. It is one thing to believe in something; it is another thing to take hold of it. God requires us to actively reach out to Him by faith and take hold of His promises. This means we are faced with God’s uncompromising demand for faith. Without faith, we cannot please God. Without faith, we cannot approach God. Without faith, we cannot receive His righteousness. Faith holds the key. Faith is our movement toward the promises of God. By faith, we take hold of God’s Word and act on it. God’s promises are recorded in the Holy Bible. We must believe the promises of God, for there is no reason for faith as good as God’s Word. God’s Word is the basis of our faith. Therefore, looking into the promises of God gives us every reason to look to Him for mercy—and there is no reason to stop looking, stop praying, or stop asking until God answers our request. Faith is practical; it demands action. Faith stops praying and begins to praise God. Faith stops worrying and begins to smile because God has done it. Faith in God is not a risk but a sure and practical act. In the Word of God is everything you require and need. All of God’s blessings are in your hands. Therefore, we must take God’s Word to heart and make it the standard for our lives. As we do so, His promises will become evident in us, in Jesus’ name. #Devotional #TBJoshua #SCOAN #EmmanuelTV #PastorEvelynJoshua

title: CAPTURE YOUR THOUGHTS
text:
Philippians 4:8 says, “Finally, brethren, whatever things are true, whatever things are noble, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report, if there is any virtue and if there is anything praiseworthy—meditate on these things.”



There is a constant battle between good and evil, love and hate, the flesh and the spirit—and that battle takes place in the minds of believers. Becoming a Christian does not mean you are automatically free from these struggles; in fact, you must consciously choose God every day.



This battle presents a common dilemma for Christians: the power of choice. And when it comes to our thoughts, there is no neutral ground—our thoughts are either of faith or of doubt. As Prophet T.B. Joshua says, “Mind management is the first priority of an overcomer.” As Christians, we are called to manage our minds so we can attract the positive reality we desire. Manage your mind because what happens in your mind will happen in time.



We must manage our thoughts to prevent sinful actions. As Prophet T.B. Joshua said, “Take care of your thoughts, for they will become your habits. Take care of your habits, for they will become your character. Take care of your character, for they will become you.”



The only way to capture our thoughts is through meditation on the Word of God. This is so important, as the Bible says in Proverbs 23:7, “For as he thinks in his heart, so is he.” When your mind is busy with God’s Word, it won’t be idle or available for sin. Once you capture your thoughts, you capture everything—you have won the battle (2 Corinthians 10:3-6).



Prayer: Heavenly Father, I ask for the grace to constantly meditate on Your Word. Please give me the strength to capture my thoughts for Your glory. Amen.



Devotional #TBJoshua #SCOAN #EmmanuelTV #PastorEvelynJoshua
