title: The Royal Television Society (RTS) Award: A Celebration of Falsehood and Unprofessional Journalism
text:
The recent decision by the Royal Television Society (RTS) to award BBC Africa Eye and openDemocracy for their false and fabricated documentary, is not only shocking but also a glaring example of how modern journalism has sunk to new lows. This award celebrates a documentary riddled with falsehoods, fabrications, and a clear agenda to tarnish the reputation of one of Africa’s most influential religious figures, Prophet T.B. Joshua, and his ministry, The Synagogue Church of All Nations (SCOAN).



The documentary, which claims to expose physical and sexual abuse by Prophet T.B. Joshua, is nothing more than a poorly constructed narrative designed to sensationalize and defame. It is deeply troubling that an organization like the RTS, which is supposed to uphold the highest standards of journalism, would reward such a biased and unverified piece of work. This award is not a reflection of excellence in journalism but rather evidence of the growing culture of dishonesty, blackmail, and unprofessionalism in the media industry.



Since the release of the documentary, numerous pieces of evidence have emerged that debunk the claims made by BBC Africa Eye and openDemocracy. Video evidence, testimonies from credible sources, police reports, and documented facts have all shown that the allegations against Prophet T.B. Joshua are baseless and fabricated. It is clear that the documentary was not created to seek the truth but to push a predetermined narrative aimed at destroying the legacy of a man who dedicated his life to helping others.



The individuals who allowed themselves to be featured in the documentary have been used as pawns in a larger game of media manipulation. They have been exploited for personal profit, and their reputations have been tarnished for generations to come. Just as Judas Iscariot betrayed Jesus for personal gain, these individuals have allowed themselves to be used to betray a man who brought hope and healing to millions around the world. History will remember them not as heroes but as tools of deception and betrayers.



The decision to award this documentary also highlights the delusional state of the world and its establishment. It is a sad reflection of how far society has strayed from truth and integrity. The fact that an organization like the RTS can publicly reward such a dishonest piece of work shows the level of shamelessness and moral decay in modern journalism. It is a clear indication that the media industry is no longer interested in truth-telling but rather in pushing agendas and creating sensational stories for profit.



It is worth recalling that during the tragic September 2014 SCOAN guest house collapse, Prophet T.B. Joshua stated that powerful individuals were behind the attack. The relentless negative reporting on him and his ministry by certain media outlets, including BBC Africa Eye and openDemocracy, gives us a clear idea of who these powerful individuals might be. Their efforts to spread disinformation about the collapse and their shameless celebration of this award are, in a way, opening our eyes to the forces behind the SCOAN building tragedy. God is already exposing the falsehoods in their documentary, and this award only serves to further reveal their true intentions.



The African proverb says, “Those whom the gods wish to destroy, they first make mad.” The actions of BBC Africa Eye, openDemocracy, and the RTS are a clear sign of madness. They have chosen to ignore the truth and reward falsehood, but their time of judgment is coming. It may be slow, but it will surely come to pass. God’s judgment is inevitable, and those who have chosen to spread lies and deceit will face the consequences of their actions.



The RTS award is a stain on the reputation of journalism. It is a celebration of falsehood, unprofessionalism, and moral decay. BBC Africa Eye, openDemocracy, and the RTS should be ashamed of themselves for promoting such a dishonest and biased piece of work. The truth has already begun to prevail, and the world is now witnessing these organizations for what they truly are: purveyors of lies and deception. As more people become aware of the facts, the credibility of BBC Africa Eye, and the RTS continues to erode. Their actions have not only damaged their own reputations but have also highlighted the dangers of media manipulation and agenda-driven storytelling.



While they may celebrate their award now, the world is waking up to their deceit. God’s judgment is inevitable, and though it may seem delayed, it will surely come to pass. Those who spread falsehoods and exploit others for personal gain will not escape accountability. The truth will always triumph, and justice will be served in due time.



#TBJoshua #BBCAfricaEye #RTSAwardControversy #MediaManipulation #SCOANBuildingCollapse #JournalismEthics

title: RELATIONSHIP GIVES RESULTS
text: John 15:5 says, “I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in Me, and I in him, bears much fruit; for without Me you can do nothing.”We all desire results, but many fail to realise that true success comes from a strong relationship with God. Prophet TB Joshua said, “I took care of the depth of my relationship with God; Jesus took care of the breadth of my success.” This means that when we prioritise our spiritual connection, God handles the results.Satan’s greatest aim is to sever our relationship with God. Prophet TB Joshua said, “The greatest thing satan aims at in tempting God’s people is to overthrow their position as children of God.” To strengthen our relationship with God, we need His Word and Spirit. “We are only made spiritual by living in the Word and by the Word living in us.” – TB Joshua. Studying, meditation and obeying God’s Word bring us closer to Him.Prayer sustains our relationship. As Prophet TB Joshua said, “Prayer is a relationship that exists between God and His children.” Through prayer, we align with God’s will and receive strength to overcome challenges.Prayer: Heavenly Father, help me grow in my relationship with You. May I abide in Your Word and remain faithful in prayer, in Jesus’ name. Amen.#devotional

title: OVERCOME STRESS!
text: Stress has become a common aspect of our modern lives, affecting our physical and mental well-being. Stress can arise from many sources such as work pressures, financial difficulties, relationship issues, or health challenges. However, stress often originates from our fear, anxiety, and lack of trust in God’s providence. Regardless, stress will wear us down physically, emotionally, and spiritually. We need to be armed with a plan for dealing with it.God is not necessarily interested in removing difficulty from our lives. He is, however, interested in making us like Jesus. The life of Christ was anything but stress-free. And yet, He is the one who offers us His easy yoke and light burden. In the book of 𝐉𝐨𝐡𝐧 𝟏𝟒:𝟐𝟕, Jesus promised, “𝐏𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐈 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐌𝐲 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐈 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐝𝐨 𝐈 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮. 𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐝, 𝐧𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐥𝐞𝐭 𝐢𝐭 𝐛𝐞 𝐚𝐟𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐝.”. One practical way to manage stress is prayer and believing in God’s promises. As Christians, we pray because we believe in a loving God who has a perfect plan for our lives and cares for us. Another helpful tool for managing stress is rest and renewal. Christ Jesus recognized the importance of rest and maintaining spiritual, mental, emotional, and physical health. In 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝟔:𝟑𝟏, Jesus tells His disciples, “𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐚𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐛𝐲 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐚 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐞.” Finally, you can view stress and anxiety as an opportunity for growth and maturity in your life and faith. For each obstacle we face, there is a lot of experience we acquire. In the book of 𝐉𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐬 𝟏:𝟐-𝟒, the Apostle suggests that trials should be met with joy because the true Christian the pressure is not seen as a burden but rather as an opportunity to grow stronger in faith. 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Father, give me Your wisdom so I can manage my life, understand Your ways and leave my burdens to You. Teach me how to rest in Your peace, maintain calmness and carry your light to this troubled world in Jesus’ name, amen!”#PeaceOfMind #HaveFaith

title: TRUE WORSHIP
text:
Matthew 15:8-9 states, “These people draw near to Me with their mouth, and honour Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me. And in vain they worship Me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.”



True worship goes beyond mere words and rituals; it involves a deep, heartfelt connection with God. It must be performed in Spirit and in Truth, requiring the total surrender of our lives to Him. It means joyfully giving back to God all that He has given us—our strength, time, honour, and resources.



True worship is not limited to singing, dancing, or clapping; it also encompasses acts of service that flow from the heart. It demands the full engagement of our hearts and complete surrender to God, inviting the Holy Spirit to guide our thoughts, actions, and intentions. By worshipping in Spirit and in Truth, we align ourselves with God’s will and reflect His love and grace in our lives.



True worship sets us apart from the world, as it calls us to live lives that are not of this world. It involves inviting God into every aspect of our daily lives and recognising that everything we have comes from Him. Our talents, time, strength, and material possessions are all gifts from God, and true worship means returning these gifts to Him with joy. Therefore, if worship is not in Spirit, it cannot be in Truth, rendering it meaningless. True worship acknowledges God’s sovereignty over all aspects of our lives and marks us as His children who live for His glory rather than our own desires.



Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to worship You in Spirit and Truth. Guide me to give You my time, my life, and my strength wholeheartedly. May my worship be a true reflection of my love for You and a testament to Your grace in my life. In Jesus’ name, Amen.



#devotional

title: ARE YOU PREPARED?
text: Matthew 24:42 says, “Therefore keep watch because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.”Are you prepared for the return of our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ? As believers, we are called to live in a constant state of readiness—ever watchful for the moment when He will come again.Preparedness is not just about anticipating a future event; it’s about aligning our hearts and minds with the will of God every single day. In a world filled with distractions and material temptations, it’s easy to lose sight of our ultimate goal. Yet we must remember: our time on earth is temporary, and our true home lies beyond what we can see.Consider the uncertainty surrounding the return of our Lord. The Bible urges us to live in vigilance and expectation, always prepared for His glorious coming. Revelation 22:11–13, 20 reminds us of the urgency of living with eternity in mind.If Jesus were to return today, would you be ready to meet Him?Each day, we must live intentionally—ensuring that our actions align with the pursuit of God’s Kingdom. Reflect on your life and ask yourself: Am I living in a way that secures my place in eternity? Our choices today shape our tomorrow. What will Jesus find you doing when He returns? The lives we live now will determine our judgment and eternal destiny.As Christians, let us live each day with purpose, knowing that our actions carry eternal weight. Colossians 3:2 exhorts us: “Set your minds on things above, not on earthly things.” By fixing our gaze on the eternal, we prepare our hearts for the glorious return of our Saviour.May we encourage one another to stay faithful, to seek God’s will, and to be ever ready for the day we meet Him face to face.#devotional

title: WE ARE STRONGER TOGETHER!
text: From the very beginning, God made it clear that it is not good for man to be alone (𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟐:𝟏𝟖). We were created for connection, not solitude. Isolation may seem safe, but it weakens our spiritual and emotional defences, leaving us vulnerable to doubt, temptation, and despair.The truth is that we are not made to be alone; history has also shown time and time again that there is power in unity. It is also God’s will for us. More specifically, 𝐄𝐜𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝟒:𝟗-𝟏𝟎 reminds us of the strength found in community: “𝐓𝐰𝐨 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐧𝐞, 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐚 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝 𝐫𝐞𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐢𝐫 𝐥𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐫: 𝐈𝐟 𝐞𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦 𝐟𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬 𝐝𝐨𝐰𝐧, 𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐡𝐞𝐥𝐩 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐮𝐩.”This means that because life is filled with challenges, we are never meant to face them alone. Although we should always run to Jesus in the midst of trouble, He places people in our lives to encourage us, teach us, and sharpen us in faith. Indeed, if your goal is to grow in your walk with God, you should remember that our relationship with God depends, far more than we think, upon our adjustment to one another. Even our Lord, Jesus Christ, trusted His disciples to grow His ministry–He did not walk alone, isolated, without interacting with others.This is a sign for you to invest in meaningful relationships! If you’ve been feeling distant or alone, know that God’s design for you is community. Allow others to walk with you on this journey. After all, we are the body of Christ! We are meant to stand together, not apart!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, Jesus, please help me recognise the people You have given me as family in Christ. Whenever I feel like staying from everyone and everything, open my eyes so I can see Your will for me. Help me reflect Your love through my relationships and teach me to live in unity with everyone, in Jesus’ name!”#Unity #Community #Strength

title: HAPPY PALM SUNDAY! ‐2025
text: On this Palm Sunday, we remember the day our Lord Jesus Christ entered Jerusalem, seated on a donkey, as the crowds welcomed Him with palm branches and shouts of praise.𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟐𝟏:𝟓: “𝐒𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐚𝐮𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐙𝐢𝐨𝐧, ‘𝐁𝐞𝐡𝐨𝐥𝐝, 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐡𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐞, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐨𝐧 𝐚 𝐝𝐨𝐧𝐤𝐞𝐲, 𝐨𝐧 𝐚 𝐜𝐨𝐥𝐭, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐨𝐟 𝐚 𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐛𝐮𝐫𝐝𝐞𝐧.’”Yet what is the meaning of this day?This day, this moment, was not just a celebration but a powerful declaration of Jesus as the promised Messiah—not a conquering king seeking earthly power, but the Servant King, humble and obedient to the will of His Father. He rode toward His destiny with full knowledge of what was to come—His suffering, crucifixion, and gave Himself away for our sake nonetheless. His mission was never about material or political gain, but about the salvation of our souls!So let us ask ourselves: Have we given Jesus His proper position in our hearts as our Saviour, Redeemer, and King of Kings? How have we responded to His love?May this day remind us that Jesus did not come just to be praised for a moment, but to reign in our hearts for eternity! #PalmSunday #Messiah

title: YOU CAN THANK GOD FOR PROBLEMES!
text: It’s easy to look at our past struggles and hardships with regret or frustration. But have you ever stopped to thank God for them? The very situations that broke you, the pain that seemed unbearable—those were the things that led you to Jesus. Without them, would you have sought Him as eagerly as you did?Surely, God’s plan for us is not to suffer and be surrounded by one problem or the other. But the Bible teaches us an important lesson on facing challenges through Apostle Paul. Even as a man of God, he was confronted by a difficult situation. Yet God used that situation for His purpose! Apostle Paul understood this well when he wrote in 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟗, “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐞, ‘𝐌𝐲 𝐠𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐬𝐮𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐦𝐲 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐟𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬.’ 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐨𝐚𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐠𝐥𝐚𝐝𝐥𝐲 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐦𝐲 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐬, 𝐬𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭’𝐬 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐦𝐞.” Your problems were never meant to destroy you—they were meant to drive you into the arms of the One who can heal, restore, and deliver. Beyond your present situation is revival, renewal and redemption!So today, instead of resenting the struggles, thank God for them for they brought you closer to Him! Take a moment to reflect, and you will realise it! Challenges remind you that His grace is enough. And through them, God is writing a testimony that will glorify His name and make you stronger!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank You for every challenge, every trial, and every difficulty that has drawn me closer to You. Though the journey has not always been easy, I now see that You have been with me every step of the way. I surrender my burdens to You today, and may every trial I face bring glory to Your name, in Jesus’ mighty name, amen!”#ThankGodForProblems #TrustGod

title: THE DWELLING WORD!
text: Proof Text: John 15:7 – “If you abide in Me, and My words abide in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.”The Word of God is not just meant to be read—it is meant to dwell in us. It is our direct connection to God, His voice speaking into our lives. When the Word lives in us, it shapes our thoughts, renews our minds, and guides our actions. A heart filled with God’s Word does not react based on emotion but responds according to divine instruction.To dwell in the Word is to make it our home. Many people read the Bible, but few allow the Bible to read them. When God’s Word finds a place in your heart, it produces faith—and faith unlocks the power of God in your life. As Prophet TB Joshua says, “Meditation brings revelation. When you meditate on the Word, the Holy Spirit brings it to life within you.”The Word of God is life. It transforms, heals, and delivers. It is the foundation for a victorious Christian life. When the Word dwells in us richly, we carry divine authority. We no longer struggle to overcome challenges—the Word within us fights for us.The dwelling Word is also the key to effective prayer. Jesus said that if His Word abides in us, whatever we ask will be done for us. This means that when we pray according to the Word, heaven responds. Prayer isn’t about how many words we say but about speaking God’s Word back to Him. As Prophet TB Joshua explains, “When you pray with the Word, God sees Himself in His Word—and He acts upon it.”A life that dwells in the Word is a life that dwells in God. It is a life marked by peace, power, and purpose. When the Word takes root in your heart, it bears fruit—faith that moves mountains, wisdom that orders your steps, and love that reflects Christ.Prayer:Lord Jesus, let Your Word dwell in me richly. Let it shape my thoughts, direct my actions, and strengthen my faith. Make me a living expression of Your Word. In Jesus’ Name, Amen.#devotional

title: THE EMPTY TOMB: A VICTORY THAT LIVES IN YOU!
text: The empty tomb is more than a symbol—it is a declaration! Jesus Christ has risen, proving that no chain is too strong, no night too dark, and no battle too impossible for Him to win. Jesus’ resurrection is the ultimate victory over sin, death, and essentially our own triumph over satan!What struggle feels like a grave in your life? Is it fear? Is it sickness? Hopelessness? Take heart, because the same power that raised Jesus from the dead is available to lift you up today and forever! He can turn your mourning into joy, your trials into testimonies, and your burdens into breakthroughs. The same power is alive and thriving today!𝐑𝐨𝐦𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟖:𝟏𝟏: “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐢𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮, 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐬𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐬𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐥 𝐛𝐨𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐬 𝐢𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮.”So, we wish you a Happy Easter! Let this day be a dawn of eternal strength in Jesus Christ’s supremacy. It is time to leave the grave of sorrow and despair behind and march in our God-given life in our Lord and Saviour.May your heart be filled with renewed faith and living hope, knowing that the same power that raised Jesus is alive in you today!#HappyEaster #EasterVictory #FromGraveToGlory

title: GOD IS WITH YOU IN YOUR CHALLENGES
text: Romans 8:28 (NIV)—“And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love Him, who have been called according to His purpose.”Every Christian should aspire and remain determined to walk with God, even when it requires great sacrifice. Are you sick or going through one challenge or another? Don’t give up—God will never leave you without a solution.Whatever situation you find yourself in, never assume God cannot see you through it. Why worry about your challenges when you can hand them over to the One who died on the Cross?Worry is one of the major battles we face today. Sometimes it’s obvious—you’re worried about your family, health, or finances. Other times, it’s subtle—you’re anxious about the future, uncertain about your next steps, or struggling to manage a situation that feels beyond you.The truth is, our list of worries often feels endless. But worry interferes with the work of God’s Spirit in our lives. Despite it all, God’s love for us never fails and never ends.Joseph was shown a glimpse of his future and held onto it—he refused to let his situation define or distract him. Likewise, your situation is not meant to break you but to bring you to a place of honour. Your challenge today is not a crisis—it is a friend. A man may be poor and still be a friend of Jesus. A person may be sick in body and still be a candidate for Heaven.So when life gets tough, don’t run away from God—run to Him. In our walk with Christ, there are both good and hard times, but every season has a purpose. Our challenges are meant to prepare us for the glory ahead.Take your worries to the Lord in prayer. Place your future—and every concern—in His hands, and trust that He will never leave you without a way out.For those whose lives are centered on Jesus Christ, the best is yet to come.Emmanuel!#Devotional

title: THE HOLY SPIRIT VISITATION IN SOUTH AFRICA WITH PASTOR EVELYN JOSHUA
text: Throughout the Scriptures, every Holy Spirit visitation brought about undeniable transformation. When the Holy Spirit moved, the barren conceived, the broken were restored, the blind received sight, and lives were forever changed.South Africa, your moment is here.Join Pastor Evelyn Joshua on May 16, 2025, at the Expo Centre, Johannesburg, for a revival where the Spirit of God will heal, deliver, and restore.Whatever your need, whatever your burden – come with faith. For when the Holy Spirit visits, the rest is history.Admission is freeLive on Emmanuel TVEmmanuel – God With Us.#HolySpiritVisitationwithpastorevelynjoshua#SCOANinSouthAfrica #PastorEvelynJoshua #HolySpiritVisitationSA#PastorEvelynJoshuaInSA#EvelynJoshuaLiveInSA#SCOAN #EmmanuelTV #TBJoshua#TBJoshuaMinistries

title: SPEND YOUR TIME RIGHT!
text:
Regret, spiritual weakness, and missed opportunities… Those are things that many have experienced, yet failed to recognise their role in it. In today’s fast-paced world, we’re constantly bombarded with distractions and temptations that can pull us away from our true purpose. Therefore, self-control is not just about saying no to things; it’s about saying yes to what truly matters—God’s will for our lives.



𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟐𝟓:𝟐𝟖 reminds us, “𝐋𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐜𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐰𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐤𝐞𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐢𝐬 𝐚 𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐤𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟-𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥.” But what is self-control? Is it only about avoiding harmful desires? Wrong choices and actions? Indeed, it is about saying no to distractions that rob us of time, but it’s about creating habits that lead to lasting spiritual growth.



The reality is that you should make the most out of life because life is too short to waste time on things that have no lasting value. Every moment is a precious gift from God, meant to be used wisely, watching our words, thoughts, and actions. We are called to make the most of the time we’ve been given, not to chase after fleeting pleasures, but to live with alignment to His plan!



The more we practice self-control, the more we allow God to mould us into the person He has created us to be. Therefore, let us guard our hearts and live with discipline, so that we may open the door to His eternal peace and joy!



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank You for the precious gift of life and the time You have given me. Teach me to discipline my mind and heart, so I can live with purpose, and give me more of Your self-control in all I do, in Jesus’ name!”



SelfControl #GoodChoices

title: CHRIST – THE WAY TO LIFE
text: John 14:6 says, “Jesus said to him, ‘I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’”In a world filled with confusion, brokenness and uncertainty, many are searching for purpose, peace and a reason to live. But Jesus tells us, “I am the way, the truth, and the life.” He did not say, “I will show you the way” or “I will teach you the way.” He boldly declared that He is the Way. This means that outside of Christ, there is no direction, no lasting truth and no real life.Christ died that we might receive life and life in abundance. He resurrected and is before God’s Throne, interceding for us. This life that Christ offers is eternal and open to all. Christ became a Link for us, the Way through which we reach God, our heavenly Father.This life offered to us saves us from sin, which incurs God’s wrath and puts us in right standing with God.We receive this life by accepting Jesus as our personal Lord and Saviour, that is, by believing and confessing Him to be Lord over our lives.Believing in Jesus Christ is trusting Him and confessing is speaking boldly of Him whom you trust. The moment you trust Jesus as the One who gives life in abundance, eternal life is yours.As Christians, we live because He lives and are free because of this life He gave us. Therefore, let us serve Him wholeheartedly with this life He has given to us.Prayer: Lord Jesus, I believe you are the Way, the Truth, and the Life. I accept Your life and promise to use this life You offered to serve You. Amen!

title: BRIDGE YOUR FUTURE
text: Have you ever taken the time to ponder how the universe was actually made? In 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟏:𝟑, the Bible says, “𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐝, ‘𝐋𝐞𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐛𝐞 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭,’ 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭.” God said – He spoke. He spoke, and light broke through. This wasn’t just a casual phrase. It was a divine demonstration of how power is released through words. Since we are made in His image, that means our words carry a similar creative force. What we say can either create a positive future for ourselves, build bridges toward purpose or walls of delay, or even demolish all things good in our lives. Indeed, 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐫𝐢𝐝𝐠𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞! 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟖:𝟐𝟏: “𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐭𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐮𝐞 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐟 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐡, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐬𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐞𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐭𝐬 𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭.”In other words, every time you speak, you’re setting direction. You’re either reinforcing your destiny or contradicting it. Are your words making room for healing, breakthrough, and abundance? Or are they limiting what God wants to do in your life and through you?It is time we became more aware of what we confess! We need to become intentional with what we say, starting today! Use your words to declare light over darkness, hope over fear, and life over every dead place! 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me to speak life, truth, and hope over my future. Let my speech reflect faith and not fear, love and not hatred. May every word I speak today build the future You’ve prepared for me, in Jesus’ mighty name!”   #PositiveConfession #PowerOfWords

title: GOD GRADES YOU
text: We live in a world where hard work is often praised, where results are celebrated, and effort is rewarded. But as believers, we must remember that while others may see the outside, God looks deeper—He evaluates the heart, the motive, and the spirit behind every action.For example, some days, helping others might feel like an inconvenience. Whether it’s a coworker asking for a favour or a family member needing your time, our natural response can often be one of reluctance, irritation, or silent complaints.Yet 𝐄𝐜𝐜𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝟗:𝟏𝟎 encourages us to put our whole heart into whatever task lies before us: “𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨, 𝐝𝐨 𝐢𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 […].”Today’s verse reminds us that “whatever your hand finds to do”—not just the things we like or choose, but whatever is placed before us, we are to do it with all our might. Not halfway and not grudgingly, but with a full heart and willing spirit! God is watching how we respond to responsibility, especially when it doesn’t benefit us directly. He sees when we help a friend in need, when we go the extra mile at work, when we serve quietly behind the scenes. And He doesn’t just see the action, He sees the attitude. 𝐀𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤, 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐦𝐚𝐫𝐤 𝐢𝐭.Thus, today, instead of saying “Why me?” try saying “Use me!”. Complaining in our service not only robs others of the blessing but also robs us of the reward. God delights in a cheerful giver, not just of money, but of time, effort, and heart!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, teach me to work with a joyful heart and see every opportunity as a chance to honour You. Help me to do even the smallest tasks with excellence without complaining, but with a loving heart, in Jesus’ mighty name!” #GodGradesYou #HeartOfService

title: GOD’S TIME IS THE BEST TIME
text: Ecclesiastes 3:1-4—“There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.”Whatever you’re facing today may not exist tomorrow — seasons change. As believers, we must trust in God’s perfect timing and stay patient. The best way to do this is by investing your time in God’s Word. “I took care of the depth of my relationship with God and Jesus took care of the breadth of my success.” — TB Joshua.Don’t waste time complaining or envying others. Instead, grow your relationship with God — that’s the greatest gift you can give yourself. People of God, give your time to Him, and in due season, He will grant your heart’s desires.You may feel delayed, but Jesus said, “I will restore all your wasted years.” Keep working hard, pray faithfully, and leave the outcome to God. When you trust His timing, you won’t murmur or compare yourself with others.At God’s appointed time, everything becomes beautiful. He may be preserving you for something greater. “For those whose lives are centered on Jesus Christ, the best is yet to come.” — TB Joshua.#Devotional

title: A Glorious Move of God: Holy Spirit Visitation with Pastor Evelyn Joshua in South Africa
text:
Multitudes of expectant worshippers from across South Africa and around the world gathered at the Johannesburg Expo Centre on May 16, 2025for a powerful and life-changing encounter with God during the Holy Spirit Visitation with Pastor Evelyn Joshua. The event, hosted by the Leader of The Synagogue, Church Of All Nations (SCOAN), Pastor Evelyn Joshua, was filled with the tangible presence of the Holy Spirit from beginning to end.



From the moment the event began, the presence of God swept through the massive crowd. Worship and praise filled the air, and the spiritual atmosphere was electrified with faith and anticipation. Hearts were open and ready for divine healing, deliverance, and restoration. Many who came burdened left with testimonies, declaring that their lives had been forever transformed.



Pastor Evelyn Joshua, accompanied by SCOAN Evangelists, arrived at the venue to begin what was clearly a prophetic mission. As she took the stage, the power of God was evident—chains were broken, sicknesses were healed, and spirits were lifted.



As the ministration unfolded, the Lord confirmed His Word with signs and wonders. Pastor Evelyn Joshua and the evangelists prayed for the sick and oppressed, and many received instant healing and deliverance. Afflictions bowed to the authority of Jesus Christ. What was seen at the Johannesburg Expo Centre was not ordinary—it was truly the hand of God at work.



Testimonies soon followed. People shared how long-standing issues had disappeared, how their faith was renewed, and how they encountered Jesus Christ in a deeply personal way. The echoes of revival resounded through every corner of the venue, confirming that God’s power knows no boundaries.



Emmanuel TV Partners Meeting: A Family in Faith



In another significant moment, the Emmanuel TV Partners Meeting in South Africa was a time of spiritual renewal and heartfelt celebration. Partners joyfully welcomed Pastor Evelyn Joshua, who addressed them with a powerful message. She reminded them that they are vital to the ongoing mission of touching lives and changing nations—an assignment that began with the late Prophet T.B. Joshua, and which continues under her humble leadership.



Quoting Ecclesiastes 4:12, Pastor Evelyn Joshua described the partners as a “threefold cord” that cannot be broken. The meeting featured Spirit-led prayer, ministration, and the distribution of thoughtful gifts from the Emmanuel TV family.



In her words, she emphasized humility, saying, “All boasting is excluded. We cannot take credit for what we do for God—it is He who enables us.” To God alone be the glory.



Clean Water for Ga Kubu, Mafikeng



As part of her mission to meet both spiritual and physical needs, Pastor Evelyn Joshua, along with Emmanuel TV Partners, brought hope to the village of Ga Kubu in Mafikeng, a community that had long suffered from water scarcity. A brand-new borehole was commissioned, bringing clean and accessible water to the residents.



This humanitarian act reflected the heart of the Emmanuel TV mission: “Where there is need, we go.” Today, thanks to this outreach, clean water flows freely in Ga Kubu, and hope is restored.



Humanitarian Outreach to Madibe, Mafikeng



Beyond the main event, Pastor Evelyn Joshua and the Emmanuel TV team also conducted a heartfelt humanitarian outreach to Madibe, Mafikeng. Welcomed warmly by the Tshidi-Barolong king, Pastor Joshua toured the community and learned about its rich cultural heritage.



Residents received essential items including:




Food supplies



Educational materials for children



Bedding



A R100,000 donation to support community welfare




This outreach is yet another reflection of the love-driven mission of Emmanuel TV: to go where there is need, bringing help, hope, and healing.



As Pastor Evelyn Joshua concluded her 2025 revival mission in South Africa and departed the beautiful nation, one thing was clear: a revival had been ignited in the hearts of many. The memories, miracles, and moments will remain with those who attended, reminding them that when the Holy Spirit visits, nothing remains the same.



Lives were changed. Hope was restored. The power of Jesus Christ was made manifest—and South Africa will never forget this divine visitation.















#HolySpiritVisitationWithPastorEvelynJoshua #EmmanuelTVspotlight #SCOANinSouthAfrica #PastorEvelynJoshua #HolySpiritVisitationSA #PastorEvelynJoshuaInSA #EvelynJoshuaLiveInSA #SCOAN #EmmanuelTV #TBJoshua #TBJoshuaMinistries #TBJoshuaLegacy

title: LOOK AHEAD
text: Failure has a way of sticking to us like glue. It whispers lies that tell us we’re disqualified, pushed aside, or unworthy of good things and a bright future. But Apostle Paul reminds us in the following powerful passage that the past—no matter how painful or messy—doesn’t have the final say.𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟑:𝟏𝟑–𝟏𝟒: “𝐅𝐨𝐫𝐠𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐝 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐚𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐝, 𝐈 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐠𝐨𝐚𝐥 𝐭𝐨 𝐰𝐢𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐳𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐰𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐬 𝐜𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐦𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐰𝐚𝐫𝐝 𝐢𝐧 𝐂𝐡𝐫𝐢𝐬𝐭 𝐉𝐞𝐬𝐮𝐬.”The same Apostle Paul who once persecuted Christians didn’t let his failures keep him from running his race. He knew that God’s calling is bigger than any of our mistakes! And the truth is that 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐥𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐦 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐥𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐩𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐢𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐞𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐡𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐬𝐮𝐜𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬. They refine your character, increase your endurance, and prepare you for the extent of the success God has in store! So today, stop replaying the moment you fell and know that you don’t have to carry the weight of yesterday into tomorrow. Start focusing on the God who is calling you forward and look ahead! 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me to release the weight of past failures. Teach me to see them as lessons for my personal growth. Give me the strength to never quit and the courage to trust Your calling on my life, in Jesus’ name, amen.”#LookAhead #ItsNotOverYet

title: HOLD ON TO YOUR CONVICTION OF GOD
text:
Hebrews 10:23 says,



 “Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.”We live in a world where everyone is exposed to things that are not consistent with God’s Word. This is why we need to draw closer to God and get to know Him more. Prophet T.B. Joshua said, “If you are reasoned into Christianity, some wise fellow can reason you out.” Many today have been reasoned out of Christianity. They feel like God has not answered their prayers and many feel ashamed to stand out for God because of what people around them will say. They lack the conviction to stand out for Christ.Conviction is the foundation of a true Christian life. Without it, we are easily swayed by circumstances, public opinion and the challenges of life. Many have fallen away from the faith because they lacked deep inner conviction. Prophet T.B. Joshua said, “Faith is a conviction.” This means that conviction is the unshakeable confidence and firm inner belief in God’s Word, even when circumstances seem uncertain, prayers go unanswered, trials and temptations arise, and people stand against your belief. When we have conviction, we stand firm like Daniel in Babylon, unshaken by threats. Like the three Hebrew boys, we boldly declare our stand even in the face of death. Conviction gives us the courage to say no to compromise, to endure hardship, and to live with eternity in view even when the world offers temporary pleasures. A Christian without conviction will easily bow to pressure, but one who is convinced of God’s truth will remain unmovable.There’s only one way to build conviction, and that is by studying God’s Word. We must spend time daily and learn at Jesus’ feet until our mentality becomes like that of Christ. Conviction grows through intimacy with God’s Word. The Holy Spirit also plays a vital role in helping our conviction. He reminds us of the truth and strengthens us to stand firmly. Remember that conviction is not just words; it is action. The more you practise what you believe, the deeper your conviction becomes.Prayer: Lord Jesus, increase my faith in You. Help me to hold fast to my conviction of faith. Amen!#Devotional

title: BRAVE THE STORM
text: God doesn’t promise the absence of storms — He promises His presence in the middle of them.Life’s challenges often come unannounced, hitting hard and fast like crashing waves. But no matter how fierce the storm, God’s promise remains unshaken: “𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐈 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐲𝐨𝐮; 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐩𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐫𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐬𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐩 𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮 […]” (𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟑:𝟐).Indeed, if we observe carefully, God’s Word does not say “if”, but “when”. When we pass through the storm, which means when we go through hardship. And hardship often comes unannounced, unexpectedly, and every time, it may feel like a tidal wave we have never faced before. It may feel like we are the only ones faced with uncommon and rare problems, but we ought to remember this: Anytime you are face to face with uncommon challenges, do not lose heart. They may be to prepare you for the uncommon blessings that are waiting ahead of you because uncommon blessings always attract uncommon challenges. That battle you’re in might just be the preparation ground for the breakthrough ahead. So don’t lose heart! Although you cannot control the storm sometimes, you have the privilege to trust the One who can! 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me not to fear the storm but to face it with faith, knowing You are with me. Give me strength to endure, wisdom to grow, and courage to walk through every challenge with confidence. I trust that You are working all things for my good. In Jesus’ name, amen!”#BraveTheStorm #GodIsWithYou

title: PROPHET TB JOSHUA: FOUR YEARS ON!
categories: PROPHET TB JOSHUA CALL TO GLORY
text:
On June 5, 2021, God called home His illustrious servant, Prophet Temitope Balogun Joshua, the General Overseer of The Synagogue, Church Of All Nations – SCOAN.



Although our hearts were heavy with the pain of loss, we took solace in knowing that everything happens at God’s appointed time.



Four years on, the exemplary life of Prophet TB Joshua continues to inspire millions across the world – beyond barriers of creed, colour and character.



Four years on, his legacy of faith, love and charity suffices to supplant vice with virtue, hunger with fullness, and lack with abundance.



Four years on, we can confirm that the age of miracles has not passed!



Today, we celebrate a worthy General in the Army of Salvation.



Thank You, Lord, for helping Your servant to finish well!



Rest on, Prophet TB Joshua!



TBJoshua #ProphetTBJoshua #TBJoshuaLegacy #TBJoshuaLegacyLivesOn #EmmanuelTV #SCOAN #ServantOfGod

title: HONOURING A LIFE LIVED FOR CHRIST’S SAKE!
text: On this day, we ought to honour the life and legacy of a man who walked in obedience, love, and divine purpose, Prophet T.B. Joshua, on the fourth anniversary of his transition to glory.This is not just a day of remembrance, but a moment of deep reflection — to recall the countless lives he touched, the hope he restored, and the faith he ignited in the hearts of millions across the world. Through his unwavering dedication to God and humanity, he showed us a genuine example of Christ’s character in action.Indeed, he taught us what real love is like, not just through his words, but also through a life of tireless service. Whether through his prophetic insight, acts of charity, or humble spirit, he exemplified what it means to live for God and for others, making his life a living sermon.Indeed, Prophet T.B. Joshua was sent by God Almighty to remind us that true greatness is found in serving without expecting, giving without limits, and loving without conditions. As we celebrate his legacy today, let us rejoice in the fruit of his labour — the countless testimonies, transformed lives, and enduring impact that continues to inspire the children of God around the globe!“𝑇ℎ𝑒 𝑔𝑟𝑒𝑎𝑡𝑒𝑠𝑡 𝑤𝑎𝑦 𝑡𝑜 𝑢𝑠𝑒 𝑙𝑖𝑓𝑒 𝑖𝑠 𝑡𝑜 𝑠𝑝𝑒𝑛𝑑 𝑖𝑡 𝑜𝑛 𝑠𝑜𝑚𝑒𝑡ℎ𝑖𝑛𝑔 𝑡ℎ𝑎𝑡 𝑤𝑖𝑙𝑙 𝑜𝑢𝑡𝑙𝑖𝑣𝑒 𝑖𝑡.” – Prophet T.B. Joshua#TBJoshuaLegacy #TheLegacyLivesOn #ProphetTBJoshua

title: BY THEIR FRUIT
text: Have you ever met someone who never told you they were a Christian, but you could just tell?Something about their peace, their calm in chaos, their patience under pressure, their kindness to strangers. They didn’t have to say it. They lived it! However, many of us, even if we show up to church every Sunday and shout “Hallelujah!” louder than everyone, keep an unforgiving heart with no peace and this is not what sets us apart as children of God.𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟐𝟐-𝟐𝟑: “𝐁𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐮𝐢𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞, 𝐣𝐨𝐲, 𝐩𝐞𝐚𝐜𝐞, 𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐛𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐜𝐞, 𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐟𝐚𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐟𝐮𝐥𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬, 𝐠𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐟-𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐥. 𝐀𝐠𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭 𝐬𝐮𝐜𝐡 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐧𝐨 𝐥𝐚𝐰.”This verse makes us understand that by their fruit, character and attitude to life we know who the children of God are: They are never anxious for anything. People know we belong to Jesus by how we live our every day life, not just where we go on Sundays.Do you walk in love even when it costs you? Do you have joy even in hardship? Are you cultivating a spirit of goodness, faithfulness and self-control? As you reflect on this message, may today be the day people start seeing not just religion in you, but a life that honours, imitates and reflects Christ Himself!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I want to live a life that reflects You. Cultivate Your Spirit’s fruit in my life—let it grow in my heart and show in every area of my life! Let my life be the evidence of Your presence. In Jesus’ name, amen!”#FruitOfTheSpirit #BeLikeChrist

title: TRUST IN GOD’S PROMISES
text: Proverbs 3:5-6 says, “Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and lean not on your own understanding; In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He shall direct your paths.”For those who place their faith in Jesus Christ, brighter days are always ahead. Yet, in moments of adversity, many find themselves questioning the reliability of God’s Word. It’s easy to fall prey to doubts planted by the devil, who whispers, ‘Does God truly care for you? If He loves you, why are you facing hardships? Why hasn’t the breakthrough come yet?’ These are tactics designed to challenge your confidence in the Word of God.In Matthew 4:1-11, when satan attempted to tempt Jesus, he said, ‘If you are the Son of God, command these stones to become bread.’ But Jesus responded powerfully, saying, ‘Man shall not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of God.’ This interaction illustrates a key truth: satan’s strategy often revolves around making us question God’s promises, urging us to focus on what we lack rather than the abundance of blessings we’ve already been given.As followers of Christ, tests and trials are not foreign to us. God’s promise is not to keep us immune to difficulties but to guide us through them. Too often, we forget the miracles and blessings of the past when faced with present challenges, letting doubt creep into our hearts when answers don’t come quickly.It’s important to remember that doubting God’s Word limits His ability to act in our lives. Reflecting on the ways God has worked in your past will strengthen your faith and help you trust Him for your current needs. When circumstances seem bleak and your situation speaks louder than His promises, resist the temptation to give up or question His truth.Your situation may have its own voice, filling your mind with discouragement and trying to convince you to abandon your faith. However, God’s Word remains the ultimate authority, surpassing any earthly hardships and doubts. Stand firm in the knowledge that His promises are steadfast and that He is always faithful to fulfil them. Today, let His Word be the foundation of your hope and trust that He will see you through, in Jesus’ name.#Devotional

title: A BEACON OF LIGHT AND SERVICE!
text: Today we honour the birth of a remarkable man, Prophet T. B. Joshua, who was born 62 years ago. Although he is now gone to our Heavenly Father, the impact of his teachings, his legacy, and his deep love for God and humankind continue to resonate deeply.Prophet T. B. Joshua showed us a genuine example and the power of being obedient to God’s calling, and we give all glory to Him for we still see the fruit of his work nowadays, more abundantly than ever! Indeed, his example continues to inspire countless individuals and leaves an enduring mark on a world yearning for genuine compassion and guidance towards the light.His life embodied the truth that perseverance in Christ leads to victory and history being made!Let us therefore be inspired by his lifestyle of service and compassion. May we, as children of the Most-High God, imitate his profound devotion for God and His Word, ensuring that his influence continues to uplift and transform lives, bringing glory to the name of Jesus Christ in every corner of the earth!#ProphetTBJoshua #AGreatProphetWasBorn

title: The Emmanuel TV Hybrid Set-Top Box: A Revolutionary Way to Watch Emmanuel TV
text:
On June 12, 2025, a special event took place at the Faith Resort prayer mountain in Lagos, Nigeria—the official launch of The Emmanuel TV Hybrid Set-Top Box. This day was even more meaningful because it marked what would have been Prophet T.B. Joshua’s 62nd birthday.



This new device is a breakthrough in TV technology, designed specifically for Emmanuel TV viewers and the global Christian community. It offers advanced features that make watching TV easier, clearer, and more interactive than ever before.



What Makes the Emmanuel TV Hybrid Box Special?



This is not just an ordinary TV decoder—it is the first of its kind in the world, built to give users the best experience when watching Emmanuel TV. Here are some of its amazing features:



Supports 400+ Languages with AI Subtitles: No matter what language you speak, this device allows you to watch content in your preferred language. Using AI-powered subtitles, it translates broadcasts into over 400 languages, making it accessible to people worldwide.



Voice-Controlled Remote: Tired of typing or searching for channels manually? The voice prompt feature lets you simply speak into the remote to find the content you want—hands-free!



Turns Any TV into a Smart TV: You don’t need an expensive smart TV to enjoy high-quality streaming. Just connect the Emmanuel TV Hybrid Box to your TV using an HDMI cable, and it instantly upgrades your viewing experience.



Works with Internet & Satellite (Hybrid Connection): Unlike regular decoders, this device supports both internet and satellite connections—and you can use them at the same time! This means you’ll always have a stable connection, whether you’re streaming online or watching via satellite.



Record, Rewind, and Pause Live TV (PVR Feature): Missed your favorite program? No problem! The Personal Video Recorder (PVR) feature lets you record live TV, rewind, fast-forward, or pause, so you never miss a moment.



Ultra-HD 4K Picture Quality: Experience crystal-clear visuals with 4K Ultra HD resolution, far better than standard HD. Every sermon, prayer, and miracle moment will look sharper and more lifelike.



No Subscription Fees – Plug and Play: Once you buy the Emmanuel TV Hybrid Box, there are no extra charges—no monthly fees, no hidden costs. Just plug it in, connect to Wi-Fi (if available), and start watching!



A Tribute to Prophet T.B. Joshua’s Legacy



This innovation was made possible under the leadership of Pastor Evelyn Joshua, who has continued to advance the vision of Emmanuel TV after the passing of Prophet T.B. Joshua. Supporters around the world have expressed gratitude for her dedication, as this device brings the church’s message to millions in a more powerful and accessible way.



The Emmanuel TV Hybrid Box is more than just technology—it’s a tool for global unity. With its multilingual support and high-quality streaming, believers from different nations can now connect more deeply with the teachings of SCOAN (The Synagogue Church Of All Nations).

If you’re looking for a better, smarter, and more affordable way to enjoy your favorite Christian programs, this device is the perfect solution!
