It calls us to mirror God’s love in flesh and bones; a love that reflects His heart in deeds and words alike. So, this year, be the change! May your kindness and generosity speak for themselves, becoming a living testimony of Christ breathing and acting through you!



Therefore, the Christian Church Of All Nations wholeheartedly wishes you a Merry Christmas, full of God’s presence and grace surrounding your days and loved ones as His love continues to unfold to the world through your life.



#MerryChristmas2025#MeaningOfChristmas

title: GOD’S FAITHFULNESS
text: Your attitude while you wait reveals far more than the words you speak—it reflects the depth of your trust in God. Waiting is often uncomfortable; yet when we complain, it is usually rooted in fear, and it is then that we begin to believe the answer may never come or that God’s promise might pass us by.  But patience flows from a heart convinced that God is present and purposeful in every delay. In the waiting, He is shaping us, strengthening us, and preparing us for what He has already prepared for us.Patience is not passive; it is an active expression of faith. It is choosing steadiness when our emotions tug us toward worry. It is choosing trust when circumstances fall silent. Because the opening of our eyes of faith is the silencing of our fears. Take a few moments to reflect: Is the way you respond in seasons of waiting drawing you toward fear and panic, or is it increasing your faith and leading you closer to God?Take a few moments to reflect: Is the way you respond in seasons of waiting drawing you toward fear and panic, or is it increasing your faith and leading you closer to God?The Bible instructs us in 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦 𝟑𝟕:𝟕, “𝑩𝒆 𝒔𝒕𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒃𝒆𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒂𝒊𝒕 𝒑𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒆𝒏𝒕𝒍𝒚 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝑯𝒊𝒎.” This means aligning your heart with His presence while you wait. It’s an invitation to quiet your anxieties, tune your thoughts to truth, and receive His peace that surpasses understanding.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, teach me to wait with trust rather than fear. Calm my heart, steady my steps, and help me see Your purpose in every delay. Strengthen my faith so that my waiting becomes worship. Amen.”#FaithJourney #TrustInGod #SpiritualGrowth

title: HOPE IN HIS HANDS!
text: Before sleep, even the quietest moments can become holy spaces, moments where our thoughts slow down enough for our hearts to speak. Ending the day in prayer and self-reflection allows us to pause, breathe, and recognise God’s presence in every part of our journey. When we thank Him for the blessings we received and the challenges we faced, we acknowledge His constant guidance.It is also a time to ask for forgiveness for any unkind words, rushed decisions, or moments where we faltered. This gentle honesty not only cleanses the heart but reshapes our character. Through reflection, we notice patterns, intentions, and opportunities to grow.God sees and understands everything we carry, even the thoughts we never speak. When God sees you, He sees something that everyone else ignores. As 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟏𝟑𝟗:𝟐-𝟒 says, “𝒀𝒐𝒖 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒘𝒉𝒆𝒏 𝑰 𝒔𝒊𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒘𝒉𝒆𝒏 𝑰 𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒆; 𝒀𝒐𝒖 𝒑𝒆𝒓𝒄𝒆𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒎𝒚 𝒕𝒉𝒐𝒖𝒈𝒉𝒕𝒔 𝒇𝒓𝒐𝒎 𝒂𝒇𝒂𝒓.” This truth reminds us that prayer is not about informing God, it is about transforming us.When we surrender our day into His hands, we rest not only physically but spiritually. Tomorrow becomes less intimidating because we entrust it to the One who never sleeps.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, as I come to the end of this day, I thank You for every blessing, every lesson, and every breath You allowed me to experience. Forgive me for the moments where I fell short, and help me grow into a more loving, patient, and faithful person. Calm my thoughts, renew my spirit, and let me rest in Your peace. Guide my steps tomorrow and strengthen my heart to reflect Your love. Amen.”#SpiritualReflection #GratitudeToGod #HopeInHim

title: RELEASE THE BITTER ROOT!
text: The Bible warns us in 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟏𝟓: “𝑺𝒆𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒊𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒏𝒐 𝒐𝒏𝒆 𝒇𝒂𝒍𝒍𝒔 𝒔𝒉𝒐𝒓𝒕 𝒐𝒇 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒈𝒓𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒐𝒇 𝑮𝒐𝒅, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒏𝒐 𝒃𝒊𝒕𝒕𝒆𝒓 𝒓𝒐𝒐𝒕 𝒈𝒓𝒐𝒘𝒔 𝒖𝒑 𝒕𝒐 𝒄𝒂𝒖𝒔𝒆 𝒕𝒓𝒐𝒖𝒃𝒍𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒅𝒆𝒇𝒊𝒍𝒆 𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒚.” What happens when bitterness is allowed to remain in the heart?Life offers pain, disappointment, and rejection, but how we respond determines whether we grow or remain stuck. Bitterness is a silent chain that binds us to the past. When we hold on to offences, we unknowingly block the blessings and breakthroughs God desires for us.Bitterness clutters the heart and clouds our vision. God cannot pour new blessings into a heart filled with resentment, and unforgiveness due to offence is one of the traps satan, the enemy of our souls, uses to hold us in bondage! When we refuse to forgive, we give bitterness permission to take root, keeping us tied to past wounds and preventing God’s grace from flowing freely.Forgiveness is the doorway to freedom. When we surrender bitterness, we open ourselves to restoration, peace, and spiritual growth. Bitterness spreads like a hidden root beneath the surface; if left unattended, it can slowly poison relationships, steal joy, and hinder our ability to hear God clearly.Letting go isn’t easy, but God gives grace to release and heal. When we forgive, chains break, peace enters, and the heart becomes free to receive God’s next move. Releasing bitterness positions us to experience His presence, walk in His power, and receive the blessings He desires to pour out.Choose freedom today. Allow God to uproot bitterness and restore your heart! What hidden bitterness or past hurt might God be asking you to surrender so He can move you forward?🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, search my heart and reveal any bitterness I may be holding on to. Give me the courage to forgive, even when it feels difficult. Help me release past hurts and embrace Your healing grace. Soften my heart, renew my spirit, and free me from anything standing between me and Your blessings. Break every chain of offence the enemy has used to hold me captive. I choose peace, restoration, and Your perfect love. In Jesus’ name, Amen.”#RealaseTheRoot #ForgivenessHeals #BitternessFree

title: THANKFUL IN EVERY SEASON!
text: Thankfulness is more than a polite response, it is a powerful spiritual posture. A thankful heart doesn’t just change your mood; it changes your perspective. When you choose to live with a thankful spirit, your eyes begin to open to the ways God is moving in your life. When your focus shifts from what you still desire to what God has already done, your spirit finds rest in His faithfulness.But, complaining is what keeps our eyes locked on what’s missing. Thankfulness lifts our gaze to what is already present. It reminds us that even in hard seasons, God is still good! Even in uncertainty, He is still working! Even in silence, He is still near! And if the situation you are in now does not guarantee your future, do not despair, the end has not yet come, the best is always yet to come. A thankful heart becomes fertile ground where peace takes root, joy rises, and trust grows deeper.The Bible reminds us in 𝟏 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐨𝐧𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟏𝟖: “𝑮𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔 𝒊𝒏 𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒄𝒊𝒓𝒄𝒖𝒎𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒏𝒄𝒆𝒔; 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒊𝒔 𝑮𝒐𝒅’𝒔 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒊𝒏 𝑪𝒉𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝑱𝒆𝒔𝒖𝒔”. Notice, it doesn’t say to give thanks only when life is easy, comfortable, or predictable. It says in all circumstances! That’s where thankfulness becomes faith in action.Today, choose to live with a thankful heart on purpose. Thank God not only for the blessings you can clearly see, but also for the ones unfolding quietly behind the scenes. When you do, you’ll discover that blessings truly do flow through a thankful heart.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, thank You for every blessing, seen and unseen. Teach my heart to remain thankful in every season of my life. Open my eyes to Your daily workaround, and let my heart overflow with praise, no matter the circumstance. In Jesus’ name, Amen. ”#Thankfulness #AllTimeGratitude #GratefulHeart

title: AN OPEN-DOOR PRAYER!
text: Prayer is not meant to feel distant or complicated. It’s an open invitation for God to step into the rhythm of your everyday life. You don’t need special words or perfect timing—just a willing heart that makes space for Him in ordinary moments. Prayer is a salve for every sore, a remedy for every malady, gently meeting you right where you are.God desires to be present in the small details of your day: your thoughts, your choices, your conversations, and even your worries! When you speak to Him honestly and often, you acknowledge that you don’t have to carry life alone. Scripture reminds us of this truth: “𝑰𝒏 𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒘𝒂𝒚𝒔 𝒔𝒖𝒃𝒎𝒊𝒕 𝒕𝒐 𝒉𝒊𝒎, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒎𝒂𝒌𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒑𝒂𝒕𝒉𝒔 𝒔𝒕𝒓𝒂𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕.” 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟑:𝟔. Prayer becomes less about formality and more about relationship—healing, strengthening, and restoring as you walk with Him.Inviting God in daily helps shift your awareness. You begin to notice His guidance, peace, and comfort woven into simple routines. As you include Him in everything, your faith grows naturally—right where you are.🙏 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I invite You into every part of my day today. Be present in my thoughts, my actions, and my conversations. Teach me to walk with You in the ordinary moments and trust You in all things. Amen!”#EverydayPrayer #InviteGodIn #PrayerLife

title: DELAY IS NOT DENIAL!
text: Ever since we were kids, we wanted things. Some of them we got, some of them we did not and some of them we had to wait a long time to actually get – or have yet to receive! While waiting can be uncomfortable, making us impatient – even doubtful – it is an essential process, because it allows us to prepare, to mature and to be in position to take good care of them, when we actually do get them. Waiting helps us grow in patience and in trusting the Lord and His timing. It helps us grow in character, as patience is a sign of spiritual maturity, while immature faith wants everything, here and now, regardless if we are in a position to actually maintain. Mature faith trusts God’s timing, for as Christians, we are commanded to follow these tiny steps of faith with patience in Christ Jesus for there is no shortcut to spiritual maturity. And spiritual maturity is exactly what we need to actually receive! As stated in 𝐉𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟐𝟗:𝟏𝟏: “𝑭𝒐𝒓 𝑰 𝒌𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒏𝒔 𝑰 𝒉𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖,” 𝒅𝒆𝒄𝒍𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒔 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅, “𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒏𝒔 𝒕𝒐 𝒑𝒓𝒐𝒔𝒑𝒆𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒕𝒐 𝒉𝒂𝒓𝒎 𝒚𝒐𝒖, 𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒏𝒔 𝒕𝒐 𝒈𝒊𝒗𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒉𝒐𝒑𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒂 𝒇𝒖𝒕𝒖𝒓𝒆”, which ensures us that God indeed has a plan for us, in it’s time and it’s season.God answers in three ways: “yes!”, “no, I’ve got something better!”, “not yet!”, so delay should not be taken as denial! The key is to not focus on the amount of time we have to wait, but in how well we wait, as waiting shapes our desires to be in accordance with God’s will, grows our trust in God, judging by every promise that He kept so far and making us stand firm on the belief that God is trustworthy!So today, let us embrace the waiting not as wasted time, but as sacred preparation. May we choose trust over impatience, faith over fear, and obedience over haste.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus Christ, help me trust in You with all my heart and lean not on my own understanding; help me surrender my will to Yours, and please make my paths straight, as I wait for Your will to be done in my life and in Your divine timing. Amen!”#DelayIsNotDenial #GodsTiming #TrustTheProcess

title: The Essence of Stillness
text: Proof Text: Psalms 46:10 “He says, “Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.”Many times we find it very hard to stay still in the presence of God. We always want to be busy doing something. We are always in a hurry and lack stillness.When God took the Israelites into the wilderness, He had a purpose for them: to bring them to obedience. Bringing them to obedience meant causing them to hunger, and then feeding them. God took this direction so that He may be revealed to them, since revelation builds faith. When God was taking them into the wilderness, He did not explain why; He just led them there. He tested them but that test was not meant for their destruction; it was meant for their growth. Once God became certain of their obedience, however, He led them out of the wilderness.People of God, the main purpose of the wilderness is to draw us close to God. The closer we get to God, the more obedience is required. Obedience to God requires that we deny ourselves the desires and pleasures of the flesh.                People of God, God doesn’t need to prove Himself. He raises you only when He is assured of your obedience, because only in obedience is God exalted, not the self. This is why God is building character in us now so that when we get to our place of destiny, we will not crash, explode and lose it all. The wilderness can be seen as a place of stillness – the place where we only move because we are asked to, not because we want to; the place where we depend solely on God’s Word, not on our intellect; the place where our gaze is moulded to remain eternally on Him. The gift of the tiger is not in the city but in the wilderness.Christians, be still. The place of stillness is where we get to know Him and see Him. Stay there until you get God’s Word. We cannot build on fantasies and dreams, but only on God’s Word. Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to be still. Give me the grace to stay with You until nothing else matters, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.#TBJoshuaLegacy #SCOAN #devotional #EmmanuelTV #foryoupage

title: GOD’S STRENGTH IN STRESS!
text: Stress and pressure often feel like weights meant to break us, yet they can become sacred ground where God reveals His strength. When life becomes hard, our first instinct is to push harder, control more, and carry everything ourselves. However, pressure is not a punishment from God. It is a platform for His power to be displayed in and through us when we reach the end of our own ability. This is when faith starts working, as faith is seeing the invisible, believing the unbelievable, and receiving the impossible.Letting God carry your load begins with surrender, not escape. It does not mean you stop working or caring, but that you refuse to bear what was never meant to rest on you alone. The Bible reminds us in 𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟓:𝟕, “𝑪𝒂𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒂𝒏𝒙𝒊𝒆𝒕𝒚 𝒐𝒏 𝒉𝒊𝒎 𝒃𝒆𝒄𝒂𝒖𝒔𝒆 𝑯𝒆 𝒄𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖.”  In every moment of stress, God is present, inviting you to release your grip and trust His sustaining hands.Today, see your pressures as invitations to depend more deeply on Him. Breathe, release your burdens in prayer, and allow God to exchange your stress for His strength. When you let Him carry what you cannot, you make room for His peace, His power, and His purpose to move in your life.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, I place my worries and burdens in Your hands today. Where I feel weak, be my strength; where I feel anxious, let Your peace surround me. Teach me to trust You more and to rest in Your care. Carry my load, guide my steps, and let Your will be done in my life. Amen!”#TrustInGod #BreakFree #StressFreeLiving

title: THE WORD OF TRUTH
text: Proof Text: Ephesians 6:14 – “Stand firm then, with the belt of truth buckled around your waist….”In a world filled with compromising actions, the truth seems to be lost.  Perversion has invaded the world, with people who once stood firm suddenly falling away. However, Paul the Apostle reminds us to stand firm and to surround ourselves with the truth.If you were ‘reasoned’ into Christianity, you must realise that a wise fellow can easily reason you out of it. The unmistakable truth is this: Christianity is not indoctrination but conviction! We must seek God for ourselves and keep seeking Him. Our relationship with God should be progressive.The world is constantly hitting us with its own point of view and sin has now been ‘commonised’ – what was once seen as sin has now become an acceptable lifestyle. We need God to live right, think right and act right. We need God to stand; we need God to affirm our confession of faith, because no one is too good or too bad to be tempted. Everyone faces temptation, and anything close to Jesus receives attack. Therefore, we must not only equip ourselves with the Truth but must also be ready to fight for it, stand for it and represent it. To fight for the Truth is to stand by what God has spoken and shown you, even when no one seems to be on your side, when everyone and everything seems to be working against you. In order for us to do this we must be deeply rooted in God’s Word. We must sit with His Word until it becomes life to us daily. This is how we prevail over the vices of the enemy, that is, by the Word of our testimony and by the Blood. People of God, when the world seems to be against you because of who you represent, continue to represent Him and stand for Him, for those who honour God through their trials will be honoured by God through their trials.Prayer: Lord Jesus, help me to stand firm in Your Word of Truth. Save me from perversion and corruption. Keep me Holy and pure and give me the grace to know You until the end, in Jesus’ name. Amen.#TBJoshuaLegacy #devotional #PastorEvelynJoshua #EmmanuelTV #SCOAN

title: AN UNSHAKABLE PEACE!
text: We live in a time of global uncertainty — a world shaped by pandemics, rapid change, personal loss, and constant instability. News cycles shift daily, fear spreads quickly, and many hearts are burdened with anxiety about the future. In such a season, spiritual calm can feel difficult to maintain.Yet true peace does not come from stable circumstances; it comes from a stable foundation. When everything around us is shaking, God calls us to anchor our hearts in Him rather than in what we can see or control.When you are facing the uncertainties of life, do not think that God has abandoned you, but look first to the Cross, where the price was paid for the wisdom and knowledge you need to handle such a situation. In 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟐, it calls us to do exactly that: “𝑳𝒐𝒐𝒌𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒖𝒏𝒕𝒐 𝑱𝒆𝒔𝒖𝒔, 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒂𝒖𝒕𝒉𝒐𝒓 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒇𝒊𝒏𝒊𝒔𝒉𝒆𝒓 𝒐𝒇 𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒇𝒂𝒊𝒕𝒉, 𝒘𝒉𝒐 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒋𝒐𝒚 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒘𝒂𝒔 𝒔𝒆𝒕 𝒃𝒆𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝑯𝒊𝒎 𝒆𝒏𝒅𝒖𝒓𝒆𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒄𝒓𝒐𝒔𝒔, 𝒅𝒆𝒔𝒑𝒊𝒔𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒔𝒉𝒂𝒎𝒆…” At the Cross, the price was paid not only for our salvation, but also for the wisdom and understanding we need to face life’s most difficult moments. The Cross reminds us that God is not distant from suffering — He stepped into it. Jesus carried pain, loss, and fear so that in our weakest seasons, we would never stand alone.In uncertain times, peace is not the absence of trouble; it is the presence of Christ. The Cross assures us that even when answers are unclear and timelines uncertain, God’s purpose remains unshaken. From Christ’s sacrifice flows divine wisdom — wisdom to make decisions, strength to endure hardship, and grace to move forward one step at a time.So, in the midst of uncertainty and personal trials, choose to look to the Cross. Let it quiet your heart, strengthen your faith, and anchor your soul. When everything else is unstable, Christ remains unshaken — and so can you.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, when I face uncertainty and fear, help me to look first to the Cross. Remind me that You have not abandoned me and that You have already paid the price for the wisdom and strength I need. Anchor my heart in Your truth, calm my spirit, and guide me through every uncertain season. Let Your peace rule in my heart and my life bring glory to You. In Jesus’ name, Amen.”#UnshakenPeace #AnchoredInTheCross #FaithInUncertainty

title: Emmanuel TV 20th Anniversary address, Pastor Evelyn Joshua
text:
20 Years Have Gone By, And We Are Still Here!



In her Emmanuel TV 20th Anniversary address, Pastor Evelyn Joshua reflects on the extraordinary gospel journey of Emmanuel TV.



Over these two decades, the channel has borne witness to a reality the Gospel itself foretells for vessels of God’s work:



“If this work is of God, you cannot overthrow it.” (Acts 5:38–39)



Across these 20 years, Emmanuel TV has known not the absence of trials, but the certainty that the work of God endures, carried forward by faith and by those who continue to hold fast to His promise.



As we mark this milestone, we are reminded of a truth Prophet T.B. Joshua once shared:



“When God is the foundation, what is said by people doesn’t matter. In fact, what is said by people is an advert.”









According to Pastor Evelyn Joshua, those words explain what history has confirmed:



When God is the foundation, trials and temptations do not stop the work, they point people to it.



“And bringing people back to God is why this channel exists. Emmanuel TV did not come to entertain us; it came to rescue us.”



“For 20 years, and by the grace of God, the rescue continues.”



Changing Lives. Changing Nations. Changing the World.



Happy 20th Anniversary, Emmanuel TV.



#EmmanuelTV#EmmanuelTVat20#EmmanuelTV20yearsAnniversary#TBJoshualegacy#PastorEvelynJoshua

title: WAIT FOR HARVEST!
text:
Spiritual growth rarely happens overnight. God’s work in us is often slow, quiet, and hidden, like seeds growing beneath the soil. Even when nothing seems to be changing on the outside, God is still working within us. We live in a world that celebrates quick success and instant results, but God is not rushed. He values faithfulness, patience, and trust far more than speed. The planting season matters deeply because it is in those unseen moments that roots grow strong and lasting faith is formed.



Moses’ life is a powerful example of this truth. Before God used him to lead Israel out of Egypt, before the miracles and the parting of the sea, Moses spent forty long years in the wilderness tending sheep. His life looked small compared to the palace he once lived in. But Scripture tells us in 𝐄𝐱𝐨𝐝𝐮𝐬 𝟑:𝟏, “𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐌𝐨𝐬𝐞𝐬 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐤 𝐨𝐟 𝐉𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐫𝐨, 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫-𝐢𝐧-𝐥𝐚𝐰, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐌𝐢𝐝𝐢𝐚𝐧, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐥𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐥𝐨𝐜𝐤 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐟𝐚𝐫 𝐬𝐢𝐝𝐞 𝐨𝐟 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐝𝐞𝐫𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐇𝐨𝐫𝐞𝐛, 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐮𝐧𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧 𝐨𝐟 𝐆𝐨𝐝”.What seemed like a delay was actually God’s careful preparation.



In the wilderness, Moses learned humility, patience, and obedience. God was shaping his heart long before He trusted him with great responsibility. The man who once acted in anger had to be formed into a leader who would listen closely to God’s voice. Moses’ calling did not appear suddenly. The fruit of his life came after years of faithfulness in quiet, ordinary seasons that few people ever saw.



In the same way, God grows us through daily obedience, because those who bless God in their trials will be blessed through their trials. He works in the small choices, choosing prayer when no one notices, trusting Him when progress feels slow, and staying faithful when the season feels dry. God never wastes a season. Every moment of faithfulness is a seed planted in His hands.



When the harvest finally comes, it reflects the quiet work God has been doing all along. If we remain faithful in the planting season, we can trust that God will bring fruit in His perfect time—fruit that lasts and gives Him glory.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me to trust You in the waiting seasons. Give me a faithful heart when growth feels slow and unseen. Teach me to rest in Your timing and believe that You are always at work for me. In Jesus’ Christ name. Amen.”



WaitForHarvest #Faithfulness #TrustGodsTiming #Slowlybutsurely

title: EASTER SUNDAY – HE IS RISEN INDEED!
text: Today, we rise in victory because Jesus Christ rose in glory. At the empty tomb, death lost its grip and life eternal was released to all who believe.He who was crucified is now glorified. He who was laid down has risen with all power. This is the assurance of our victory and the proof of God’s unfailing love.Because He lives, your story is not over, your victory is certain. He conquered the grave and the authority to rise above every challenge, fear, limitation.Today, we don’t just remember – we celebrate a living Saviour! JESUS CHRIST IS ALIVE… HE IS RISEN INDEED!#SCOAN #EmmanuelTV #HappyEaster #Easter #EasterSunday

title: HE GAVE WHAT WAS HARDEST TO GIVE
text: There is something about this season that invites us to slow down… to look again at a moment we have heard many times, yet may never have fully grasped. A moment where power did not defend itself, where love did not hold back, where heaven watched as the Son chose the cross.He had every reason to turn away. Every reason to stop the pain before it began. Yet He stayed. Not because the nails held Him, but because love did.And now, in view of all He has done, the question is how you will respond.This Easter, do not let this be just another story you scroll past. Let it meet you. Let it search you. Let it change you.Lay down the pride that keeps you from surrender.Release the offence you have been holding onto.Forgive, even when it feels undeserved.Give, even when it costs you something.Love, even when it is not returned.Because this is the language of the cross.He gave what was hardest to give… so you could live a life that reflects that same love.#EmmanuelTV #EmmanuelTVSpotlight #TBJoshua #Easter #GoodFriday

title: INFLUENCE SHAPES DESTINY!
text: In 1 Corinthians 15:33, the Bible warns us, “Do not be misled: Bad company corrupts good character.” Since Apostle Paul emphasised this truth, we, as children of God, too must take it seriously and guard the influences we allow into our lives. The people we surround ourselves with, have a powerful influence on the direction of our lives. Every conversation we engage in and every habit we observe can either strengthen or weaken our character. However, godly relationships shape our thinking, guide our decisions, and encourage us to live according to God’s purpose for our lives.Remember, no one is above influence! Even when our intentions are good, constant exposure to negative attitudes, harmful habits, or careless living can slowly pull us off course. That is why the Bible reminds us to be mindful of our company—because what we allow around us will eventually shape who we become.You have been given a good destiny but destiny can be changed when you don’t know where you are destined to be. Therefore, choosing the right company is an act of wisdom and faith—because when you surround yourself with those who inspire you to become better, your life will naturally move in the right direction and align with the destiny meant for you. 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, help me recognise the influences in my life and give me the courage to walk away from anything that draws me away from You. Connect me with people who will strengthen my faith, sharpen my character, and lead me closer to Your purpose. In Jesus’ name, Amen”#BewareOfFriends #ChooseDirection #GodlyWisdom

title: THE PRIVILEGE OF BEING BORN AGAIN
text: Proof Text: Romans 3:10“As it is written: There is none righteous, no, not one.”Everyone has been tempted. Being born again does not mean you cannot make mistakes. Christians can fall, Christians can fail. The difference between you and others is that you have a relationship with God. When you misbehave, you can immediately run to Him and say, “Lord Jesus, this is what I have done. Help me.” And He will forgive you, restore you, and strengthen you not to repeat the same mistake.We will continue to face issues that challenge and even violate our conscience. Temptations will come. Corruption, wrongdoing and injustice surround us daily. We cannot close our eyes to what is happening around us. But, as believers, we are not without help.The Bible says in Romans 3:10 that no one is righteous on their own. We all face the temptation to do wrong. However, there is a way — Jesus Christ. Through Him, you receive courage, strength and conviction to stand your ground and say, “No, I will not do this.” That courage comes only through Christ.When you give your life to Jesus and make Him your Lord—your CEO in all you do—something changes. You begin to think differently. You dream differently. You develop a sensitivity you never had before. You are no longer directed by the influence of others but by your Heavenly Father.Being born again is not just by word of mouth. You don’t need to announce it—your life will reveal it. Broken things become useful in God’s hands. No matter your past, no matter your mistakes, God can transform you.How do you know you are born again?You know you are born again when you have the privilege of letting the Creator assist you in all you do. Before you speak, you ask Him. Before you act, you seek His guidance. You and Christ are cooperating. You are no longer living independently—you are living in partnership with your Creator.When you are born again, your pain does not destroy you. Instead, it prepares you for extraordinary service. Sickness, poverty, challenges—none of these mean God has abandoned you. Rather, they can deepen your desire to serve Him. The more the trial, the more you draw closer to God.Temptation may come but if every temptation drives you nearer to God instead of away from Him, then the enemy has already lost. The highest motive for serving God is the desire to please Him.When you are truly born again, you are not controlled by the majority or by popular opinion. Christ becomes your majority. The dividend of being born again is this: the Creator of heaven and earth begins to assist you in all you do. You walk freely, live freely and stand boldly because He is with you. So ask yourself, “Am I truly born again?”Prayer:Lord Jesus, thank You for the privilege of being born again. Forgive me for the times I relied on myself instead of cooperating with You. Strengthen my desire and determination to please You alone. Let Your will be done in my life, my home, my career, and all I do. Amen.#devotional

title: CHOOSING RIGHT DEMANDS BRAVERY!
text: Doing what is right takes courage, for the narrow path is rarely crowded. Choosing righteousness is not always celebrated, and standing firm may cost us comfort, approval, or peace with the world. Yet, Heaven watches closely, and God honors those who remain faithful when obedience is hard!As it is well known, Jesus Christ has given us a mind and the ability to choose between right and wrong. Each decision becomes a quiet testimony of who we trust and whom we serve. In moments of pressure and uncertainty, God whispers strength to the faithful, reminding us,“𝑯𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝑰 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒄𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖? 𝑩𝒆 𝒔𝒕𝒓𝒐𝒏𝒈 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒄𝒐𝒖𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒐𝒖𝒔. 𝑫𝒐 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒃𝒆 𝒂𝒇𝒓𝒂𝒊𝒅; 𝒅𝒐 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒃𝒆 𝒅𝒊𝒔𝒄𝒐𝒖𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒅, 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝑮𝒐𝒅 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒃𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒘𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒈𝒐.” – 𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚 𝟏:𝟗.When we choose what is right, even in silence or sacrifice, our faith takes root and grows deep. God shapes courage within us, refines our character, and uses our obedience for His glory. Though the cost may be great, the reward of walking in truth is greater still—because God never forgets a heart that chooses Him.Are you willing to obey God faithfully, even when the reward is unseen?🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, give me a brave and willing heart to choose what is right, even when it is difficult and unseen. Guide my thoughts, strengthen my resolve, and help me honor You with every choice I make. Amen!”#ChoosingRight #CourageousFaith #ObedienceToGod

title: STAY FOCUSED!
text: The world pulls your attention in a hundred directions. Responsibilities, ambitions, social media, pressures, and endless information compete daily for your focus. If you are not intentional, distraction becomes normal, and spiritual clarity becomes rare. We overcome by keeping our purpose, our vision, and our mission in the forefront of our minds. Focus is not something you accidentally maintain—it is something you deliberately protect. When your purpose stays visible, confusion loses its control.Scripture calls us to guard our thoughts. 𝐂𝐨𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟑:𝟐 says, “𝐒𝐞𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐯𝐞, 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐨𝐧 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡𝐥𝐲 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬.” This is a decision. It is choosing eternal priorities over temporary noise.What fills your mind shapes your spiritual condition. 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟖 teaches us to think about what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and praiseworthy. When your thoughts are aligned with truth, your life begins to reflect stability and peace.Many lose focus not because they lack ability, but because they lack direction. When you forget your mission, every opportunity seems urgent. When you remember your calling, you begin to filter what deserves your attention.The enemy does not always need to destroy you—distraction is often enough. A scattered mind produces a scattered life. But a disciplined mind produces spiritual strength. Protect your time with God. The world will always compete for your attention, but only what is eternal will truly matter.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me to guard my focus in a distracted world. Teach me to keep my purpose, vision, and mission before my mind. Remove the noise that pulls me away from You and give me discipline to set my thoughts on eternal things. Let my attention reflect my devotion to You. In Jesus’ name, amen.”#StayFocused #SpiritualClarity #MindSetOnChrist

title: GRACE TO MAINTAIN
text: Proof Text: Ephesians 2:8 – “For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God.”Everybody cherishes breakthrough; that is why we work hard. Little do we know, however, that the battle is not always for the strong or that the race is not always for the swift. After our struggles and hard labour, God still has to mark our work. That is the meaning of grace — not the work of righteousness which you have done, but according to His grace.No man knows what will happen next. This is why we must pray as if everything depends on God and work as if everything depends on us.The best man in the world can only maintain his position and honour as long as God keeps him in it because honour attracts hatred and persecution. No one can survive attacks without God because attacks come from satan, but God protects.If we are left to ourselves, we will fall and the enemy will triumph. If God withdraws His support, protection, and love from us, we will fall. God knows that we are naturally fearful and weak when facing trials.One would think that in battle the most powerful should always win, yet many good men remain unnoticed and uncelebrated. This shows that life is not sustained by strength alone but mainly by grace.At certain times in life, we find ourselves being unduly hated and persecuted because of the grace of God upon our lives. When that grace is upon you, many things in your life will defy human logic, causing many to want to resist you and what you represent.People of God, the best man can only maintain his integrity as long as God keeps him in it. It is better not to achieve than to achieve and fall. When it is time to pray, do not only ask for blessings — also ask for the grace to maintain what you already have. Anybody can achieve success, but not everyone can maintain it.May you be blessed with the grace to receive and to maintain.Prayer:Lord Jesus, help me to depend on Your grace and not on my strength. Teach me to trust You in every battle and give me the grace to maintain every blessing You have given me. Strengthen my heart to stand firm and rely on Your authority above all. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

title: GROWING THROUGH DELAY!
text: Although many of us view prayer mainly as a way to receive answers from God, it is much more than that, it is about building a deeper relationship with Him. Often, we desire immediate results, but God allows seasons of waiting so that our faith and dependence on Him can grow. In moments of delay, prayer shifts from being request-driven to becoming a relationship-building encounter, where trust replaces impatience and faith overcomes anxiety.Delayed answers do not mean that God is silent or absent. On the contrary, God is always at work in ways we may not immediately see. He uses the waiting season to shape our character, strengthen our patience, and prepare us for what lies ahead. As we continue to pray faithfully, our relationship with Him deepens, and we begin to value His presence more than the outcome we are expecting.Today, be encouraged to wait well and pray deeply. 𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐫𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐮𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐝, and His timing is always perfect—His plans never fail. This truth is echoed by the psalmist in 𝐏𝐬𝐚𝐥𝐦𝐬 𝟐𝟕:𝟏𝟒: “𝐖𝐚𝐢𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝; 𝐛𝐞 𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐠 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐡𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐰𝐚𝐢𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐫𝐝.”  Remain steadfast in prayer, hold firmly to faith, and allow the waiting season to produce spiritual growth in your life. In God’s appointed time, the answer will come—and it will reveal His glory.𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, in moments of silence, draw us closer to You. Let our faith grow, our hope remain firm, and our trust rest in Your perfect timing. May Your will be done in our lives as we continue to walk with You. In Jesus’ name, Amen.”#TrustInGod #WaitingSeason #PrayDeeply

title: FOLLOW GOD’S DIRECTION
text: The life we live is what ushers us into the name of Jesus — a life that is in line with God’s Word. When you wake up in the morning, you need direction. Direction can come only from a heart in which God dwells — that is, from the spirit.However, when many people wake up, they only bother about what comes next and give directions to themselves. This is the cause of many challenges in the world: making up our own directions or directing ourselves, whereas God alone should be our Director. Indeed, God’s direction is what we need now and always. Today’s solution may not be appropriate for tomorrow’s problem.As we all know, so much is happening around us. Do not listen to your situation and then act out of character. Instead, allow God’s Word to channel your way, and never allow your challenges to dictate your direction.You see those challenges? Leave them for God! Remember that blessings attract challenges. When blessings come without challenges, you may not be able to manage them well. Challenges help us grow stronger and preserve us for God.Your spirit needs to be renewed. Many may believe they already have everything; however, something is usually lacking — and that is the renewal of the spirit. Many people are financially buoyant but spiritually weak. We are becoming more prosperous materially than spiritually, and that is the cause of many complaints. Even if you have money now, it cannot take away your nightmares, isolation, or depression.In John 16:33, Jesus says:“I have told you these things, so that in Me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”Surely, in this world there will be tribulations, sickness, disease, poverty, hardship, and many things that can disturb your peace. Jesus says to cheer up and put it all behind you. Do not let your challenges overshadow you.People of God, our spirit must be renewed through meditating on the Word, constantly turning it over in our hearts until we are filled with it. You must prosper spiritually first, because that is where the ability and strength of God lie.You may believe there is nothing in this world that you have not enjoyed. However, have you truly enjoyed a relationship with God? If you achieve this, it will positively affect everyone around you. It is time for you to know God as children know their father — stop imagining it. Someone may tell you, “Jesus said this,” but it is time for you to hear Him for yourself.Our relationship with God should take priority, for Heaven is the reward. What is that thing you are doing for which you expect a reward? Remember that God is the Rewarder. What are you planting? Whatever you plant here, you will reap its reward there.The money you have and the possessions you seek can never fully satisfy you, because that is the nature of humankind. But in your relationship with God, there is a special place for you.The life we live is what moves us into Jesus’ name in line with God’s Word, and it also prompts us to call upon the name of Jesus. If you truly want to advance in your spiritual life, you must begin with isolation — creating time for yourself to meet with God and talk with Him. Everything great starts small. You must cultivate the habit of meeting with God.People of God, once you begin this according to God’s Word, the door you have been knocking on will open. Everything starts outside reality, but when it begins with truth and faith, it enters reality. Brethren, remember: better is not good enough; the best is yet to come!PrayerO Holy Spirit, continue to reveal Yourself to me and show me the direction to Your throne, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: YOUR CALLING IS GREATER!
text: It is by human instinct that we look at the life of those around us and believe that they are either more fortunate, far off or in a better position than we are. This forces us to compare; compare our lives, lifestyles and even calling. This too places us in a position to want to compete with them, which ultimately kills our joy. As different individuals with different hearts and different ways of perceiving things, we all have different but unique callings in our lives. We ought to be content with this fact, so we are able to flourish and complete the mission set before us. The book of 𝟏 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏𝟐:𝟏𝟐 says,”𝑱𝒖𝒔𝒕 𝒂𝒔 𝒂 𝒃𝒐𝒅𝒚, 𝒕𝒉𝒐𝒖𝒈𝒉 𝒐𝒏𝒆, 𝒉𝒂𝒔 𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒚 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒕𝒔, 𝒃𝒖𝒕 𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒊𝒕𝒔 𝒎𝒂𝒏𝒚 𝒑𝒂𝒓𝒕𝒔 𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒎 𝒐𝒏𝒆 𝒃𝒐𝒅𝒚, 𝒔𝒐 𝒊𝒕 𝒊𝒔 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝑪𝒉𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒕”. This verse emphasizes the unique role that each and every person has to play and how each of those roles are important. It also tells us how we, the body of Christ all have different roles to play but for one purpose; to glorify God. We ought not to waste time comparing our lives with the lives of others just because they appear better. Instead, we should look to Jesus Christ; focusing on what He wants us to do and asking Him to lead our footsteps. The hope of it all is the time we have now, time to realign our thoughts and focus on our personal journeys. In the end, your calling is not something to copy; it is something to discover! God has not assigned you someone else’s path, so comparing or competing will only lead to frustration. True peace comes when you seek Him for direction and embrace what He has uniquely placed within you. 🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank you for creating me uniquely. Thank you for setting me apart for a role I fit best. Help me be content with what you have trusted me with. May I stay focused on what you called me to do, guide me and be the lamp to my feet as I walk on the path set before me, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ, amen.” #PurposeOverComparison #ComparisonKills #UniquePurpose

title: KEEP YOUR EYES ON JESUS
text: The Gospel of Matthew 14:28–30“And Peter answered Him and said, ‘Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water.’ So He said, ‘Come.’ … But when he saw that the wind was boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, ‘Lord, save me!’”Life is filled with moments of pressure, uncertainty, and challenges that can easily shift our attention away from God. In the story of Peter, we see a powerful lesson: as long as he focused on Jesus, he was able to do the impossible. However, the moment he shifted his attention to the wind and the storm around him, fear entered his heart, and he began to sink.This shows us that what we focus on has the power to either sustain us or overwhelm us.Many believers today find themselves in the same position as Peter. Instead of focusing on Jesus Christ, they focus on sickness, failure, delay, disappointment, and the storms of life. God never promised a life without trials, but He promised His presence in every situation. When your eyes are fixed on Christ, peace and strength will rule your heart even when everything around you is unstable.Paul and Silas also demonstrated this truth when they were imprisoned. Instead of complaining or losing hope, they prayed and praised God, and their focus invited God’s power, which broke their chains. In the same way, when we magnify God instead of our problems, our challenges begin to lose their grip on our lives, and we begin to experience divine intervention.PRAYER:Lord Jesus Christ, strengthen my faith when I am weak and fill my heart with peace that surpasses all understanding. Lord, help me to trust in Your promises at all times. Let my eyes remain fixed on You in every season of my life, in Jesus’ name. Amen.

title: USE YOUR TIME WISELY!
text: Time is a gift we have been given by God. Yet, it is easy to misuse it by waiting, delaying, or doing nothing while hoping life will somehow change. But growth, purpose, and breakthrough don’t come from passivity. Each day is an opportunity—a chance to take a step forward, to be faithful in the small things, and to use what God has already placed in your hands. What you do daily matters more than what you intend to do.Too often, we fall into extremes—either waiting on God to do everything or trying to carry everything in our own strength. But God never designed life to work that way. Trusting God does not consist in praying alone. There are times to pray in faith and times to act faith. In other words, there are things we do ourselves and others we expect of God. When you choose to show up, to act, and to remain consistent, you position yourself for God to move in powerful ways. Your obedience, even in small steps, opens the door for His greater work in your life as it explains in 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟔:𝟑: “𝑪𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒊𝒕 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒘𝒐𝒓𝒌 𝒕𝒐 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒏𝒔 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒃𝒆 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒔𝒉𝒆𝒅”Don’t waste your time waiting for a more convenient time or a sudden miracle while ignoring the responsibility you have today. Often, the miracle you’re looking for is hidden in your daily discipline, your persistence, and your faithfulness. As you move, God moves with you—guiding, strengthening, and establishing your path step by step.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord, help me to value and use my time wisely. Teach me not to be passive, but to live with purpose and intention. Give me the discipline to act, the willingness to obey, and the faith to trust in Your ability as I walk forward each day. Amen.”#DontWasteTime #DailyMotivation #BeActive #IntentionalLiving

title: FOCUS ON THE RACE WITH GOD
text: In Romans 8:31, Apostle Paul says, “If God is for me, no one can succeed against me.” When God is with you, even though you walk through the valley of the shadow of death, you will not fear a million enemies because He has promised in His Word that, for your sake, every mountain shall be levelled and every hill shall be made plain. When you pass through the waters, He will be with you, and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned.Jesus conquered the world and gave us victory. Why, then, are you still troubled? What situation are you in today? Are you feeling lonely and insecure? Are you sick and dying? Are you feeling guilty and condemned as a result of your past life? Life does not just happen to us; it is all about choices and how we respond to every situation. God chooses what we go through; we choose how we go through it. God has arranged our lives according to His will. Nothing can come against you without God’s knowledge and approval.People of God, no matter what you are going through as a Christian, if it is allowed by God as a trial, God will speak strength and courage into your life through it. You must not consider it strange or doubt your Guard. Don’t let your situation intimidate you. Don’t give room to fear, because fear is your actual enemy.Our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ, will not leave you without a solution to your problem.You must realise that, for those whose lives are centred on Jesus Christ, the best is yet to come!Prayer:Lord Jesus, whatever situation I am going through that may shift my focus from You, I commit it all into Your hands. O Holy Spirit, strengthen my focus on You. In Jesus Christ’s name, we pray. Amen.

title: AN IMPACT THAT STILL CHANGES THE WORLD!
text: “Your success and happiness depend on your willingness to help others solve their problems!” – Prophet T.B. JoshuaOn this day, we commemorate the enduring legacy of Prophet T.B. Joshua—a life wholly surrendered to God and devoted to the service of humanity.Though years since his passing on to glory may have gone by, the impact of the fulfillment his calling remains very much alive and active. His journey was one marked by deep faith, strength, and a genuine love for people from all walks of life. He did not simply preach the Gospel—he lived it, demonstrating that true spirituality is expressed through compassion, humility, and selfless giving.Today invites us not only to remember, but to be inspired. Inspired to carry forward the values he embodied—to be instruments of peace, to extend kindness without hesitation, and to trust God even in uncertain times. His life reminds us that one person, yielded to God, can become a channel of transformation for countless others.As we honour his memory, may we also renew our commitment to reflect Christ in action! For the greatest tribute we can offer is not only in words, but in walking the path of love, faith, and service that he so clearly showed and that is why his legacy still speaks louder than ever!#TBJoshuaLegacy #ProphetTBJoshua #TheLegacyLivesOn

title: If TB Joshua Were a White Man?
categories: PROPHET TB JOSHUA CALL TO GLORY
tags: If TB Joshua Was a White Man
text:
IF TB Joshua Was a White Man



As we remember the life of Prophet TB Joshua, the founder of SCOAN, one question sits heavy on the heart: was he truly honored the way he should have been? Yes, he was admired around the world. People came from every nation to sit under his teaching and receive prayer. He was a global figure. But even with all that admiration, something was missing. The full honor that belongs to a man of his greatness was not given. Why? Because he was a black man from Africa.



If TB Joshua were a white man with blue eyes and blonde hair, the story would be very different. The same people who held back honor would have rushed to give it. The same voices that tried to paint him evil would have called him a blessing to the world.



Let us be clear. TB Joshua was not a small man. He was loved by millions across the earth. People travelled far distances just to step into SCOAN. The poor called him father. The broken called him restorer. He gave food to the hungry, hope to the hopeless, and healing to the sick. This is a man who was celebrated by common people, the rich, the high and mighty. Yet, even with this love, there was a plan to destroy his name. A plan that had nothing to do with his character and everything to do with his skin.









The BBC Documentary: An Attack Born of Race



The BBC documentary that came after his death was not honest journalism. It was an assignment. It was racially engineered. The makers of that documentary did not come with open hearts. They came with a script already written. They looked for anyone who would speak against him and shut out the millions who would speak for him. They took the words of a few and tried to bury the legacy of a great man of God.



This would not have happened if TB Joshua were a white man. No documentary would have been made to destroy him. The same miracles would have been called a move of God. The same ministry would have been called a global treasure. But because he was an African man who rose too high, they wanted to bring him down.



In Christ, there is only one race with a spiritual inheritance. Jesus came as a Jew, from the tribe of Judah. Every believer is grafted in. So, in the spirit, TB Joshua was a Jew, a son of Abraham by faith. The world saw a black Nigerian, but heaven saw a prophet.



If his skin were white, the world might have rushed to call him another saviour. But the true Saviour has already come, and His name is Jesus. TB Joshua pointed to Him with everything he had. The irony is that the man the world tried to demonize was the closest reflection of Jesus’ compassion and power that our generation has witnessed. He did not need blonde hair to be great. He carried the breath of God, and that was enough.



A Prophet Sent by God



We remember TB Joshua not by the lies spread about him, but by the truth. He was a man sent by God. He taught the Word with simplicity and power. He loved without condition. He lived humbly, though the world was at his feet. He was not perfect, because no man is. But he was genuine. He was real. And the power of God upon his life was real.



If he had white skin and blue eyes, the world would have called him a living saint. They would have placed him high, maybe too high. But God chose him from Africa. God chose him from Nigeria. And God does not make mistakes.



Today, we honour Prophet TB Joshua. Not because the world gave him full honour, but because heaven did. We celebrate a life that showed us Jesus. We remember a man who gave everything for the gospel. Wicked men tried to paint him as evil, but they failed. The lies will fade. The truth will stand. And the legacy of this great African prophet will shine forever.



#TBJoshua #SCOAN #ProphetTBJoshua #IfTBJoshuaWasAWhiteMan #AfricanProphet #BBCDocumentary #RacialBias #Christianity #Faith #JesusChrist #SpiritualInheritance #NigerianProphet #Truth #Legacy #Remembrance

title: CALLED TO SHINE!
text: Ever since we were little children, we were taught the difference between right and wrong. We were mischievous and curious, eager to explore the world around us —often falling, getting hurt, crying more than once. But as we grew older, we slowly began to understand the value of our parents’ teachings—the same words we once ignored. Doing the right thing is not always easy. It is often easier to fall into temptation, to follow the crowd, to do what everyone else is doing just to fit in—to seem “normal” by worldly standards. But as Christians, we are called to stand out, not blend in. We are called to make different choices and lead different lifestyles while being in it, because you should not do what many do, but what the best do. As the Bible teaches us in the book of 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐰 𝟓:𝟏𝟒-𝟏𝟔: “𝒀𝒐𝒖 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒍𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝒐𝒇 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒐𝒓𝒍𝒅. 𝑨 𝒕𝒐𝒘𝒏 𝒃𝒖𝒊𝒍𝒕 𝒐𝒏 𝒂 𝒉𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒄𝒂𝒏𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒃𝒆 𝒉𝒊𝒅𝒅𝒆𝒏. 𝑵𝒆𝒊𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓 𝒅𝒐 𝒑𝒆𝒐𝒑𝒍𝒆 𝒍𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝒂 𝒍𝒂𝒎𝒑 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒑𝒖𝒕 𝒊𝒕 𝒖𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒓 𝒂 𝒃𝒐𝒘𝒍. 𝑰𝒏𝒔𝒕𝒆𝒂𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒚 𝒑𝒖𝒕 𝒊𝒕 𝒐𝒏 𝒊𝒕𝒔 𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒏𝒅, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒊𝒕 𝒈𝒊𝒗𝒆𝒔 𝒍𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝒕𝒐 𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚𝒐𝒏𝒆 𝒊𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒉𝒐𝒖𝒔𝒆. 𝑰𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒔𝒂𝒎𝒆 𝒘𝒂𝒚, 𝒍𝒆𝒕 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒍𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝒔𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒆 𝒃𝒆𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝒐𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒔, 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒚 𝒎𝒂𝒚 𝒔𝒆𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒈𝒐𝒐𝒅 𝒅𝒆𝒆𝒅𝒔 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒈𝒍𝒐𝒓𝒊𝒇𝒚 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝑭𝒂𝒕𝒉𝒆𝒓 𝒊𝒏 𝒉𝒆𝒂𝒗𝒆𝒏”. Jesus Christ has given us a mind and the ability to choose between right and wrong. Choosing to do what is right, however, is not always easy. Darkness doesn’t need much to spread—but neither does light! At times, we may feel overwhelmed by the darkness around us. But if we shift our focus, we will see that a single act of kindness, one word of truth, a heartfelt prayer can create ripple effects that push back more darkness than we realise. All we need to do is sincerely ask our Heavenly Father for help. Then the burden becomes lighter, for God strengthens us in our weakness and helps us see the road ahead more clearly.So, start making better choices for your life and for yourself, and trust where God leads you!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, help me to be a light in the darkness, to reflect Your love through my words and actions. When I feel weak, remind me that You are with me, lifting my burdens and leading my steps. Use my life to bring hope, even in small ways, and let everything I do glorify You. In Jesus’ name, Amen”.#BeTheLight #GodlyChoices #LiveForChrist

title: A LEGACY THAT CANNOT BE BURIED!
categories: PROPHET TB JOSHUA CALL TO GLORY
text: Today, we honour the birth of a man whose impact continues to echo beyond time all over the world— Prophet T. B.
