title: WHERE TO MEET GOD
text: The Bible says knowing God is not only about seeing His miracles but also learning His ways. Humankind is designed to think, plan, and act with God. When you act with God, you will know God’s opinion about yourself and others. Are you acting with God? If not, it is not too late to start believing God’s Word. You must realize that God is not far from you.In Exodus 3:2–4, the Bible says, “There the angel of the Lord appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire, it didn’t burn up. So Moses thought, ‘I will go over and see this strange sight—why the bush does not burn up.’ When the Lord saw that he had gone over to look, God called to him from within the bush, ‘Moses! Moses!’ And Moses said, ‘Here I am.’”People of God, we are called to God’s kind of lifestyle—a lifestyle of positive thinking, positive talking, and positive acting. When you follow this kind of lifestyle, nothing can change your mind about what you believe, and nothing can derail you from your focus. This is God’s standard. God is indeed a Spirit.In Romans 4:17, He calls the things that are not as if they were, and they come to be. Communion with God springs from our union with Christ. Christ came to declare God to us. God is in His Word, and He does nothing without His Word because Christ and the Word are one. Jesus is the Word by whom God speaks to us today. I am in it, you are in it, and, most importantly, God is in it. Here, you meet God face to face.We need to develop our relationship with the Holy Spirit by devotedly reading our Bible daily. The Bible is given to us in the first place simply to invite us to make ourselves at home in the Word of God and become more familiar with the way God speaks and the way in which we answer Him with our lives. The more you think about what you have read, the more you become familiar with His voice. This means it is not only about committing the Word to memory, which is actually valuable in itself. More importantly, we must make the Word an integral part of our lives.The Word carries us beyond the realm of sense knowledge into the very presence of God, giving us the right standing there. There, we meet God face to face. If you give your attention to God, you are what God says you are, you have what God says you have, and you can do what God says you can do.People of God, if you take God’s Word to heart and truly make it part of you, it will, by its very nature, change you. When the Word changes you, you will find yourself called to act—I mean, act with God.Prayer: Lord Jesus, I give You my all. Come and make Your home in me and continue to lead me in the right path, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: GET TO KNOW GOD’S WORD
text: Bible Verse: John 15:7 (KJV)“If ye abide in Me, and My words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.”Today, many people claim to be Christians, yet they do not know what God’s Word says concerning them. They claim to be Spirit-filled Christians but lack the manifestation of the Living Word in their lives.God’s Word tells us in the Book of John that we remain in Him through His Word and His Spirit. The Word and the Spirit are one and inseparable; we cannot separate God’s Word from His Spirit.If we say we are Spirit-filled, God’s Word must dwell in us, take root within us, and produce good fruit. The Word is a tool in the hands of the Holy Spirit.When Jesus was tempted in the wilderness, He did not respond with prayer and fasting; He responded with the Word of God.When we come face to face with the enemy of our souls, our only weapon against his schemes, lies, deceit, perversions, and folly is the written Word. Without the written Word, we stand little chance against the enemy.To be Spirit-filled is not merely to be filled with the power of the Holy Spirit, but also to manifest His character. When the Holy Spirit dwells within us, He helps us develop a holy character.If we truly want to be Spirit-filled, we must get to know God’s Word. God’s Word is a treasure.God’s Word builds spiritual consciousness in the heart of the believer. A believer without God’s Word is like a farmer without tools.People of God, it is necessary for us to know God’s Word. Prayer and fasting must go hand in hand with Bible study. Remember, scriptural prayer releases the power of God.Prayer:Lord Jesus, thank You for Your Word. I ask, O Lord, that as I read Your Word, You will grant me understanding so that I may know You better. Give me the grace to know Your Word more and more, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: MONEY MINDSET MATTERS!
text: Many Christians feel pressure or uncertainty about money. Bills, future needs, and managing what God has entrusted can feel overwhelming. But God wants us to approach our finances with a mindset rooted in Him—not in fear or scarcity. He cares about our money not just for wealth, but to help us plan wisely, give generously, and steward His blessings well.The Bible reminds us in 𝐇𝐞𝐛𝐫𝐞𝐰𝐬 𝟏𝟑:𝟓, “𝑲𝒆𝒆𝒑 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒍𝒊𝒗𝒆𝒔 𝒇𝒓𝒆𝒆 𝒇𝒓𝒐𝒎 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒍𝒐𝒗𝒆 𝒐𝒇 𝒎𝒐𝒏𝒆𝒚 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒃𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒏𝒕𝒆𝒏𝒕 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒘𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒉𝒂𝒗𝒆, 𝒃𝒆𝒄𝒂𝒖𝒔𝒆 𝑮𝒐𝒅 𝒉𝒂𝒔 𝒔𝒂𝒊𝒅, ‘𝑵𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝑰 𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖; 𝒏𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝑰 𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒔𝒂𝒌𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖.” Building a godly money mindset starts with identity. When you know you are who God says you are, you will stay focused on your goal alone and nothing can change your focus. This confidence in God shapes every financial choice you make.The second pillar is resolve. A resolve to do whatever proper thing it takes separates the weak from the strong. God calls us to act intentionally with our finances: plan carefully, avoid waste, give to those in need, and make disciplined choices that honour Him. When identity and resolve work together, money becomes a tool for blessing others, and God’s purposes for freedom, generosity, and stewardship unfold in your life.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Lord Jesus, help me build a godly money mindset. Help me be rooted in You, so that I will give to those who need it, and plan well so that I will not waste away the blessings You have given me. Align my finances with Your will because I know that all wealth belongs to You. Amen.”#MoneyMindset #ChristianLiving #BiblicalStewardship #GodsProvision #KingdomMindset

title: WHAT HAS GOD DESTINED YOU TO DO?
text: God is the Creator and Maker of all things, and He does not create anything without a purpose; even the wicked exist for His ultimate plans. As the Bible says, “The Lord has made everything for its purpose, even the wicked for the day of trouble” (Proverbs 16:4).Prophet T.B. Joshua taught us that, as Christians, “The first step to knowing our destiny—what God wants us to be—is to get to know God better.” You can only know God better if His Word dominates your heart and gains supremacy over you. Remember, God and His Word are one; they are inseparable (“In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God”—John 1:1). You can only know God by reading His Word and meditating on it. To meditate means to let the Word dominate your heart by turning it over and over again in your mind, ensuring that you “meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do everything written in it” (Joshua 1:8).However, you must ensure your heart is at its best for God. Keep it free from all unforgiveness, bitterness, envy, jealousy, past pain, deep hurt, and malice, etc. The Bible warns us to “get rid of all bitterness, rage and anger, brawling and slander, along with every form of malice” (Ephesians 4:31), because God cannot dwell in a heart full of these things. Therefore, you must free your heart before you read the Holy Bible. As Jesus teaches us, “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God” (Matthew 5:8).Prayer:O Holy Spirit, free my heart to follow You, to connect with You and make my heart Your dwelling place. I surrender all my cares to You and I let You take control over my life and all that concerns me, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen.#devotional

title: FOLLOW GOD’S PROCESS
text: We come into the knowledge of faith by divine revelation. As Apostle Paul writes in 1 Corinthians 12:3, “Therefore I want you to know that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, ‘Jesus be cursed,’ and no one can say, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ except by the Holy Spirit.” No doubt, revelation is about becoming aware of something previously unknown. The name ‘Jesus of Nazareth’ must be revealed to you through revelation. Revelation brings conviction, and conviction brings real movement. By real movement, we mean power steps—steps of intent and purpose.You can’t separate Christianity from power. Just because I tell you that studying the Bible is good for you doesn’t mean that I can get you to believe that studying the Bible is actually good for you. You must receive that revelation in order to believe. The challenge we have now is that we are too conditioned to believe that what we read about in the Bible was only for the people in the Bible. When you remember your weaknesses and faults, you begin to think that the plea, “Son of David, have mercy on me,” was meant only for Blind Bartimaeus. We are too conditioned to believe that what God said could happen to others cannot happen to us. That is the conditioning we are talking about. We look at our weaknesses and think, “It can happen to Abraham or Blind Bartimaeus, but because of my sin, it is not going to happen to me.” Actually, it can happen to you too, in the name of Jesus Christ.Success or greatness is not about your weaknesses, faults, or the pitfalls you face; it is about what Jesus did for you on the Cross. If your sin has been forgiven, what follows is Jesus making you fit for God. You are a work of art. If you want to be God’s person, then you must follow His process. This is why Jesus is trying to build character in you now so that when you get to the place of your destiny, you will not crack, explode, and lose it all. Nothing good happens without discipline. If you are not following the process, you can still retrace your steps and put things right.God wants you to prosper. He does not want you to succeed financially while your children become victims of drugs and bad gangs. Your children are part of your blessing. There is no shortcut. Life is a marathon, not a sprint; however, many people want to take so-called shortcuts. Many want to get married because of their age, yet they cannot even manage a pet at home. Jesus was able to manage His affairs; that is why we are here today. Jesus does not want any one of us to end our days saying, “I could have been this; I would have been that.”People of God, it is not too late; you can still turn your children back to God. Nothing happens without discipline. If you are blessed without being disciplined, you will likely lose it; it will crash at the time you need it most. Whenever you are disciplined, what follows is always good. God is trying to build character now. Character is the oil in the lamp. If there is no oil in the lamp, it will go out—your business, your glory. The oil in the lamp is character; the light is the proceeds. Money, fame, and popularity—these are the proceeds. But the oil in the lamp is character. When the oil runs dry, the proceeds will soon dry up too. So, people of God, keep the oil burning in your life; be more concerned about God’s character than the proceeds.Prayer: O Holy Spirit, continue to reveal Yourself in all that concerns me! Continue to build Your holy character in me, in Jesus Christ’s name! Amen.

title: LET GOD LEAD!
text: “I do not need to plan; I trust God”. Although this statement may seem wise, it is a deception! People often confuse a lack of planning with trusting God. Whereas, trusting God does not mean not planning at all, but rather planning and allowing God to direct you. It could seem innocent to lay back and expect God to take the wheel, but that is a recipe for disaster. It is expected of us to delight in the Lord, meaning to seek Him, in order for Him to guide our steps as we go. Essentially, that means planning with Him so that our efforts are more meaningful and the journey worthwhile. 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐛𝐬 𝟏𝟔:𝟑 says to “𝑪𝒐𝒎𝒎𝒊𝒕 𝒕𝒐 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅 𝒘𝒉𝒂𝒕𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒅𝒐, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝑯𝒆 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒃𝒍𝒊𝒔𝒉 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒑𝒍𝒂𝒏𝒔”. This verse emphasises the importance of entrusting our actions and plans to God, being rest assured that He will guide and support our endeavours. It encourages us to seek divine assistance in our undertakings, reinforcing the idea that relying on God leads to success, because when you know where you are going, whatever happens to you midway, cannot change your focus.When you surrender your plans to Him, you are not losing control; you are gaining direction. What once felt uncertain becomes guided, and what once felt heavy becomes meaningful. God does not call you to wander aimlessly, but to walk intentionally with Him, step by step, day by day. Even when the full picture is not clear, His guidance is sure. Your dreams matter, but His direction transforms those dreams into purpose. As you trust Him with your plans, you begin to see that every effort, every step, and every season has significance. So, plan with purpose. Invite God into every detail. And move forward with confidence, knowing that when He leads, your path is not only clear but deeply meaningful.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, help me to trust You more. Give me the wisdom to plan for my future and allow You to guide my steps. I pray against any fear that may keep me away from planning. I surrender my plans to You, and I trust You to direct my path, in Jesus’s mighty name, Amen!”#LetGodLead #CommitYourPlans #Proverbs163 #LiveForChrist #FaithJourney #Amen #DailyDevotion

title: KEEP THE FAITH!
text: Have you ever felt like God has forgotten you? That His promises for your life seem like a distant dream just out of your grasp or like a fairytale that has little to nothing to do with the reality you are experiencing? These times where God seems silent, are exactly the times where God does His most delicate work in our hearts in order to fulfil His plan in our lives. Because in every situation, God is still saying something!Silence doesn’t mean absence! God never stops working for us and there is nothing more ridiculous than to allow your present situation to cause you to doubt the fulfilment of God’s Word or promises for your life. You only need to think of the previous times that God came through for you with a solution just at the right moment or with an answer at the perfect time, because precision is God’s way of doing things, as He is perfect and His timing is the best! There is no point in trying to rush the process! His timing may test your patience, but it always proves His faithfulness. Faith is the only thing it takes for actualization, for when you trust Him fully, what is promised cannot be delayed beyond its appointed time. So, be patient; God’s response is not for those in a hurry. As the Scripture says in 𝐈𝐬𝐚𝐢𝐚𝐡 𝟒𝟑:𝟏: “𝑩𝒖𝒕 𝒏𝒐𝒘, 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒊𝒔 𝒘𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅 𝒔𝒂𝒚𝒔—𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒉𝒐 𝒄𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒕𝒆𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖, 𝑱𝒂𝒄𝒐𝒃, 𝒉𝒆 𝒘𝒉𝒐 𝒇𝒐𝒓𝒎𝒆𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖, 𝑰𝒔𝒓𝒂𝒆𝒍: ‘𝑫𝒐 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒇𝒆𝒂𝒓, 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝑰 𝒉𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒓𝒆𝒅𝒆𝒆𝒎𝒆𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖; 𝑰 𝒉𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒔𝒖𝒎𝒎𝒐𝒏𝒆𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒃𝒚 𝒏𝒂𝒎𝒆; 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒎𝒊𝒏𝒆’”. He knows you by name, He cares about you, He is fully aware of your situation and is always working for your good, even when you can’t see or feel it!🙏𝗣𝗿𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗿: “Lord Jesus, cultivate steadfast faith in me, so I can stand firm, even without getting what I want when I want it. Help me surrender my life to you and trust you fully, as I know you care for me, my dreams, my desires and everything that has to do with me, as there is no other place I want to be than in your loving hands who form me into what you will. Amen.”#KeepTheFaith #TrustGod #FaithInGod #WalkByFaith #GodsTiming #GodIsFaithful #TrustHisPlan #NeverGiveUp #HopeInChrist #StandFirm #FaithOverFear

title: BE AN IMITATOR OF GOD
text:
Someone else’s testimony can inspire your faith, but your own actions must be based on your faith in God’s Word. The Bible says in John 11:40, “Then Jesus said, ‘Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?’” Your actions must be based on your faith in God’s Word. What keeps us from despair is not what we see but what we believe.



Our faith is often based on the experience of man—what man has done, the science that guides him, the works of his hands, and how he has organized society. The Bible says we must never make the tragic mistake of believing in an experience or in the testimony of an experience.



You can only meet God by obeying what He tells you to do. Today, we imitate others. The fact that something strange happened to you does not mean God has visited you—it is just an experience. We do not know what to call a miracle of God, and we are not consistent in our actions. Our relationships are unstable because we base our faith on experience. However, we must stop basing our faith on experience, which comes mostly from our inconsistent feelings. For faith to be consistent, it must be based on something with more stability than our feelings—and that thing is God’s Word.



Faith relates to the invisible, and many times, if not at all times, God leads us in different ways. He may lead me one way, and He may ask others to take another way, but the results will be the same. What you may encounter on your journey, I may not encounter. This is why we should not imitate one another. All we need is the knowledge of the Word of Truth. The Spirit teaches us that believing is possessing. The instant you believe, you have. Therefore, to base faith on experience is a tragic mistake.



I repeat: God deals with people in different ways, so stop imitating others and act in faith. Faith is what has kept many of us where we are today; it is what has sustained our lives, success, and progress. It is imitation that limits success. Stop imitating others—just act in faith. Allow God’s Word to direct your path.



We want to be at our best before serving God. But what if that time never comes? We always want to be at our best before we can pray and fast. When you are not at your best, you do not want to pray. And even when you pray, your mind tends to be elsewhere. Waiting for your “best time” may mean never getting the chance to truly serve God.



When you cannot serve God with all your heart whenever there is no money in your pocket, you definitely will not be able to serve Him when there is money in your pocket. Many times, we deal with God as if He does not know our state or condition. People of God, when you are aware of Christ’s presence, you will honor Him by believing whatever He says, and you will stop imitating others as you manifest faith in God’s Word.



I leave you in faith and hope to meet you there, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.



Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to believe whatever You say and strengthen my faith in You alone, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: WALK BY FAITH!
text: Feelings can warn us, inspire us, and reveal what matters deeply to us, but they should not be the sole measure of reality. Wisdom comes from learning to acknowledge emotions without surrendering our thinking to them. When truth and emotion seem to conflict, maturity is found in pausing long enough to discern which voice deserves to lead.What you feel in a difficult moment may push you toward fear or doubt, but God’s voice remains greater than every other voice. Fear and insecurity dominate a life without faith, because, when fear says you are alone, God says He will never leave you. When insecurity says you are not enough, God says His grace is sufficient. As the Bible teaches us in 𝟐 𝐂𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟓:𝟕: “𝑭𝒐𝒓 𝒘𝒆 𝒘𝒂𝒍𝒌 𝒃𝒚 𝒇𝒂𝒊𝒕𝒉, 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒃𝒚 𝒔𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕.” Faith calls us higher, does not follow impulse, mood, or opinion, but stands on the unchanging truth of God’s Word. Therefore, your faith must be controlled by God’s Word, not by what you feel, what circumstances look like, or what others tell you.Even in seasons where faith feels weak and emotions feel loud, God remains constant. He is not shaken by what overwhelms us, and He does not change when our hearts feel uncertain. Growth often happens in the tension between what we feel and what we choose to believe. So, keep returning to what God has spoken and do not turn temporary emotions into permanent decisions, because His Word will always be the safest place for your heart to rest.  🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, help me to walk by faith and not by feelings. When fear and doubt rise, remind me of Your truth. Strengthen my heart to trust You above everything else. In Jesus’ name, Amen!”#WalkByFaith #TrustGodBlindly #KeepGoing #LivingByFaith #GodIsGreater #DailyDevotion

title: NEVER OUT OF HIS SIGHT!
text: By human nature we immediately think that when we struggle, God is turning his back towards us. We relate struggle or misfortune to the absence of God. This is in fact a false narrative. 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐢𝐬 𝟏𝟔:𝟏𝟑 reads: “𝑺𝒉𝒆 𝒈𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒔 𝒏𝒂𝒎𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑳𝒐𝒓𝒅 𝒘𝒉𝒐 𝒔𝒑𝒐𝒌𝒆 𝒕𝒐 𝒉𝒆𝒓: ‘𝒀𝒐𝒖 𝒂𝒓𝒆 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑮𝒐𝒅 𝒘𝒉𝒐 𝒔𝒆𝒆𝒔 𝒎𝒆’ 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒔𝒉𝒆 𝒔𝒂𝒊𝒅, ‘𝑰 𝒉𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒔𝒆𝒆𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝑶𝒏𝒆 𝒘𝒉𝒐 𝒔𝒆𝒆𝒔 𝒎𝒆'” This scripture speaks about a woman named Hagar who felt abandoned by God in her time of pain until she saw the hand of God upon her situation. This scripture serves as a reminder that even in our lowest moments, God sees his people. We forget that as a child of God, nothing can happen to us outside of God’s control. We naturally start to panic and maybe even blame God for being unfaithful towards us. The truth is, when we feel like God does not see us or notice our struggles, that is when He is closest to us.In every season whether you feel seen or forgotten remember this truth: You are never out of God’s sight. He sees your struggles, your quiet prayers, and even the battles you don’t put into words. Nothing about your life is hidden from Him, and nothing you go through is meaningless. When the world overlooks you, God is still watching with care, guiding your steps, and holding you close. Rest in this assurance: You are fully seen, deeply known, and never forgotten by Him.Even in the silence, His presence surrounds you. Every tear you shed is noticed; every burden is understood. He is working in ways you cannot yet see. What feels hidden now is never hidden from Him. Trust that His eyes are on you and His plans for you are still unfolding!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank You for opening my heart to Your Word and reminding me that You are the God who sees me. Even in moments when I feel forgotten, overwhelmed, or alone, help me to remember that Your eyes are always upon me. Teach me not to measure Your presence by my circumstances, but to trust that You are near in every season of my life!”#GodWhoSeesMe #GodSeesYou #NeverForgotten #GodIsWithYou #TrustGod #GodsPresence #FaithInGod #DailyDevotional #BibleVerse #Genesis1613

title: REFUSE TO BE DISTRACTED
text: As a Christian, you are in a spiritual walk with the Lord. And in your spiritual walk with the Lord, you will face both good and hard times alike. As a child of God, your hard times are as good as your good times because there is no real evil in it—it is actually for the glory of God. As recorded in the first two chapters of the Book of Job, we see a child of God facing hard times; the ignorant people around him assumed that he was being punished for his sins. Knowing that God was working on him, putting him through a test, Job remained positive and hopeful, knowing it was going to be only a brief stop on the way to his destination. Job did not sin against God; rather, he asserted the fact that there is a time for everything. He understood that God often allows some adverse situations so that He can take us to the next level because He loves us.Indeed, just as God oftentimes grants in wrath, He also sometimes denies in love. If God would gratify all our desires, it would soon appear that we merely desire fame and authority without being willing to taste of Christ’s cup or have His baptism. No doubt, God loves us and will only give His children what is good for them. Joseph had to pass through the dry pit to slavery at Potiphar’s house and then to the prison and from the prison to the throne. These stopping intervals prepared him for the challenges ahead. Every successful teacher was once a student. We Christians enjoy the opportunity to be coaches to others.When people of God adopt a lifestyle that is based on purpose, they enrich the lives of others by leaving positive imprints on them. When you are able to expand this philosophy to a wider vision, your purpose or vision will crystallize. People of God, if you focus only on making money, a large slice of life will pass you by because money is just a small slice of life. Money cannot give us joy, peace, comfort, or eternal life; only Jesus can. The blessings of the world enrich the body temporarily, but the blessings of Christ enrich the soul for eternity.As Christians, we are commanded to follow these tiny steps of faith with patience in Christ Jesus, for there is no shortcut to spiritual maturity. When you are in haste to achieve something in life, you are bound to make costly mistakes that will pull you back, if not down. In order not to end up like the majority out there, who are merely wandering and unsure of their goals and dreams, you must set clear objectives. When your vision is clear, your life will have meaning. In order to live life to the fullest, you must have goals that reflect your purpose. When your purpose is in the forefront of your mind, nothing can affect it because it is a sacred place.People of God, what is your mere stopping interval? Is it sickness, poverty, or disappointment? The way you handle it matters. In order to turn hard times into good times, you must always stay true to your purpose in life, come rain or shine. Why are stopping intervals important in the life of a Christian? It is because they help us discover where we have missed the mark to redirect our focus towards God’s will, to help us assess our progress, to take our proper position in Christ, and to prepare us for the challenges ahead. People of God, stay focused and refuse to be distracted, for those who bless God in their trials will be blessed by God through their trials.Prayer: O Holy Spirit, help me to stay true to my purpose as You continue to give me the faith and patience to overcome every trial that is distracting me from running the heavenly race. In Jesus Christ’s name, I pray. Amen.

title: GREAT FAITH STARTS SMALL!
text: In a world that celebrates big achievements and instant success, God often works in a completely different way — through small, consistent acts of obedience. Many believers wait for a “big moment” to prove their faith, but spiritual growth is built in the quiet, daily decisions no one else sees.Joshua did not become a great leader overnight. His strength was not only in courage but in his steady obedience to God’s instructions. Step by step, day by day, he followed faithfully — even when the tasks seemed small or ordinary. This is why God’s command to him was so clear and powerful. As it is written in 𝐉𝐨𝐬𝐡𝐮𝐚 𝟏:𝟕 “𝑩𝒆 𝒔𝒕𝒓𝒐𝒏𝒈 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚 𝒄𝒐𝒖𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆𝒐𝒖𝒔. 𝑩𝒆 𝒄𝒂𝒓𝒆𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒕𝒐 𝒐𝒃𝒆𝒚 𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒍𝒂𝒘 𝒎𝒚 𝒔𝒆𝒓𝒗𝒂𝒏𝒕 𝑴𝒐𝒔𝒆𝒔 𝒈𝒂𝒗𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖; 𝒅𝒐 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒕𝒖𝒓𝒏 𝒇𝒓𝒐𝒎 𝒊𝒕 𝒕𝒐 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒓𝒊𝒈𝒉𝒕 𝒐𝒓 𝒕𝒐 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒍𝒆𝒇𝒕, 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒕 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒎𝒂𝒚 𝒃𝒆 𝒔𝒖𝒄𝒄𝒆𝒔𝒔𝒇𝒖𝒍 𝒘𝒉𝒆𝒓𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒈𝒐.”This verse reveals something important: “Joshua’s consistency and obedience to God’s instruction are a challenge to all Christians today, especially the busy elites of the http://www.com.” Success in God’s eyes is deeply connected to obedience — not partial, but consistent. Every time you choose obedience — even when it feels insignificant — you are building something eternal. You are shaping your character, strengthening your faith, and aligning your life with God’s will. Small obedience leads to big impact.So don’t underestimate the power of small beginnings. Keep praying. Keep trusting. Keep obeying. Because in God’s hands, small steps become great testimonies.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank You for teaching me that even the smallest act of obedience matters. Help me to stay consistent and faithful in my daily walk with You. Give me the strength to follow Your Word, even in the little things. Shape my heart to trust You step by step. May my life reflect obedience that honors You in all I do. In Jesus’ name, Amen!”#SmallSteps #BigFaith #DailyObedience #ChristianGrowth #Growth #SpiritualGrowth #DailyDevotion

title: LET GOD!
text: In a world that encourages us to take charge of every situation, letting go can feel uncomfortable. We often believe that if we can control our circumstances, we can protect ourselves from disappointment and uncertainty, yet God’s Word teaches a different path. He invites us to bring our burdens, fears, and unanswered questions to Him, trusting that He cares for us more than we can imagine.People associate control with freedom, but true freedom is found in surrendering all to Jesus Christ, as true humility means total dependence on God for everything. Surrendering is the recognition that His wisdom is greater than our understanding and His plans are better than our own. The Bible teaches us in 𝟏 𝐏𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝟓:𝟔-𝟕, to: “𝐇𝐮𝐦𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬, 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞, 𝐮𝐧𝐝𝐞𝐫 𝐆𝐨𝐝’𝐬 𝐦𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐲 𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐝, 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐇𝐞 𝐦𝐚𝐲 𝐥𝐢𝐟𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮 𝐮𝐩 𝐢𝐧 𝐝𝐮𝐞 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞. 𝐂𝐚𝐬𝐭 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐱𝐢𝐞𝐭𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐇𝐢𝐦 𝐛𝐞𝐜𝐚𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐇𝐞 𝐜𝐚𝐫𝐞𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐲𝐨𝐮”.The people of God are called to something deeper, to live by what God says, not merely by what they see or hear. When we release our grip on circumstances and place them in God’s hands, we make room for His peace, guidance, and power to work in our lives. God never intended for us to carry the weight of life’s uncertainties alone. He calls us to trust Him completely, not just with what we understand but also with what we cannot explain. Surrendering is not giving up; it is giving over. It is choosing to place our confidence in God’s wisdom, power, and timing rather than our own limited understanding.Today, let us choose trust over worry and faith over control. Let us lay our concerns before the Lord and be rest assured that He is in charge. What we surrender to God is never lost; it is placed in the hands of the One who knows the end from the beginning. As we humble ourselves before Him, may we discover the freedom, peace, and confidence that come from letting go and letting God!🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, help me surrender what I am still holding on to. Teach me that true humility is surrender and trust in you. Give me the grace to let go of control, trusting that you will take care of me, in Jesus’ mighty name I pray, amen”.  #SurrenderToGod #HumbleYourself #Humility #GodsWord #GodPlan #ChristianLifestyle #DailyDevotion #Prayer

title: The Benefits of Our Challenges
text:
Anything close to Jesus receives attack. And as we also know, life has two sides: positive and negative. The Bible encourages us to let our trials be of joy—“Consider it pure joy, my brothers and sisters, whenever you face trials of many kinds, because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance. Let perseverance finish its work so that you may be mature and complete, not lacking anything” (James 1:2-4).



As Christians, we may have challenges, but our challenges are not like those of others. Your challenge could be sickness or poverty. But you must understand that challenges are meant to strengthen our desire and determination for God. They are to improve us, not to impair us. The Bible urges us to watch and pray. This means we must discipline our heart before prayer. Many submit to panic even when they say they are Christians. We should be still and not submit to panic. True believers welcome adversities and challenges as friends. As a Christian, you may have affliction, challenges, but your challenges are not like others’, for there is value in challenges. You see that situation that looks impossible? I assure you there is value in it.



True believers must determine not to listen to the panic of the moment but to find the quiet voice of counsel and hear what the Holy Spirit has to say concerning the matter. That challenge may be to stop you awhile in order to prepare for a new level in life. Challenges are to connect you to the future you desire. When we listen to the Holy Spirit, He will guide us away from the pitfalls of every enemy. Continuously pray in the Holy Spirit and listen to His voice. He will not allow your daily challenges to overwhelm you.



The value in challenges is that they help us to explore possibilities and look deeper. You say you are a Christian; in reality, however, it is only when challenges come that we can know whether truly you are a Christian. As believers, we must understand that when times are stable and the sea is calm and secure, no one is really tested. The devil gets many to his side because of challenges. When you are facing challenges, the devil will ask where your God is.



Therefore, you must apply yourself to your work and duty as a Christian soldier. This means you must match your actions with your words if you want to succeed in life. Action is of the heart, and words are of the mouth. Now that you know your position when it comes to challenges, temptations, and troubles, you must begin to see the value in them. This is the only way you can be connected to the future you desire.



Prayer: Lord, release my spirit to follow You. I have surrendered everything to You. Give me the grace to overcome my pain, in Jesus’ name. Amen.

title: FROM WORRY TO WORSHIP!
text: We all face situations that can make us anxious. Unanswered questions, unexpected challenges, and concerns about the future can easily weigh down our hearts. Yet, God’s Word reminds us that worry is never the answer. As it mentions in 𝐏𝐡𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐩𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟒:𝟔-𝟕: “𝑫𝒐 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒃𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒙𝒊𝒐𝒖𝒔 𝒂𝒃𝒐𝒖𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒚𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒈, 𝒃𝒖𝒕 𝒊𝒏 𝒆𝒗𝒆𝒓𝒚 𝒔𝒊𝒕𝒖𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏, 𝒃𝒚 𝒑𝒓𝒂𝒚𝒆𝒓 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒑𝒆𝒕𝒊𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏, 𝒘𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒕𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒌𝒔𝒈𝒊𝒗𝒊𝒏𝒈, 𝒑𝒓𝒆𝒔𝒆𝒏𝒕 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒓𝒆𝒒𝒖𝒆𝒔𝒕𝒔 𝒕𝒐 𝑮𝒐𝒅. 𝑨𝒏𝒅 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒑𝒆𝒂𝒄𝒆 𝒐𝒇 𝑮𝒐𝒅, 𝒘𝒉𝒊𝒄𝒉 𝒕𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒔𝒄𝒆𝒏𝒅𝒔 𝒂𝒍𝒍 𝒖𝒏𝒅𝒆𝒓𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈, 𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒈𝒖𝒂𝒓𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒉𝒆𝒂𝒓𝒕𝒔 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒎𝒊𝒏𝒅𝒔 𝒊𝒏 𝑪𝒉𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒕 𝑱𝒆𝒔𝒖𝒔.”𝑾𝒉𝒆𝒏 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒘𝒐𝒓𝒓𝒚 𝒂𝒃𝒐𝒖𝒕 𝒕𝒐𝒎𝒐𝒓𝒓𝒐𝒘, 𝒚𝒐𝒖 𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒑𝒑𝒍𝒆 𝒚𝒐𝒖𝒓 𝒂𝒃𝒊𝒍𝒊𝒕𝒚 𝒕𝒐 𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒌, 𝒂𝒄𝒕 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒆𝒙𝒆𝒓𝒄𝒊𝒔𝒆 𝒇𝒂𝒊𝒕𝒉 𝒊𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒑𝒓𝒆𝒔𝒆𝒏𝒕. Worry drains your spirit, but worship refocuses it. When you shift your attention from your problems to God’s promises, anxiety begins to lose its grip and peace takes its place. No situation is too difficult for God, and no burden is too heavy for Him to carry.Instead of dwelling on what you cannot control, lift your heart in worship and trust the One who holds your future in His hands. Worship is more than singing songs—it is choosing to focus on God’s goodness, faithfulness, and power despite your circumstances.As you focus on God’s faithfulness, your perspective changes. Your faith grows stronger, fear loses its voice, and your heart finds rest in His presence. Remember, God already knows your needs before you ask, and He is working behind the scenes for your good.🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank You for Your love, care, and faithfulness. Fill my heart with Your peace and help me to trust You in every situation. Turn my fears into faith and my anxiety into worship. Remind me that You are in control and that Your plans for me are good, in  Jesus’ name, amen!”#TrustInHim #GodsPeace #PrayerChangesThings #Worship #PraiseGod #Prayer #Thanksgiving #GiveThanks

title: NEW WINE
text: PROOF TEXT: 2 Corinthians 4:8–9“We are hard pressed on every side, but not crushed; perplexed, but not in despair; persecuted, but not abandoned; struck down, but not destroyed.”In the making of wine, grapes are pressed in order to bring out what is most important: the wine. In the same way, as Christians, we are constantly faced with different kinds of trials that test our faith.These trials may press us on every side, yet we are not destroyed. We may be persecuted, but we are not abandoned. As we share in Christ’s suffering, we bear on our bodies the marks of Christ.Remember, Christ faced persecution — name-calling, slanderous remarks. He was flogged, spat on and pierced. All that He faced at the hands of His perpetrators was necessary for His victory on the Cross.How we choose to handle our trials matters. If we become discouraged, we hand the victory over to the enemy.Our trials and tests only draw us closer to our victory. They are indicators that we are being prepared for something new — something more.God allows trials and tests to strengthen our faith, prepare us for a new level in life, and strip us of our pride, arrogance and self-sufficiency.Trials and tests will crush you, just like grapes are crushed to produce wine, but not for your destruction; it is for the glory of God.Men of faith such as Job, Joseph, Apostle Paul and even Prophet T.B. Joshua faced trials and tests. How they handled their trials determined their results.If they had given up or become discouraged, they may not have been remembered for their faith today. However, they did not give up. They remained in faith in Christ Jesus, and the rest is history.People of God, the Bible continues to offer us encouragement in times of adversity. Its words are true; if only we will take God at His Word and remain in faith.PRAYER:Lord Jesus, thank You for the gift of trials and tests. Help me to trust You in my trials. Give me the grace to remain in faith and keep pressing forward. In Jesus’ name I pray. Amen.

title: PURPOSE OVER PRAISE!
text:
If we were to be asked how much influence external factors like social media, our jobs, or the opinion of others have on us, you will most likely say ‘‘none” or “not much at all’’. The truth would be that we are influenced much more than we are willing to admit by these external factors in our lives. The approval and opinions of others seem to make us think they can fill some sort of void, but it can only be filled by God.



Being praised by people naturally feeds man’s pride, that is why it is so addictive. But, in 𝐆𝐚𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐧𝐬 𝟏:𝟏𝟎 we read: “𝑨𝒎 𝑰 𝒏𝒐𝒘 𝒕𝒓𝒚𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒕𝒐 𝒘𝒊𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒂𝒑𝒑𝒓𝒐𝒗𝒂𝒍 𝒐𝒇 𝒉𝒖𝒎𝒂𝒏 𝒃𝒆𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔, 𝒐𝒓 𝒐𝒇 𝑮𝒐𝒅? 𝑶𝒓 𝒂𝒎 𝑰 𝒕𝒓𝒚𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒕𝒐 𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒔𝒆 𝒑𝒆𝒐𝒑𝒍𝒆? 𝑰𝒇 𝑰 𝒘𝒆𝒓𝒆 𝒔𝒕𝒊𝒍𝒍 𝒕𝒓𝒚𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒕𝒐 𝒑𝒍𝒆𝒂𝒔𝒆 𝒑𝒆𝒐𝒑𝒍𝒆, 𝑰 𝒘𝒐𝒖𝒍𝒅 𝒏𝒐𝒕 𝒃𝒆 𝒂 𝒔𝒆𝒓𝒗𝒂𝒏𝒕 𝒐𝒇 𝑪𝒉𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒕”. Therefore, we either serve Jesus Christ or the world. We were created to make an impact, not to seek people’s approval. Living for the praise of other people will never lead to growth because seasons change, and so do people, but God never does. He is the only constant in life and the only one who will love every version of you and not change how He feels towards you, because when God sees you, He sees something that everyone else ignores.



In a world obsessed with likes, followers, and public approval, it is easy to measure our worth by people’s reactions. But, what truly matters is not what others say about you, but what God Almighty says about you. God never created us to live for applause—He created us to live with purpose. Human praise is temporary, but God’s calling is eternal. When we focus more on pleasing God than impressing people, we begin to walk in true freedom and confidence, and we will experience true peace and joy. Therefore, do not let the noise of this world define your identity. Your value is found in Christ, and your purpose is greater than any platform, trend, or algorithm. Live not for attention, but for assignment. Choose purpose over popularity and let your life reflect the One who called you for something greater.



🙏𝐏𝐫𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫: “Heavenly Father, thank You for the constant reminder to serve You and no other. Help me live for impact and for Your glory. May I never become a victim of seeking others’ approval about my life. Help me be focused in a very distracting world. In Jesus’ mighty name I pray, Amen”.

title: GIVE YOUR HEART TO JESUS CHRIST
text: As Prophet T. B. Joshua taught us, it is important for us to hear God’s Word not only with our ears but also with our heart. Hearing God’s Word with your heart requires openness and hunger for God’s message. Allowing the Word in the midst of your heart means allowing it continuously, not occasionally. As Proverbs 4:23 urges us, we must keep our heart with all diligence, for out of the heart spring the issues of life.You may be concerned about many things already, but you need to be more diligent in keeping your heart. This is because it is from the well-kept heart that living issues flow, that is, good products for the glory of God and the edification of others. By all means, we must keep our hearts. We should consider keeping the heart from being defiled by sin and disturbed by trouble. The heart plays a significant role in our relationship with God—in our spiritual well-being. As Prophet T. B. Joshua taught us, managing the heart and its thoughts is important, necessary, and fundamental to our faith and holy living.The greatest thing God looks at and requires is the heart. Let us look at why David asked for a recreated heart and a right spirit. David knew that he had a serious heart problem, so he asked God for help. His greatest concern was for God to change his corrupt nature. He saw how unclean his heart was and lamented it. He realised that it was not in his own power to amend it, so he begged God, who has the prerogative over man’s heart, to give him a clean heart. Only He who made the heart can make it anew, and nothing is impossible for Him. In the words of Prophet T. B. Joshua, unless the heart is transformed, a person’s life can never be thoroughly reformed.Of a truth, Christianity lies in the heart; as such, we must lift up to God not only clean hands but also a pure heart. Our failure to give Christ His proper place in our heart is actually responsible for the crisis of our faith. The happiness of seeing God is promised to those—and only those—who are pure in heart. The heart must be purified by faith and be set aside entirely for God only. People of God, what the Almighty requires of us is a broken and contrite spirit, that is, a repentant and penitent spirit that is truly sorry for wrongdoing.You must acknowledge your weakness—I mean, your position as a sinner in need of cleansing. You have to invite God into your heart by meditation. Meditation on God’s Word is a visit with Him. When you take God’s Word into your heart, it will, by its very nature, change you. Right now, ask God to give you a heart that does not bear grudges, a heart that is pure and humble. If you come to God in humility and sincerity of heart, He will welcome you.Prayer: Lord Jesus, create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: Our STRUGGLE MAKES US STRONGER!
text: As a child of God, in this world you are bound to receive attack, rejection and hatred. However, you must not fear, for God can use any foolish thing to release you into your divine future. In Ecclesiastes 3:1-10, the Bible tells us that life is in three stages and that each stage serves a purpose. A man cannot discover new oceans if he doesn’t lose sight of the shore. As Christians, our values must be tested against facts and experiences. This is the only way we can identify those who are genuinely sincere in their relationship with God.Once our Lord Jesus Christ passed this test, the anointing began to flow. This shows that persecution is a tonic to the anointing. When you are persecuted for what you believe, count it all joy that your chance of victory is at hand. As Christians, we must not think suffering to be a strange thing. Right now, some of our best friends may be avoiding us, and it may seem there is no one to run to. But we must understand that Jesus Christ is our Refuge and Strength, a very present Help in trouble. God takes unlikely people and puts them into His palace for eternity.As believers, we are not here to get used to darkness, but we are here to shine as light. Have you been handed a divorce letter or a quit notice asking you to get out of your apartment? Don’t despair, for the end has not come! Listen: Your best has not come yet!Ask any successful person, and they will tell you how much rejection, disappointment and disagreement they had to endure in order to come to a new level in life. Come on, child of God! Stay strong in challenges as you trust that your personal improvement and fulfilment in life will come through the continual process of learning from both positive and negative experiences.As such, we must do everything to maintain our union with Him. Therefore, strengthen your desire for God to prepare you for the challenges ahead, to preserve you for redemption and to reform you in Christ. People will challenge you. People will question you. People will try to get you off track. However, you must resist the temptation to act out of character.When your motives are misjudged by people, do not be discouraged. Remember that our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ was constantly misjudged, but He refused to be discouraged, knowing that being misjudged is the last stage before supernatural promotion. The persecution we suffer at the hands of our detractors causes us to be known all over the world. Indeed, man’s rejection provokes God’s direction. When man rejects you, God will start to direct you. Leave it for God.PRAYER:Lord, I surrender every obstacle into Your hands and trust that You will make my path straight and make me stronger for You, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.

title: FOLLOW THE RIGHT PROCESS
text: God Almighty disciplines us as a way to reform us, strengthen our desire and determination, and prepare us for a new level in life. Today, everyone wants to be great, but not everyone wants to go through the right process. If you are in a hurry to achieve something, you are likely to make costly mistakes that will pull you back, if not down. If you ignore God’s process and focus only on the result, you may likely not have the patience to differentiate between God’s supply and satan’s bait.If the process you go through is not God’s process, you will not be able to maintain the result. However, if the process is God’s process, the result will stand the test of time. God is processing us now through the heat of trials so that by the time we get to the place of destiny, we would have become mature and disciplined enough to maintain it. Nothing good happens without discipline. If gold must be gold, it must pass through fire. You are a work of art. If you want to become God’s person, you must follow His process. Today, one of the reasons we ignore the process is because we imitate others. One of the reasons we are so impatient is because we compare ourselves to others.Becoming rich and influential without having the right character and undergoing the right process will amount to nothing in the end. God wants us to prosper in all areas of our lives. He does not want us to succeed financially by losing ourselves to conditions. It is in the mind of God to answer prayers; even when He seems not to respond immediately to our petition, He is still saying something. So, do not worry if you have not yet got the right results despite following the right process. Be assured that you are about to get the mother of results! Remember what the Bible says in Proverbs 16:9: “A man’s heart plans his way, but the LORD directs his steps.”Brethren, God is indeed preparing you for something greater than what you can presently see. All you need to do is to be patient. Soon, those laughing at you for your patience will testify about your result, just as it happened in the case of Sarah (Genesis 21:6), when she said, “God has made me laugh, and all who hear will laugh with me.” Because you wait patiently on God and follow His process, all those who hear about you will rejoice with you. Be it in your business, career, and health, they will rejoice with you, in Jesus’ name!People of God, make your plans, work hard, but always allow God to lead you.Prayer:O Holy Spirit, come and reform my character to follow You and strengthen my desire and determination for You, in Jesus Christ’s name. Amen.
